Query_Text_en: Study objective : To detect dynamic hyperinflation [ DH ] by evaluating reduction in inspiratory capacity [ IC ] during metronome-paced hyperventilation [ MPH ] in patients with moderate-to-severe COPD , studied before and after treatment with tiotropium .
Translation: 研究目的：通过评估中度至重度慢性阻塞性肺疾病（COPD）患者在节拍器控制下的过度通气（MPH）过程中吸气容量（IC）的减少，检测动态肺过度膨胀（DH），并在使用噻托溴铵治疗前后进行研究。

Query_Text_en: Patients were encouraged to maintain a constant tidal volume during MPH .
Translation: 鼓励患者在MPH过程中保持恒定的潮气量。

Query_Text_en: Results : At baseline , mean FEV1was 1.5 0.1 L [ SE ] [ 57 1.6 % of predicted ] , mean FVC was 2.6 0.1 L [ 77 1.8 % of predicted ] , and mean FEV1\/FVC was 56 1 % .
Translation: 结果：基线时，平均FEV1为1.5±0.1升（标准误），为预测值的57±1.6%；平均FVC为2.6±0.1升，为预测值的77±1.8%；平均FEV1/FVC为56±1%。

Query_Text_en: After 180 g of aerosolized albuterol sulfate , mean FEV1was 1.7 0.1 L [ 63 1.5 % of predicted ] [ p [ 0.001 ] and mean FEV1\/FVC was 58 1 % .
Translation: 吸入180克硫酸沙丁胺醇后，平均FEV1为1.7±0.1升（为预测值的63±1.5%，p＜0.001），平均FEV1/FVC为58±1%。

Query_Text_en: Compared to baseline , after 30 days and 1.5 h after tiotropium there was an increase in IC of 0.18 0.04 L [ p [ 0.0001 ] ; FEV1of 0.13 0.03 L [ 5.6 0.8 % of predicted ; p = 0.0002 ] ; FVC of 0.22 0.05 L [ 6.5 1.3 % of predicted ; p [ 0.001 ] ; and decrease in end-expiratory lung volume [ EELV ] \/ total lung capacity [ TLC ] of-3 .1 0.6 % [ p = 0.0001 ] ; a decrease in end-inspiratory lun ]
Translation: 与基线相比，经过30天并在吸入噻托溴铵后1.5小时，IC增加了0.18±0.04升（p＜0.0001）；FEV1增加了0.13±0.03升（为预测值的5.6±0.8%，p=0.0002）；FVC增加了0.22±0.05升（为预测值的6.5±1.3%，p＜0.001）；呼气末肺容积（EELV）/总肺容量（TLC）下降了-3.1±0.6%（p=0.0001）；吸气末肺容积也有所下降。

Query_Text_en: Results following MPH-induced DH at baseline and after 30 days of tiotropium were similar , with decreases in IC [ -0.35 0.03 L ; p [ 0.001 ] ; FEV1 [ -0.05 0.04 L ; p = 0.2 ] ; and FVC [ -0.22 0.03 L ; p [ 0.0001 ] ; no change in TLC ; and increases in EELV\/TLC [ 11.8 1.0 % of predicted ; p [ 0.0001 ] and EILV\/TLC [ 4.0 1.3 % of predicted , p [ 0.003 ] .
Translation: 在基线和使用噻托溴铵30天后，MPH诱导的动态肺过度充气（DH）结果相似，具体表现为：吸气量（IC）减少[-0.35±0.03 L，p<0.001]；用力呼气量第一秒（FEV1）减少[-0.05±0.04 L，p=0.2]；用力肺活量（FVC）减少[-0.22±0.03 L，p<0.0001]；肺总量（TLC）无变化；呼气末肺容积占肺总量百分比（EELV/TLC）增加[11.8±1.0%预测值，p<0.0001]；吸气末肺容积占肺总量百分比（EILV/TLC）增加[4.0±1.3%预测值，p=0.003]。

Query_Text_en: Conclusion : In patients with moderate-to-severe COPD , tiotropium did not reduce MPH-induced DH and reduction in IC , compared to baseline .
Translation: 结论：对于中重度慢性阻塞性肺疾病患者，噻托溴铵未能减少由MPH引起的动态过度充气和吸气容量的降低，与基线相比无显著改善。

Query_Text_en: However , because tiotropium induced bronchodilation and increased baseline IC , lower operational lung volumes may blunt the effect of MPH-induced DH .
Translation: 然而，由于噻托溴铵能够引起支气管扩张并增加基线吸气容量，较低的实际肺容量可能会削弱 MPH 所致的动态肺过度充气效应。

Query_Text_en: The noninvasive simplicity of MPH-induced DH provides a clinically useful screening surrogate to monitor changes in IC following treatment with tiotropium .
Translation: 由MPH诱导的DH具有无创且简便的特点，为临床提供了一种有用的筛查替代方法，可用于监测噻托溴铵治疗后IC的变化。

Query_Text_en: As previously noted , since FEV1may be a poor predictor of clinical symptoms , exercise tolerance , and response to bronchodilators in COPD , additional measures have been sought .
Translation: 如前所述，由于FEV1可能无法有效预测COPD患者的临床症状、运动耐受性以及对支气管扩张剂的反应，因此人们一直在寻求其他评估指标。

Query_Text_en: Alternatively , exercise testing using constant or incremental cycle ergometry with repeated measurements of inspiratory capacity [ IC ] has been used to detect dynamic hyperinflation [ DH ] and evaluate the response to bronchodilators .
Translation: 另一种方法是采用恒定或递增负荷的自行车测力计进行运动测试，并反复测量吸气容量（IC），以检测动态肺气肿（DH）并评估对支气管扩张剂的反应。

Query_Text_en: O'Donnell et al provided confirmatory evidence that Borg dyspneic ratings and measurements of inspiratory capacity [ IC ] and endurance time during submaximal cycle exercise testing are highly reproducible and responsive to changes in severe COPD .
Translation: O'Donnell等人提供了确证性证据，表明在亚最大强度自行车运动测试中，Borg呼吸困难评分以及吸气容量（IC）和耐力时间的测量在重度COPD患者中具有高度的可重复性，并能敏感反映病情变化。

Query_Text_en: We have emphasized that previous studies have demonstrated the utility of repeated measurements of IC during exercise to reflect changes in end-expiratory lung volume [ EELV ] since total lung capacity [ TLC ] remains constant after acute bronchodilation and during exercise .
Translation: 我们强调，已有研究表明，在运动过程中反复测量吸气能力（IC）对于反映呼气末肺容量（EELV）的变化具有重要意义，因为在急性支气管扩张后及运动过程中，总肺容量（TLC）保持不变。

Query_Text_en: Progressive reduction in IC during exercise reflects DH and is a good predictor of decreased exercise ability as well as increased exertional dyspnea .
Translation: 运动过程中IC逐步下降反映了动态过度充气，是预测运动能力下降和运动性呼吸困难加重的良好指标。

Query_Text_en: Additionally , peak values of inspiratory esophageal pressures used as a surrogate to estimate effort are relatively constant and correlated with breathing frequency at a given tidal volume during multiple measurements of exercise IC .
Translation: 此外，在多次运动肺活量（IC）测量中，用作评估呼吸努力的吸气食管压峰值在特定潮气量下相对恒定，并与呼吸频率相关。

Query_Text_en: Changes in IC reflect DH and are correlated with breathing frequency in COPD patients .
Translation: IC的变化反映了动态过度充气，并与COPD患者的呼吸频率相关。

Query_Text_en: We have suspected increasing breathing frequency would produce changes in IC similar to change in IC observed during exercise .
Translation: 我们曾怀疑，增加呼吸频率会导致IC发生类似于运动时观察到的变化。

Query_Text_en: We recently compared metronome-paced hyperventilation [ MPH ] , a relatively simple procedure , with incremental symptom-limited cycle ergometry to provoke respiratory rate-induced DH and reduction of IC in patients with moderate-to-severe COPD and reported similar changes in IC .
Translation: 我们最近将节拍器引导下的过度通气（MPH），这一相对简单的操作方法，与递增负荷、症状限制的自行车测力试验进行了比较，用以诱发中重度COPD患者因呼吸频率增加导致的动态肺过度充气（DH）和吸气量（IC）下降，并报告了两种方法在IC变化方面具有相似的结果。

Query_Text_en: We also reported 54 g of inhaled ipratropium bromide failed to blunt the decrease in IC .
Translation: 我们还报告称，吸入54微克异丙托溴铵未能抑制IC的下降。

Query_Text_en: O'Donnell et al showed greater bronchodilation with much larger doses of nebulized ipratropium bromide [ 500 g ] when compared to usual doses of inhaled albuterol sulfate in patients with COPD .
Translation: O'Donnell等人研究发现，在COPD患者中，雾化异丙托溴铵（500微克）的大剂量相比常规剂量的吸入硫酸沙丁胺醇，能够产生更显著的支气管扩张效果。

Query_Text_en: In a subsequent study , using constant cycle ergometry , O'Donnell et al reported that 18 g of tiotropium in patients with moderate-to-severe COPD improved IC , exercise endurance , and exertional dyspnea .
Translation: 在后续的一项研究中，O'Donnell等人采用恒定周期的功率自行车测试，报告称在中至重度慢性阻塞性肺疾病患者中，18克噻托溴铵能够改善吸气量、运动耐力和运动性呼吸困难。

Query_Text_en: The present study evaluates the role of tiotropium in MPH-induced DH in patients with moderate-to-severe COPD .
Translation: 本研究评估了噻托溴铵在中重度慢性阻塞性肺疾病患者中甲基苯丙胺诱发动态肺过度充气中的作用。

Query_Text_en: At baseline , all COPD patients were tiotropium naive [ 80 % of patients ] or had a 30-day washout time [ 20 % of patients ] .
Translation: 在基线时，所有COPD患者均为初次使用噻托溴铵（占患者的80%），或已完成30天的洗脱期（占患者的20%）。

Query_Text_en: We selected 60 patients with a smoking history20 pack-years and documented moderate-to-severe COPD who were clinically stable for at least 6 weeks prior to the present study and were not receiving oxygen .
Translation: 我们筛选了60名有吸烟史（20包年）且已确诊中重度慢性阻塞性肺疾病（COPD）的患者，这些患者在本研究开始前至少6周临床状况稳定，且未接受氧疗。

Query_Text_en: History of wheezing and\/or responsiveness to aerosolized albuterol were not specific inclusion or exclusion criteria .
Translation: 有喘息史和/或对雾化吸入沙丁胺醇有反应并不是特定的纳入或排除标准。

Query_Text_en: Patients were instructed to continue all their usual medications but to withhold short-acting 2-agonists and\/or aerosolized ipratropium bromide for 6 h and long-acting 2-agonists for 48 h prior to testing .
Translation: 患者被指导继续服用他们所有常用的药物，但在测试前需停用短效β2激动剂和/或雾化异丙托溴铵6小时，以及停用长效β2激动剂48小时。

Query_Text_en: After obtaining informed patient consent and approval from the Institutional Review Board from each participating site , patients underwent lung function studies before and after 180 g of aerosolized albuterol sulfate using techniques and predictive values previously described in detail .
Translation: 在获得患者知情同意并经各参与机构伦理委员会批准后，患者在吸入180克雾化硫酸沙丁胺醇前后，按照既往详细描述的方法和预测值进行肺功能检测。

Query_Text_en: We used a spirometer [ Vmax29 ; SensorMedics ; Yorba Linda , CA ] and pressure-compensated flow plethysmograph [ model 6200 ; SensorMedics ] .
Translation: 我们使用了肺活量计（Vmax29，SensorMedics，美国加利福尼亚州约巴林达）和压力补偿流量体积描记仪（型号6200，SensorMedics）。

Query_Text_en: The goal was to achieve a respiratory rate twice the baseline rate for 20 s , which was immediately followed by sequential measurement of IC , expiratory spirometry , and within 30 s plethysmographic measured functional residual capacity .
Translation: 目标是在20秒内将呼吸频率提高到基线的两倍，随后立即依次测量吸气量、呼气肺活量，并在30秒内通过体积描记法测量功能残气量。

Query_Text_en: While no attempt was made to control end-tidal carbon dioxide , patients were coached to maintain a respiratory rate synchronous with the metronome .
Translation: 虽然未对呼气末二氧化碳进行控制，但患者被指导以节拍器的节奏保持呼吸频率同步。

Query_Text_en: however , no attempt was made to blunt any increase in ventilation synchronous with the metronome .
Translation: 然而，并未采取任何措施来抑制与节拍器同步的通气量增加。

Query_Text_en: Patients were studied before [ baseline ] and after 30 days of 18 g of tiotropium .
Translation: 患者在基线前和服用18克噻托溴铵30天后接受了研究。

Query_Text_en: Technicians who performed these studies were blinded as to patient medication [ s ] .
Translation: 进行这些研究的技术人员对患者所用药物情况不知情。

Query_Text_en: The technique for measuring IC has been previously described .
Translation: 该测量IC的技术已在此前进行了详细描述。

Query_Text_en: Repeated-measures analysis of variance was used for lung function results obtained before and after tiotropium intervention .
Translation: 对吸入噻托溴铵干预前后获得的肺功能结果采用重复测量方差分析法进行统计。

Query_Text_en: For the 60 patients with MPH , models with time [ day 0 and day 30 ] [ baseline and after hyperventilation ] were tested .
Translation: 针对这60名患有MPH的患者，研究测试了包含时间因素（第0天和第30天）以及状态因素（基线和过度通气后）的模型。

Query_Text_en: Pairwise tests were performed using the Tukey adjustment method for post hocmultiple comparisons for intervention .
Translation: 针对干预措施，采用Tukey调整法进行了事后多重比较的成对检验。

Query_Text_en: Results are presented as mean SE .
Translation: 结果以均值 ± 标准误表示。

Query_Text_en: Analysis was done using a statistical software package [ SAS 8.02 for Windows ; SAS Institute ; Cary , NC ] .
Translation: 分析采用统计软件包[SAS 8.02 for Windows；SAS Institute；Cary，NC]进行。

Query_Text_en: Statistical significance was p [ 0.05 .
Translation: 统计显著性为 p < 0.05。

Query_Text_en: We studied 60 COPD patients [ 28 men ; mean age , 66 10 years [ SD ] ] with a smoking history of 53 37 pack-years .
Translation: 我们对60例慢性阻塞性肺疾病（COPD）患者进行了研究，其中男性28例，平均年龄为66±10岁（标准差），吸烟史为53±37包年。

Query_Text_en: Thirty patients were studied in Lakewood and 30 patients were studied in Toronto , and there were no significant site differences in age , gender , and smoking history .
Translation: 在莱克伍德和多伦多各有30名患者参与了研究，两地在年龄、性别和吸烟史方面无显著差异。

Query_Text_en: At baseline , routine lung function findings were similar in patients from the two sites [ combined data are described in Table 1 ] and are consistent with moderate-to-severe COPD .
Translation: 基线时，来自两个中心患者的常规肺功能检测结果相似（合并数据见表1），且均符合中重度COPD的特征。

Query_Text_en: Following 180 g of aerosolized albuterol sulfate , FEV1 increased 14 12 % .
Translation: 吸入180微克硫酸沙丁胺醇气雾剂后，FEV1提高了14.12%。

Query_Text_en: After 18 g\/d of inhaled tiotropium for 30 days , the changes in lung function results at 1 h predose [ trough ] and 1.5 h after tiotropium appear in Table 2 and Figure 1 .
Translation: 在吸入噻托溴铵18微克/天持续30天后，吸药前1小时（谷值）和吸药后1.5小时的肺功能变化结果见表2和图1。

Query_Text_en: There was significant persistent bron-chodilation at trough compared to baseline but significantly less magnitude than at 1.5 h after tiotropium [ Table 2 ] .
Translation: 与基线相比，吸入末期出现了显著且持续的支气管扩张，但其幅度明显低于吸入噻托溴铵后1.5小时的效果［见表2］。

Query_Text_en: Compared to the baseline IC of 2.15 0.09 L , IC increased 0.09 0.03 L [ p = 0.0001 ] at trough , and 0.18 0.04 L [ p [ 0.0001 ] at 1.5 h after dose .
Compared to the baseline FEV1of 1.5 0.06 L , FEV1increased 0.08 0.03 L [ p = 0.004 ] at trough and 0.13 0.03 L [ p = 0.0002 ] at 1.5 h after dose [ Table 2 ; Fig 1 ] .
No significant changes were noted in TLC .
Translation: TLC未见显著变化。

Query_Text_en: Following MPH , there was a significant decrease in FEV1and IC at baseline as reported in Table 3 and Figure 2 .
Translation: 如表3和图2所示，MPH后，基线时的FEV1和IC均显著下降。

Query_Text_en: Resting FEV1was 1.37 0.07 L ; after 20 s of MPH , FEV1was 1.30 0.06 L [ p = 0.005 ] .
Translation: 静息状态下的FEV1为1.37±0.07升；经过20秒的MPH后，FEV1降至1.30±0.06升（p=0.005）。

Query_Text_en: There was no change in TLC .
Translation: TLC未发生变化。

Query_Text_en: The magnitude of the decrease in IC correlated modestly with decrease in tidal volume during MPH [ Spearman = 0.453 , = 0.0003 ] .
Translation: IC的减少幅度与MPH期间潮气量的减少呈中等相关（斯皮尔曼相关系数=0.453，P=0.0003）。

Query_Text_en: However , the decrease in FEV1was not significant [ Table 3 ; Fig 2 ] .
Translation: 然而，FEV1的下降并不显著［见表3，图2］。

Query_Text_en: The present study in 60 COPD patients with moderate-to-severe expiratory airflow limitation demonstrated the provocative ability of MPH at twice the resting respiratory rate for 20 s to induce DH with a significant decrease in IC .
Translation: 本研究在60例中至重度呼气气流受限的COPD患者中表明，以静息呼吸频率两倍、持续20秒的快呼（MPH）具有诱发动态肺过度充气（DH）的能力，并导致吸气容量（IC）显著下降。

Query_Text_en: There was a similar decrease in IC following MPH-induced DH at baseline when compared to 30 days of inhaled tiotropium , 18 g.
Translation: 与吸入18克噻托溴铵30天相比，基线时经甲基苯丙胺诱导的动态过度充气后，肺容量也出现了类似的下降。

Query_Text_en: However , tiotropium was a potent bronchodilator , and the resultant increase in IC and decrease in operational EELV and end-inspiratory lung volume [ EILV ] from baseline helped blunt the subsequent challenge of MPH-induced DH .
Translation: 然而，噻托溴铵是一种强效支气管扩张剂，其引起的吸气能力（IC）增加以及操作性呼气末肺容量（EELV）和吸气末肺容量（EILV）较基线水平的降低，有助于减轻随后由MPH诱发的动态肺过度充气（DH）反应。

Query_Text_en: The noninvasive simplicity of hyperventilation at a respiratory rate of 30 breaths\/min for 20 s provided a clinically useful screening surrogate to incremental or constant cycle ergometry to monitor changes in IC following exercise and to study the effect of tiotropium on DH .
Translation: 以每分钟30次呼吸频率进行20秒的过度通气，其无创且简便的特点，为监测运动后吸气量（IC）变化以及研究噻托溴铵对动态肺过度充气（DH）影响，提供了一种临床上有用的筛查替代方法，可替代递增或恒定功率的自行车测力计测试。

Query_Text_en: The present results are consistent with our previous observations .
Translation: 目前的结果与我们此前的观察一致。

Query_Text_en: We reported close agreement using Bland and Altman method , indicating MPH was more sensitive than incremental cycle ergometry to detect a decrease in IC both before and after aerosolized inhaled ipratropium bromide , 54 g.
Translation: 我们采用Bland和Altman方法报告了高度一致性，表明MPH在检测IC下降方面比递增自行车测功仪更为敏感，无论是在吸入气雾化异丙托溴铵（54克）前后。

Query_Text_en: In normal subjects during exercise , minute ventilation increases primarily as a result of increased tidal volume rather than increased respiratory rate .
Translation: 在正常人群中，运动时每分钟通气量的增加主要是由于潮气量的增大，而不是呼吸频率的增加。

Query_Text_en: In contrast , when COPD patients with at least moderately severe expiratory airflow limitation and increased EELV undergo symptom-limited exercise , we1and others have noted the increase in respiratory rate to approximately double the baseline value was primarily responsible for increased minute ventilation .
Translation: 相比之下，当慢性阻塞性肺疾病（COPD）患者存在至少中度严重的呼气气流受限和呼气末肺容量（EELV）升高，在进行症状受限的运动时，我们和其他研究者注意到，呼吸频率增加至约为基础值的两倍，是导致分钟通气量增加的主要原因。

Query_Text_en: Not surprisingly , O ' Donnell and Webb reported respiratory frequency strongly correlated with Borg dyspnea scores and DH strongly correlated with breathlessness during exercise in COPD .
Translation: 奥唐奈尔和韦布的研究结果显示，呼吸频率与Borg呼吸困难评分呈强相关，动态肺过度充气与慢阻肺患者运动时的呼吸困难也高度相关。

Query_Text_en: It has been previously reported in COPD patients following acute bronchodilation , even after exercise , that a decrease in EELV is associated with an improvement in breathlessness symptom score .
Translation: 已有研究报告显示，在慢性阻塞性肺疾病（COPD）患者急性支气管扩张后，即使在运动后，呼气末肺容量（EELV）的下降与呼吸困难症状评分的改善相关。

Query_Text_en: but since the starting point for EELV is lower after acute bronchodilation , the peak is also lower when the same load is reached .
Translation: 但由于急性支气管扩张后EELV的起点较低，当达到相同负荷时，其峰值也较低。

Query_Text_en: A similar phenomenon occurs with EILV .
Translation: EILV也出现了类似的现象。

Query_Text_en: However , no interaction has been shown for the effect of bronchodilators on either EELV or EILV .
Translation: 然而，目前尚无证据表明支气管扩张剂对EELV或EILV有任何相互作用的影响。

Query_Text_en: The rationale to measure IC during exercise is that among all variables studied , changes in IC [ baseline and peak exercise ] not only showed good reproducibility but correlated best with changes in Borg dyspnea scale .
Translation: 在所有被研究的变量中，运动过程中测量吸气容量的依据在于，吸气容量的变化（包括基线和运动峰值）不仅具有良好的重复性，而且与博格呼吸困难评分的变化相关性最强。

Query_Text_en: In our previous study , the failure to achieve reduction in EELV and EILV or equivalent increase in IC after administration of 54 g of ipratropium bromide at all levels [ baseline and peak exercise and after hyperventilation ] is in contrast to results previously reported .
Translation: 在我们之前的研究中，无论是在基线、运动高峰还是过度通气后，给予54克异丙托溴铵后未能实现EELV和EILV的降低或IC的相应增加，这与此前报道的结果形成了鲜明对比。

Query_Text_en: However , 500 g of nebulized ipratropium bromide was used by O'Donnell et al , which is approximately 10 times the dose used in our initial study .
Translation: 然而，O'Donnell等人使用了500微克的雾化异丙托溴铵，这一剂量大约是我们初步研究中所用剂量的10倍。

Query_Text_en: In contrast to our initial study using 54 g of ipratropium bromide , the results in the present study following 18 g of tiotropium demonstrated significant increases in IC , FVC , and FEV1 , and decreases in EELV and EILV at 30-day trough and peak response time when compared to baseline values .
Translation: 与我们最初使用54克异丙托溴铵的研究相比，本研究在使用18克噻托溴铵后，结果显示在30天谷值和峰值反应时间点，与基线值相比，IC、FVC和FEV1均显著增加，EELV和EILV则显著降低。

Query_Text_en: It is important to compare our results before and after tiotropium intervention on MPH-induced DH with those previously reported by O'Donnell et al and Maltais et al using constant-load cycle ergometry .
Translation: 在对MPH诱导的动态过度充气进行噻托溴铵干预前后，比较我们的结果与O'Donnell等人和Maltais等人采用恒定负荷自行车测功仪所报告的结果具有重要意义。

Query_Text_en: In the present study , baseline [ mean SD ] FEV1was 1.5 0.1 L [ 55 11 % of predicted ] , compared to 1.3 0.5 L [ 41 12 % of predicted ] 10 and 1.2 0.4 L [ 43 13 % of predicted ] .
Translation: 在本研究中，基线[均值±标准差]FEV1为1.5±0.1升（占预测值的55±11%），相比之下，分别为1.3±0.5升（占预测值的41±12%）和1.2±0.4升（占预测值的43±13%）。

Query_Text_en: The mean increase in FEV1after 30 days plus 1.5 h of tiotropium in the present study was 130 mL , compared to 220 mL after 42 days plus 1.3 h and 260 mL after 42 days plus 1.3 h of tiotropium .
Translation: 本研究中，吸入噻托溴铵30天加1.5小时后，FEV1的平均增加量为130毫升，而在吸入噻托溴铵42天加1.3小时后，FEV1的平均增加量分别为220毫升和260毫升。

Query_Text_en: At similar time thresholds as above , in the current study , the mean increase in IC was 180 mL , compared to 250 mL and 220 mL .
Translation: 在与上述相似的时间节点下，本研究中IC的平均增加量为180毫升，而此前分别为250毫升和220毫升。

Query_Text_en: The decreased magnitude of these responses compared to previous studies may be related to initial less expiratory airflow limitation at baseline and incomplete wash - out of long-acting 2-agonists at 48 h.
Translation: 与以往研究相比，这些反应幅度的减小可能与基线时初始呼气气流受限程度较低，以及长效β2激动剂在48小时内未完全清除有关。

Query_Text_en: In the current study , the mean decrease in IC immediately following MPH was -370 mL at baseline and -350 mL following 1.5 h of tiotropium for 30 days .
Translation: 在本研究中，基线时吸入甲基苯丙胺后肺活量平均减少370毫升，连续使用噻托溴铵30天后1.5小时，平均减少350毫升。

Query_Text_en: This compares to a mean decrease in IC following constant-load ergometry of -450 mL at both baseline and following tiotropium and -410 mL vs -490 mL .
Translation: 相比之下，在恒定负荷功率测力计测试中，IC的平均下降值在基线和使用噻托溴铵后均为-450 mL，而两组分别为-410 mL和-490 mL。

Query_Text_en: In the above studies , the magnitude of decrease in IC following MPH-induced DH and constant-load ergometry was similar before and after tiotropium .
Translation: 在上述研究中，无论是在使用噻托溴铵前还是后，由于甲基苯丙胺诱导的动态过度充气和恒定负荷功率测试导致的吸气能力下降幅度都相似。

Query_Text_en: However , because of tiotropium induced bronchodilation and reduction in resting operational lung volumes both at rest and during exercise [ increased IC ] , patients noted improvement in exertional dyspnea and exercise endurance .
Translation: 然而，由于噻托溴铵引起的支气管扩张以及在静息和运动时静息操作性肺容量的减少（吸气量增加），患者在运动时的呼吸困难和运动耐力均有所改善。

Query_Text_en: These and other physiologic results support the observation of improved clinical outcomes in similar COPD patients receiving long-term tiotropium .
Translation: 这些及其他生理学结果支持了这样一个观察：在接受长期噻托溴铵治疗的类似COPD患者中，临床结局有所改善。

Query_Text_en: Attempts have been made to find simpler and less expensive tests to objectively assess exercise limitation and response to bronchodilator therapy .
Translation: 人们已尝试寻找更简单、成本更低的检测方法，以客观评估运动受限情况及对支气管扩张剂治疗的反应。

Query_Text_en: Marin et al showed that IC decreased , using a standard 6-min walk test , as with standard exercise testing among COPD patients .
Translation: Marin等人通过标准的6分钟步行测试发现，慢阻肺患者的吸气能力（IC）有所下降，这与常规运动测试的结果一致。

Query_Text_en: MPH at two times the resting breathing frequency is a simple maneuver that can be performed by almost any patient and can be done in any respiratory laboratory .
Translation: 以静息呼吸频率两倍进行的最大自主通气（MPH）是一项简单的操作，几乎所有患者都能完成，并且可以在任何呼吸实验室进行。

Query_Text_en: If the decrease in IC following MPH is as reproducible as that following exercise , it may be used as a screening surrogate for exercise-induced DH and to assess response to bronchodilators in COPD patients as in our present and previous study .
Translation: 如果MPH后IC的下降与运动后IC的下降一样具有可重复性，那么它可以作为运动诱发动态过度充气的筛查替代指标，并用于评估COPD患者对支气管扩张剂的反应，正如我们当前及以往的研究所示。

Query_Text_en: Normal age-matched control subjects in our previous study1did not decrease IC with exercise as do patients with COPD .
Translation: 在我们之前的研究中，正常年龄匹配的对照组在运动过程中并未像COPD患者那样出现吸气能力（IC）的下降。

Query_Text_en: Furthermore , since the extent of DH and decrease in IC with exercise is related to resting IC , hyperventilation testing should be provocative in COPD patients with moderate-to-severe expiratory airflow limitation .
Translation: 此外，由于运动时动态过度充气和吸气能力下降的程度与静息吸气能力有关，对于中到重度呼气气流受限的慢阻肺患者，通气过度测试应具有一定的激发性。

Query_Text_en: The response to 180 g of aerosolized albuterol sulfate by metered-dose inhaler was not considered an inclusion or exclusion criteria in the present study , and the mean [ SD ] increase in FEV1in liters was 14 12 % , and only 17 of 60 COPD patients were responders according to American Thoracic Society criteria .
Translation: 本研究未将对180微克定量吸入气雾剂硫酸沙丁胺醇的反应作为纳入或排除标准，受试者的FEV1（用升表示）平均[标准差]增加为14±12%，根据美国胸科协会的标准，60例COPD患者中仅有17例为反应者。

Query_Text_en: In a previous study , 16 of 29 COPD patients [ 55 % ] met the American Thoracic Society criteria for responders following 500 g of aerosolized ipratropium bromide , yet there was poor correlation with exercise endurance time .
Translation: 在一项先前的研究中，29名慢性阻塞性肺疾病患者中有16人（占55%）在吸入500微克异丙托溴铵后符合美国胸科学会对应答者的标准，但与运动耐力时间的相关性较差。

Query_Text_en: Lack of response or poor reproducibility of FEV1are among the reasons that prompted the search for other objective markers of abnormal lung function that correlate with symptoms and are responsive and reproducible in COPD patients .
Translation: FEV1缺乏反应性或重复性差，是促使人们寻找其他能够反映异常肺功能、与症状相关且在COPD患者中具有良好反应性和可重复性的客观指标的原因之一。

Query_Text_en: If confirmed by other investigators , we suspect the decrease in IC obtained during MPH at twice the resting respiratory rate for 20 s may be used as a screening surrogate for exercise testing in the evaluation and response to DH before and after aerosolized or systemic bronchodilator in COPD patients with mild-to-severe expiratory airflow limitation .
Translation: 如果其他研究者证实，我们认为，在COPD患者中，MPH期间以静息呼吸频率两倍进行20秒时获得的IC下降，可能作为运动测试的筛查替代指标，用于评估和判断气道动态过度膨胀（DH）在吸入或全身支气管扩张剂治疗前后的反应，适用于轻度至重度呼气气流受限的患者。

Query_Text_en: The goal of the present study was not to displace standardized cardiopulmonary testing with its inherent merits including quantification of exercise work performance , endurance time , and exertional dyspnea , but rather to simplify the detection of DH using MPH as a screening surrogate .
Translation: 本研究的目标并非取代具有诸多优势的标准化心肺测试，如运动工作表现、耐力时间和运动性呼吸困难的量化，而是希望通过以最大呼气压力作为筛查替代指标，简化动态肺过度充气的检测过程。

Query_Text_en: Context The decrease in overall death rates in the United States may mask changes in death rates from specific conditions .
Translation: 美国整体死亡率的下降可能掩盖了某些具体疾病死亡率的变化。

Query_Text_en: Objective To examine temporal trends in the age-standardized death rates and in the number of deaths from the 6 leading causes of death in the United States .
Translation: 目的：分析美国六大主要死因的年龄标准化死亡率及死亡人数的时间变化趋势。

Query_Text_en: Design and Setting Analyses of vital statistics data on mortality in the United States from 1970 to 2002 .
Translation:
设计与设置  
对1970年至2002年间美国死亡率生命统计数据进行分析。

Query_Text_en: Main Outcome Measure The age-standardized death rate and number of deaths [ coded as underlying cause ] from each of the 6 leading causes of death : heart disease , stroke , cancer , chronic obstructive pulmonary disease , accidents [ ie , related to transportation [ motor vehicle , other land vehicles , and water , air , and space ] and not related to transportation [ falls , fire , and accidental posioning ] ] , and diabetes mellitus .
Translation: 主要结局指标：按年龄标准化的死亡率及6种主要死因（作为根本死因编码）的死亡人数，包括心脏病、中风、癌症、慢性阻塞性肺病、意外事故（即与交通有关的事故［机动车、其他陆地交通工具、水上、航空及太空交通］和非交通相关事故［跌倒、火灾、意外中毒］）以及糖尿病。

Query_Text_en: Results The age-standardized death rate [ per 100 000 per year ] from all causes combined decreased from 1242 in 1970 to 845 in 2002 .
Translation: 结果显示，所有原因合并的年龄标准化死亡率（每10万人每年）从1970年的1242下降到2002年的845。

Query_Text_en: The largest percentage decreases were in death rates from stroke [ 63 % ] , heart disease [ 52 % ] , and accidents [ 41 % ] .
Translation: 死亡率降幅最大的是中风（63%）、心脏病（52%）和意外事故（41%）。

Query_Text_en: The largest absolute decreases in death rates were from heart disease [ 262 deaths per 100 000 ] , stroke [ 96 deaths per 100 000 ] , and accidents [ 26 deaths per 100 000 ] .
Translation: 死亡率绝对下降幅度最大的是心脏病（每10万人中262例）、中风（每10万人中96例）和意外事故（每10万人中26例）。

Query_Text_en: The death rate from all types of cancer combined increased between 1970 and 1990 and then decreased through 2002 , yielding a net decline of 2.7 % .
Translation: 1970年至1990年间，所有类型癌症的总死亡率有所上升，随后至2002年逐步下降，最终实现了2.7%的净降幅。

Query_Text_en: In contrast , death rates doubled from chronic obstructive pulmonary disease over the entire time interval and increased by 45 % for diabetes since 1987 .
Translation: 相比之下，在整个时间区间内，慢性阻塞性肺疾病的死亡率翻了一番，而自1987年以来，糖尿病的死亡率上升了45%。

Query_Text_en: Despite decreases in age-standardized death rates from 4 of the 6 leading causes of death , the absolute number of deaths from these conditions continues to increase , although these deaths occur at older ages .
Translation: 尽管六大主要死因中有四项的年龄标准化死亡率有所下降，但这些疾病的死亡总人数仍在增加，只是死亡发生在更高龄段。

Query_Text_en: These temporal trends have major implications for health care and health care costs in an aging population .
Translation: 这些时间趋势对老龄化人口的医疗服务和医疗成本具有重大影响。

Query_Text_en: however , the overall trend masks substantial variations in cause-specific rates and in the number of deaths occurring in different age groups from specific conditions .
Translation: 然而，总体趋势掩盖了不同病因死亡率以及各年龄组因特定疾病死亡人数的显著差异。

Query_Text_en: Understanding these trends and the relationship between the age-standardized death rates and the actual number of deaths that occur can provide valuable insight into the forces that shape the nation s health .
Translation: 理解这些趋势，以及年龄标准化死亡率与实际死亡人数之间的关系，有助于深入洞察影响国家健康状况的各种因素。

Query_Text_en: We examined trends in death rates and number of deaths from the 6 leading causes in the United States and considered the relationship of these trends to disease prevention and health care in an aging population .
Translation: 我们分析了美国六大主要死因的死亡率和死亡人数的变化趋势，并探讨了这些趋势与疾病预防及老龄化人口健康护理之间的关系。

Query_Text_en: Cause of death statistics in the United States are based on underlying cause of death .
Translation: 美国的死亡原因统计基于死亡的根本原因。

Query_Text_en: The underlying cause is defined as the disease or injury that initiated the sequence of events leading directly to death .
Translation: 根本原因被定义为引发一系列直接导致死亡事件的疾病或损伤。

Query_Text_en: It is selected from the conditions entered in the cause of death section on the death certificate by the certifying physician , coroner , or medical examiner based on the sequence of morbid events and coding rules specified by the International Classification of Diseases [ ICD ] .
Translation: 它是由认证医生、验尸官或医学检查员根据死亡证明上的死因栏所填写的情况，并依据国际疾病分类（ICD）规定的病理事件顺序和编码规则进行选择的。

Query_Text_en: Effective with data year 1968 , computer software has been used by the National Center for Health Statistics to determine the underlying cause of death from information on all causes [ multiple causes ] listed on the death certificate .
Translation: 自1968年起，国家卫生统计中心开始使用计算机软件，根据死亡证明上列出的所有死因（多重死因）信息，判定死亡的根本原因。

Query_Text_en: For mortality statistics in the interval 1970 through 2002 , underlying causes of death were classified according to the ICD-8 , ICD-9 , and ICD-10 coding and selection rules , with major causes of death grouped consistently across the ICD codes to facilitate evaluation of long-term trends .
Translation: 1970年至2002年间的死亡率统计数据中，死亡的根本原因按照ICD-8、ICD-9和ICD-10的编码及选择规则进行分类，并将主要死因在不同ICD编码下进行统一归类，以便于对长期趋势进行评估。

Query_Text_en: The ICD-10 codes used for the 6 leading causes of death were I00-I09 , I11 , I13 , and I20-I51 for heart disease ; C00-C97 for cancer ; I60-I69 for stroke [ cerebrovascular disease ] ; E10 - E14 for diabetes mellitus ; J40-J47 for chronic obstructive pulmonary disease [ COPD ] ; and V01-X59 and Y85-Y86 for accidents [ ie , related to transportation [ motor vehicle , other land vehicles , and water , air , and space ] and not related to transportation [ falls , fire , and accidental posioning ] ] .
Translation: 用于六大主要死亡原因的ICD-10编码分别为：心脏病为I00-I09、I11、I13和I20-I51；癌症为C00-C97；中风（脑血管疾病）为I60-I69；糖尿病为E10-E14；慢性阻塞性肺疾病（COPD）为J40-J47；事故为V01-X59和Y85-Y86（包括与交通有关的事故，如机动车、其他陆地交通工具以及水、空、太空交通事故，以及与交通无关的事故，如跌倒、火灾和意外中毒）。

Query_Text_en: The ICD-8 and the ICD-9 codes were 390-398 , 402 , 404 , and 410-429 for heart disease ; 430-438 for stroke ; 250 for diabetes mellitus ; and 800-949 for accidents .
Translation: ICD-8和ICD-9编码中，心脏病的代码为390-398、402、404和410-429；脑卒中的代码为430-438；糖尿病的代码为250；事故的代码为800-949。

Query_Text_en: For cancer , the ICD-8 codes were 140-207 and the ICD-9 codes were 140-208 , 238.6 .
For COPD , the ICD-8 codes were 490-493 and 519.3 and the ICD-9 codes were 490-496 .
Translation: 对于慢性阻塞性肺疾病（COPD），ICD-8编码为490-493和519.3，ICD-9编码为490-496。

Query_Text_en: We calculated the age-standardized death rates [ directly adjusted to the 2000 US standard population ] for all causes and the 6 leading causes of death using SEER \* Stat software , developed by the Surveillance , Epidemiology , and End Results program of the National Cancer Institute .
Translation: 我们使用SEER*Stat软件（由美国国家癌症研究所的监测、流行病学和最终结果项目开发）计算了所有死因及六大主要死因的年龄标准化死亡率［直接调整至2000年美国标准人口］。

Query_Text_en: When the 2002 death rate for a particular condition was lower than the 1970 rate , the contribution of this decrease to the overall decrease in all-cause death rates over the same time interval was expressed as a percentage .
Translation: 当某一疾病在2002年的死亡率低于1970年时，该死亡率下降对同期全因死亡率总体下降的贡献以百分比表示。

Query_Text_en: Trends in age-standardized death rates from 1970 through 2002 for each of these conditions were described using join-point regression analysis .
Translation: 1970年至2002年间，这些疾病的年龄标准化死亡率趋势采用断点回归分析方法进行了描述。

Query_Text_en: The join-point regression model fits a series of joined straight lines on a log scale to the trends in age-adjusted rates .
Translation: 结点回归模型在对数尺度上对年龄调整率的趋势拟合一系列相连的直线。

Query_Text_en: The terms increase or decrease were used when the slope [ co-efficient ] of the trend was statistically different from zero [ 2-sided P [ .05 ] ; otherwise , the terms stable or level were used .
Translation: 当趋势的斜率（系数）在统计学上显著异于零（双侧P值<0.05）时，使用“上升”或“下降”来描述；否则，使用“稳定”或“持平”来表述。

Query_Text_en: We also examined the leading causes of death in 2002 by age and temporal trends in age-specific death rates and number of deaths from heart disease and cancer for individuals aged 40 years or older by 10-year age intervals from 1970 to 2002 .
Translation: 我们还分析了2002年分年龄段的主要死亡原因，并考察了1970年至2002年间，40岁及以上人群按10岁年龄组划分的心脏病和癌症的年龄别死亡率及死亡人数的时间趋势。

Query_Text_en: Between 1970 and 2002 , the age-standardized death rate [ per 100 000 population ] from all causes combined decreased 32 % from 1242.2 to 844.6 based on the year 2000 age standard [ TABLE ] .
Translation: 根据2000年年龄标准，1970年至2002年间，所有原因的年龄标准化死亡率（每10万人）下降了32%，从1242.2降至844.6。

Query_Text_en: Among the 6 leading causes of death [ Table and FIGURE 1 ] , the largest percentage decreases during this interval were in the death rates from heart disease [ 52 % ] , cerebrovascular disease or stroke [ 63 % ] , and accidents [ 41 % ] .
Translation: 在六大主要死因中【见表格及图1】，在此期间，死亡率降幅最大的是心脏病（52%）、脑血管疾病或中风（63%）以及意外事故（41%）。

Query_Text_en: The absolute decrease was largest for heart disease [ 262 deaths per 100 000 ] followed by stroke [ 96 deaths per 100 000 ] , accidents [ 26 deaths per 100 000 ] , and cancer [ 5 deaths per 100 000 ] .
Translation: 绝对降幅最大的是心脏病（每10万人减少262例死亡），其次是中风（每10万人减少96例死亡）、意外事故（每10万人减少26例死亡）和癌症（每10万人减少5例死亡）。

Query_Text_en: The age-standardized death rate from all types of cancers combined first increased from 1970 to 1990 , and then decreased through 2002 , yielding a net decline of 2.7 % .
Translation: 1970年至1990年，所有类型癌症的年龄标准化死亡率先上升，随后至2002年呈下降趋势，整体净降幅为2.7%。

Query_Text_en: In contrast , death rates doubled since 1970 for COPD and increased by 45 % since 1987 for diabetes mellitus [ 3 % net increase from 1970 to 2002 ] .
Translation: 相比之下，自1970年以来，慢性阻塞性肺疾病的死亡率翻了一番，而自1987年以来，糖尿病的死亡率上升了45%（1970年至2002年净增长为3%）。

Query_Text_en: When examined by join-point regression analysis , the decrease in heart disease and cancer death rates continues , whereas the decrease in the mortality rates from stroke and accidents has slowed or stopped since the early 1990s .
Translation: 通过断点回归分析发现，心脏病和癌症的死亡率持续下降，而自20世纪90年代初以来，脑卒中和意外事故的死亡率下降趋势已减缓或停止。

Query_Text_en: In 2002 , the leading causes of death were heart disease among persons aged 75 years or older , cancer among persons aged 40 to 74 years , and accidents among persons younger than age 40 years [ FIGURE 2 ] .
Translation: 2002年，75岁及以上人群的主要死因是心脏病，40至74岁人群的主要死因是癌症，40岁以下人群的主要死因是意外事故［见图2］。

Query_Text_en: Analysis of temporal trends in age-specific death rates from heart disease and cancer shows that the decrease in the mortality rate from heart disease [ FIGURE 3 , top panel ] affects all age groups containing individuals aged 40 years or older throughout the entire time interval , whereas the decrease in age-specific death rates from all types of cancer begins later and becomes smaller in proportionate terms with increasing age [ Figure 3 , bottom panel ] .
Translation: 对心脏病和癌症年龄特异性死亡率的时间趋势分析显示，心脏病死亡率的下降[见图3，上方]在整个时间区间内影响了所有包含40岁及以上个体的年龄组，而所有类型癌症的年龄特异性死亡率下降则开始得较晚，且随着年龄增长，其比例性下降幅度逐渐减小[见图3，下方]。

Query_Text_en: A different perspective on the temporal trends in mortality from heart disease and cancer is provided by data on the number of deaths that occur from these conditions [ FIGURE 4 ] .
Translation: 关于心脏病和癌症死亡率的时间趋势，死亡人数的数据提供了另一种视角 [图4]。

Query_Text_en: Because of the aging and growth of the population , the number of deaths attributed to heart disease among persons aged 80 years or older [ Figure 4 , top panel ] increased 60 % from 1970 to 2002 , even though the age-standardized death rate decreased by 40 % in this age group over the same period [ Figure 3 , top panel ] .
Translation: 由于人口老龄化和增长，尽管同期该年龄组的年龄标准化死亡率下降了40% [见图3，上图]，但80岁及以上人群因心脏病导致的死亡人数 [见图4，上图] 在1970年至2002年间仍增加了60%。

Query_Text_en: Figure 4 also illustrates the influence of the baby boomer generation [ born after World War II ] as reflected in the pattern of deaths due to heart disease and cancer in individuals aged 50 to 59 years .
Translation: 图4还展示了“婴儿潮一代”（二战后出生）对50至59岁人群心脏病和癌症死亡模式的影响。

Query_Text_en: A large increase in the number of individuals in this age group began in approximately 1990 , resulting in an increase in the number of cancer deaths and flattening rather than decreasing the number of deaths from heart disease .
Translation: 自大约1990年起，该年龄组人口数量大幅增加，导致癌症死亡人数上升，心脏病死亡人数则呈现持平趋势，而非下降。

Query_Text_en: This article provides a concise overview of trends in both age-standardized death rates and numbers of deaths for the 6 leading causes of mortality in the United States from 1970 to 2002 , updating a similar analysis from 1950 to 1986 .
Translation: 本文简要概述了1970年至2002年美国六大主要死亡原因的年龄标准化死亡率及死亡人数的变化趋势，并对1950年至1986年期间的类似分析进行了更新。

Query_Text_en: These findings illustrate the substantial and continuing progress in reducing the age-standardized death rate from heart disease , the lack of continuing progress for stroke and accidents , and the increase in the age-standardized rates for COPD and diabetes .
Translation: 这些发现表明，心脏病的年龄标准化死亡率已取得显著且持续的下降进展，而中风和意外事故的死亡率则未见持续改善，慢性阻塞性肺病和糖尿病的年龄标准化死亡率则呈上升趋势。

Query_Text_en: The study also illustrates that the reduction in age-standardized death rates , the best measure of progress against diseases , is not synonomous with reducing the number of deaths from these conditions .
Translation: 研究还表明，年龄标准化死亡率的降低——这是衡量疾病防治进展的最佳指标——并不等同于相关疾病死亡人数的减少。

Query_Text_en: In fact , the number of deaths continues to increase because of population growth and aging .
Translation: 事实上，由于人口增长和老龄化，死亡人数仍在持续上升。

Query_Text_en: It is the number of individuals affected by various conditions rather than the age-standardized rate that influence the planning and allocation of preventive and medical services .
Translation: 在预防和医疗服务的规划与资源分配中，真正起作用的是受各种疾病影响的具体人数，而不是年龄标准化率。

Query_Text_en: Inaccuracies in death certificates and changes in classification of causes of death are potential limitations in the interpretation of mortality trends .
Translation: 死亡证明中的不准确性以及死亡原因分类的变化，可能会对死亡率趋势的解读构成一定限制。

Query_Text_en: However , our analyses are restricted to broad disease categories for which death certificate data are more accurate than for specific diseases .
Translation: 然而，我们的分析仅限于死亡证明数据较为准确的广泛疾病类别，而非具体疾病。

Query_Text_en: Although 2 revisions of the ICD have been implemented in the United States during the study period [ ICD-9 in 1979 and ICD-10 in 1999 ] , there was only 1 significant discontinuity in these broad disease categories .
Translation: 尽管在研究期间美国实施了两次ICD修订（1979年采用ICD-9，1999年采用ICD-10），这些广泛疾病分类中仅出现了一次显著的不连续性。

Query_Text_en: The ICD-8 codes developed by the World Health Organization did not have a code for COPD without mention of asthma , bronchitis , or emphysema .
Translation: 世界卫生组织制定的ICD-8编码中，并没有针对未提及哮喘、支气管炎或肺气肿的慢性阻塞性肺疾病（COPD）设立专门的编码。

Query_Text_en: However , in 1970 the National Center for Health Statistics introduced a code [ 519.3 ] , used in the United States , for this category of diseases , allowing comparability in classification of deaths due to COPD under ICD-8 , ICD-9 , and ICD-10 .
Translation: 然而，1970年，美国国家卫生统计中心引入了用于该类疾病的编码[519.3]，使得在ICD-8、ICD-9和ICD-10下因慢性阻塞性肺疾病（COPD）导致的死亡分类具有可比性。

Query_Text_en: The effect of the changes in ICD rules on the 6 leading causes of death described herein have been studied by calculating the comparability ratio based on the classification of 1 year s mortality data by both the new ICD codes and the previous ICD codes .
Translation: 通过采用新旧ICD编码对一年死亡数据进行分类，并计算可比性比率，研究了ICD规则变化对本文所述六大主要死因的影响。

Query_Text_en: All comparability ratios [ the total number of deaths due to a specific cause under the new revision divided by the total number of deaths under the previous revision ] for the cause of death categories described were between 0.99 and 1.06 .
Translation: 所述死因类别的所有可比率［即新修订版下某一特定死因的死亡总数除以前一修订版下的死亡总数］均介于0.99至1.06之间。

Query_Text_en: Several important insights are suggested by these temporal trends in the death rates and number of deaths at various ages .
Translation: 这些死亡率和不同年龄段死亡人数的时间趋势揭示了若干重要见解。

Query_Text_en: First , the decrease in the age - standardized death rate for 4 of the 6 leading causes of death in the United States represents progress toward one of the fundamental goals of disease prevention by extending the number of years of potentially healthy life .
Translation: 首先，美国六大主要死因中有四种的年龄标准化死亡率下降，这表明在延长潜在健康寿命年限这一疾病预防的基本目标上取得了进展。

Query_Text_en: This progress has been greater for heart disease and for accidental deaths than for cancer , yet even for cancer the age-standardized death rate has been decreasing by 1.1 % per year since 1993 .
Translation: 在心脏病和意外死亡方面，这一进展比癌症更为显著，但即便是癌症，自1993年以来，按年龄标准化的死亡率每年也在以1.1%的速度下降。

Query_Text_en: Less favorable developments are the slowing of the decline in age - standardized mortality rates from stroke and accidents since the early 1990s , and the increase in death rates from COPD and diabetes .
Translation: 不利的情况包括自20世纪90年代初以来，脑卒中和事故的年龄标准化死亡率下降速度放缓，以及慢性阻塞性肺疾病和糖尿病死亡率的上升。

Query_Text_en: Several other countries have reported similar slowdowns in the decrease in stroke mortality ; this is striking in the face of a continuing decrease in age-standardized mortality from heart disease .
Translation: 其他一些国家也报告了类似的脑卒中死亡率下降速度放缓的情况；这一现象尤为显著，因为心脏病的年龄标准化死亡率仍在持续下降。

Query_Text_en: Analyses that differentiate subgroups of stroke mortality suggest that an increase in hemorrhagic [ nonthrombotic , nonembolic ] stroke may be partly offsetting a continuing decrease in thrombotic stroke .
Translation: 对脑卒中死亡率不同亚组的分析表明，出血性（非血栓性、非栓塞性）脑卒中的增加，可能在一定程度上抵消了血栓性脑卒中持续下降的趋势。

Query_Text_en: A likely explanation for this is increased use of aspirin and other antithrombotic agents .
Translation: 对此的一个可能解释是阿司匹林及其他抗血栓药物的使用增加。

Query_Text_en: The reduction in the death rate from accidents from 1970 through the early 1990s coincided with implementation of a 55 - mph speed limit during the first energy crisis in the 1970s and mandated use of seat belts in most states beginning in 1984 .
Translation: 1970年至20世纪90年代初，事故死亡率的下降，正值20世纪70年代第一次能源危机期间实施55英里限速，以及自1984年起大多数州强制使用安全带的时期。

Query_Text_en: The recent flattening of the accident mortality rate coincides with the relaxation of the maximum interstate speed limits since 1987 .
Translation: 自1987年以来，最高州际公路限速的放宽，恰逢事故死亡率趋于平稳。

Query_Text_en: The biphasic trend in cancer mortality rates reflects both the impact of the tobacco epidemic on tobacco-related cancers through 1990 , followed by reduction in cancer mortality through tobacco control and advances in early detection , in treatment , or in both .
Translation: 癌症死亡率的双相变化趋势反映了两个方面的影响：一是1990年前烟草流行对与烟草相关癌症的影响，二是随后通过控烟措施以及早期筛查和治疗等方面的进步带来的癌症死亡率下降。

Query_Text_en: The increase in COPD death rates results largely from the long-term effects of tobacco smoking in an aging population , whereas the increase in diabetes mortality since the late 1980s reflects dramatic increases in obesity .
Translation: 慢性阻塞性肺疾病（COPD）死亡率的上升主要归因于老龄化人群中长期吸烟的影响，而自20世纪80年代末以来糖尿病死亡率的上升则反映了肥胖率的显著增加。

Query_Text_en: A consequence of the large decrease in cardiovascular death rates , combined with the high birth rates that immediately followed World War II , is the growing importance of health and health care needs in an aging population .
Translation: 心血管疾病死亡率大幅下降与二战后婴儿潮时期高出生率相叠加，导致人口老龄化进程中健康及医疗需求日益凸显。

Query_Text_en: While improved detection and treatment for chronic diseases has resulted in declining mortality rates , it has also increased the prevalence of treated disease and an associated increase in health care expenditures .
Translation: 虽然对慢性疾病的检测和治疗水平有所提升，导致死亡率下降，但也使接受治疗的疾病患病率上升，并带来了医疗支出相应增加。

Query_Text_en: Context Early mechanical revascularization in patients with acute myocardial infarction [ AMI ] complicated by cardiogenic shock is a therapeutic strategy that reduces mortality .
Translation: 在急性心肌梗死（AMI）并发心源性休克的患者中，早期机械性血运重建是一种能够降低死亡率的治疗策略。

Query_Text_en: It has been a class I recommendation in guidelines from the American College of Cardiology and the American Heart Association since 1999 for patients younger than 75 years .
Translation: 自1999年以来，美国心脏病学会和美国心脏协会的指南一直将其作为针对75岁以下患者的一级推荐。

Query_Text_en: However , little is known about implementation of these guidelines in practice .
Translation: 然而，关于这些指南在实际中的落实情况，了解甚少。

Query_Text_en: Objectives To assess trends in early revascularization and mortality for patients with cardiogenic shock complicating AMI and to determine whether the national guidelines affect revascularization rates .
Translation: 目的：评估因心源性休克并发急性心肌梗死（AMI）患者的早期血运重建和死亡率趋势，并确定国家指南是否影响血运重建率。

Query_Text_en: Design , Setting , and Patients Prospective , observational study of 293 633 patients with ST-elevation myocardial infarction [ 25 311 [ 8.6 % ] had cardiogenic shock ; 7356 [ 29 % ] had cardiogenic shock at hospital presentation ] enrolled in the National Registry of Myocardial Infarction [ NRMI ] from January 1995 to May 2004 at 775 US hospitals with revascularization capability [ defined as the capability to perform cardiac catheterization , percutaneous coronary intervention [ PCI ] , and open-heart surgery ] .
Translation: 研究设计、场所与患者：本研究为前瞻性观察性研究，共纳入293,633例ST段抬高型心肌梗死患者（其中25,311例[8.6%]发生心源性休克，7,356例[29%]在入院时即出现心源性休克），所有患者均登记于美国心肌梗死国家登记数据库（NRMI）。研究时间为1995年1月至2004年5月，涉及美国775家具备血管再通能力的医院（血管再通能力定义为能够开展心脏导管检查、经皮冠状动脉介入治疗[PCI]及心脏外科手术）。

Query_Text_en: Main Outcome Measures Management patterns and in-hospital mortality rates .
Translation: 主要结局指标为管理模式和住院期间死亡率。

Query_Text_en: Results There was an increase in primary PCI rates from 27.4 % to 54.4 % [ P [ .001 ] in hospitals with revascularization capability that paralleled the change in PCI for ST-elevation myocardial infarction .
Translation: 结果显示，在具备血运重建能力的医院，初级经皮冠状动脉介入治疗（PCI）率从27.4%上升至54.4% [P <.001]，这一变化与ST段抬高型心肌梗死（STEMI）患者PCI率的变化趋势一致。

Query_Text_en: There was no significant change in rates of immediate coronary artery bypass graft surgery [ from 2.1 % to 3.2 % ] .
Translation: 即刻冠状动脉搭桥手术的发生率无显著变化（由2.1%上升至3.2%）。

Query_Text_en: Propensity-adjusted multivariable analyses demonstrated that primary PCI was associated with a decreased odds of death during hospitalization [ odds ratio , 0.46 ; 95 % confidence interval , 0.40-0 .53 ] .
Translation: 倾向性调整多变量分析显示，初级经皮冠状动脉介入治疗（PCI）与住院期间死亡风险降低相关（比值比为0.46，95%置信区间为0.40-0.53）。

Query_Text_en: There were no differences in the rates of change in revascularization rates based on the date when the guidelines were released regardless of patient age .
Translation: 无论患者年龄如何，根据指南发布的时间，血运重建率的变化速度均无显著差异。

Query_Text_en: Overall in-hospital cardiogenic shock mortality decreased from 60.3 % in 1995 to 47.9 % in 2004 [ P [ .001 ] .
Translation: 总体来看，住院期间因心源性休克导致的死亡率从1995年的60.3%下降至2004年的47.9%（P <.001）。

Query_Text_en: Conclusions The use of PCI for patients with cardiogenic shock was associated with improved survival in a large group of hospitals with revascularization capability .
Translation: 结论 在具备血运重建能力的大型医院中，对心源性休克患者采用经皮冠状动脉介入治疗（PCI）与生存率的提高相关。

Query_Text_en: The American College of Cardiology and American Heart Association guidelines had no detectable temporal impact on revascularization rates .
Translation: 美国心脏病学会和美国心脏协会的指南对血管再通率没有明显的时间影响。

Query_Text_en: These findings support the need for increased adherence to these guidelines .
Translation: 这些发现表明，有必要进一步加强对这些指南的遵循。

Query_Text_en: Cardiogenic shock remains the leading cause of death in patients hospitalized with acute myocardial infarction The SHOCK randomized trial demonstrated that in patients with AMI complicated by cardiogenic shock , early mechanical revascularization reduced 6 - and 12-month mortality compared with initial medical stabilization [ including intra-aortic balloon pump [ IABP ] counterpulsation and fibrinolytic therapy ] followed by late or no revascularization .
Translation: 心源性休克仍然是急性心肌梗死住院患者的主要死亡原因。SHOCK随机对照试验显示，对于合并心源性休克的急性心肌梗死患者，早期机械性血运重建可降低6个月和12个月的死亡率，相较于初始药物稳定治疗（包括主动脉内球囊反搏和溶栓治疗）后延迟或不进行血运重建。

Query_Text_en: There was a significant interaction between treatment and age , with apparent lack of benefit of early revascularization for the small subset of patients aged 75 years or older .
Translation: 治疗方式与年龄之间存在显著的交互作用，对于年龄在75岁及以上的少数患者，早期血管再通治疗似乎并无明显益处。

Query_Text_en: Based on these findings , the American College of Cardiology [ ACC ] and the American Heart Association [ AHA ] elevated early mechanical revascularization for cardiogenic shock to a class I recommendation for patients younger than 75 years with ST-elevation left bundle-branch block AMI in their revised guidelines for the management of AMI published in September 1999 .
Translation: 基于这些研究结果，美国心脏病学会（ACC）和美国心脏协会（AHA）在1999年9月发布的《急性心肌梗死管理修订指南》中，将对75岁以下伴有ST段抬高型左束支传导阻滞急性心肌梗死患者实施早期机械血运重建，提升为I类推荐，用于治疗心源性休克。

Query_Text_en: Evidence-based guidelines hold considerable promise for continued improvement of health care delivery .
Translation: 循证指南对于持续提升医疗服务水平具有巨大潜力。

Query_Text_en: However , the availability of clinical practice guidelines does not automatically lead to changes in practice .
Translation: 然而，临床实践指南的发布并不必然带来实践的改变。

Query_Text_en: Its use in recipients of intravenous fibrinolytic therapy 9 years later was 66.9 % .
Translation: 9年后，静脉溶栓治疗患者的使用率为66.9%。

Query_Text_en: Several recent studies have also reported that quality of care for patients with AMI was far from optimal , and compliance with guidelines from the ACC and the AHA was not satisfactory .
Translation: 近期多项研究也指出，急性心肌梗死患者的医疗质量远未达到最佳水平，对美国心脏病学会和美国心脏协会指南的遵循情况亦不理想。

Query_Text_en: The National Registry of Myocardial Infarction [ NRMI ] is a national data-base that has tracked practice patterns and outcomes of patients with AMI in the United States since 1990 .
Translation: 美国心肌梗死国家登记数据库（NRMI）自1990年以来，一直跟踪记录美国急性心肌梗死患者的诊疗模式和治疗结果。

Query_Text_en: We used the NRMI database to determine trends in the use of early mechanical revascularization for patients with AMI complicated by cardiogenic shock , and the relationship between mortality and the use of these procedures overall and among those younger or older than the cut point of 75 years specified in the guidelines from the ACC and the AHA .
Translation: 我们利用NRMI数据库分析了早期机械血运重建在合并心源性休克的急性心肌梗死患者中的应用趋势，以及总体和按照ACC与AHA指南规定的75岁年龄分界点分组后，这些治疗方式与患者死亡率之间的关系。

Query_Text_en: We also sought to determine the impact of the new guidelines on revascularization rates in patients with AMI complicated by cardiogenic shock managed in a non-protocol-directed clinical setting .
Translation: 我们还旨在评估在非规范化临床管理环境下，新指南对合并心源性休克的急性心肌梗死患者血运重建率的影响。

Query_Text_en: The NRMI is a series of 5 industry-sponsored , prospective , observational studies of patients hospitalized with AMI throughout the United States .
Translation: NRMI是一项由行业资助的系列研究，包括5项前瞻性观察性研究，针对美国各地因急性心肌梗死住院的患者进行调查。

Query_Text_en: The data collection process and quality-control features of the NRMI have been described .
Translation: NRMI 的数据收集流程及质量控制措施已有相关描述。

Query_Text_en: Participation in the registry is voluntary .
Translation: 参与该登记是自愿的。

Query_Text_en: Registry hospitals tend to be larger than nonparticipating hospitals , are more likely to be certified by the Joint Commission on Accreditation of Healthcare Organizations , are more likely to be affiliated with a medical school , and are more likely to have available facilities for cardiac catheterization , coronary percutaneous coronary intervention [ PCI ] , and cardiac surgery .
Translation: 登记医院通常规模较非参与医院更大，更有可能获得美国医疗机构认证联合委员会的认证，更有可能与医学院附属，并且更有可能配备心脏导管插入、冠状动脉经皮介入治疗（PCI）及心脏外科手术等相关设施。

Query_Text_en: To be included in the NRMI , patients must have had a documented AMI according to local hospital criteria such as history , serial cardiac markers , and electrocardiographic findings .
Translation: 被纳入NRMI的患者，必须根据当地医院的标准，如病史、连续心脏标志物检测及心电图结果，有明确记录的急性心肌梗死（AMI）诊断。

Query_Text_en: Concomitant medications , invasive procedures , transfer status , and adverse events are recorded if they occur at any time during hospitalization .
Translation: 如在住院期间发生，需记录合用药物、侵入性操作、转诊情况及不良事件。

Query_Text_en: Participating hospitals are encouraged to enter consecutive patients with AMI irrespective of treatment strategy and outcome .
Translation: 鼓励参与医院连续录入所有急性心肌梗死患者，无论其治疗方案和结果如何。

Query_Text_en: A total of 293 633 nontransfer patients admitted with ST-elevation or left bundle-branch block AMI to a prospectively selected cohort of 775 hospitals with revascularization capability-defined as the capability to perform cardiac catheterization , PCI , and open-heart surgery were extracted from the 1.97 million AMI patients reported to the NRMI-2 , NRMI-3 , and NRMI-4 registries from June 1994 through May 2004 .
Translation: 在1994年6月至2004年5月期间，NRMI-2、NRMI-3和NRMI-4登记系统共报告了197万例急性心肌梗死（AMI）患者。从中筛选出293,633例非转诊、因ST段抬高或左束支传导阻滞型AMI入院的患者，这些患者均被纳入前瞻性选择的、具备血运重建能力（即能够进行心脏导管检查、经皮冠状动脉介入治疗和心脏直视手术）的775家医院队列。

Query_Text_en: Of the 293 633 ST-elevation myocardial infarction [ STEMI ] patients , 25 311 [ 8.6 % ] were diagnosed with cardiogenic shock .
Translation: 在293,633例ST段抬高型心肌梗死（STEMI）患者中，有25,311例（占8.6%）被诊断为心源性休克。

Query_Text_en: Twenty-nine percent of these patients had shock at presentation [ n = 7356 ] and 71 % [ n = 17 955 ] subsequently developed cardiogenic shock during hospitalization in 656 hospitals during the 10-year study period .
Translation: 在为期十年的研究期间，656家医院中有29%的患者在入院时即出现休克（n = 7356），而71%（n = 17,955）的患者在住院期间随后发生了心源性休克。

Query_Text_en: We analyzed trends over time in baseline characteristics as well as management patterns , and in-hospital mortality rates in both STEMI patients and cardiogenic shock patients .
Translation: 我们分析了STEMI患者和心源性休克患者的基线特征、治疗模式以及住院期间死亡率的时间变化趋势。

Query_Text_en: A subset of hospitals were evaluated to determine whether the trends demonstrated for all hospitals were similar in this subset of core hospitals that consistently reported cardiogenic shock patients in the registry .
Translation: 对部分医院进行了评估，以确定在该核心医院子集——即持续向登记册报告心源性休克患者的医院中，所呈现的趋势是否与所有医院的整体趋势一致。

Query_Text_en: Inclusion criteria for this core set of hospitals required that each hospital report at least 10 cardiogenic shock patients over the reporting life of NRMI-2 , NRMI-3 , and NRMI-4 , with at least one of the cardiogenic shock cases discharged in each year of the 10-year analysis .
Translation: 该核心医院组的纳入标准要求，每家医院在NRMI-2、NRMI-3和NRMI-4的报告周期内，至少报告10例心源性休克患者，并且在10年分析期间的每一年，至少有一例心源性休克病例出院。

Query_Text_en: We performed separate analyses for patients younger than 75 years and 75 years or older as well as for study hospitals and core hospitals .
Translation: 我们分别对年龄小于75岁的患者和年龄在75岁及以上的患者，以及研究医院和核心医院进行了单独分析。

Query_Text_en: This study was deemed exempt from review by the institutional review board at New York University .
Translation: 本研究经纽约大学机构审查委员会认定为免于审查。

Query_Text_en: For continuous data , linear regression analysis was used to test whether the slope of the regression or trend differed significantly from zero , and whether it differed before and after a specified date .
Translation: 对于连续性数据，采用线性回归分析检验回归斜率或趋势是否显著偏离零，以及在指定日期前后是否存在显著差异。

Query_Text_en: Considering all possible bimonthly cutoff dates , linear and multivariable regression techniques were used to model the proportion of procedure use and to test whether the slope after the cutoff date was statistically different from the slope before the cutoff date separately for cardiogenic shock patients younger than 75 years and aged 75 years or older .
Translation: 考虑到所有可能的双月截止日期，研究采用了线性和多变量回归技术，对操作使用比例进行了建模，并分别针对小于75岁的心源性休克患者和75岁及以上的患者，检验了截止日期之后的斜率是否与截止日期之前的斜率在统计学上存在显著差异。

Query_Text_en: The period showing the strongest effect in the patients younger than 75 years was then used to examine rate changes in the populations , including core hospitals and all STEMI patients .
Translation: 随后，研究人员选取对75岁以下患者影响最显著的时间段，进一步分析包括核心医院及所有STEMI患者在内的人群发病率变化。

Query_Text_en: We also specifically considered the periods before and after the publication of the guidelines from the ACC and the AHA in September 1999 .
Translation: 我们还特别考虑了1999年9月美国心脏病学会（ACC）和美国心脏协会（AHA）发布指南前后的时期。

Query_Text_en: The association between primary PCI use and mortality is well established even after adjusting for confounders ; however , selection bias relating to procedure use can obscure this finding .
Translation: 即使在调整混杂因素后，初级经皮冠状动脉介入治疗（PCI）与死亡率之间的关联已被充分证实；然而，关于该治疗方式选择的偏倚可能会掩盖这一结果。

Query_Text_en: Therefore , propensity scores were calculated using logistic regression for patients who received primary PCI and for those patients who did not receive primary PCI to identify patients who shared similar clinical and demographic characteristics .
Translation: 因此，采用逻辑回归方法计算了接受初级经皮冠状动脉介入治疗（PCI）和未接受初级PCI患者的倾向评分，以识别具有相似临床和人口学特征的患者。

Query_Text_en: Independent variables were included in a forward logistic regression model and were used to model primary PCI as the dependent variable .
Translation: 自变量被纳入前向逻辑回归模型，并用于以初级经皮冠状动脉介入治疗（PCI）为因变量的建模分析。

Query_Text_en: The clinically relevant variables considered important in matching on patient characteristics between the 2 patient groups were demographics [ patient age , sex , race , weight , payer ] , medical history [ MI , angina , congestive heart failure , coronary artery bypass graft [ CABG ] surgery , stroke , diabetes , hypertension , current smoker , hypercholesterolemia , prior PCI ] , and clinical presentation [ prehospital delay , chest pain , pulse , anterior MI , and year of discharge ] .
Translation: 在两组患者特征匹配时，临床相关的重要变量包括人口学特征（患者年龄、性别、种族、体重、付款方式）、病史（心肌梗死、心绞痛、充血性心力衰竭、冠状动脉搭桥术、卒中、糖尿病、高血压、当前吸烟者、高胆固醇血症、既往经皮冠状动脉介入治疗）以及临床表现（院前延迟、胸痛、脉搏、前壁心肌梗死和出院年份）。

Query_Text_en: The hospital characteristics of teaching hospital , annualized primary PCI volume , and US region also were considered to be important in generating the propensity score .
Translation: 教学医院、年度初级经皮冠状动脉介入（PCI）手术量以及美国地区等医院特征，也被认为是在生成倾向评分时的重要因素。

Query_Text_en: Using in-hospital mortality as the dependent variable , logistic regression models were constructed using successive blocks of relevant predictor fields .
Translation: 以住院死亡率为因变量，采用逐步纳入相关预测变量的方式构建了逻辑回归模型。

Query_Text_en: Primary PCI use was incorporated first into the model , followed by demographics [ patient age , sex , race , weight , and payer ] , medical history [ MI , angina , congestive heart failure , CABG surgery , stroke , diabetes , hypertension , current smoker , hypercholesterolemia , and prior PCI ] , clinical presentation [ prehospital delay , chest pain , pulse , anterior MI , year of discharge , and treatment factors [ IABP and immediate CABG surgery ] ] , and propensity score .
Translation: 模型首先纳入了初始经皮冠状动脉介入治疗（PCI）的使用情况，随后依次加入人口学特征（患者年龄、性别、种族、体重及支付方式）、既往病史（心肌梗死、心绞痛、充血性心力衰竭、冠状动脉搭桥术、卒中、糖尿病、高血压、当前吸烟者、高胆固醇血症及既往PCI）、临床表现（院前延误、胸痛、脉搏、前壁心肌梗死、出院年份）以及治疗因素（主动脉内球囊反搏和即时冠状动脉搭桥术），最后纳入倾向评分。

Query_Text_en: The adjusted odds ratios [ AORs ] and their 95 % confidence intervals [ CIs ] were used to relate mortality to primary PCI by using successive blocks of predictors .
Translation: 通过采用逐步纳入预测变量的方法，利用校正后的比值比（AOR）及其95%置信区间（CI）分析了死亡率与初始经皮冠状动脉介入治疗（PCI）之间的关系。

Query_Text_en: To assess if any improvement in mortality occurred during the 10-year period , the 95 % CIs and their AORs were generated and examined for the years 1995 through 2003 , with reference to 2004 .
Translation: 为评估在这十年间死亡率是否有所改善，以2004年为参照，计算并分析了1995年至2003年各年的95%置信区间及其调整后比值比（AOR）。

Query_Text_en: An AOR was considered statistically significant if its 95 % CI did not include 1.0 .
Translation: 如果95%置信区间未包含1.0，则该比值比被认为具有统计学意义。

Query_Text_en: All statistical analyses were performed using SAS software version 8.2 [ SAS Institute Inc , Cary , NC ] .
Translation: 所有统计分析均使用SAS软件8.2版本（SAS Institute Inc，Cary，NC）进行。

Query_Text_en: All P values use 2-tailed tests of significance ; P = .05 was considered significant .
Translation: 所有P值均采用双侧显著性检验；P = 0.05被视为具有统计学意义。

Query_Text_en: The rate of total shock [ cardiogenic shock at presentation and\/or clinical event shock , which was diagnosed after admission ] in patients in the STEMI population [ n = 293 633 ] was 8.6 % [ n = 25 311 ] .
Translation: 在STEMI人群（n = 293,633）中，发生总休克（包括入院时的心源性休克和/或入院后诊断的临床事件性休克）的比例为8.6%（n = 25,311）。

Query_Text_en: Approximately 29 % [ n = 7356 ] of total shock patients presented with cardiogenic shock , and the remaining 71 % [ n = 17 955 ] with total shock experienced shock only later during their stay [ FIGURE 1 ] .
Translation: 约29%（n = 7356）的休克患者在入院时即表现为心源性休克，其余71%（n = 17 955）的休克患者则在住院期间后期才出现休克症状［见图1］。

Query_Text_en: Patients younger than 75 years had cardiogenic shock at presentation less often [ 2.3 % ] than patients aged 75 years or older [ 3.1 % ] .
Translation: 75岁以下患者在初诊时出现心源性休克的比例较低（2.3%），而75岁及以上患者的比例为3.1%。

Query_Text_en: There was a slight but statistically significant upward trend in rates over time for those younger than 75 years [ P [ .001 ] but not for those aged 75 years or older [ P = .14 ] .
Translation: 对于75岁以下人群，随着时间推移，发生率呈现轻微但具有统计学意义的上升趋势（P <.001）；而对于75岁及以上人群，则未见显著变化（P =.14）。

Query_Text_en: Demographics and clinical characteristics of the 7356 patients with cardiogenic shock at presentation appear in TABLE 1 .
Translation: 7356例初诊为心源性休克患者的人口学及临床特征见表1。

Query_Text_en: There were no differences over time in history of diabetes mellitus , congestive heart failure , stroke , and prior CABG surgery .
Translation: 在糖尿病、充血性心力衰竭、中风及既往冠状动脉搭桥手术史方面，随时间推移未见差异。

Query_Text_en: There were fewer patients in recent years with history of MI , but more patients with prior PCI , hypertension , and dyslipidemia .
Translation: 近年来，既往有心肌梗死病史的患者减少，但既往接受经皮冠状动脉介入治疗、患有高血压和血脂异常的患者增多。

Query_Text_en: Mean age and the proportion of women de - creased over time .
Translation: 平均年龄和女性比例随着时间的推移有所下降。

Query_Text_en: Time-related differences for several variables were statistically significant but small .
Translation: 多个变量的时间相关差异在统计学上虽显著，但幅度较小。

Query_Text_en: We evaluated rates of fibrinolytic therapy , IABP , diagnostic cardiac catheterization , PCI [ total and primary ] , and CABG surgery [ immediate and total ] .
Translation: 我们评估了溶栓治疗、主动脉内球囊反搏（IABP）、诊断性心脏导管检查、经皮冠状动脉介入治疗（包括总量和急诊）、以及冠状动脉搭桥手术（包括即时和总量）的实施率。

Query_Text_en: There was an increase in the rate of cardiac catheterization [ from 51.5 % to 74.4 % ] , no change in IABP use [ 39.2 % ] , and a reduction in the rates of fibrinolytic therapy [ from 19.9 % to 5.6 % ] .
Translation: 心脏导管插入术的比例有所上升（从51.5%增至74.4%），主动脉内球囊反搏（IABP）的使用率保持不变（39.2%），而溶栓治疗的比例则有所下降（从19.9%降至5.6%）。

Query_Text_en: We found an increase in rates of primary PCI [ from 27.4 % to 54.4 % ] and total PCI [ from 34.3 % to 64.1 % ] , a decrease in overall CABG surgery rates [ from 11.5 % to 8.8 % ] , and no significant change in immediate CABG surgery rates [ FIGURE 2 ] .
Translation: 我们发现，初次经皮冠状动脉介入治疗（PCI）率由27.4%上升至54.4%，总PCI率由34.3%上升至64.1%；冠状动脉旁路移植术（CABG）总体手术率由11.5%下降至8.8%；而即刻CABG手术率则无显著变化（见图2）。

Query_Text_en: Among the 7356 patients with cardiogenic shock at presentation , 238 [ 3.24 % ] died prior to the median door-to-PCI time without having received PCI .
Translation: 在7356名初诊时出现心源性休克的患者中，有238人（占3.24%）在未接受经皮冠状动脉介入治疗（PCI）的情况下，于中位“入院至PCI”时间之前死亡。

Query_Text_en: For each year in the trend analysis , the median time was calculated using the set of nontransfer PCI patients .
Translation: 在趋势分析的每一年中，均使用非转诊PCI患者的数据计算了中位时间。

Query_Text_en: For cardiogenic shock patients , the median door-to-PCI times declined over time from 117 to 103 minutes [ P = .001 ] .
Translation: 对于心源性休克患者，介入治疗（PCI）起始时间的中位数由117分钟降至103分钟（P = 0.001）。

Query_Text_en: Furthermore , the mortality rate decreased over time for patients who underwent primary PCI for cardiogenic shock [ TABLE 3 ] .
Translation: 此外，接受初次经皮冠状动脉介入治疗的心源性休克患者的死亡率随着时间推移有所下降［见表3］。

Query_Text_en: Multivariable analysis of in-hospital mortality adjusted for demographics , medical history , clinical presentation , hospital characteristics , year of discharge , and procedures demonstrated that primary PCI remained strongly independently associated with a lower in - hospital mortality rate [ AOR , 0.46 ; 95 % CI , 0.40-0 .53 for confounding and propensity ; TABLE 4 ] .
Translation: 多变量分析在调整了人口统计学特征、既往病史、临床表现、医院特征、出院年份及相关操作后显示，初始经皮冠状动脉介入治疗（PCI）仍与较低的住院期间死亡率呈显著独立相关（校正比值比AOR为0.46，95%置信区间为0.40-0.53，已校正混杂因素和倾向性见表4）。

Query_Text_en: Among the covariates in the model using all predictor blocks and propensity score , immediate CABG surgery during hospitalization was associated with lower mortality [ AOR , 0.34 ; 95 % CI , 0.25-0 .47 ] in the full model including propensity score .
Translation: 在包含所有预测变量组和倾向评分的模型中，住院期间立即进行冠状动脉搭桥手术与较低的死亡率相关联[调整后比值比（AOR）为0.34，95%置信区间为0.25-0.47]，该结果基于包含倾向评分的完整模型。

Query_Text_en: A history of diabetes and a history of PCI were associated with in - creased mortality .
Translation: 有糖尿病史和经皮冠状动脉介入治疗（PCI）史与死亡率升高相关。

Query_Text_en: We found increases in primary PCI rates over time in patients younger than 75 years [ from 31.4 % to 63.7 % ; P [ .001 ] and aged 75 years or older [ from 18.8 % to 36.8 % ; P [ .001 ; FIGURE 3 ] .
Translation: 我们发现，随着时间的推移，75岁以下患者的初级经皮冠状动脉介入治疗（PCI）率从31.4%上升到63.7%（P < 0.001），而75岁及以上患者的PCI率则从18.8%上升到36.8%（P < 0.001；见图3）。

Query_Text_en: Use rates of immediate CABG surgery remained low and did not show a time trend in patients younger than 75 years [ from 2.4 % to 3.6 % ; P = .87 ] or in patients aged 75 years or older [ from 1.3 % to 2.6 % ; P = .46 ] .
Translation: 在75岁以下患者中，即时冠状动脉搭桥术的使用率始终较低，且未显示出时间趋势（从2.4%升至3.6%，P=0.87）；在75岁及以上患者中，该手术的使用率同样较低，且无时间趋势（从1.3%升至2.6%，P=0.46）。

Query_Text_en: Mortality rates decreased significantly over time in patients younger than 75 years and in patients aged 75 years or older [ Table 2 ] .
Translation: 在75岁以下患者和75岁及以上患者中，死亡率随时间显著下降［见表2］。

Query_Text_en: After adjusting for demographics , previous medical history , and clinical and hospital characteristics , there was still a steady decrease in the likelihood of death with each increase in year .
Translation: 在调整了人口统计学因素、既往病史以及临床和医院特征后，随着年份的增加，死亡风险依然呈现出持续下降的趋势。

Query_Text_en: Primary PCI outcomes improved in patients younger than 75 years , with postprocedure mortality declining from 34.4 % to 28.2 % [ P .001 ] , but there was no significant change in mortality in patients aged 75 years or older [ Table 3 ] .
Translation: 75岁以下患者的初级经皮冠状动脉介入治疗（PCI）效果有所改善，术后死亡率从34.4%下降至28.2%（P<0.001），而75岁及以上患者的死亡率则无显著变化（见表3）。

Query_Text_en: We performed a multivariable analysis to assess if the revised guidelines from the ACC and the AHA published in September 1999 had a detectable impact on rates of early mechanical revascularization [ primary PCI , immediate CABG surgery ] in patients with cardiogenic shock .
Translation: 我们进行了多变量分析，以评估美国心脏病学会（ACC）和美国心脏协会（AHA）于1999年9月发布的修订指南，是否对心源性休克患者早期机械血运重建（包括原发性经皮冠状动脉介入治疗和紧急冠状动脉搭桥手术）的发生率产生了可检测的影响。

Query_Text_en: There was no statistically significant difference in the slopes of revascularization based on the published guidelines for either all patients or those younger than 75 years of age or aged 75 years or older .
Translation: 根据已发布的指南，无论是针对所有患者，还是针对年龄小于75岁或年龄在75岁及以上的患者，血管再通率的变化趋势均无统计学显著差异。

Query_Text_en: However , after looking at the slope of primary PCI use divided at any possible 2-month increments , we observed a significant change only in patients younger than 75 years , which was strongest in April 2003 [ P = .02 ] .
Translation: 然而，在将初级经皮冠状动脉介入治疗（PCI）的使用率按任意可能的两个月时间段进行分组后，我们发现，只有在75岁以下患者中观察到显著变化，这一变化在2003年4月最为明显（P = 0.02）。

Query_Text_en: The slopes of rates of primary PCI use were similar for patients with cardiogenic shock in the subset of core hospitals .
Translation: 在核心医院子集中，伴有心源性休克患者接受初级经皮冠状动脉介入治疗的比例变化趋势相似。

Query_Text_en: In comparison , the slopes of primary PCI rates in all patients with acute STEMI in the NRMI [ n = 293 633 ] demonstrated consistently significant increases in rate at all cut points , including April 2003 and guideline-era periods [ Figure 3 ] .
Translation: 相比之下，NRMI数据库中所有急性STEMI患者（n = 293,633）的初级PCI率在各个时间节点，包括2003年4月和指南实施时期，均呈现出持续且显著的增长趋势 [见图3]。

Query_Text_en: The change in slope of primary PCI rate in patients younger than 75 years with cardiogenic shock in 2003 parallels the increasing primary PCI rates in all patients with STEMI .
Translation: 2003年，75岁以下合并心源性休克患者的初级经皮冠状动脉介入治疗（PCI）率变化趋势，与所有ST段抬高型心肌梗死（STEMI）患者初级PCI率的上升趋势相一致。

Query_Text_en: This large observational study of patients hospitalized with AMI suggests that over the last 10 years there has been a relatively stable rate of AMI complicated by cardiogenic shock , but there has been a decline in the associated in-hospital mortality rate for hospitals with revascularization capability .
Translation: 这项针对急性心肌梗死住院患者的大型观察性研究表明，过去十年中，合并心源性休克的急性心肌梗死发生率相对稳定，但在具备血运重建能力的医院中，相关的住院死亡率有所下降。

Query_Text_en: There was a significant increase in total and primary PCI rates .
Translation: 总量和初次经皮冠状动脉介入治疗率均显著上升。

Query_Text_en: Primary PCI also was independently associated with a reduction in the odds of death during hospitalization even after adjustment with the propensity score .
Translation: 即使在应用倾向评分调整后，初始经皮冠状动脉介入治疗（PCI）仍与住院期间死亡风险的降低独立相关。

Query_Text_en: There were low and unchanging rates of IABP use , while fibrinolytic therapy use diminished over time .
Translation: 主动脉内球囊反搏（IABP）的使用率一直较低且未见变化，而溶栓治疗的使用率则随着时间推移有所下降。

Query_Text_en: The association of increasing primary PCI rates for patients with cardiogenic shock and lower mortality rates is consistent with a benefit of early mechanical revascularization compared with initial medical stabilization and late or no revascularization that was shown in the SHOCK trial .
Translation: 心源性休克患者初始经皮冠状动脉介入（PCI）率的提高与死亡率的降低相关，这一结果与SHOCK试验中显示的早期机械性血运重建优于初始药物稳定治疗及延迟或未进行血运重建的获益是一致的。

Query_Text_en: The mortality rates were similar for those who underwent PCI in the SHOCK trial , SHOCK registry , and in the NRMI hospitals .
Translation: 在SHOCK试验、SHOCK登记研究以及NRMI医院中接受经皮冠状动脉介入治疗（PCI）的患者，其死亡率相似。

Query_Text_en: This suggests that the randomized trial results are broadly applicable .
Translation: 这表明随机试验的结果具有广泛的适用性。

Query_Text_en: The magnitude of the benefit of emergency revascularization is better estimated by the randomized SHOCK trial because selection bias is never fully accounted for even in a propensity analysis .
Translation: 紧急血运重建的益处大小，由于即使在倾向性分析中也无法完全消除选择偏倚，因此通过随机对照的SHOCK试验能够更准确地评估。

Query_Text_en: A notable difference between the SHOCK trial experience and the NRMI community experience is the marked difference in the use of CABG surgery .
Translation: SHOCK试验与NRMI社区经验之间的一个显著区别在于冠状动脉旁路移植手术（CABG）的使用存在明显差异。

Query_Text_en: more than two thirds had moderate or severe 3-vessel CAD and more than 20 % had severe 3-vessel CAD .
Translation: 超过三分之二的患者患有中度或重度三支血管冠状动脉疾病，且超过20%的患者患有重度三支血管冠状动脉疾病。

Query_Text_en: Cardiac surgeons were active SHOCK investigators , likely contributing to the finding that nearly 40 % of those randomized to early revascularization had urgent early CABG surgery .
Translation: 心脏外科医生积极参与了SHOCK研究，这很可能促成了一个发现：在被随机分配至早期血运重建的患者中，近40%接受了紧急早期冠状动脉搭桥手术。

Query_Text_en: In the current study , immediate and overall CABG surgery rates were low and unchanged over time .
Translation: 在本研究中，冠状动脉搭桥手术的即时和总体实施率均较低，且随时间未见变化。

Query_Text_en: The Cooperative Cardiovascular Project demonstrates that implementation of guidelines into clinical practice in pilot states results in better performance on the defined quality indicators and reduced mortality .
Translation: 合作心血管项目表明，在试点州将指南应用于临床实践，可以提升既定质量指标的表现，并降低死亡率。

Query_Text_en: Furthermore , the Guidelines Applied in Practice initiative has shown that implementation of guidelines-based tools for AMI may facilitate quality improvement among a variety of institutions , patients , and caregivers .
Translation: 此外，“实践中应用指南”倡议表明，基于指南的急性心肌梗死（AMI）工具的实施，有助于在不同机构、患者和护理人员中推动质量提升。

Query_Text_en: Based on the SHOCK trial findings , the ACC and AHA revised guidelines elevated early mechanical revascularization for the management of AMI complicated by cardiogenic shock as a class I recommendation for patients younger than 75 years .
Translation: 根据SHOCK试验的结果，美国心脏病学会（ACC）和美国心脏协会（AHA）修订了指南，将早期机械性血运重建提升为75岁以下合并心源性休克的急性心肌梗死（AMI）患者的I类推荐。

Query_Text_en: Despite considerable investment in the development and dissemination of national guidelines for the management of AMI , several recent studies reported that quality of care for patients with AMI was far from optimal , with 30 % of all reperfusion-eligible patients not receiving such therapy .
Translation: 尽管在制定和推广急性心肌梗死（AMI）管理的国家指南方面投入了大量资源，近期多项研究仍显示，AMI患者的医疗质量远未达到理想水平，30%的符合再灌注条件的患者并未接受相关治疗。

Query_Text_en: The situation is even worse in patients aged 65 years or older , in which 80 % of reperfusion-eligible patients did not receive this potentially life-saving therapy .
Translation: 在65岁及以上患者中，情况更加严峻，有80%的符合再灌注条件的患者未能接受这一可能挽救生命的治疗。

Query_Text_en: We observed no difference in early mechanical revascularization use in all patients or in those younger than 75 years with AMI complicated by cardiogenic shock after publication of the guidelines .
Translation: 在指南发布后，无论是所有患者，还是年龄小于75岁的合并心源性休克的急性心肌梗死患者，早期机械性血运重建的使用率均未见差异。

Query_Text_en: Fear of high PCI-associated mortality rates in states with public reporting of operator scorecards may lead to less intervention in high-risk patients as reported by Moscucci et al. eluctance to perform PCI on high-risk patients with cardiogenic shock in New York state did not appear to explain our findings because only 1.65 % of our cardiogenic shock cohort was from New York state hospitals .
Translation: Moscucci等人报道，在公开操作员评分的州，由于担心经皮冠状动脉介入（PCI）相关的高死亡率，可能导致对高风险患者的干预减少。然而，我们的研究结果并不能用纽约州对心源性休克高风险患者进行PCI的犹豫来解释，因为我们的心源性休克队列中，只有1.65%的患者来自纽约州的医院。

Query_Text_en: Analysis of the slope of primary PCI rates in cardiogenic shock patients demonstrated a significant increase in rates only late during the study period for any bimonthly interval in patients younger than 75 years .
Translation: 对心源性休克患者接受初级经皮冠状动脉介入治疗（PCI）比例的变化趋势分析显示，在研究后期，75岁以下患者的PCI比例在任何两个月区间内才出现显著增长。

Query_Text_en: this increase may be more a result of the overall increasing rates for all STEMI patients [ n = 293 633 ] , and may be related to the publication of reports favorable to primary PCI .
Translation: 这种增长可能更多地反映了所有STEMI患者（n = 293,633）总体发生率的上升，并且可能与有利于初始经皮冠状动脉介入治疗（PCI）报告的发表有关。

Query_Text_en: The SHOCK trial reported no apparent benefit of early revascularization for patients older than 75 years , but there were only 56 elderly patients in the cohort and there were imbalances between the 2 treatment groups .
Translation: SHOCK试验报告称，对于75岁以上的患者，早期血运重建并未显示出明显的益处，但该队列中老年患者仅有56例，且两组治疗间存在不平衡。

Query_Text_en: The AHA made no recommendation for the elderly .
Translation: 美国心脏协会未对老年人提出任何建议。

Query_Text_en: Recent analysis of the SHOCK trial registry demonstrated that early mechanical revascularization is associated with improved survival in patients aged 75 years or older or those who were clinically selected [ approximately 20 % ] for early mechanical revascularization .
Translation: 近期对SHOCK试验登记数据的分析显示，早期机械血运重建可显著提高75岁及以上患者或临床选择接受早期机械血运重建的患者（约占20%）的生存率。

Query_Text_en: Our study and other nonrandomized studies of elderly patients support the latter and demonstrate decreasing mortality in elderly patients in association with increasing PCI use in hospitals with revascularization capability .
Translation: 我们的研究以及其他针对老年患者的非随机研究支持后一种观点，并显示在具备血管再通能力的医院，随着经皮冠状动脉介入治疗（PCI）使用率的提高，老年患者的死亡率呈下降趋势。

Query_Text_en: The 2004 guidelines on the management of AMI gave a class IIA recommendation for early revascularization in those older than 75 years who are suitable candidates [ 36.7 % of the cohort in the NRMI registries ] .
Translation: 2004年关于急性心肌梗死管理的指南对75岁以上且适合接受治疗的患者（在NRMI注册队列中占36.7%）给予了IIA类早期血运重建的推荐。

Query_Text_en: Approximately 15 % of cardiogenic shock complicating AMI is due to mechanical complications , but the exact number is not known in this study because these data were not systematically collected .
Translation: 约15%的急性心肌梗死并发心源性休克由机械性并发症引起，但本研究中未能得出确切比例，因为相关数据并未系统收集。

Query_Text_en: Even after adjusting for an estimated 15 % of mechanical complications , emergency revascularization was underused for pump failure .
Translation: 即使在估算了15%的机械性并发症后，针对泵衰竭的紧急血运重建仍未得到充分应用。

Query_Text_en: The use of primary PCI was not examined in patients who were admitted to hospitals without revascularization capability .
Translation: 对于入院医院不具备血运重建能力的患者，未对其采用初始经皮冠状动脉介入治疗进行研究。

Query_Text_en: In this registry , as in all registries , there was no independent review of source documents to confirm the diagnosis of cardiogenic shock .
Translation: 在该登记系统中，和所有登记系统一样，并未对原始文件进行独立审核以确认心源性休克的诊断。

Query_Text_en: However , the rate of cardiogenic shock we found was similar to that found in other studies , supporting the validity of the diagnoses .
Translation: 然而，我们发现的心源性休克发生率与其他研究结果相似，这也进一步验证了诊断的有效性。

Query_Text_en: There was a general increase in the overall use of primary PCI and a parallel increase in the rate of primary PCI for shock in all age categories in hospitals with revascularization capability .
Translation: 在具备血管再通能力的医院中，所有年龄组的初级经皮冠状动脉介入治疗（PCI）总体使用率普遍上升，同时用于休克患者的初级PCI比例也相应增加。

Query_Text_en: This increase in PCI for shock patients was associated with improved survival , suggesting that the SHOCK trial results are applicable to a large group of hospitals with PCI and open heart surgery capability .
Translation: 对于休克患者而言，PCI使用率的提升与生存率的改善相关，表明SHOCK试验的结果适用于拥有PCI和心脏外科手术能力的大多数医院。

Query_Text_en: The recommendation from the ACC and the AHA for early mechanical revascularization as a class I indication for treatment of patients with AMI complicated by cardiogenic shock had no detectable temporal impact on clinical management of these patients .
Translation: 美国心脏病学会和美国心脏协会将早期机械血运重建作为治疗合并心源性休克的急性心肌梗死患者的一级推荐，但这一建议在临床管理中并未产生明显的时间性影响。

Query_Text_en: Early CABG surgery was underused in the NRMI compared with the SHOCK trial .
Translation: 与SHOCK试验相比，NRMI中早期冠状动脉搭桥手术的使用率偏低。

Query_Text_en: In accordance with guidelines from the ACC and the AHA , we recommend more aggressive use of early mechanical revascularization , including early CABG surgery , in patients with AMI complicated by cardiogenic shock .
Translation: 根据美国心脏病学会（ACC）和美国心脏协会（AHA）的指南，我们建议对合并心源性休克的急性心肌梗死（AMI）患者更积极地采用早期机械性血运重建措施，包括早期冠状动脉旁路移植术（CABG）。

Query_Text_en: The findings of our study support the need for efforts aimed at guideline adherence to improve survival of patients with cardiogenic shock .
Translation: 我们的研究结果表明，应加强遵循指南的相关措施，以提升心源性休克患者的生存率。

Query_Text_en: Overall in-hospital mortality de - creased from 60.3 % in 1995 to 47.9 % in 2004 [ P [ .001 ; TABLE 2 ] . This paralleled the increasing use of revascularization .
Translation: 总体住院死亡率从1995年的60.3%下降至2004年的47.9%（P <.001；见表2）。这一变化与血管再通治疗的使用增加相一致。

Query_Text_en: Purpose : To estimate the prevalence of undiagnosed airflow obstruction [ AFO ] in Hong Kong smokers with no previous diagnosis of respiratory disease , and to assess its variability when applying different prediction equations and diagnostic criteria .
Translation: 目的：评估香港吸烟者中未被诊断的气流阻塞（AFO）的患病率，这些吸烟者此前未被诊断为呼吸系统疾病，并分析在采用不同预测公式和诊断标准时其患病率的变化情况。

Query_Text_en: Methods : A multicenter , population-based , cross-sectional prevalence study was performed in smokers aged 20 to 80 years .
Translation: 方法：本研究为多中心、基于人群的横断面患病率调查，研究对象为年龄在20至80岁的吸烟者。

Query_Text_en: Three different criteria [ fixed 70 % [ Global Initiative for Chronic Obstructive Lung Disease and British Thoracic Society ] , fixed 75 % , and European Respiratory Society [ ERS ] ] were applied to define a lower limit of normal [ LLN ] of the FEV1\/FVC ratio to compare with the Hong Kong Chinese reference equation [ criterion 1 ] , which had used a distribution-free method to obtain the lower fifth percentile of FEV1\/FVC ratio as the LLN .
Translation: 采用了三种不同的标准[固定70%（全球慢性阻塞性肺疾病倡议和英国胸科学会）、固定75%以及欧洲呼吸学会（ERS）]来定义FEV1/FVC比值的下限（LLN），并与香港华人的参考方程[标准1]进行比较。该参考方程采用无分布方法，将FEV1/FVC比值的第5百分位作为LLN。

Query_Text_en: Results : In 525 male patients , using criterion 1 [ local internal prediction equation ] and defining AFO as FEV1\/FVC less than LLN , the overall prevalence of AFO was 13.7 % : 8.3 % in age ] 20 to 40 years , 14.0 % in age ] 40 to 60 years , and 17.8 % in age ] 60 to 80 years .
Translation: 结果：在525名男性患者中，采用标准1【本地内部预测方程】并将AFO定义为FEV1/FVC低于LLN时，AFO的总体患病率为13.7%：20至40岁年龄组为8.3%，40至60岁年龄组为14.0%，60至80岁年龄组为17.8%。

Query_Text_en: When the local internal prediction equation was used as the comparison reference , the fixed-ratio methods tended to miss AFO in younger age groups and overdiagnose AFO in old age , while the ERS criteria , which uses an almost lower fifth percentile-equivalent method , showed less of such a trend but still only showed moderate agreement with criterion 1 .
