Query_Text_en: He told me that they always began by complaining in a vague manner about their health , and by practice he soon guessed what was really the matter .
Translation: 他告诉我，他们总是先含糊其辞地抱怨自己的健康状况，而凭借经验，他很快就能猜出他们真正的问题所在。

Query_Text_en: Owing to my father s skill in winning confidence he received many strange confessions of misery and guilt .
Translation: 由于我父亲善于赢得他人的信任，他常常听到许多关于痛苦与罪疚的奇异忏悔。

Query_Text_en: He often remarked how many miserable wives he had known .
Translation: 他常常提起自己认识的那些不幸的妻子有多少。

Query_Text_en: this he attributed to their having lost a common bond in their young children having grown up .
Translation: 他将此归因于他们失去了共同的纽带——年幼的孩子们已经长大成人。

Query_Text_en: But the most remarkable power which my father possessed was that of reading the characters , and even the thoughts of those whom he saw even for a short time .
Translation: 但我父亲最为非凡的能力，是能够读懂他所见之人的性格，甚至是他们的思想，即便只是短暂相处。

Query_Text_en: We had many instances of the power , some of which seemed almost supernatural .
Translation: 我们曾多次见证这种力量，其中有些现象几乎令人觉得超乎寻常。

Query_Text_en: It saved my father from ever making ( with one exception , and the character of this man was soon discovered ) an unworthy friend .
Translation: 这让我的父亲始终没有结交不值得信赖的朋友（只有一次例外，而且这个人的品性很快就被识破）。

Query_Text_en: everybody called on him , and he was invited to many houses .
Translation: 大家都去拜访他，他也受邀到许多家庭做客。

Query_Text_en: for he felt sure that the man was not to be trusted .
Translation: 因为他确信这个人不值得信任。

Query_Text_en: After a few months he suddenly bolted , being heavily in debt , and was found out to be little better than an habitual swindler .
Translation: 几个月后，他突然逃跑，因债务缠身，被发现其实不过是个惯于诈骗的人。

Query_Text_en: Here is a case of trustfulness which not many men would have ventured on .
Translation: 这是一个鲜有人敢于尝试的信任案例。

Query_Text_en: An Irish gentleman , a complete stranger , called on my father one day , and said that he had lost his purse , and that it would be a serious inconvenience to him to wait in Shrewsbury until he could receive a remittance from Ireland .
Translation: 一天，一位完全陌生的爱尔兰绅士拜访了我的父亲，说他丢了钱包，如果要在什鲁斯伯里等到从爱尔兰汇款到来，将会给他带来很大的不便。

Query_Text_en: He then asked my father to lend him 20 , which was immediately done , as my father felt certain that the story was a true one .
Translation: 随后，他向我父亲借了20元，我父亲立刻借给了他，因为他确信这个故事是真的。

Query_Text_en: As soon as a letter could arrive from Ireland , one came with the most profuse thanks , and enclosing , as he said , a 20 Bank of England note , but no note was enclosed .
Translation: 一封来自爱尔兰的信刚一可能送达，就收到了，信中满是感谢之词，并声称附上了一张面值20英镑的英格兰银行钞票，但实际上并未附上任何钞票。

Query_Text_en: I asked my father whether this did not stagger him , but he answered not in the least . On the next day another letter came with many apologies for having forgotten ( like a true Irishman ) to put the note into his letter of the day before ...
Translation: 我问父亲这件事是否让他感到动摇，但他回答一点也没有。第二天又来了一封信，信中多次道歉，说自己忘记了（像个地道的爱尔兰人）把便条放进前一天的信里……

Query_Text_en: and the young man s insanity led him to accuse himself of all the crimes under heaven .
Translation: 而这位年轻人的疯狂使他将天下所有罪行都归咎于自己。

Query_Text_en: When my father afterwards talked over the matter with the uncle , he said , I am sure that you nephew is really guilty of . . .  : a heinous crime .
Translation: 后来我父亲和那位叔叔谈起这件事时说：“我确信你的侄子确实犯下了……一桩骇人听闻的罪行。”

Query_Text_en: we thought that no human being knew the fact except ourselves !
Translation: 我们以为除了我们自己，没有其他人知道这个事实！

Query_Text_en: and it was very characteristic of my father that he said he could not explain how it was .
Translation: 我父亲的典型之处就在于，他说自己无法解释这是怎么回事。

Query_Text_en: The following story shows what good guesses my father could make .
Translation: 下面这个故事展示了我父亲善于推测的能力。

Query_Text_en: Lord Shelburne , afterwards the first Marquis of Lansdowne , was famous ( as Macaulay somewhere remarks ) for his knowledge of the affairs of Europe , on which he greatly prided himself .
Translation: 谢尔本勋爵（后来的第一代兰斯多恩侯爵）以其对欧洲事务的深厚了解而闻名（正如麦考利在某处所指出的），对此他引以为傲。

Query_Text_en: He consulted my father medically , and afterwards harangued him on the state of Holland .
Translation: 他先就医疗问题向我父亲请教，随后又滔滔不绝地谈论起荷兰的局势。

Query_Text_en: My father had studied medicine at Leyden , and one day ( while there ) went a long walk into the country with a friend who took him to the house of a clergyman ( we will say the Rev. Mr. A , for I have forgotten his name ) , who had married an Englishwoman .
Translation: 我父亲曾在莱顿学习医学，有一天（在那期间），他和一位朋友到乡下远足，这位朋友带他去了一个牧师的家（我们暂且称他为A先生，因为我已忘记他的名字），这位牧师娶了一位英国女性为妻。

Query_Text_en: My father was very hungry , and there was little for luncheon except cheese , which he could never eat .
Translation: 我父亲当时非常饿，但午餐几乎没有什么可吃的，只有奶酪，而他从来无法吃奶酪。

Query_Text_en: The old lady was surprised and grieved at this , and assured my father that it was an excellent cheese , and had been sent her from Bowood , the seat of Lord Shelburne .
Translation: 老妇人对此感到惊讶和难过，并向我父亲保证这是一块极好的奶酪，是从谢尔本勋爵的庄园博伍德寄来的。

Query_Text_en: My father wondered why a cheese should be sent her from Bowood , but thought nothing more about it until it flashed across his mind many years afterwards , whilst Lord Shelburne was talking about Holland .
Translation: 我父亲曾疑惑为何有人从鲍伍德寄来一块奶酪给她，但当时并未多想，直到许多年后，谢尔本勋爵谈及荷兰时，这件事才突然浮现在他的脑海中。

Query_Text_en: So he answered , I should think from what I saw of the Rev. Mr. A , that he was a very able man , and well acquainted with the state of Holland .
Translation: 他回答说，根据我对A牧师的观察，我认为他是一位非常有才干的人，对荷兰的情况也十分熟悉。

Query_Text_en: My father saw that the Earl , who immediately changed the conversation , was much startled .
Translation: 我父亲注意到伯爵显然受到了很大惊吓，立刻转移了话题。

Query_Text_en: On the next morning my father received a note from the Earl , saying that he had delayed starting on his journey , and wished particularly to see my father .
Translation: 第二天早晨，我父亲收到了一封伯爵的便条，称他推迟了行程，特别希望见我父亲一面。

Query_Text_en: When he called , the Earl said , Dr. Darwin , it is of the utmost importance to me and to the Rev. Mr. A to learn how you have discovered that he is the source of my information about Holland .
Translation: 当他来访时，伯爵说道：“达尔文博士，我和A先生都非常关心，您是如何发现他是我关于荷兰情报来源的？”

Query_Text_en: So my father had to explain the state of the case , and he supposed that Lord Shelburne was much struck with his diplomatic skill in guessing , for during many years afterwards he received many kind messages from him through various friends .
Translation: 因此，我父亲不得不向他解释事情的原委，他认为谢尔本勋爵对他在推测方面展现出的外交技巧印象深刻，因为在此后的许多年里，谢尔本勋爵通过不同的朋友多次向他传达友好的问候。

Query_Text_en: for Sir C. Lyell asked me many years ago why the Marquis of Lansdowne ( the son of grandson of the first marquis ) felt so much interest about me , whom he had never seen , and my family .
Translation: 多年以前，莱尔爵士曾问我，为什么兰斯多恩侯爵（第一代侯爵的孙子）会如此关心我和我的家人，尽管他从未见过我们。

Query_Text_en: and without my having asked any one , Lord Lansdowne proposed me and got me elected .
Translation: 在我未曾向任何人提出请求的情况下，兰斯多恩勋爵主动提名我，并促成了我的当选。

Query_Text_en: If I am right in my supposition , it was a queer concatenation of events that my father not eating cheese half-a-century before in Holland led to my election as a member of the Athenaeum Club
Translation: 如果我的推测没错，那么，正是半个世纪前我父亲在荷兰没有吃奶酪这一奇特的连锁事件，最终导致我被选为雅典娜俱乐部的成员。

Query_Text_en: The sharpness of his observation led him to predict with remarkable skill the course of any illness , and he suggested endless small details of relief .
Translation: 他敏锐的观察力使他能够极为准确地预测疾病的发展，并提出了无数细致的缓解建议。

Query_Text_en: I was told that a young doctor in Shrewsbury , who disliked my father , used to say that he was wholly unscientific , but owned that his power of predicting the end of an illness was unparalleled .
Translation: 有人告诉我，什鲁斯伯里有位年轻医生不喜欢我父亲，常说他毫无科学精神，但也承认他对疾病结局的预测能力无人能及。

Query_Text_en: Formerly when he thought that I should be a doctor , he talked much to me about his patients .
Translation: 以前，他认为我将来会成为一名医生时，经常和我谈起他的病人。

Query_Text_en: and he advised me if ever I was myself ill not to allow any doctor to take more than an extremely small quantity of blood .
Translation: 他建议我，如果我自己生病，绝不要让任何医生抽取超过极少量的血。

Query_Text_en: Long before typhoid fever was recognized as distinct , my father told me that two utterly distinct kinds of illness were confounded under the name of typhus fever .
Translation: 早在伤寒被确认为一种独立疾病之前，我父亲就告诉我，当时有两种截然不同的疾病被混淆在“斑疹伤寒”这一名称之下。

Query_Text_en: He was vehement against drinking , and was convinced of both the direct and inherited evil effects of alcohol when habitually taken even in moderate quantity in a very large majority of cases .
Translation: 他强烈反对饮酒，并坚信在绝大多数情况下，即使是适量长期饮用酒精，也会直接或遗传性地产生有害影响。

Query_Text_en: But he admitted and advanced instances of certain persons who could drink largely during their whole lives without apparently suffering any evil effects , and he believed that he could often beforehand tell who would thus not suffer .
Translation: 但他承认并举出了一些人的例子，这些人终生大量饮酒，似乎并未遭受任何明显的不良影响，而且他相信自己常常能够提前判断哪些人不会因此受到伤害。

Query_Text_en: He himself never drank a drop of any alcoholic fluid .
Translation: 他本人从不沾染任何酒精饮品。

Query_Text_en: This remark reminds me of a case showing how a witness under the most favourable circumstances may be utterly mistaken .
Translation: 这句话让我想起一个案例，说明即使在最有利的情况下，证人也可能完全弄错。

Query_Text_en: Whereupon the gentleman said , Come , come , Doctor , this won t do though it is very kind of you to say so for my sake for I know that you take a very large glass of hot gin and water every evening after your dinner .
Translation: 于是那位先生说道：“不行，不行，医生，虽然你这么说是为了我，很感谢你的好意，但我知道你每天晚饭后都会喝一大杯热杜松子酒兑水。”

Query_Text_en: So my father asked him how he knew this .
Translation: 于是我父亲问他是怎么知道这件事的。

Query_Text_en: The man answered , My cook was your kitchen-maid for two or three years , and she saw the butler every day prepare and take to you the gin and water .
Translation: 那人回答道：“我的厨娘曾在你家做了两三年厨房女佣，她每天都看到管家为你准备杜松子酒兑水，并亲自送到你那里。”

Query_Text_en: and the butler used first to put some cold water in the glass , which the girl mistook for gin , and then filled it up with boiling water from the kitchen boiler .
Translation: 管家先在杯子里倒了一些冷水，女孩误以为那是杜松子酒，随后又用厨房锅炉里的沸水将杯子注满。

Query_Text_en: My father used to tell me many little things which he had found useful in his medical practice .
Translation: 我父亲过去常常跟我讲许多他在行医过程中发现有用的小窍门。

Query_Text_en: Thus ladies often cried much while telling him their troubles , and thus caused much loss of his precious time . He soon found that begging them to command and restrain themselves , always made them weep the more , so that afterwards he always encouraged them to go on crying , saying that this would relieve them more than anything else , and with the invariable result that they soon ceased to cry , and he could hear what they had to say and give his advice .
Translation: 因此，女士们在向他倾诉烦恼时常常哭得很厉害，这也让他宝贵的时间损失不少。他很快发现，劝她们自制和克制只会让她们哭得更厉害，于是后来他总是鼓励她们继续哭，告诉她们这样会比其他方式更能缓解情绪。结果总是，她们很快就停止了哭泣，他便能听她们说话并给予建议。

Query_Text_en: but if they answered that they had heard that the food in question had done good to some one else , he firmly refused his assent .
Translation: 但如果他们回答说听说这种食物对别人有益，他则坚决表示不同意。

Query_Text_en: He gave one day an odd little specimen of human nature .
Translation: 有一天，他展示了一个关于人性的奇特小例证。

Query_Text_en: When a very young man he was called in to consult with the family physician in the case of a gentleman of much distinction in Shropshire .
Translation: 他年纪尚轻时，就被请来与家庭医生共同会诊一位在什罗普郡颇有声望的绅士。

Query_Text_en: The old doctor told the wife that the illness was of such a nature that it must end fatally .
Translation: 老医生告诉妻子，这种病的性质决定了最终必然是致命的。

Query_Text_en: My father took a different view and maintained that the gentleman would recover : he was proved quite wrong in all respects ( I think by autopsy ) and he owned his error .
Translation: 我父亲持不同看法，坚持认为那位先生会康复；事实证明他在各方面都错了（我记得是通过尸检证实的），他也承认了自己的错误。

Query_Text_en: but after a few months the widow sent for him , having dismissed the old family doctor .
Translation: 但几个月后，这位寡妇把他叫了过去，已经辞退了家里的老医生。

Query_Text_en: In another case my father told a lady that her husband would certainly die .
Translation: 在另一起案例中，我父亲告诉一位女士，她的丈夫一定会去世。

Query_Text_en: Some months afterwards he saw the widow who was a very sensible woman , and she said , You are a very young man , and allow me to advise you always to give as long as you possibly can , hope to any near relative nursing a patient .
Translation: 几个月后，他见到了那位寡妇，她是一位非常明理的女性。她说：“你还很年轻，请允许我给你一个建议：只要还有可能，就应当尽量给正在照顾病人的近亲以希望。”

Query_Text_en: You made me despair , and from that moment I lost strength .
Translation: 你让我感到绝望，从那一刻起我便失去了力量。

Query_Text_en: My father said that he had often since seen the paramount importance , for the sake of the patient , of keeping up the hope and with it the strength of the nurse in charge .
Translation: 我父亲说，他后来常常看到，为了患者的利益，保持负责护士的希望和力量至关重要。

Query_Text_en: This he sometimes found difficult to do compatibly with truth .
Translation: 他有时发现，要做到这一点而不违背事实并不容易。

Query_Text_en: One old gentleman , however , caused him no such perplexity .
Translation: 然而，有一位年长的绅士却没有让他感到这样的困惑。

Query_Text_en: He was sent for by Mr. P , who said , From all that I have seen and heard of you I believe that you are the sort of man who will speak the truth , and if I ask , you will tell me when I am dying .
Translation: 他被P先生召见，P先生说：“根据我所见所闻，我相信你是那种会说实话的人。如果我问你，你会告诉我我什么时候快要死了。”

Query_Text_en: Now I much desire that you should attend me , if you will promise , whatever I may say , always to declare that I am not going to die .
Translation: 现在我非常希望你能陪在我身边，但你要答应我，无论我说什么，都要一直告诉我，我不会死。

Query_Text_en: My father acquiesced on the understanding that his words should in fact have no meaning .
Translation: 我父亲同意了，但前提是他的言语实际上不具任何意义。

Query_Text_en: and thus the deaths of many friends were often recalled to his mind .
Translation: 因此，他常常回忆起许多朋友的逝世。

Query_Text_en: Owing to his strong memory he knew an extraordinary number of curious stories , which he liked to tell , as he was a great talker .
Translation: 由于他记忆力极强，知道许多奇闻轶事，并且非常喜欢讲述，因为他是个极善言谈的人。

Query_Text_en: yet he had the art of making every one obey him to the letter .
Translation: 然而，他却有本事让每个人都对他言听计从。

Query_Text_en: Many persons were much afraid of him .
Translation: 许多人都非常害怕他。

Query_Text_en: and was told that Miss , whom my father had somehow mortally offended , was telling everybody that she would call and tell that fat old doctor very plainly what she thought of him .
Translation: 据说，我父亲不知为何得罪了小姐，她正在向所有人宣称，自己会亲自去找那个胖胖的老医生，把她对他的看法直截了当地告诉他。

Query_Text_en: She had already called , but her courage had failed , and no one could have been more courteous and friendly .
Translation: 她已经打过电话了，但最终还是没能鼓起勇气，没有人能比她更彬彬有礼、友善了。

Query_Text_en: and the poor creature , as soon as she saw me , was in the most abject state of terror that I ever saw , weeping bitterly and asking me over and over again , Is your father coming ? but was soon pacified .
Translation: 那可怜的生物一见到我，就陷入了我所见过的最极度的恐惧之中，痛哭流涕，一遍又一遍地问我：“你父亲要来吗？”但很快就被安抚下来了。

Query_Text_en: and these words succeeded perfectly during the rest of her long life .
Translation: 在她漫长的余生中，这些话始终发挥了极好的作用。

Query_Text_en: My father was very sensitive , so that many small events annoyed him or pained him much .
Translation: 我父亲非常敏感，因此许多小事都会让他感到烦恼或痛苦。

Query_Text_en: and he answered , Every road out of Shrewsbury is associated in my mind with some painful event .
Translation: 他回答说：“在我心中，通往施鲁斯伯里的每一条路都与某些痛苦的往事联系在一起。”

Query_Text_en: Yet he was generally in high spirits .
Translation: 然而，他通常情绪高昂。

Query_Text_en: He was easily made very angry , but his kindness was unbounded .
Translation: 他很容易发怒，但他的善良无可限量。

Query_Text_en: He was widely and deeply loved .
Translation: 他深受广大人民的爱戴。

Query_Text_en: He was a cautious and good man of business , so that he hardly ever lost money by any investment , and left to his children a very large property .
Translation: 他为人谨慎，是一位出色的生意人，因此几乎从未因任何投资而亏损，并为子女留下了丰厚的财产。

Query_Text_en: I remember a story showing how easily utterly false beliefs originate and spread .
Translation: 我记得有一个故事，生动展示了荒谬的错误观念是如何轻易产生并传播开的。

Query_Text_en: Mr. E , a squire of one of the oldest families in Shropshire , and head partner in a bank , committed suicide .
Translation: E先生是什罗普郡最古老家族之一的乡绅，也是某银行的首席合伙人，他自杀身亡。

Query_Text_en: My father was sent for as a matter of form , and found him dead .
Translation: 我父亲被例行通知前往，结果发现他已经去世了。

Query_Text_en: I may mention , by the way , to show how matters were managed in those old days , that because Mr. E was a rather great man , and universally respected , no inquest was held over his body .
Translation: 顺便提一句，为了说明当年事务的处理方式，由于E先生地位显赫，备受尊敬，因此并未对他的遗体进行验尸。

Query_Text_en: My father , in returning home , thought it proper to call at the bank ( where he had an account ) to tell the managing partners of the event , as it was not improbable that it would cause a run on the bank .
Translation: 我父亲在回家的路上，认为有必要去他开户的那家银行，向管理合伙人通报这一事件，因为这很可能会引发挤兑。

Query_Text_en: Well , the story was spread far and wide , that my father went into the bank , drew out all his money , left the bank , came back again , and said , I may just tell you that Mr. E has killed himself , and then departed .
Translation: 这个故事广为流传：我父亲走进银行，取出了所有的钱，离开后又返回，接着说，“我可以告诉你，E先生自杀了”，然后便离开了。

Query_Text_en: It seems that it was then a common belief that money withdrawn from a bank was not safe until the person had passed out through the door of the bank .
Translation: 当时人们普遍认为，只有将钱取出并走出银行大门，钱才算真正安全。

Query_Text_en: My father did not hear this story till some little time afterwards , when the managing partner said that he had departed from his invariable rule of never allowing any one to see the account of another man , by having shown the ledger with my father s account to several persons , as this proved that my father had not drawn out a penny on that day .
Translation: 我父亲是在事发后不久才听说这件事的。当时，事务所的管理合伙人表示，他破例打破了从不让他人查阅他人账户的惯例，将我父亲的账户账本展示给了几位相关人士，以证明我父亲那天并未提取过一分钱。

Query_Text_en: It would have been dishonourable in my father to have used his professional knowledge for his private advantage .
Translation: 如果我父亲利用他的专业知识谋取私利，那将是不光彩的。

Query_Text_en: yet he formed a theory for almost everything which occurred .
Translation: 然而，几乎每当发生什么事情，他总会提出一套理论来解释。

Query_Text_en: but his example ought to have been of much moral service to all his children .
Translation: 然而，他的榜样本应对所有子女产生极大的道德影响。

Query_Text_en: One of his golden rules ( a hard one to follow ) was , Never become the friend of any one whom you can not respect .
Translation: 他的一条黄金法则（虽然很难做到）是：永远不要与那些你无法尊重的人交朋友。

Query_Text_en: Catherine , married Rev. Charles Langton .
Translation: 凯瑟琳嫁给了查尔斯·兰顿牧师。

Query_Text_en: The elder son , Erasmus , was born in 1804 , and died unmarried at the age of seventy-seven .
Translation: 长子伊拉斯谟出生于1804年，终身未婚，享年七十七岁。

Query_Text_en: He , like his brother , was educated at Shrewsbury School and at Christ s College , Cambridge .
Translation: 他和他的兄弟一样，曾在什鲁斯伯里学校和剑桥大学基督学院接受教育。

Query_Text_en: He studied medicine at Edinburgh and in London , and took the degree of Bachelor of Medicine at Cambridge . He never made any pretence of practising as a doctor , and , after leaving Cambridge , lived a quiet life in London .
Translation: 他曾在爱丁堡和伦敦学习医学，并在剑桥获得医学学士学位。他从未假装以医生身份行医，离开剑桥后便在伦敦过着平静的生活。

Query_Text_en: There was something pathetic in Charles Darwin s affection for his brother Erasmus , as if he always recollected his solitary life , and the touching patience and sweetness of his nature .
Translation: 查尔斯·达尔文对其兄弟伊拉斯谟的感情中带有一种令人怜悯的色彩，仿佛他始终记得兄弟孤独的生活，以及那令人动容的耐心与温和的性格。

Query_Text_en: He often spoke of him as Poor old Ras , or Poor dear old Philos I imagine Philos ( Philosopher ) was a relic of the days when they worked at chemistry in the tool-house at Shrewsbury a time of which he always preserved a pleasant memory .
Translation: 他常常称他为“可怜的老拉斯”或“可爱的老菲洛斯”。我想，“菲洛斯”（即“哲学家”）这个称呼，是他们在什鲁斯伯里工具房里一起做化学实验时留下的旧日昵称——那段时光，他始终怀有美好的回忆。

Query_Text_en: Erasmus being rather more than four years older than Charles Darwin , they were not long together at Cambridge , but previously at Edinburgh they lived in the same lodgings , and after the Voyage they lived for a time together in Erasmus house in Great Marlborough Street .
Translation: 伊拉斯谟比查尔斯·达尔文年长四岁多，因此他们在剑桥共处的时间并不长，但在此之前，他们曾在爱丁堡同住一处住所。达尔文环球航行归来后，两人又曾在大马尔伯勒街的伊拉斯谟家中共同生活过一段时间。

Query_Text_en: At this time also he often speaks with much affection of Erasmus in his letters to Fox , using words such as my dear good old brother .
Translation: 在这一时期，他在写给福克斯的信中常常深情地提到伊拉斯谟，称其为“我亲爱的好兄弟”等字眼。

Query_Text_en: In later years Erasmus Darwin came to Down occasionally , or joined his brother s family in a summer holiday .
Translation: 在后来的几年里，伊拉斯谟·达尔文偶尔会来到唐恩，或者在暑假期间与哥哥一家团聚。

Query_Text_en: But gradually it came about that he could not , through ill health , make up his mind to leave London , and then they only saw each other when Charles Darwin went for a week at a time to his brother s house in Queen Anne Street .
Translation: 但由于健康状况不佳，他渐渐无法下决心离开伦敦，于是他们只有在查尔斯·达尔文每次到他哥哥位于安妮女王街的家中住上一周时才能见面。

Query_Text_en: My brother Erasmus possessed a remarkably clear mind with extensive and diversified tastes and knowledge in literature , art , and even in science .
Translation: 我哥哥伊拉斯谟头脑异常清晰，在文学、艺术乃至科学领域都拥有广泛而多样的兴趣和知识。

Query_Text_en: With a camera fitted into a pair of sunglasses connected to a computer , a 62-year-old blind man , identified only as Jerry , has learned to recognize objects well enough to navigate the New York City subway system independently .
Translation: 一位62岁的盲人男子（仅透露姓名为Jerry），通过在太阳镜上安装摄像头并连接电脑，已经能够识别物体，并足以独立乘坐纽约市地铁系统。

Query_Text_en: Jerry 's road to partial sight began in 1978 , when doctors at New York 's Dobelle Institute implanted 68 electrodes on the surface of a region of Jerry 's brain called the visual cortex -- where signals from the eyes are processed .
Translation: Jerry恢复部分视力的历程始于1978年，当时纽约多贝尔研究所的医生在他大脑中名为视觉皮层的区域表面植入了68个电极——这个区域正是处理来自眼睛信号的地方。

Query_Text_en: By electrically stimulating the area , doctors hoped that could restore some of Jerry 's vision .
Translation: 医生希望通过对该区域进行电刺激，能够恢复杰瑞部分视力。

Query_Text_en: Normally , the brain does not interpret tile phosphene patterns as identifiable objects .
Translation: 通常情况下，大脑不会将瓷砖样的磷光图案解读为可识别的物体。

Query_Text_en: Today , Jerry 's sunglasses are outfitted with a tiny video camera that captures images that are processed by a portable computer .
Translation: 如今，杰里的太阳镜上配备了一台微型摄像机，用于捕捉图像，并由一台便携式计算机进行处理。

Query_Text_en: When Jerry scans an object , he sees a pattern of phosphenes . Computer algorithms enlarge the edges of the pattern so that it appears as an outline .
Translation: 当Jerry扫描一个物体时，他会看到一组磷光点的图案。计算机算法会放大图案的边缘，使其呈现出轮廓的形状。

Query_Text_en: A major benefit of the Dobelle system is that it can help the estimated 1.1 million Americans whose blindness has many causes , not just damage to the retina .
Translation: 多贝尔系统的一个主要优势在于，它能够帮助约110万美国盲人，这些人的失明原因多种多样，并不仅仅是视网膜损伤。

Query_Text_en: It only covers an area about 2 inches wide by 8 inches tall viewed at arm ' s length , giving Jerry tunnel vision .
Translation: 它只覆盖了大约2英寸宽、8英寸高的区域，在伸直手臂的距离观看时，这让杰瑞产生了隧道视野。

Query_Text_en: To overcome this problem , the commercial version of the system , which will be marketed abroad by the end of this year , will feature 512 electrodes .
Translation: 为解决这一问题，该系统的商业版将在今年年底前向海外市场推出，并将配备512个电极。

Query_Text_en: It was only after `` much prodding '' from his wife , he says , that William Sampson went for a routine checkup that led to a diagnosis of prostate cancer .
Translation: 他说，正是因为妻子的一再催促，威廉·桑普森才去做了例行检查，结果被诊断出患有前列腺癌。

Query_Text_en: And because the cancer was small , Sampson , a 57-year-old crane operator was able to choose the least grueling form of treatment .
Translation: 由于癌症体积较小，57岁的起重机操作员桑普森得以选择最轻松的治疗方式。

Query_Text_en: Instead of major surgery or weeks of radiation therapy , Sampson chose to undergo an increasingly popular outpatient procedure , receiving implants of scores of tiny radioactive `` seeds '' into his prostate gland , and went home that evening .
Translation: 萨姆森没有选择重大手术或长达数周的放射治疗，而是接受了一种越来越受欢迎的门诊治疗——在前列腺内植入数十颗微小的放射性“种子”，当天晚上便回家了。

Query_Text_en: The rice-size pellets will remain there permanently , radiating his tumor from inside .
Translation: 米粒大小的颗粒将永久留在体内，从内部对肿瘤进行照射。

Query_Text_en: But it could be many years before he knows for certain .
Translation: 但他可能要过很多年才能确定。

Query_Text_en: Unlike most other types of cancer , prostate cancer can recur as many as 10 years later , and sometimes even longer than that .
Translation: 与大多数其他类型的癌症不同，前列腺癌可能在长达十年后甚至更久的时间里复发。

Query_Text_en: Choosing among different prostate cancer treatments is a big dilemma in medicine today , and it confronts tens of thousands of men each year .
Translation: 在当今医学领域，如何选择不同的前列腺癌治疗方案是一个重大难题，每年有数以万计的男性面临这一抉择。

Query_Text_en: It is the second biggest cancer killer of men after lung cancer , the risks of which can be lessened significantly by not smoking .
Translation: 它是继肺癌之后男性第二大致死癌症，而通过不吸烟可以显著降低患肺癌的风险。

Query_Text_en: `` Not all men with prostate cancer should receive the same treatment -- and in some cases , no treatment may be the best option , '' say the Prostate Cancer Treatment Guidelines that were published in 1999 by the American Cancer Society and the National Comprehensive Cancer Network .
Translation: “并非所有前列腺癌患者都应接受相同的治疗——在某些情况下，不进行治疗可能是最佳选择。”这是美国癌症协会和国家综合癌症网络于1999年发布的《前列腺癌治疗指南》中提出的观点。

Query_Text_en: Because most prostate tumors are slow growing , men too old or too sick from another ailment may not live long enough to benefit , some younger men may choose to `` watch and wait '' when found to have a very small tumor .
Translation: 由于大多数前列腺肿瘤生长缓慢，年纪较大或因其他疾病身体状况较差的男性可能无法活得足够长，因而无法从治疗中获益；一些较年轻的男性在发现肿瘤很小的时候，可能会选择“观察等待”。

Query_Text_en: Stem cells , formed in the earliest stages of embryo1 development , have the potential for cultivation into any type of tissue or organ because they contain raw , `` unprogrammed '' DNA .
Translation: 干细胞是在胚胎发育的最早阶段形成的，因其含有未经“编程”的原始DNA，具有培养成任何类型组织或器官的潜力。

Query_Text_en: They could be the key to solving Britain 's donor crisis .
Translation: 他们可能是解决英国器官捐献危机的关键。

Query_Text_en: Some scientists believe stem cell harvesting should begin right away as these cells can be deep frozen and survive unharmed for decades .
Translation: 一些科学家认为应该立即开始采集干细胞，因为这些细胞可以深度冷冻，并在数十年内保持完好无损。

Query_Text_en: To avoid harming the immune system , researchers are devising a method of genetically engineering cells to produce different vaccines within the body over time .
Translation: 为避免对免疫系统造成损害，研究人员正在设计一种方法，通过基因工程让细胞在体内随着时间推移产生不同的疫苗。

Query_Text_en: Scientists begin by inserting the genes for different vaccines into cells found in bone marrow called mesenchymal stem cells .
Translation: 科学家首先将不同疫苗的基因导入骨髓中的间充质干细胞。

Query_Text_en: The genes sequentially instruct the cells to produce proteins called antigens on their surfaces that are recognized by defense cells called T-cells .
Translation: 这些基因依次指示细胞在其表面产生被称为抗原的蛋白质，这些抗原能够被名为T细胞的防御细胞识别。

Query_Text_en: This book is about both ancient history and modern science .
Translation: 本书既涉及古代历史，也涵盖现代科学。

Query_Text_en: Though its subject is not Greek mythology , its aim may be freely interpreted as describing the pervasive influence of Terpsichore , the Muse of dance and rhythm , over our lives , and how science , through Galileo 's pendulum , managed to tame that which Euripides called ' measureless and wild ' time .
Translation: 尽管其主题并非希腊神话，但其目的可以自由解读为描述舞蹈与节奏缪斯特尔普西科瑞对我们生活的广泛影响，以及科学如何通过伽利略的钟摆，驯服了欧里庇得斯所称的“无度而狂野”的时间。

Query_Text_en: The periodic motion of that swinging bob exerted a remarkable influence on the development of modern science and mathematics .
Translation: 那个摆球的周期运动对现代科学和数学的发展产生了显著影响。

Query_Text_en: This influence eventually extended over not only our understanding of all the natural phenomena that vary with time but even the way science views the very existence of the material world the particles that make up the objects we touch as well as the light and sound with which we sense our surroundings .
Translation: 这种影响最终不仅扩展到我们对所有随时间变化的自然现象的理解，还影响了科学对物质世界本身存在方式的看法，包括构成我们所接触物体的粒子，以及我们感知周围环境的光和声音。

Query_Text_en: The Greek myth may thus be seen as completed when Terpsichore , with the aid of science , finally deconstructed her father , the powerful Zeus , master of the universe .
Translation: 因此，希腊神话可以被视为在特尔普西科拉借助科学的力量最终解构了她的父亲——宇宙的主宰、强大的宙斯时，才得以完成。

Query_Text_en: I am indebted to two biologists , David Kehoe and Arthur Koch , for discussions and advice on matters in their field of which , as a physicist , I was ignorant .
Translation: 我非常感谢两位生物学家大卫·基霍和阿瑟·科赫，在我作为物理学家对他们领域一无所知的情况下，曾就相关问题与我进行了讨论并给予了宝贵建议。

Query_Text_en: If I still did not get some things quite right , it is entirely my fault and not theirs .
Translation: 如果我还有些地方没有理解正确，那完全是我的责任，与他们无关。

Query_Text_en: My debt also extends to my wife , Ruth , for invaluable editorial assistance .
Translation: 我还要感谢我的妻子露丝，她为我的编辑工作提供了宝贵的帮助。

Query_Text_en: He was seventeen and bored listening to the Mass being celebrated in the cathedral of Pisa .
Translation: 他十七岁，在比萨大教堂里听弥撒时感到无聊。

Query_Text_en: Looking for some object to arrest his attention , the young medical student began to focus on a chandelier high above his head , hanging from a long , thin chain , swinging gently to and fro in the spring breeze .
Translation: 为了寻找能吸引自己注意力的事物，这位年轻的医学生开始专注于头顶高处的一盏吊灯。吊灯悬挂在一条细长的链子上，随着春天的微风轻轻地来回摇摆。

Query_Text_en: How long does it take for the oscillations to repeat themselves , he wondered , timing them with his pulse .
Translation: 他一边用自己的脉搏计时，一边思考这些振荡需要多久才会重复一次。

Query_Text_en: To his astonishment , he found that the lamp took as many pulse beats to complete a swing when hardly moving at all as when the wind made it sway more widely .
Translation: 令他惊讶的是，他发现这盏灯在几乎静止时完成一次摆动所需的脉搏次数，与被风吹得大幅摇摆时所需的脉搏次数竟然相同。

Query_Text_en: The name of the perceptive young man , destined to make other momentous scientific discoveries , was Galileo Galilei .
Translation: 这位敏锐的青年名叫伽利略·伽利莱，他注定将取得其他重大科学发现。

Query_Text_en: The legend of how Galileo discovered the isochronism of the simple pendulum , as told by his biographer Vincenzio Viviani , is apocryphal , but neither the fact that he found it nor the profound effects it had on our civilization in later centuries can be denied .
Translation: 伽利略如何发现单摆等时性的传说，正如他的传记作者温琴佐·维维亚尼所叙述的那样，虽属轶事，但他确实发现了这一现象，以及这一发现对后世文明产生的深远影响，却是不容否认的。

Query_Text_en: This book is about the rhythm of time , how that rhythm was finally regulated by Galileo 's pendulum , the impact the oscillations of the pendulum had on our perception of that rhythm , and how these oscillations were later found to manifest themselves in many other natural phenomena .
Translation: 本书探讨了时间的节奏，以及伽利略的摆钟如何最终规范了这一节奏，摆钟的振荡对我们感知时间节奏产生的影响，以及这些振荡后来被发现同样存在于许多其他自然现象之中。

Query_Text_en: The first three chapters set the stage , describing the rhythms of time as registered before the stabilizing advent of the pendulum swing : the imprinting of the succession of night and day on living organisms , the history of the calendar , characterized by the struggle of civilizations to reconcile the lunar and solar cycles , and the reckoning of shorter time intervals until the Middle Ages .
Translation: 前三章为全书奠定基础，描述了钟摆出现之前时间节律的记录方式：夜与昼的交替如何在生物体上留下印记，历法的发展史——即各文明为协调阴历与阳历所作的努力，以及直到中世纪对较短时间间隔的计量方式。

Query_Text_en: Neither the biological mechanisms that nature employed to implant rhythms in living creatures nor the methods human cultures developed to keep track of the periods imposed on us by the heavens were stable or accurate .
Translation: 无论是自然界赋予生物节律的生物机制，还是人类文化为记录天体所带来的周期而发展出的各种方法，都既不稳定，也不精确。

Query_Text_en: But the former conferred a sufficient adaptive advantage to make them a ubiquitous feature of life , and for eons the latter fulfilled people 's needs adequately .
Translation: 然而，前者带来了足够的适应性优势，使其成为生命中无处不在的特征，而后者则在漫长的岁月里充分满足了人们的需求。

Query_Text_en: After the Renaissance , however , commercial and scientific advances exerted an urgent pressure to measure time more accurately , and the further progress of Western civilization would have been severely hampered without the invention of a stable and steady clock .
Translation: 然而，文艺复兴之后，商业和科学的进步迫切要求更加精确地计量时间，如果没有稳定且精准的时钟发明，西方文明的进一步发展将会受到严重阻碍。

Query_Text_en: Large-scale maritime navigation as well as modern science depended on it .
Translation: 大规模的海上航行以及现代科学都依赖于此。

Query_Text_en: The pendulum and , later , other physically equivalent mechanisms served this purpose admirably .
Translation: 钟摆以及后来其他物理上等效的机制都很好地实现了这一目的。

Query_Text_en: Surprisingly , the physics of the harmonic oscillator that is , Galileo 's pendulum which made it possible to regulate the flow of time , leads far beyond a mere device for making accurate clocks .
Translation: 令人惊讶的是，谐振子物理学——也就是伽利略的摆钟，使时间流动得以调控——不仅仅是制造精确时钟的工具，其意义远远超出了这一用途。

Query_Text_en: These oscillators have been found to be the basis not only of what we hear as the sound of music and see as the colors of light but , via the quantum theory , of what we understand as the fabric of the universe .
Translation: 这些振荡器不仅构成了我们所听到的音乐之声和所看到的光之色彩的基础，而且通过量子理论，成为我们理解宇宙结构的根本。

Query_Text_en: Without oscillators , there would be no particles : no air to breathe , no fluids to sustain life , and no solid matter to form the earth .
Translation: 没有振荡器，就不会有粒子：没有可供呼吸的空气，没有维持生命的液体，也没有构成地球的固体物质。

Query_Text_en: Here is the story of the simplest , yet most fundamental physical system in nature and how it ties the rhythm of time together with our very material existence .
Translation: 这就是自然界中最简单却最基本的物理系统的故事，以及它如何将时间的节奏与我们的物质存在紧密相连。

Query_Text_en: Imagine living on a large chunk of rock hurtling endlessly through space .
Translation: 想象一下，生活在一块不断穿越太空、永不停歇的巨大岩石上。

Query_Text_en: It revolves neither about a central sun nor on its own axis , and it has no satellite circling it . ( Never mind that such a world would lack light and heat to sustain life . ) There are no mornings , no evenings , no summers , no winters , only a monotonous , temporally undifferentiated world .
Translation: 它既不围绕中心太阳旋转，也不自转，且没有任何卫星环绕其周围。（且不论这样的世界缺乏维持生命所需的光和热。）没有清晨，没有傍晚，没有夏天，没有冬天，只有一个单调、时间上毫无差异的世界。

Query_Text_en: The answer may well be no. .
Translation: 答案很可能是否定的。

Query_Text_en: Our entire notion of the passage of time is based on the perception of periodic change , on the repeated transition from day to night the rising and setting of the sun marking the daytime , of the moon visible at night and on the recurrence of the seasons .
Translation: 我们对时间流逝的全部观念，都是建立在对周期性变化的感知之上——白天与黑夜的交替、太阳的升起与落下标志着白昼，夜晚则有月亮高悬，以及四季的循环更替。

Query_Text_en: Time was born of rhythm , and periodicity is part of who we are .
Translation: 时间源于节奏，周期性是我们本质的一部分。

Query_Text_en: Flying his Winnie Mae westward around the world in 1931 , the American aviator Wiley Post is reputed to have been the first to explore and record that bothersome phenomenon we are now all familiar with , jet lag .
Translation: 1931年，美国飞行员怀利·波斯特驾驶他的“温妮·梅”号向西环绕地球飞行，据称他是第一个探索并记录我们如今都熟知的令人困扰的现象——时差反应的人。

Query_Text_en: Observing the effects of time shifts from one longitude to another on the performance of pilots , he is said to have found that the human body can not adjust itself to changing time zones faster than about 2 hours per day .
Translation: 据称，他通过观察飞行员在不同经度间时间变化对其表现的影响，发现人体适应时区变化的速度最快每天只能调整约两小时。

Query_Text_en: How much of his experience was simply the effect of fatigue , however , remains unclear .
Translation: 然而，他的经历中有多少仅仅是疲劳的影响，仍不清楚。

Query_Text_en: Although biological mechanisms do not work with the accuracy or stability of modern clocks , a sense of time and its rhythms is built into the functioning of the human body .
Translation: 尽管生物机制的准确性和稳定性无法与现代时钟相比，但时间感及其节律已内在地融入人体的运作之中。

Query_Text_en: Our heart , with its beating pulse , is the clock-like internal rhythm we are most aware of .
Translation: 我们的心脏及其跳动的脉搏，是我们最为感知的、如钟表般的内部节律。

Query_Text_en: In his discovery of the law of the pendulum , which turned out to have the most profound effect on all later time-measuring devices , Galileo used if legend can be believed his own pulse beat as the test .
Translation: 在发现摆的规律时，伽利略——如果传说可信的话——用自己的脉搏作为测试，这一发现对后来的所有计时装置都产生了深远影响。

Query_Text_en: There are , however , other biological timekeepers with longer periods that also play important roles in our lives .
Translation: 然而，除此之外，还有其他周期更长的生物节律器，同样在我们的生活中发挥着重要作用。

Query_Text_en: While their coordinated rates of progress are autonomous overall , we know that after a few days our inner clocks can be reset and will fall in step with a shifted rhythm ;
Translation: 虽然它们的协调进程总体上是自主的，但我们知道，经过几天后，我们的生物钟可以被重置，并会适应新的节奏。

Query_Text_en: our lack of synchronization with the local time , even after a long flight across the Atlantic or the Pacific , slowly disappears .
Translation: 我们与当地时间的时差感，即使在横跨大西洋或太平洋的长途飞行后，也会逐渐消失。

Query_Text_en: The technical term , introduced in 1959 , for the internal timer that keeps track of this 24-hour periodicity and retains it even in the absence of external cues is the circadian system ( from the Latin circa for ' about ' or ' approximately ' and dies for ' day ' because its period is approximately one day ) .
Translation: 1959年引入的技术术语“昼夜节律系统”，指的是内部计时器，它能够记录这种24小时的周期性，并在没有外部线索的情况下依然保持这一节律。“昼夜节律”一词源自拉丁语，circa意为“约”或“大约”，dies意为“日”，因为其周期大约为一天。

Query_Text_en: Though more or less known to biologists for over two hundred years , this and other biological clocks have been the subject of intensive research during the last half century .
Translation: 虽然生物学家在两百多年前就或多或少地了解了这一生物钟及其他类似机制，但在过去的半个世纪里，这些生物钟才成为深入研究的重点。

Query_Text_en: The first human physiological variables that scientists observed to be governed by a circadian rhythm were pulse rate and body temperature .
Translation: 科学家最早发现受昼夜节律调控的人体生理变量是脉搏和体温。

Query_Text_en: Even while resting in bed and fasting , the deep body temperature of a person varies by almost one degree centigrade between its low in the early morning hours and a high late in the afternoon .
Translation: 即使在卧床休息和禁食的情况下，人体的深层体温在清晨最低和下午晚些时候最高之间，仍会相差近一摄氏度。

Query_Text_en: As discovered more than 150 years ago , the excretions of our kidneys , which regulate the concentrations of vital substances such as salt in our blood , rise and fall in the course of the day .
Translation: 早在150多年前，人们就发现，肾脏的排泄物会在一天之中发生变化，而肾脏正是调节血液中盐等重要物质浓度的器官。

Query_Text_en: More than 100 additional physiological and psychological variables are also subject to diurnal periodicities .
Translation: 还有一百多种其他生理和心理变量也受到昼夜周期的影响。

Query_Text_en: For example , the speed with which children can do computations varies by about 10 percent between its slowest value in the early morning to a high before noon , dropping to a nadir in the early afternoon , rising again to a peak about 6 o'clock in the afternoon , and then falling off in the evening .
Translation: 例如，儿童进行计算的速度在一天中会有所波动：早晨时速度最慢，随后在中午前达到最高值，差异约为10%；下午早些时候降至最低点，傍晚六点左右再次上升至峰值，晚上则又有所下降。

Query_Text_en: This was first measured in 1907 and again a half century later , and both studies came up with similar results .
Translation: 这一现象最早于1907年被测量，半个世纪后又进行了测量，两项研究得出的结果都十分相似。

Query_Text_en: It has not been easy to find the answer .
Translation: 找到答案并非易事。

Query_Text_en: In some cases the suspected extraneous cues , such as possible intruding electric fields that varied in the course of a day , were very subtle , but careful experiments on both human and nonhuman subjects at many scientific laboratories have led to the definite conclusion that our body contains an autonomous timekeeper .
Translation: 在某些情况下，诸如在一天中变化的可能干扰性电场等可疑外部线索非常微妙，但许多科学实验室对人类和非人类受试者进行的细致实验已经得出明确结论：我们体内存在一个自主的计时器。

Query_Text_en: Individuals who volunteered to be kept in total artificial isolation for extended periods , sometimes shut up in caves with no time cues of any kind , helped find the answers .
Translation: 一些志愿者自愿在完全人工隔离的环境中长时间生活，有时甚至被关在没有任何时间线索的洞穴里，这些实验帮助人们找到了答案。

Query_Text_en: some thirty years later , a French speleologist spent two months in a cold cave , 375 feet under ground in the Alps .
Translation: 大约三十年后，一位法国洞穴学家在阿尔卑斯山地下375英尺的寒冷洞穴中度过了两个月。

Query_Text_en: The Frenchman called his above-ground supporters by telephone whenever he ate , went to sleep , and woke , and he recorded in detail his thoughts and impressions of the passage of time .
Translation: 这位法国人在吃饭、睡觉和醒来时，都会通过电话与地面上的支持者联系，并详细记录自己对时间流逝的感受和想法。

Query_Text_en: All such explorers found themselves subject to definite internal time signals .
Translation: 所有这些探险者都发现自己受到明确的内部时间信号的影响。

Query_Text_en: It turned out , however , that the measured period of their bodily variables ( all of which were consistent with one another ) , as well as their subjective impression of the time of day , their periods of sleep and waking , were slightly longer than 25 hours ;
Translation: 然而，结果显示，他们的身体各项指标的周期（彼此之间高度一致）、对一天时间的主观感受、以及睡眠和觉醒的周期，实际上都略长于25小时。

Query_Text_en: by the time they emerged from their prolonged isolation , their internal timer was many hours out of phase with the external 24-hour clock .
Translation: 当他们结束长时间的隔离时，他们的生物钟与外部的24小时制已经相差了好几个小时。

Query_Text_en: Two issues here have to be clearly distinguished : the rate at which the biological clock advances ( which determines the period of its rhythm ) , and the phase of its rhythm at a given time .
Translation: 这里需要明确区分两个问题：一是生物钟推进的速度（决定其节律周期），二是在某一时刻其节律所处的相位。

Query_Text_en: Even an accurate watch worn on a flight from New York to Los Angeles will be three hours out of phase upon arrival and will have to be reset .
Translation: 即使是一块精准的手表，在从纽约飞往洛杉矶的航班上，抵达后也会与当地时间相差三小时，需要重新校准。

Query_Text_en: because its period is longer than that of an accurate reference clock , only repeated resetting will make it show the correct time .
Translation: 由于其周期比精确参考时钟更长，只有反复重置才能使其显示正确时间。

Query_Text_en: In some instances the unrecognized existence of these circadian rhythms has interfered with experiments set up to measure psychological stimulus-response reactions that would not be expected to vary with time .
Translation: 在某些情况下，未能意识到这些昼夜节律的存在，干扰了旨在测量心理刺激—反应关系的实验，而这些反应本不应随时间变化。

Query_Text_en: What is more , because the endogenous rhythm differs somewhat from 24 hours , the interference was not always easy to detect : even repeating an experiment at the same time every day did not necessarily eliminate a systematic error introduced by variations in a subject 's reaction depending on the time of day when the test was performed .
Translation: 此外，由于内源性节律与24小时存在一定差异，这种干扰并不总是容易被察觉：即使每天在同一时间重复实验，也不一定能消除因受试者反应随测试时间不同而产生的系统性误差。

Query_Text_en: When more than one rhythm is at work the external diurnal and the slightly different circadian the result can be quite confusing .
Translation: 当外部的昼夜节律与略有差异的生物节律同时作用时，结果可能会相当混乱。

Query_Text_en: The autonomy of biological clocks is now a well-established fact .
Translation: 生物钟的自主性如今已成为公认的事实。

Query_Text_en: In a person isolated from environmental cues , the human circadian system proceeds at a fairly uniform speed that is longer than the 24-hour day .
Translation: 在没有环境线索干扰的情况下，人体的昼夜节律系统以相当均匀的速度运行，其周期长于24小时。

Query_Text_en: In a person who is not isolated , it is kept synchronous with the cycle of the sun through constant entraining in response to environmental variations mostly variations in light intensity .
Translation: 对于未被隔离的人来说，生理节律通过不断适应环境变化，主要是光强度的变化，与太阳周期保持同步。

Query_Text_en: In other words , though running at a steady rate , our internal clock is slow by about an hour per day , but since it is continually automatically reset by cycles of light and dark , under normal circumstances the loss of time is not cumulative ; our internal clock is thus entrained with the rhythm of the sun .
Translation: 换句话说，尽管我们的生物钟以稳定的速度运行，但每天大约会慢一个小时。然而，由于它会被昼夜交替不断自动校准，在正常情况下，这种时间的损失不会累积，因此我们的生物钟能够与太阳的节律保持同步。

Query_Text_en: Humans , of course , are only one species , and the circadian is only one of the biological rhythms .
Translation: 人类当然只是众多物种中的一种，而昼夜节律也只是众多生物节律中的一种。

Query_Text_en: In addition to the heart beat , some internal timekeepers have shorter periods they are called ultradian such as the 0.1 second period of the electric activity of the brain measured in an elec-troencephalogram ( EEG ) .
Translation: 除了心跳之外，一些体内的节律器周期更短，被称为超昼节律，例如脑电图（EEG）中测得的大脑电活动，其周期为0.1秒。

Query_Text_en: Still others are longer , such as the 28-day menstrual cycle of women and the circannual time-keepers regulating hibernation in bears ; possibly some internal clocks have much longer periods .
Translation: 还有一些周期则更长，比如女性的28天月经周期，以及调节熊类冬眠的周年生物钟；也许某些内部时钟的周期要长得多。

Query_Text_en: Rhythmic behavior appears to be a property of most biological systems .
Translation: 节律行为似乎是大多数生物系统的特性。

Query_Text_en: The synchronized flashing of fireflies displays a short period ( about 1 second but varying from species to species ) .
Translation: 萤火虫的同步闪烁呈现出一个较短的周期（大约1秒，但不同物种之间有所差异）。

Query_Text_en: Male fireflies in Malaysia and New Guinea congregate by the thousands in trees , flashing rhythmically and in unison , producing a spectacular display .
Translation: 马来西亚和新几内亚的雄萤火虫成千上万地聚集在树上，节奏一致地闪烁，形成壮观的景象。

Query_Text_en: Their ultradian periods of bright light emission are found to be self-sustaining and endogenous , but when they congregate in large groups they mutually entrain their flashing to be synchronous .
Translation: 他们明亮光发射的超日节律周期被发现具有自我维持性且源于内在机制，但当它们大量聚集时，会相互影响，使闪光同步。

Query_Text_en: ( Entrainment can also be initiated by a blinking ashlight . )
Translation: （同步现象也可以通过闪烁的手电筒来触发。）

Query_Text_en: In some cases , a behavior that appears to depend on a long-term timing device may actually require only a circadian system .
Translation: 在某些情况下，看似依赖长期计时装置的行为实际上可能只需要昼夜节律系统。

Query_Text_en: The Canadian snowshoe rabbit , for example , whose pelt is brown in the summer and white in the winter , starts changing the color of its coat well before the first snowfall , to take advantage of camoufiage .
Translation: 以加拿大雪鞋兔为例，它的皮毛在夏季呈棕色，冬季则变为白色。为了利用伪装优势，它会在初雪到来之前就开始改变毛色。

Query_Text_en: It recognizes when August comes around not by a circannual clock but by relying on its circadian timer to keep track of the number of hours of daylight as compared with darkness .
Translation: 它并不是依靠年周期时钟来识别八月的到来，而是通过其昼夜节律计时器，记录白昼与黑夜的时长变化来判断。

Query_Text_en: If blindfolded for part of the day in July , it will alter its appearance earlier .
Translation: 如果在七月份的部分时间被蒙上眼睛，它会更早改变其外观。

Query_Text_en: In other mammals , circannual as well as circadian clocks regulate metabolism and reproductive cycles so that enough fat is deposited for the winter and young are born at a season of abundant food supply and favorable weather .
Translation: 在其他哺乳动物中，周年节律和昼夜节律共同调节新陈代谢和繁殖周期，从而确保在冬季来临前积累足够的脂肪，并使幼崽在食物充足、气候适宜的季节出生。

Query_Text_en: In these instances , too , the length of the day helps to entrain the rhythm , even though that rhythm has a much longer period .
Translation: 在这些情况下，尽管该节律的周期要长得多，昼长同样有助于对节律进行同步。

Query_Text_en: Some crabs living in coastal waters have circatidal clocks that keep track of the environmental rhythm most vital for them , the tides .
Translation: 生活在沿海水域的一些螃蟹拥有潮汐生物钟，能够感知对它们最为重要的环境节律——潮汐变化。

Query_Text_en: There are other maritime animals whose spawning and fertility are governed by internal timers geared directly to the cycle of the moon .
Translation: 还有其他海洋动物的产卵和繁殖受内部时钟控制，这些时钟与月亮的周期直接相关。

Query_Text_en: Serious research on circadian timing systems began after a serendipitous observation by the Swiss physician August Forel in 1910 .
Translation: 对昼夜节律系统的严肃研究始于1910年瑞士医生奥古斯特·福雷尔一次偶然的观察。

Query_Text_en: Eating his breakfast on the terrace of his house in the Alps one morning shortly after his arrival for the summer , he noticed that the open jam jar on the table attracted a few bees from a nearby hive .
Translation: 一天早晨，他刚到阿尔卑斯山的住所不久，正在露台上吃早餐时，发现桌上打开的果酱罐吸引了附近蜂巢的几只蜜蜂。

Query_Text_en: On subsequent mornings , however , he was intrigued to see them come just before breakfast was ready , as though they anticipated the arrival of the jam .
Translation: 然而，在接下来的几天早晨，他发现他们总是在早餐准备好之前就来了，似乎是在预料果酱即将送到，这让他感到很有趣。

Query_Text_en: When he then decided to avoid the pesky critters by eating inside , they still came at the appointed time to the table outside , looking for food .
Translation: 当他决定在室内用餐以避开这些讨厌的小动物时，它们仍然在约定的时间来到室外的餐桌前觅食。

Query_Text_en: Since the bees did not visit his house at any other time of day , he concluded they must have a ' memory of time . '
Translation: 由于蜜蜂在一天中的其他时间并未造访他的房屋，他因此得出结论：蜜蜂一定具有“时间记忆”。

Query_Text_en: Some twenty years later , the ethologists Ingeborg Beling and Karl von Frisch conducted systematic observations of individually marked bees that had been offered sugar water for several days at a fixed place and time .
Translation: 大约二十年后，动物行为学家英格博·贝林和卡尔·冯·弗里施对经过单独标记的蜜蜂进行了系统观察，这些蜜蜂在固定的地点和时间连续几天被提供糖水。

Query_Text_en: On the day of observation , when no food was presented , the researchers recorded the arrival of each bee and found a sharp peak during the ' training ' time ( with a slight preference for early arrival ) .
Translation: 在观察当天，研究人员没有提供食物，他们记录了每只蜜蜂的到达时间，发现蜜蜂在“训练”时间段内出现了明显的高峰（并且略微偏向提前到达）。

Query_Text_en: However , this timetraining was successful only when the interval between feedings was 24 hours , or close to it ; it failed for intervals of 19 or 48 hours between feedings .
Translation: 然而，这种时间训练只有在喂食间隔为24小时或接近24小时时才有效；当喂食间隔为19小时或48小时时则无效。

Query_Text_en: To make sure that the bees were not sensing some external cues that the experimenters had missed , Beling conducted some of his experiments in a salt mine , deep under ground .
Translation: 为了确保蜜蜂没有感知到实验人员忽略的某些外部信号，贝林在地下深处的盐矿中进行了一些实验。

Query_Text_en: Max Renner trained bees in his laboratory in France to expect food at 8:15 p.m. but tested them the next day after a transatlantic flight to New York City .
Translation: 马克斯·雷纳在法国的实验室里训练蜜蜂在晚上8点15分期待获得食物，但第二天他将这些蜜蜂带到纽约市，经过一次跨大西洋飞行后对它们进行了测试。

Query_Text_en: There , they looked for their snacks as usual , but at about 8:15 p.m. French time .
Translation: 在那里，他们像往常一样寻找自己的零食，但在法国时间晚上8点15分左右。

Query_Text_en: Hamsters and other rodents turned out to be particularly useful for measuring circadian rhythms in mammals .
Translation: 事实证明，仓鼠等啮齿动物在测量哺乳动物的昼夜节律方面尤其有用。

Query_Text_en: Kept under steady illumination , without any indications of the time of day , in a cage with an exercise wheel in which they could run at will , they would exercise regularly every day at about the same time for very similar periods ;
Translation: 在持续照明、没有任何昼夜时间指示的环境下，被关在带有跑轮的笼子里，可以随意奔跑，它们每天都会在大致相同的时间、以相似的时长规律运动。

Query_Text_en: their feeding and drinking schedules were found to be equally regular .
Translation: 他们的饮食作息同样规律。

Query_Text_en: Such studies have shown that , without any external cues , many circadian ' habits ' persist for very long periods , even for the life of the animal ; others begin to fade earlier .
Translation: 这些研究表明，在没有任何外部提示的情况下，许多昼夜节律的“习惯”能够持续很长时间，甚至贯穿动物的一生；而其他一些则较早开始消退。

Query_Text_en: Until the middle of the twentieth century , the remarkable ability of migratory birds to navigate over long distances was regarded as a great mystery .
Translation: 直到二十世纪中叶，候鸟能够进行长距离迁徙的非凡导航能力仍被视为一个巨大的谜团。

Query_Text_en: Now we know that it is based at least in part on their circadian system .
Translation: 现在我们知道，这至少在一定程度上是基于他们的昼夜节律系统。

Query_Text_en: The Pacific golden plover manages to find its way over 2,000 miles of ocean from the Aleutians to Hawaii in the fall and back in the spring .
Translation: 太平洋金鸻每年秋季能够从阿留申群岛飞越两千多英里海洋抵达夏威夷，春季再飞回原地。

Query_Text_en: in the afternoon , on the right .
Translation: 下午，在右侧。

Query_Text_en: The zoologist Gustav Kramer was the first to demonstrate that birds are able to keep track of where the sun should be , depending on the time of day .
Translation: 动物学家古斯塔夫·克雷默是首位证明鸟类能够根据一天中的时间判断太阳应在位置的人。

Query_Text_en: He observed that during the migrating season most starlings in his circular aviary , which was lit by the sun through slits in the walls , would perch facing the direction in which they would have migrated if free .
Translation: 他观察到，在候鸟迁徙季节，大多数被关在圆形鸟舍中的椋鸟会面向它们如果自由时将要迁徙的方向栖息。这个鸟舍通过墙上的缝隙让阳光照射进来。

Query_Text_en: When , by means of mirrors , he suddenly changed the direction of illumination , the birds would change their direction of perch accordingly , thereby showing that they use the sun as their guide .
Translation: 当他通过镜子突然改变照明方向时，鸟儿也会相应地改变栖息的方向，从而表明它们以太阳为导航。

Query_Text_en: But when the direction of the sun 's illumination changed very gradually in the course of the day , it had no effect on them ; their circadian clock allowed them to adjust for the sun 's movement .
Translation: 但当天光照射的方向在一天中逐渐变化时，这对它们没有影响；它们的生物钟能够让它们适应太阳的移动。

Query_Text_en: Other migrating birds were found to be able to navigate not only by the sun but even by the stars at night , again by using their built-in timer .
Translation: 研究发现，其他候鸟不仅能够依靠太阳导航，甚至还能在夜间利用星星导航，这同样得益于它们体内自带的“计时器”。

Query_Text_en: That 's how whitethroated warblers navigate their flight annually in the fall from northern Europe across the Adriatic Sea and the Mediterranean to Egypt and back in the spring ;
Translation: 这正是白喉莺每年秋季从北欧飞越亚得里亚海和地中海前往埃及，并在春季返回时所采用的导航方式。

Query_Text_en: during cloudy nights they become confused .
Translation: 在多云的夜晚，它们会变得迷失方向。

Query_Text_en: Certain species of ants , too , have been discovered to find their way every day to the same foraging spot by using the direction of the sun in conjunction with a circadian clock .
Translation: 有些蚂蚁种类也被发现能够每天利用太阳的方向和生物钟的配合，找到同一个觅食地点。

Query_Text_en: If enclosed in a dark box , they lose their orientation , but upon release into the sunny open , they quickly find their previous direction and continue on their way , even though the sun has meanwhile moved .
Translation: 如果被关在黑暗的盒子里，它们会失去方向感，但一旦被释放到阳光明媚的户外，它们很快就能重新找到先前的方向并继续前行，尽管此时太阳已经发生了移动。

Query_Text_en: Internal timing systems exist in plants as well .
Translation: 植物内部也存在时间调节系统。

Query_Text_en: That many plants react to the time of day by opening or closing their leaves or blossoms has been known for a long time .
Translation: 许多植物会根据一天中的时间开合叶片或花朵，这一现象早已为人所知。

Query_Text_en: Androsthenes , one of Alexander the Great 's generals on his march to India , recorded that the leaves of the tamarind trees he saw there opened in the morning and folded up at night .
Translation: 亚历山大大帝东征印度时的一位将领安德罗斯忒涅斯曾记载，他在当地看到的罗望子树，其树叶清晨展开，夜晚则合拢。

Query_Text_en: Most gardeners have noticed that some flowers close up their petals in the evening and reopen them at dawn or later , while the daylily opens a new bloom every morning .
Translation: 大多数园艺爱好者都注意到，有些花卉在傍晚会合拢花瓣，到了清晨或稍晚时分又重新绽放，而萱草每天早晨都会开放一朵新花。

Query_Text_en: The great eighteenth-century botanist Carolus Linnaeus designed a timekeeping flowerbed , with specially arranged species of flowers whose blossoms would open at specific times of the day ( see Figure 1 ) .
Translation: 伟大的十八世纪植物学家卡尔·林奈设计了一座计时花坛，精心排列了不同种类的花卉，使其花朵在一天中特定的时间开放（见图1）。

Query_Text_en: The circadian timer in bees presumably coevolved to enable them , without the need for external cues from a visible sun , to visit their favorite flowers for nectar at times when their blossoms were open , so as not to waste energy on unnecessary scouting .
Translation: 蜜蜂的昼夜节律计时器很可能是与其生态需求共同进化的，使它们即使在没有可见阳光等外部线索的情况下，也能在花朵开放时准确前往自己偏爱的花朵采集花蜜，从而避免因不必要的侦查而浪费能量。

Query_Text_en: To find the answer , the French astronomer Jean-Jacques De Mairan performed experiments on mimosa trees , which , like the Indian tamarind tree , fold up their leaves in the evening and reopen them in the morning .
Translation: 为寻找答案，法国天文学家让-雅克·德梅朗对含羞草进行了实验。这种植物与印度罗望子树一样，傍晚时会合拢叶片，清晨又重新展开。

Query_Text_en: even in total darkness ( he kept them shut up in a dark room for lengthy periods of time ) it would open its leaves and fold them more or less at the same time as the onset of day and night , respectively .
Translation: 即使在完全黑暗的环境中（他曾长时间将它们关在黑暗的房间里），它仍会在白天和夜晚开始时分别张开和合拢叶片，时间大致相同。

Query_Text_en: While its rhythm was not entirely independent of the external diurnal cycle , the plant did keep , at least for a while , an imprint of the daily change of light with which it matured .
Translation: 虽然植物的节律并非完全独立于外部的昼夜循环，但它确实在成熟过程中，至少在一段时间内，保留了每日光照变化的印记。

Query_Text_en: During the nineteenth century , the study of the daily leaf movements of plants was taken up by the botanists Francis Darwin ( third son of Charles ) , William Pfeffer , and Julius von Sachs ( the latter two in Germany ) , as well as their students and collaborators .
Translation: 19世纪期间，植物日常叶片运动的研究由植物学家弗朗西斯·达尔文（查尔斯·达尔文的三子）、威廉·佩弗尔和尤利乌斯·冯·萨克斯（后两位在德国）以及他们的学生和合作者开展。

Query_Text_en: For many years the circadian internal clock of plants , like that of animals , was considered quite mysterious , but after much research over the last half century , pioneered by the German biologist Erwin B nning , its existence is now well established and many of its components have been isolated .
Translation: 多年来，植物的昼夜节律生物钟与动物一样一直被认为相当神秘。然而，经过过去半个世纪的大量研究，尤其是在德国生物学家欧文·本宁的开创性工作下，植物生物钟的存在如今已被充分证实，其诸多组成部分也已被分离出来。

Query_Text_en: Like animals , plants have endogenous cycles of various durations .
Translation: 与动物一样，植物也具有不同周期的内源性循环。

Query_Text_en: For example , as though in preparation for the coming winter , many plants seem to have an internal circannual timer that enables them to anticipate the onset of the cold season and harden their cells so as to survive a sudden frost .
Translation: 例如，许多植物似乎拥有一种内部的周年生物钟，仿佛在为即将到来的冬季做准备，使它们能够预先感知寒冷季节的到来，并通过强化细胞结构来抵御突如其来的霜冻。

Query_Text_en: As in the case of the snowshoe rabbit , often this apparently circannual timing is , in reality , a response to the length of day , measured by means of a circadian clock .
Translation: 就像雪鞋兔的情况一样，这种看似一年周期的时间安排实际上往往是对日照长度的反应，而日照长度则是通过昼夜节律钟来测量的。

Query_Text_en: These internal rhythms are either inherited or learned from external stimuli , but they persist for various lengths of time after the latter are removed , and their periods do not vary with ambient temperature .
Translation: 这些内部节律要么是遗传的，要么是通过外部刺激习得的，但即使外部刺激消失后，这些节律仍会持续不同的时间，并且其周期不会因环境温度的变化而改变。

Query_Text_en: In order to remain synchronous with the outside world , however , the internal clock has to be entrained and regularly reset by light cues .
Translation: 然而，为了与外部世界保持同步，生物体的内部时钟必须通过光照信号进行调节并定期重置。

Query_Text_en: Though rhythmic temperature changes also work in some instances , the cues that serve to entrain most biological clocks these are called zeitgebers ( timegivers ) by physiologists seem to be varying levels of light intensity .
Translation: 虽然在某些情况下，节律性的温度变化也能发挥作用，但能够同步大多数生物钟的线索——生理学家称之为“时间给予者”（zeitgebers）——主要是光强度的变化。

Query_Text_en: This is hardly surprising , as the origin of the diurnal rhythm of our life is the experience of the succession of day by night ; that environmental fact must have been of key importance in the evolution of the internal timing mechanism .
Translation: 这并不令人意外，因为我们生活中昼夜节律的起源正是白天与黑夜交替的体验；这一环境事实在内部计时机制的进化过程中必然起到了关键作用。

Query_Text_en: The process of entrainment is not necessarily a sudden , discontinuous resetting of the clock , however .
Translation: 然而，同步过程并不一定是对生物钟的突然、不连续的重置。

Query_Text_en: In many instances it is , after an instantaneous initiation , a gradual change from an old phase to a new one , like the slow turning of the hands of a clock by an external agent , without altering its intrinsic period , that is , without causing it to go faster or slower from that point on .
Translation: 在许多情况下，这种变化是在瞬间启动后，逐步从旧阶段过渡到新阶段，就像外部力量缓慢转动钟表的指针一样，但并不改变其固有周期，也就是说，从那一刻起并不会让钟表走得更快或更慢。

Query_Text_en: Remarkably enough , circadian rhythms exist even in the simplest biological organisms , such as the single-celled blue-green algae ( cyanobacteria ) , in which an internal clock paces the 24-hour cycles of nitrogen oxation and photosynthesis .
Translation: 令人惊讶的是，昼夜节律甚至存在于最简单的生物体中，比如单细胞的蓝绿藻（又称为 cyanobacteria），其内部时钟调控着氮氧化和光合作用的24小时周期。

Query_Text_en: The cycles serve to separate these two processes in time , which is crucial for their proper functioning because the presence of oxygen a product of photosynthesis interferes with nitrogen fixation .
Translation: 这些循环的作用是将这两个过程在时间上分开，这对于它们的正常运行至关重要，因为光合作用产生的氧气会干扰固氮过程。

Query_Text_en: The marine dino . agellate Gonyaulax polyedra is a single-celled bioluminescent alga that exists in very large quantities in coastal waters off the West Coast of North America .
Translation: 海洋甲藻多甲藻（Gonyaulax polyedra）是一种单细胞发光藻类，在北美西海岸近海水域中大量存在。

Query_Text_en: Bioluminescence is a chemical process in which an enzyme , luciferase , oxidizes a luciferin molecule , producing a new molecule at a higher energy state , which subsequently descends to its ground state , emitting a light quantum .
Translation: 生物发光是一种化学过程，在该过程中，酶——荧光素酶催化荧光素分子的氧化反应，生成处于较高能量状态的新分子，该分子随后回到基态，并释放出一个光量子。

Query_Text_en: Gonyaulax exhibits two kinds of luminescence : a low-intensity steady glow that varies rhythmically , peaking near the approach of dawn , and a much brighter rhythmic flash , at its maximum near midnight , that requires an external disturbance to set it off .
Translation: 冈尼藻表现出两种类型的发光：一种是低强度的持续微光，呈节律性变化，在接近黎明时达到峰值；另一种则是亮度更高的节律性闪光，在午夜前后最为强烈，但需要外部扰动才能触发。

Query_Text_en: In addition , Gonyaulax also has other circadian rhythms , including one which causes a sharp spike in cell division at dawn , and another spike in its photosynthetic capacity .
Translation: 此外，甲藻还具有其他昼夜节律，包括清晨细胞分裂的急剧高峰，以及光合作用能力的另一次高峰。

Query_Text_en: but under normal conditions it has a distinct diurnal periodicity , maintaining all of its rhythms for weeks when under steady , dim illumination .
Translation: 但在正常条件下，它具有明显的昼夜周期性，即使在持续、微弱的照明下，也能数周保持其所有节律。

Query_Text_en: In total darkness , with its photosynthesis at a stand-still , it quickly loses all its rhythms but regains them at their previous pace when photosynthesis is restored by a short , intense flash of light .
Translation: 在完全黑暗中，光合作用停止后，它很快失去所有节律；但当通过一次短暂而强烈的光照恢复光合作用时，这些节律又会以原有的速度恢复。

Query_Text_en: Surprising as it may seem , this simple organism , consisting of a single cell , can thus sustain many independent circadian and other rhythms .
Translation: 令人惊讶的是，这种由单个细胞组成的简单生物，竟然能够维持多种独立的昼夜节律及其他节律。

Query_Text_en: Indeed , it has been demonstrated that the timers contained in single cells govern even the biological periodicities of large , complicated organs such as the human heart , whose ongoing rhythm keeps us alive .
Translation: 事实上，已有研究表明，单个细胞内的定时器甚至能够调控大型复杂器官（如维持我们生命的人体心脏）的生物节律。

Query_Text_en: Some forty years ago , Isaac Harary at the University of California in Los Angeles invented a process to separate the cells of a rat 's heart and keep them alive in a nutrient medium .
Translation: 大约四十年前，加利福尼亚大学洛杉矶分校的艾萨克·哈拉里发明了一种将大鼠心脏细胞分离并在营养液中维持其存活的方法。

Query_Text_en: Examining them under a microscope , he found that some of these single cells were still beating at the old rhythm , all on their own .
Translation: 在显微镜下观察时，他发现其中一些单个细胞依然以原有的节奏自主跳动。

Query_Text_en: What is perhaps most surpris-ing is that even some single-celled bacteria that divide and multiply once every 16 hours manage to pass along identical copies of their 24-hour clocks , running and in phase , to their off-spring !
Translation: 令人颇感意外的是，即便是一些每16小时分裂繁殖一次的单细胞细菌，也能将运行且同步的24小时生物钟的完全复制品传递给它们的后代！

Query_Text_en: Almost every gene in these organisms is controlled by their circadian system .
Translation: 这些生物体内几乎每一个基因都受其昼夜节律系统的调控。

Query_Text_en: In many birds , circadian rhythms appear to be controlled by the pineal gland , which Descartes thought was the seat of the soul in humans .
Translation: 在许多鸟类中，昼夜节律似乎由松果体控制，而笛卡尔曾认为松果体是人类灵魂的所在。

Query_Text_en: This photosensitive organ rhythmically produces the hormone melatonin , which signals the gland 's activity to other parts of the body , even in vitro .
Translation: 这个感光器官有节律地分泌褪黑激素，这种激素能够将该腺体的活动信号传递到身体的其他部位，即使在体外也是如此。

Query_Text_en: When cultured in an environment with 12 hours of light and 12 hours of darkness and then transferred to one with constant illumination , pineal tissue will continue emitting cyclically varying amounts of melatonin for several days .
Translation: 在12小时光照和12小时黑暗的环境中培养后，松果体组织在转移到持续照明的环境下，仍会持续数天周期性地分泌不同量的褪黑激素。

Query_Text_en: What is more , when pineal tissue was transplanted from one bird to another bird whose pineal gland had been removed , the new host not only regained the circadian rhythms it had previously lost , but the phase of its newly acquired rhythms was that of the donor : the host acted as if it lived in the donor 's time zone .
Translation: 此外，当将松果体组织从一只鸟移植到另一只已被切除松果体的鸟体内时，新的宿主不仅重新获得了此前失去的昼夜节律，而且其新获得的节律相位与供体一致：宿主的行为仿佛生活在供体的时区。

Query_Text_en: Even pieces of the gland in vitro will for some time continue to produce melatonin at a rhythmic rate .
Translation: 即使在体外，腺体的部分组织也能在一段时间内以有节律的速度持续产生褪黑激素。

Query_Text_en: On the other hand , in mammals , including humans , the primary central pacemakers of most , though not all , of these rhythms are the two clusters of nerve cell bodies called the suprachiasmatic nuclei ( SCN ) , located in the hypothalamus just above the optic chiasm behind the retina .
Translation: 另一方面，在包括人类在内的哺乳动物中，这些节律的主要中枢起搏器（虽然并非全部）是位于下丘脑、视网膜后方视交叉上方的两个神经元细胞团，称为视交叉上核（SCN）。

Query_Text_en: The SCN are able to generate rhythms on their own , without any kind of light cues .
Translation: 视交叉上核能够自主产生节律，无需任何光照信号。

Query_Text_en: Newborn rats , for example , kept in total darkness , exhibit a distinct circadian rhythm even on their first day of life .
Translation: 例如，刚出生的小鼠即使被置于完全黑暗的环境中，在生命的第一天也会表现出明显的昼夜节律。

Query_Text_en: Under normal operations , however , the SCN are synchronized with the day-night cycle of their surroundings , the entrainment paths being visual projections directly from the retina .
Translation: 然而，在正常运作情况下，SCN会与其所处环境的昼夜周期保持同步，其同步路径是来自视网膜的直接视觉投射。

Query_Text_en: In fact , it has very recently been discovered that the eye contains special photo sensors , not used for vision , connected directly to the SCN , enabling even some people who are blind to entrain their circadian rhythm .3 In addition , the hypothalamus also contains another , distinct ultradian pacemaker that regulates the release of a follicle-stimulating hormone every hour a circhoral clock .
Translation: 事实上，最近的研究发现，眼睛中存在特殊的光感受器，这些感受器并不用于视觉，而是直接与视交叉上核（SCN）相连，使部分盲人也能够调整他们的昼夜节律。此外，下丘脑还包含另一种独立的超昼夜节律调节器，负责每小时释放促卵泡激素，这被称为环小时钟。

Query_Text_en: Many separate circadian oscillators have now been found scattered throughout the body , to regulate local rhythms in behavior and physiological functioning .
Translation: 目前已发现许多独立的昼夜节律振荡器分布在全身各处，调节行为和生理功能的局部节律。

Query_Text_en: These timers can maintain their rhythms by themselves for only a few days and are constantly entrained by signals from the master clock , the SCN .
Translation: 这些生物钟自身只能维持节律几天，需不断通过来自主时钟——视交叉上核（SCN）的信号进行同步。

Query_Text_en: The question of whether the rhythms of the many kinds of biological clocks found in organisms are imprinted on them by external signals early in life or , instead , are genetically determined has been answered by detailed experiments , particularly those performed on the ubiquitous fruit fly .
Translation: 关于生物体内多种生物钟节律究竟是在生命早期由外部信号赋予，还是由基因决定的问题，已经通过详细的实验得到了答案，尤其是对常见的果蝇所进行的实验。

Query_Text_en: Drosophila melanogaster has two relatively stable circadian systems , one regulating its rest-activity cycle and another governing the times of day at which their young emerge from their pupae .
Translation: 果蝇拥有两套相对稳定的昼夜节律系统，一套调节其休息-活动周期，另一套则控制幼虫从蛹中孵化的时间。

Query_Text_en: In 1979 R. J. Konopka produced mutants that had no periodicity at all , others that had short periods of about 19 hours , and still others that had periods as long as 28 hours .
Translation: 1979年，R. J. Konopka培育出了完全没有周期性的突变体，还有一些突变体的周期约为19小时，另一些则长达28小时。

Query_Text_en: Each mutant differed by a single gene ( thereafter named per ) from the standard laboratory fruit fly ( the ' wild type ' ) .
Translation: 每个突变体与标准实验室果蝇（即“野生型”）仅在一个基因（此后称为per基因）上存在差异。

Query_Text_en: Geneticists also studied the fungus Neuro-spora , whose production of spores is governed by a circadian system .
Translation: 遗传学家还研究了真菌神经孢霉，其孢子的产生受昼夜节律系统调控。

Query_Text_en: Mutants exhibited a range of different periods ; in a mixture of cells with various mutants as well as wild types , the length of the circadian period turned out to be proportional to the percentage of nuclei with mutant genes .
Translation: 突变体表现出不同的周期长度；在含有多种突变体和野生型细胞的混合群体中，昼夜节律周期的长度与携带突变基因细胞核的比例成正比。

Query_Text_en: In this case , there was no unique genetic locus that determined the length of the circadian period in a population .
Translation: 在这种情况下，并不存在决定群体昼夜节律周期长度的唯一遗传位点。

Query_Text_en: That chemistry alone is capable of producing rhythmic behavior has been known since 1950 , when the Russian chemist Boris Belousov discovered what has come to be called the Belousov-Zhabotinsky reaction , which produces rhythmically changing waves that separate reaction products of different colors ( see Figure 2 ) .
Translation: 早在1950年，人们就已知化学反应本身能够产生节律性行为。当时，俄罗斯化学家鲍里斯·别洛乌索夫发现了后来被称为别洛乌索夫-扎博京斯基反应的现象，该反应能够产生有节奏变化的波动，将不同颜色的反应产物分隔开来（见图2）。

Query_Text_en: In plants , the clock mechanism has to be of an analogous purely biochemical nature .
Translation: 在植物中，生物钟机制必须具有类似的纯生化特性。

Query_Text_en: Indeed , experiments performed on the energy metabolism of yeast cells fermenting in suspension have shown that when the metabolic steady state is perturbed by the addition of a substrate , their fermenting energy production called glycolysis begins to oscillate with a period of several minutes , and these variations in glycolysis can then be studied in vitro in a cell-free preparation , with nothing at work to engender them but chemistry .
Translation: 事实上，对悬浮发酵酵母细胞能量代谢的实验表明，当通过添加底物扰动其代谢稳态时，其发酵能量产生过程——即糖酵解——会开始以数分钟为周期发生振荡，而这些糖酵解的变化随后可以在无细胞体系中进行体外研究，此时只有化学反应在起作用。

Query_Text_en: The observed oscillatory behavior is the typical consequence of what engineers call a feedback mechanism : the enzyme doing the glycolysis , converting fructose-6-phos-phate ( F-6-P ) to fructose-diphosphate ( FDP ) , is itself activated by FDP .
Translation: 所观察到的振荡行为是工程师所称的反馈机制的典型结果：负责糖酵解、将果糖-6-磷酸（F-6-P）转化为果糖二磷酸（FDP）的酶，正是由FDP激活的。

Query_Text_en: Thus , when the glycolysis begins to produce FDP , it is stimulated and accelerates , diminishing the concentration of the original F-6-P , thereby inhibiting further FDP production and slowing the fermentation until , after a considerable delay , the F-6-P has been replenished by newly arriving stock .
Translation: 因此，当糖酵解开始产生FDP时，其过程受到刺激并加速，导致原有的F-6-P浓度下降，从而抑制了进一步的FDP生成，使发酵速度减慢，直到经过相当长的延迟，F-6-P才因新到的原料补充而恢复。

Query_Text_en: At the right concentration and metabolic flow , the levels of both F-6-P and FDP will , as a result , change rhythmically , each with the same period but out of phase , with F-6-P low when FDP is high , and vice versa .
Translation: 在适当的浓度和代谢流条件下，F-6-P和FDP的水平会因此呈现有节奏的变化，两者周期相同但相位相反：当F-6-P含量较低时，FDP含量较高，反之亦然。

Query_Text_en: ( The delay caused by the slowness of the biochemical pro-cesses involved is crucial in producing the rhythmic changes in concentration rather than a quick relaxation into equilibrium , as it would without the time lag . ) Choosing appropri-ate enzymes , concentrations , and flow rates in a system without any cells , biologists have been able to achieve meta-bolic oscillations with 24-hour periods circadian rhythms by purely chemical means .
Translation: 由于生化过程的缓慢导致的延迟，对于产生浓度的周期性变化至关重要，否则如果没有时间滞后，系统会迅速趋于平衡。生物学家通过在无细胞系统中选择合适的酶、浓度和流速，仅凭化学方法就能够实现具有24小时周期的代谢振荡，即昼夜节律。

Query_Text_en: A similar feedback mechanism has been found to produce the circadian rhythm in Droso-phila , only in this case the places of F-6-P and FDP are taken by the PER protein produced by the per gene and the messenger RNA it synthesizes , as well as several other pro-teins .
Translation: 类似的反馈机制也被发现能够在果蝇中产生昼夜节律，只不过在这种情况下，F-6-P和FDP的位置由per基因产生的PER蛋白及其合成的信使RNA，以及其他几种蛋白质所取代。

Query_Text_en: ( Though the principles of the mechanism are the same , the proteins involved in producing the biological clock in the cyanobacteria are quite different from those in Drosophila , from which we may conclude that circadian systems are unlikely to have evolved from a single common ancestor . )
Translation: 尽管其机制原理相同，但参与蓝藻生物钟形成的蛋白质与果蝇中的蛋白质有很大不同，因此我们可以推断，昼夜节律系统不太可能源自同一个共同祖先。

Query_Text_en: The outcome of such feedback is often described by a limit cycle , in which the plot of the amount of one of the reagents against that of the other approaches the same closed curve more and more closely , no matter where they started out ( see Figure 3 ) .
Translation: 这种反馈的结果通常被描述为极限环，即无论初始状态如何，将一种反应物的数量与另一种反应物的数量作图后，其轨迹都会越来越接近同一条封闭曲线（见图3）。

Query_Text_en: The concentrations of the two substances then perform a dance , each varying from high to low with a fixed rhythm .
Translation: 两种物质的浓度随后开始交替变化，以固定的节奏一高一低，仿佛在跳舞。

Query_Text_en: The mechanism responsible for generating the cyclic behavior of a much more structured and complicated organ such as the SCN is not yet well understood and remains an important subject for continuing research .
Translation: 负责产生像视交叉上核这样结构更为复杂的器官周期性行为的机制，目前尚未被充分理解，仍然是持续研究的重要课题。

Query_Text_en: There are indications that the latter is the case .
Translation: 有迹象表明，情况确实如此。

Query_Text_en: In vitro , even individual neurons of the SCN retain their circadian rhythms for many days running , but collaborative effects may be involved as well .
Translation: 在体外条件下，即使是下丘脑视交叉上核的单个神经元也能持续数日保持其昼夜节律，但协同作用也可能参与其中。

Query_Text_en: As mentioned earlier , there are also partially autonomous circadian pacemakers in the body which are constantly entrained by the SCN , but the signaling mechanisms are still not fully known .
Translation: 如前所述，人体内还存在部分自主的昼夜节律起搏器，这些起搏器持续受到视交叉上核的调节，但其具体的信号传导机制尚未完全明了。

Query_Text_en: One thing , however , can be stated with certainty : even though the literature frequently refers to the endogenous rhythmic behavior of many biological systems as ' oscillatory , ' no physical oscillators are present in any of them , which is the fundamental reason why these living clocks are able to tell time only circa and never with complete accuracy .
Translation: 然而，有一点可以确定：尽管文献中常常将许多生物系统的内源性节律行为称为“振荡”，但实际上这些系统中并不存在任何物理振荡器，这正是这些生物钟只能大致计时而无法完全精确的根本原因。

Query_Text_en: There would , however , have been no adaptive advantage for organisms to produce a clock of greater stability , even if that had been possible .
Translation: 然而，即使具备条件，生物体制造一个更为稳定的生物钟也不会带来适应性优势。

Query_Text_en: Mechanisms requiring daily entrainment have served quite satisfactorily for eons .
Translation: 需要每日同步的机制在漫长岁月中一直运作得相当令人满意。

Query_Text_en: In the next chapter , we will turn outward , away from biological systems to the various elaborate designs that human cultures have invented to record the passage of time , from the calendar to the watch with a second hand .
Translation: 在下一章，我们将视角转向外部，离开生物系统，探讨人类文化为记录时间流逝而创造的各种精巧设计，从日历到带有秒针的手表。

Query_Text_en: Long after unreliable timing devices had been in use for millennia , the pendulum was discovered to be an unfailing instrument when the need for real stability and accuracy in the measuring of time finally arose .
Translation: 在不可靠的计时装置已被使用了数千年之后，随着对计时真正稳定性和准确性的需求最终出现，摆被发现是一种极为可靠的计时工具。

Query_Text_en: Whether early humans were consciously aware of the continuous flow of time is of course impossible to tell , but it appears that this notion was firmly in place by the time civilization arose .
Translation: 早期人类是否有意识地感知到时间的连续流动，当然无法确定，但可以看出，这一观念在文明兴起时已经牢固确立。

Query_Text_en: Early civilizations had three good reasons to make use of the rhythmic nature of their experience of time : to measure the duration of a given process , such as the length of travel time from one place to another , to calculate how long ago certain memorable events took place , and to specify the now , as well as a future now , for ordering their lives and their relations to others .
Translation: 早期文明有三个充分理由利用他们对时间节奏性的体验：一是用于衡量某一过程的持续时间，比如从一个地方到另一个地方的旅行时间；二是用于计算某些值得纪念的事件发生距今多久；三是用于界定“现在”以及未来的“现在”，以便安排自己的生活和与他人的关系。

Query_Text_en: For the first purpose , simple comparisons were initially sufficient : your voyage will take twice as long as it takes to travel from Shiraz to Isphahan .
Translation: 对于第一个目的，最初只需进行简单的比较：你的旅程将是从设拉子到伊斯法罕所需时间的两倍。

Query_Text_en: But as civilization advanced , it became necessary to divide a time interval into several equal parts .
Translation: 但随着文明的发展，将时间间隔划分为若干相等部分变得必要。

Query_Text_en: When sailors on board ship or soldiers at an army camp had to take turns at night manning the watch , such duties were surely expected to be of more or less equal duration .
Translation: 当船上的水手或军营中的士兵在夜间轮流值守时，这些值班任务理应时长大致相等。

Query_Text_en: For the second purpose , early civilizations employed the simple counting of universally recognized recurring events : the disaster happened 10 floodings of the Nile ago ; we have had three new moons since your father left .
Translation: 为实现第二个目的，早期文明采用了对普遍公认的周期性事件进行简单计数的方法：比如说，这场灾难发生在尼罗河洪水十次之前；自你父亲离开以来，我们已经经历了三个新月。

Query_Text_en: The need for telling the time of year must have arisen first among hunter-gatherers .
Translation: 对季节时间的认知需求最早应当出现在狩猎采集者中。

Query_Text_en: With the advent of agriculture , however , plowing , planting , and harvesting had to occur at the proper times , and it was no accident that the calendar was invented in those civilizations where farming first evolved .
Translation: 然而，随着农业的出现，耕地、播种和收获都必须在适当的时间进行，因此，历法的发明并非偶然，而是在最早发展出农业的文明中诞生的。

Query_Text_en: As the need for such arcane knowledge of the proper seasons increased , so did the power and mystery of those who were able to provide it .
Translation: 随着对正确时节等深奥知识的需求不断增长，能够提供这些知识的人也变得愈发神秘且权力日益增强。

Query_Text_en: Since the sun , moon , and stars had already been imbued with religious and superstitious significance for millennia , early astronomy and the construction of a calendar based on it were intimately associated with the practice of religion , and the keepers and purveyors of the mysteriously acquired information were the priests , who jealously guarded their sources .
Translation: 由于太阳、月亮和星辰几千年来一直被赋予宗教和迷信的意义，早期天文学及其基础上的历法制定与宗教实践密不可分，而掌握并传播这些神秘知识的人正是祭司，他们对信息来源严加保密。

Query_Text_en: The construction of Stonehenge some 3,500 years ago thus served both a religious and a practical purpose .
Translation: 大约3500年前，巨石阵的建造既具有宗教意义，也具有实际用途。

Query_Text_en: Even as the agricultural need for a calendar advanced the power of the priests , so the religious requirements of placating the gods and showing them proper respect by observing a regular schedule of feast days further strengthened the desire to have a rigidly ordered calendar .
Translation: 农业对历法的需求提升了祭司的权力，而通过定期举行节日以安抚神灵并表达敬意的宗教要求，又进一步强化了对严格有序历法的渴望。

Query_Text_en: After all , the movements of the heavenly bodies appeared to be the only regular and predictable activities of the otherwise capricious and willful gods .
Translation: 毕竟，在那些反复无常、任性妄为的诸神中，唯有天体的运行显得规律而可预测。

Query_Text_en: Thus , astrology developed into astronomy , which became the incubator of mathematics .
Translation: 因此，占星术发展为天文学，进而成为孕育数学的温床。

Query_Text_en: ( Under Roman law , astrologers were called ' the mathematicians . ' )
Translation: 在罗马法律下，占星师被称为“数学家”。

Query_Text_en: With all those scary microbes out there , it 's hard to get worked up over a toenail fungus or a case of athlete 's foot .
Translation: 面对外界那些令人担忧的微生物，人们很难对脚趾甲真菌或香港脚这样的问题感到紧张。

Query_Text_en: But the fungi that cause these and dozens of other infections are not as trivial as they may seem .
Translation: 然而，引发这些以及其他数十种感染的真菌，并不像看起来那样无足轻重。

Query_Text_en: Fungi have a way of turning nasty -- seeping into the bloodstream and invading vital organs .
Translation: 真菌具有变得危险的特性——它们能够渗入血液，侵袭重要器官。

Query_Text_en: However , as anyone who has wrestled with a persistent case of athlete 's foot knows , it 's not easy to root out a fungus once it 's taken hold .
Translation: 然而，任何曾经与顽固脚气作斗争的人都知道，一旦真菌侵入，要彻底根除并非易事。

Query_Text_en: Merck is expected to get FDA 's approval this year for a novel class of antifungals derived from Spanish soil .
Translation: 默克预计今年将获得美国食品药品监督管理局（FDA）批准，其新型抗真菌药物源自西班牙土壤。

Query_Text_en: But the real hopes for the long term are pinned to molecular biologists ;
Translation: 但真正的长期希望寄托在分子生物学家身上。

Query_Text_en: they are best equipped to identify targets unique to fungi and to design drugs that will attack them and them alone .
Translation: 他们最有能力识别真菌特有的靶点，并设计只针对这些靶点的药物。

Query_Text_en: Tiny biotech companies and huge pharmaceutical firms alike are working on drugs that will kill off fungi by preventing enzymes from binding to DNA or by halting protein synthesis .
Translation: 无论是小型生物技术公司还是大型制药企业，都在研发能够通过阻止酶与DNA结合或抑制蛋白质合成来杀灭真菌的药物。

Query_Text_en: As recalcitrant as they are , they do n't morph rapidly like bacteria into superstrains that are resistant to drug therapy .
Translation: 尽管它们顽固难治，但不像细菌那样迅速变异成对药物治疗产生抗性的超级菌株。
