Query_Text_en: So once someone figures out how to control fungi , chances are they will remain at bay for a long time .
Translation: 一旦有人掌握了控制真菌的方法，真菌很可能会长时间被遏制。

Query_Text_en: Inside an old factory building in Cambridge , Mass , a remarkable machine with the improbable name Zeus is hard at work .
Translation: 在马萨诸塞州剑桥市一座老旧工厂大楼内，一台名为“宙斯”的神奇机器正忙碌运转。

Query_Text_en: Flexing its two robotic arms , the computer-driven device reaches a gain and again into a storage area the size of a toddler 's crib , where thousands of individual samples of genetic material sit in tiny wells etched into plastic plates , each one identified by a unique bar code .
Translation: 这台由计算机控制的设备灵活运用两只机械臂，反复伸入一个如幼儿床般大小的储存区，那里成千上万个基因样本被安置在塑料板上微小的孔中，每个样本都通过独特的条形码进行识别。

Query_Text_en: One by one , Zeus searches for a particular code , dips into the corresponding well with a fine , quill-likes probe and picks up a minuscule droplet of liquid DNA .
Translation: 宙斯逐一寻找特定的编码，用细如羽毛的探针深入相应的井中，取出微小的一滴液态DNA。

Query_Text_en: Then Zeus transfers each precious droplet to a nearby sheet of nylon , moistens a designated spot and pivots back to the glass plates to find the next sample on its list .
Translation: 随后，宙斯将每一滴珍贵的液体转移到附近的一张尼龙膜上，润湿指定的位置，然后转回玻璃板，寻找清单上的下一个样本。

Query_Text_en: When Zeus is done , the nylon sheet will be spotted with a grid of about 1,000 droplets , forming what researchers call a microarray .
Translation: 当 Zeus 完成操作后，尼龙薄膜上将布满大约 1,000 个小液滴，排列成网格状，研究人员称之为微阵列。

Query_Text_en: Once the machine has created a few dozen of these arrays , they will be rolled up , inserted into glass tubes .
Translation: 一旦机器制造出几十组这样的阵列，这些阵列将被卷起并插入玻璃管中。

Query_Text_en: Genentech , the US company that pioneered the use of injectable proteins and antibodies as drugs , is stepping up its efforts to discover pill-based medicines .
Translation: 美国率先将可注射蛋白质和抗体用于药物研发的基因泰克公司，正在加大力度推进口服药物的研发。

Query_Text_en: Dr Henner denied that proteins , few of which achieve the billion-dollar annual sales regularly reached by tablet-based medicines , were no longer enough to fuel growth at the rapidly expanding company .
Translation: 亨纳博士否认了这样的说法：蛋白质类药物——很少有产品能像片剂药物那样实现每年十亿美元的销售额——已无法支撑这家快速扩张公司的增长。

Query_Text_en: With a market capitalisation of nearly $ 50 billion , Genentech is larger than many `` big pharm '' groups .
Translation: 基因泰克的市值接近500亿美元，规模已超过许多大型制药集团。

Query_Text_en: Most advanced is an internal programme to develop a pill that attacks T-cells -LRB- immune system cells -RRB- involved in psoriasis , a chronic skin condition .
Translation: 目前最先进的是一项内部研发项目，旨在开发一种针对参与银屑病（一种慢性皮肤病）的T细胞（免疫系统细胞）的药丸。

Query_Text_en: Genentech is close to market with an injectable antibody-based drug that inhibits T-cells , but now has a `` rather advanced small-molecule programrne that blocks the same interaction , '' said Dr Henner .
Translation: Genentech即将推出一种基于抗体的可注射药物，该药物可抑制T细胞，但现在也有一个“相当先进的小分子项目，可以阻断同样的相互作用，”Henner博士说。

Query_Text_en: Genentech is also expected to announce a collaboration to develop tablet-form drugs with a start-up company next month .
Translation: 基因泰克预计将在下个月宣布与一家初创公司合作开发片剂药物。

Query_Text_en: Susan Desmond Hellmann , executive vice-president , said even without small molecules , Genentech had the `` best pipeline in the biotechnology industry '' .
Translation: 执行副总裁苏珊·德斯蒙德·赫尔曼表示，即使没有小分子药物，基因泰克依然拥有“生物技术行业中最强的产品研发管线”。

Query_Text_en: It has six marketed drugs including Herceptin and Rituxan , the first antibodies used to treat cancer , a growth hormone and a medicine to relieve the symptoms of cystic fibrosis .
Translation: 它拥有六种上市药物，包括赫赛汀和利妥昔单抗——首批用于治疗癌症的抗体药物——一种生长激素，以及一种用于缓解囊性纤维化症状的药物。

Query_Text_en: While it ca n't yet be said that every mouthful of food has been changed through genetic engineering , it is likely that almost every American has had a mouthful of engineered food .
Translation: 虽然还不能说每一口食物都经过了基因工程改造，但几乎可以肯定，每个美国人都吃过经过基因工程处理的食品。

Query_Text_en: Take the soybean , for example . About 55 percent of last year 's crop was genetically engineered in some fashion , reports the American Soybean Association .
Translation: 以大豆为例。美国大豆协会报告称，去年约有55%的大豆作物经过了某种形式的基因工程改造。

Query_Text_en: And though few Americans sit down to a plate of soybeans for dinner , these legumes arrive through the back door as an additive to scores of foods like mayonnaise , margarine cooking oils , salad dressings , coffee creamers , beer , cereals , candy , and shortenings .
Translation: 尽管很少有美国人晚餐时直接食用大豆，这种豆类却以添加剂的形式悄然进入了众多食品，如蛋黄酱、人造黄油、食用油、沙拉酱、咖啡伴侣、啤酒、谷物、糖果以及起酥油等。

Query_Text_en: Now that those gains are leveling off , scientists are looking to biotechnology to increase food production even more .
Translation: 如今，这些增产效益已趋于平稳，科学家们正寄希望于生物技术，以进一步提高粮食产量。

Query_Text_en: Researchers are also inserting bacterial genes into corn and soybean plants to better protect them from insects or render them immune to certain herbicides .
Translation: 研究人员还将细菌基因植入玉米和大豆，以增强其抗虫能力或使其对某些除草剂产生免疫。

Query_Text_en: For farmers , crops engineered with genes that resist cold , drought , or other adverse weather conditions can boost crop yields with less money and effort .
Translation: 对于农民来说，通过基因工程改造，使作物具备抗寒、抗旱或其他恶劣天气条件的能力，可以在投入更少资金和精力的情况下提高产量。

Query_Text_en: For the future , expect foods that can help prevent cancer , fruits and vegetables that deliver vaccines , and crops that even make their own fertilizer .
Translation: 未来，我们可以期待能够预防癌症的食品、能够传递疫苗的水果和蔬菜，以及能够自制肥料的农作物。

Query_Text_en: Some will have the gene inserted in the wrong place , some will have no gene at all . Eventually , the researcher will get the seed he wants .
Translation: 有些种子会在错误的位置插入基因，有些则根本没有插入基因。最终，研究人员会获得他们想要的种子。

Query_Text_en: In the half century after the ratification of the Constitution American business enterprise became increasingly specialized in commerce and production .
Translation: 在宪法批准后的半个世纪里，美国的商业企业在商业和生产领域日益专业化。

Query_Text_en: The trend was particularly evident in commerce .
Translation: 这一趋势在商业领域尤为明显。

Query_Text_en: As commerce expanded and as commercial activities became more specialized , the dependence on market mechanisms to coordinate these activities increased proportionally .
Translation: 随着商业的扩展和商业活动的日益专业化，对市场机制协调这些活动的依赖也相应增加。

Query_Text_en: In the 1790s the general merchant , the businessman who had dominated the economy of the colonial period , was still the grand distributor . He bought and sold all types of products and carried out all the basic commercial functions .
Translation: 18世纪90年代，作为殖民时期经济主导者的综合商人依然是主要的商品分销者。他经营各种商品，承担着所有基本的商业职能。

Query_Text_en: He was an exporter , wholesaler , importer , retailer , shipowner , banker , and insurer .
Translation: 他既是出口商、批发商、进口商、零售商，也是船东、银行家和保险商。

Query_Text_en: By the 1840s , however , such tasks were being carried out by different types of specialized enterprises .
Translation: 然而，到19世纪40年代，这些任务已经由不同类型的专业企业来完成。

Query_Text_en: Banks , insurance companies , and common carriers had appeared . Merchants had begun to specialize in one or two lines of goods : cotton , provisions , wheat , dry goods , hardware , or drugs .
Translation: 银行、保险公司和公共运输公司相继出现。商人们开始专营一两类商品，如棉花、食品、小麦、百货、五金或药品。

Query_Text_en: They concentrated more and more on a single function : retailing , wholesaling , importing , or exporting .
Translation: 他们越来越专注于某一项业务：零售、批发、进口或出口。

Query_Text_en: Economic expansion and business specialization greatly increased the number of business enterprises operating in the economy .
Translation: 经济的扩张和企业专业化极大地增加了经济中经营企业的数量。

Query_Text_en: In the 1790s a relatively few merchants living in the eastern ports carried on the major share of the trade beyond local markets . By the 1840s the much larger flows of a greater variety of goods were guided from the producers of the raw materials through the processes of production and distribution to the ultimate consumer by hundreds and thousands of businessmen who had little personal acquaintance with others .
Translation: 18世纪90年代，居住在东部港口的少数商人承担了大部分超出本地市场的贸易。到了19世纪40年代，种类更加丰富、数量更为庞大的商品流通，从原材料生产者经过生产和分销环节，最终到达终端消费者，这一过程由成百上千几乎彼此不相识的商人共同引导完成。

Query_Text_en: The motives of the businessmen were to make a profit on each of the many transactions and such motivation seemed to be enough to assure the successful operation of the economy .
Translation: 商人的动机是通过每一笔交易获利，而这种动力似乎足以保证经济的顺利运作。

Query_Text_en: Although , as Adam Smith wrote , each businessman intends only his gain , he is . . .  : led by an invisible hand to promote an end which is not his intention .
Translation: 正如亚当·斯密所言，尽管每位商人只追求自身利益，但他却被一只看不见的手引导，推动着实现并非他本意的目标。

Query_Text_en: In fact , Smith continued , by pursuing his own interest he frequently promotes that of society more effectively than when he really intends to promote it .
Translation: 事实上，史密斯接着说，通过追求自身利益，他往往比真正有意促进社会利益时，更能有效地促进社会的利益。

Query_Text_en: If the expansion of the economy brought specialization in the activities of business enterprise , it did little to alter the internal operation or organization of these enterprises or their methods of transacting business .
Translation: 尽管经济的扩张带来了企业经营活动的专业化，但对企业的内部运作、组织结构及其经营方式几乎没有产生影响。

Query_Text_en: In the 1790s American businessmen still relied entirely on commercial practices and procedures invented and perfected centuries earlier by British , Dutch , and Italian merchants .
Translation: 18世纪90年代，美国商人仍然完全依赖英国、荷兰和意大利商人几个世纪前发明并完善的商业惯例和流程。

Query_Text_en: Stuart Bruchey , in his study of the Olivers , Baltimore merchants of the 1790s , points to the remarkable similarities between the nature of their activities and those of the Venetian merchants .
Translation: 斯图亚特·布鲁奇在研究18世纪90年代巴尔的摩商人奥利弗家族时指出，他们的经营活动与威尼斯商人有着显著的相似之处。

Query_Text_en: The Olivers ' ' form of organization , and their method of managing men , records and investments would have been almost immediately understood by the fifteenth century merchant of Venice ' .
Translation: 奥利弗家族的组织形式，以及他们管理人员、记录和投资的方法，几乎可以被十五世纪的威尼斯商人立即理解。

Query_Text_en: The Americans of the 1790s and the Italians of the 1390s used the partnership form of business and the same double-entry bookkeeping records , records in which Adventure and Merchandise accounts were conspicuous features .
Translation: 18世纪90年代的美国人和14世纪90年代的意大利人都采用了合伙企业的经营形式，并使用了相同的复式记账记录，其中“冒险账户”和“商品账户”是显著的特征。

Query_Text_en: Both sold on their own account and on consignment for standardized commission rates and employed ship captains and supercargoes as consignees .
Translation: 他们既以自营方式销售，也以代销方式按统一佣金率销售，并雇佣船长和货主作为受托人。

Query_Text_en: Americans also made use of institutional arrangements perfected by the Dutch and British , such as formal exchanges to carry out market transactions , more sophisticated instruments of credit , and concepts and usages of commercial law .
Translation: 美国人还借鉴了荷兰和英国完善的制度安排，例如通过正式交易所进行市场交易、更为复杂的信贷工具，以及商业法律的理念和实践。

Query_Text_en: The practices that Americans had inherited remained quite satisfactory until after the 1840s .
Translation: 美国人所继承的做法一直相当令人满意，直到19世纪40年代以后才发生变化。

Query_Text_en: The Americans adjusted commercial law to meet the needs of a rapidly expanding economy and a federal polity .
Translation: 美国调整了商业法律，以适应经济的快速扩张和联邦体制的需要。

Query_Text_en: They made increasing use of the incorporated stock company developed in the sixteenth century by the British to promote overseas trade and colonization and used in the eighteenth century to manage ancillary or utilities operations such as docks , water works , and the like .
Translation: 他们越来越多地利用股份有限公司这一由英国人在十六世纪为促进海外贸易和殖民活动而创立的企业形式，并在十八世纪用于管理码头、水务等附属或公用事业。

Query_Text_en: Traditional forms were refined , but the practices , instruments , and institutions of commercial capitalism which had evolved to meet the growth of trade and the coming of market economies in the Mediterranean basin in the twelfth and thirteenth centuries were not fundamentally altered .
Translation: 传统形式得到了完善，但为了适应十二、十三世纪地中海地区贸易增长和市场经济兴起而发展起来的商业资本主义的做法、工具和制度，并未发生根本性的变化。

Query_Text_en: Before the 1840s there was no revolution in the ways of doing business in the United States .
Translation: 在19世纪40年代之前，美国的商业运作方式并未发生变革。

Query_Text_en: The great transformation was to await the coming of new technologies and markets that permitted a massive production and distribution of goods .
Translation: 伟大的转型有赖于新技术和新市场的出现，这些技术和市场使商品得以大规模生产和分销。

Query_Text_en: Those institutional changes which helped to create the managerial capitalism of the twentieth century were as significant and as revolutionary as those that accompanied the rise of commercial capitalism a half a millennium earlier .
Translation: 那些促成二十世纪管理型资本主义形成的制度变革，其重要性和革命性堪比五百年前商业资本主义兴起时所伴随的制度变革。

Query_Text_en: In 1790 general merchants still ruled the economy .
Translation: 1790年，综合商人依然主导着经济。

Query_Text_en: In this economy the family remained the basic business unit .
Translation: 在这种经济体制下，家庭依然是基本的经营单位。

Query_Text_en: The most pervasive of these units was the family farm .
Translation: 其中最为普遍的单位是家庭农场。

Query_Text_en: In 1790 only 202,000 out of the 3,930,000 Americans lived in towns and villages of more than 2,500 , and of the 2,881,000 workers , 2,069,000 labored on farms . Only in the south , where crops were cultivated by slave labor , did the production of staples become more than a family affair .
Translation: 1790年，美国总人口为393万，仅有20.2万人居住在人口超过2,500的城镇和村庄。在288.1万劳动者中，有206.9万人在农场工作。只有在南方，依靠奴隶劳作的农作物种植，主粮生产才超越了家庭经营的范畴。

Query_Text_en: In the production of crops , only on the plantation did a class of managers appear .
Translation: 在农作物生产中，只有在种植园中才出现了一类管理者阶层。

Query_Text_en: The small amount of manufacturing carried on outside the home was the work of artisans in small shops .
Translation: 家庭之外进行的少量制造活动，主要由小作坊里的工匠完成。

Query_Text_en: In the towns , the artisan often had the assistance of one or two apprentices or journeymen , who were usually treated as part of the family .
Translation: 在城镇中，工匠通常会有一两名学徒或熟练工协助，他们一般被视为家庭成员的一部分。

Query_Text_en: In the ports , somewhat larger , though still very small , shipyards , ropewalks , candle manufactories , and rum distilleries operated .
Translation: 在港口，规模略大但仍然很小的船厂、制绳厂、蜡烛制造厂和朗姆酒蒸馏厂开始运营。

Query_Text_en: As Sam Bass Warner wrote of Philadelphia on the eve of the American Revolution : The core element of the town economy was the one-man shop .
Translation: 正如萨姆·巴斯·华纳在描述美国革命前夕的费城时所写：“城市经济的核心要素是个体经营的作坊。”

Query_Text_en: Most Philadelphians labored alone , some with a helper or two . Other resources besides land were exploited , but on a limited scale .
Translation: 大多数费城人都是独自劳动，有些则有一两名助手。除了土地之外，其他资源也被开发利用，但规模有限。

Query_Text_en: Lumbering continued to be a by-product of land clearing , although Maine and North Carolina supplied timber regularly for both the Royal Navy and the West Indian trade .
Translation: 伐木业依然是清理土地的副产品，尽管缅因州和北卡罗来纳州为英国皇家海军和西印度群岛贸易定期供应木材。

Query_Text_en: Local farmers provided most of the lumber that went into the making of masts , spars , barrels , staves , as well as beams , shingles , and paneling for houses , churches , warehouses , and other buildings .
Translation: 当地农民提供了制造桅杆、帆桁、木桶、桶板，以及房屋、教堂、仓库和其他建筑所需的横梁、木瓦和护墙板的大部分木材。

Query_Text_en: The output of the only coal mines in the colonies , in Virginia , was hardly 1,000 tons a year .
Translation: 殖民地唯一的煤矿位于弗吉尼亚，其年产量仅约1,000吨。

Query_Text_en: Except for some iron , all metals were imported .
Translation: 除少量铁之外，所有金属均为进口。

Query_Text_en: The largest business unit either in mining or manufacturing was the iron plantation , where the iron ore was mined , wood converted into charcoal , iron ore refined into pigs , and the pigs forged into wrought iron .
Translation: 无论是在采矿业还是制造业，规模最大的企业单位都是铁厂。在这里，铁矿石被开采出来，木材被转化为木炭，铁矿石被炼成生铁，生铁再被锻造成熟铁。

Query_Text_en: These plantations , with their rural setting , the seasonal nature of their work , and the use of indentured servants and occasionally slaves , were operated in many ways like the rice and tobacco plantations of the southern colonies .
Translation: 这些种植园由于其乡村环境、季节性劳作特点，以及雇佣契约仆役和偶尔使用奴隶的做法，在许多方面的运作方式与南部殖民地的水稻和烟草种植园类似。

Query_Text_en: The activities of these producing units were coordinated through the business transactions of the merchants who resided in the port and river towns .
Translation: 这些生产单位的活动是通过居住在港口和河流城镇的商人的商业交易进行协调的。

Query_Text_en: The resident merchant distributed and marketed the products of these small enterprises and supplied them with raw materials , tools , and furnishings . For this reason , this all-purpose businessman dominated the economy .
Translation: 常驻商人负责分销和销售这些小企业的产品，并为其提供原材料、工具和设备。因此，这种全能型商人在经济中占据主导地位。

Query_Text_en: He exported , imported , and sold all types of products at retail and at wholesale . He took title to the goods he purchased for his regular customers .
Translation: 他经营各种产品的进出口业务，并进行批发和零售。他为自己的常规客户购买商品并取得所有权。

Query_Text_en: He also acted as correspondent or agent for merchants in other ports , taking their goods on consignment and selling for a fixed commission .
Translation: 他还担任其他港口商人的通讯员或代理人，接受他们的货物寄售，并按固定佣金进行销售。

Query_Text_en: The resident general merchant acted as the community s financier and was responsible for the transportation as well as the distribution of goods . He provided short-term loans to finance staple crops and manufactured goods when they were in transit , and he made long-term loans to planters , farmers , and artisans to enable them to clear land or to improve their facilities .
Translation: 常驻总商担任社区的金融家，负责货物的运输和分销。他为主粮和制造品在运输途中提供短期贷款，并向种植园主、农民和工匠提供长期贷款，以帮助他们开垦土地或改善设施。

Query_Text_en: Usually in cooperation with other merchants , he arranged for the handling of ships needed to carry these goods and often , with other partners , was a shareholder in these ships .
Translation: 他通常与其他商人合作，安排运输这些货物所需的船只，并且常常与其他合伙人一起成为这些船只的股东。

Query_Text_en: With other merchants , he also insured ships and cargoes .
Translation: 他还与其他商人一起为船只和货物投保。

Query_Text_en: Again with others , he built wharves for the ships .
Translation: 他与其他人一起为船只建造了码头。

Query_Text_en: In the same port town , he helped to finance the construction , both by himself and with others , of rum distilleries , candle works , ropewalks , and shipyards that is , those manufacturing industries not carried on by craftsmen in small family shops .
Translation: 在同一个港口小镇，他不仅自己出资，还与他人共同资助了朗姆酒蒸馏厂、蜡烛厂、制绳厂和船厂的建设——也就是说，这些制造业并非由工匠在小型家庭作坊中经营。

Query_Text_en: In all these activities , the colonial merchant knew personally most of the individuals involved .
Translation: 在所有这些活动中，殖民地商人都亲自认识大多数参与者。

Query_Text_en: He tried , where possible , to have members of his own family act as his agents in London , the West Indies , and other North American colonies .
Translation: 他尽可能让自己的家族成员在伦敦、西印度群岛及其他北美殖民地担任自己的代理人。

Query_Text_en: If he could not consign his goods and arrange for purchase and sale of merchandise through a family member or through a thoroughly reliable associate , the merchant depended on a ship captain or supercargo ( his authorized business agent aboard ship ) to carry out the distant transactions .
Translation: 如果商人无法通过家庭成员或极为可靠的合伙人托运货物并安排商品的买卖，他就只能依赖船长或随船商务代理（即他在船上的授权商务代表）来完成远途交易。

Query_Text_en: Even then , the latter was often a son or a nephew .
Translation: 即便如此，后者往往是儿子或侄子。

Query_Text_en: The merchant knew the other resident merchants in his town , who collaborated with him in insuring and owning ships , as he did the shipbuilders , rope-makers , and local artisans who supplied his personal as well as his business needs .
Translation: 这位商人认识镇上的其他常驻商人，他们与他合作进行船只保险和所有权事务；他同样熟悉造船工人、制绳工匠以及为他个人和业务需求提供服务的本地工匠。

Query_Text_en: Finally , he was acquainted with the planters , the farmers , and country storekeepers , as well as the fishermen , lumbermen , and others from whom he purchased goods and to whom he provided supplies .
Translation: 他还熟悉种植园主、农民和乡村店主，以及那些向他出售商品、他为其提供物资的渔民、伐木工人等。

Query_Text_en: Between Baltimore and Charleston , where there were few ports with resident merchants , a somewhat different pattern of commerce developed .
Translation: 在巴尔的摩和查尔斯顿之间，由于很少有常驻商人的港口，形成了一种略有不同的商业模式。

Query_Text_en: In Maryland and Virginia , and to some extent farther south , planters bought directly from the British merchants .
Translation: 在马里兰和弗吉尼亚州，以及在更南部的一些地区，种植园主直接向英国商人采购商品。

Query_Text_en: Factors in London arranged for the sale of their tobacco and rice and at the same time purchased any supplies they needed .
Translation: 伦敦的代理人负责安排他们的烟草和大米的销售，同时也采购他们所需的各种物资。

Query_Text_en: The planters , in turn , often provided their smaller neighbors with the same type of services they received from the British factors .
Translation: 种植园主则常常以类似于他们从英国代理商那里获得的服务，来为周边较小的农户提供帮助。

Query_Text_en: As tobacco planting moved inland in the mid-eighteenth century , Scottish merchants began to send factors and agents to set up permanent stores , where tobacco could be collected and finished goods sold to the upland farmers and planters .
Translation: 18世纪中叶，随着烟草种植向内陆扩展，苏格兰商人开始派遣代理人和代表前往内陆设立常设商店，用于收购烟草并向内陆农民和种植园主销售制成品。

Query_Text_en: Farther south , the resident merchants in the towns of Charleston and Savannah began to handle the trade of their region in much the same way as did northern merchants .
Translation: 在更南方，查尔斯顿和萨凡纳等城镇的本地商人开始以与北方商人类似的方式经营本地区的贸易。

Query_Text_en: With the coming of political independence , this personal family business world began to change .
Translation: 随着政治独立的到来，这种以家族为核心的私人商业世界开始发生变化。

Query_Text_en: The break with Britain disrupted old trading patterns and led to the opening of new areas to American merchants , including the Baltic , the Levant , China , India , and the East Indies .
Translation: 与英国的决裂打破了原有的贸易格局，使美国商人得以进入新的市场，包括波罗的海、地中海东部（黎凡特）、中国、印度和东印度群岛。

Query_Text_en: The continuing growth of population and the rapid expansion west into Kentucky and Tennessee , north into Maine , and southwest into Georgia enlarged domestic markets , as did the growing seaport towns themselves .
Translation: 人口的持续增长，以及向西进入肯塔基和田纳西、向北进入缅因、向西南进入佐治亚的迅速扩张，连同不断发展的港口城镇，都扩大了国内市场。

Query_Text_en: After the outbreak of the wars of the French Revolution , trade with Europe and the West Indies , which had been cut off since the Revolution , again boomed .
Translation: 法国大革命战争爆发后，自革命以来中断的与欧洲和西印度群岛的贸易再次繁荣起来。

Query_Text_en: Far more important , however , for the American economy than the after-effects of the political revolution in France was the advancing industrial revolution in Great Britain .
Translation: 然而，对于美国经济来说，比法国政治革命的后续影响更为重要的是英国正在推进的工业革命。

Query_Text_en: For the new United States became almost overnight the major source of supply of the raw material and the major market for the products of the new machine-made textiles .
Translation: 新成立的美国几乎一夜之间成为新型机织纺织品原材料的主要供应地和产品的主要市场。

Query_Text_en: The coming of these new trades was the most important single factor in bringing specialization to business enterprise and impersonalization into business activities .
Translation: 这些新行业的出现，是推动企业专业化和业务活动非人格化的最重要单一因素。

Query_Text_en: Even without the boom in cotton and textiles , specialization in commercial business enterprises certainly would have come to the United States in the fifty years after 1790 . Before the Revolution specialization was already appearing in the distribution of goods in New York , Philadelphia , and other large towns .
Translation: 即使没有棉花和纺织业的繁荣，商业企业的专业化在1790年后的五十年间也必然会在美国出现。事实上，在独立战争之前，专业化已经在纽约、费城及其他大城市的商品流通领域初现端倪。

Query_Text_en: The distinction between merchants and shopkeepers was becoming clear .
Translation: 商人与店主之间的区别日益明显。

Query_Text_en: The former continued to sell at retail as well as at wholesale , but the shopkeepers sold only at retail , buying from the merchants rather than directly from abroad .
Translation: 前者既进行零售，也进行批发，而店主只做零售业务，他们从商人处进货，而不是直接从国外采购。

Query_Text_en: By 1790 , the merchants were also beginning to specialize in certain lines of trade .
Translation: 到1790年，商人们也开始在某些特定的贸易领域进行专业化经营。

Query_Text_en: Specialization was coming , too , in manufacturing in New England , and possibly parts of the middle states , with the beginning of a domestic or putting-out system , and the first use of simple machines . Well before the 1790s , shoes , boots , and even furniture were being manufactured for the West Indian and other distant markets by entrepreneurs who put-out work into the homes of farmers and town dwellers .
Translation: 新英格兰地区的制造业也开始出现专业化趋势，部分中部州亦然，随着国内分工或外包制度的兴起，以及简单机械的首次应用。在1790年代之前，鞋靴乃至家具等产品，已由企业家们生产，销往西印度群岛及其他远方市场，他们将工作分派到农民和城镇居民的家庭中进行。

Query_Text_en: Nevertheless , the rapid reorientation and expansion of American commerce and the rapid development of specialized business institutions resulted directly from the new and unprecedented high volume of cotton exports and new machine-made imports .
Translation: 然而，美国商业的迅速转向与扩展，以及专业化商业机构的快速发展，正是直接源于棉花出口量的空前增长和新型机器制造进口商品的大量涌入。

Query_Text_en: The impact of cotton on American commerce did not become fully apparent until after 1815 , although it had begun to make itself felt in the 1790s .
Translation: 棉花对美国商业的影响直到1815年之后才完全显现，尽管早在18世纪90年代就已初见端倪。

Query_Text_en: The French Revolution and the Napoleonic Wars kept the older West Indian and European carrying trades booming until 1807 .
Translation: 法国大革命和拿破仑战争使传统的西印度和欧洲运输贸易一直繁荣至1807年。

Query_Text_en: Then , for the next eight years , embargoes , trade restrictions , and wars shut down practically all trade except for a brief period in 1810 and 1811 .
Translation: 随后，在接下来的八年里，禁运、贸易限制以及战争几乎中断了所有贸易，只有在1810年和1811年间有过短暂的恢复。

Query_Text_en: The wars and wartime commerce overshadowed the rise of the brand new and profoundly significant cotton trade .
Translation: 战争与战时贸易掩盖了全新且极具意义的棉花贸易的兴起。

Query_Text_en: As the new cotton textile machinery in Britain went into production , Americans responded quickly .
Translation: 随着英国新型棉纺织机械投入生产，美国人迅速作出了回应。

Query_Text_en: Cotton was first grown commercially in the United States in 1786 .
Translation: 美国于1786年首次开始商业化种植棉花。

Query_Text_en: By 1793 , the year Eli Whitney invented the cotton gin , annual exports were already 488,000 pounds .
Translation: 到1793年，也就是伊莱·惠特尼发明轧棉机的那一年，棉花年出口量已达48.8万磅。

Query_Text_en: By 1801 , they reached 20.9 million pounds , by 1807 , 66.2 million , and by 1810 ( the year when trade restrictions were temporarily lifted ) , 83.8 million .
Translation: 到1801年，棉花出口量达到2090万磅；到1807年，增至6620万磅；到1810年（贸易限制暂时解除的那一年），更是达到8380万磅。

Query_Text_en: In 1815 , 83.0 million pounds exported was valued at $ 17.5 million .
Translation: 1815年，出口量为8300万磅，价值1750万美元。

Query_Text_en: By 1825 , the value of cotton exports had risen to $ 37 million , and by 1840 to $ 64 million . Between 1821 and 1850 , the United States provided over 75 percent of Britain s annual supply of raw cotton .
Translation: 到1825年，棉花出口总值已上升至3700万美元；到1840年，这一数字达到6400万美元。在1821年至1850年间，美国为英国每年提供的原棉供应量超过75%。

Query_Text_en: The volume and value of these exports contrast sharply with the modest expansion of the older crops , namely , tobacco , rice , sugar , and wheat .
Translation: 这些出口产品的数量和价值与传统作物——即烟草、水稻、甘蔗和小麦——的温和增长形成了鲜明对比。

Query_Text_en: Exports of tobacco , for example , were valued at $ 8 million in 1815 and only $ 10 million in 1840 .
Translation: 以烟草为例，1815年烟草出口额为800万美元，到1840年仅为1000万美元。

Query_Text_en: Cotton brought commercial agriculture to broad regions of the south where , because of climate and soil , other staple crops were unable to grow .
Translation: 棉花将商品农业引入了南方广大地区，在这些地区，由于气候和土壤条件，其他主要作物无法生长。

Query_Text_en: Moreover , cotton moved westward in the south a generation before wheat moved west in the north .
Translation: 此外，棉花在南方向西扩展的时间，比小麦在北方向西扩展早了整整一代人。

Query_Text_en: As the cotton plantations in the lower Mississippi Valley were coming into production , they provided an important initial market to the farmers in the new western settlements at a time when the lack of transportation facilities made it costly to ship whiskey , hogs , horses , and mules to the east or to Europe .
Translation: 随着密西西比河下游的棉花种植园开始投入生产，它们为新西部定居点的农民提供了一个重要的初期市场。当时，由于交通设施的缺乏，将威士忌、猪、马和骡子运往东部或欧洲的成本很高。

Query_Text_en: The spread of commercial agriculture in the south encouraged commercial specialization in the east .
Translation: 南方商业农业的扩展促进了东部的商业专业化。

Query_Text_en: The unprecedented volume of the cotton trade helped to make New York the nation s leading city and initiated the swift decline of the all-purpose general merchant .
Translation: 前所未有的大规模棉花贸易推动纽约成为全国领先的城市，并加速了全能型综合商人的迅速衰落。

Query_Text_en: The cotton trade was handled increasingly by specialized firms that preferred not to take title to the goods ( except when they wanted to speculate ) and were instead paid for their services by fixed commissions .
Translation: 棉花贸易日益由专业公司经营，这些公司通常不愿取得货物所有权（除非出于投机目的），而是通过收取固定佣金获得报酬。

Query_Text_en: Because they had no control over the fluctuating prices set by the international forces of supply and demand , these and other merchants who were becoming specialized disliked the risk of taking title to the goods , preferring the more certain 5 percent commission .
Translation: 由于无法控制由国际供求关系决定的波动价格，这些以及其他逐渐专业化的商人不愿承担商品所有权带来的风险，更倾向于选择较为稳定的5%佣金。

Query_Text_en: For the first time in the United States merchants began to sell much more on commission than on their own account .
Translation: 美国商人首次开始以佣金方式销售的商品远远多于自营商品。

Query_Text_en: The first cotton traders were new rather than existing merchants . In New York they were at the start agents of British textile firms who came to sell cloth and to make arrangements for obtaining raw cotton .
Translation: 最早的棉花贸易商是新兴商人，而非原有的商人。在纽约，他们最初是英国纺织公司的代理人，前来销售布匹并安排获取原棉的事宜。

Query_Text_en: They were soon joined by young men , many of them New Englanders , who began their business life in this trade .
Translation: 很快，许多年轻人加入了他们的行列，其中不少来自新英格兰，他们的商业生涯正是从这一行业起步的。

Query_Text_en: New Englanders also went to the south . There they and local merchants in the cotton ports and in the new towns in the interior Columbia , Augusta , Macon , Montgomery , Jackson , and Natchez became factors for planters who had recently cleared the land in the rich black belt of Alabama and Georgia and the bottom lands along the Mississippi River .
Translation: 新英格兰人也前往南方。在那里，他们与棉花港口及内陆新兴城镇——哥伦比亚、奥古斯塔、梅肯、蒙哥马利、杰克逊和纳奇兹——的当地商人一起，成为种植园主的代理人。这些种植园主刚刚在阿拉巴马和乔治亚肥沃的黑带地区以及密西西比河沿岸的低地开垦土地。

Query_Text_en: Although the distinction between commission and commercial houses is often not a clear one , the census figures suggest the importance of the commission business to the foreign trade . In the census of 1840 , 381 commission houses and only 24 commercial houses were listed as engaged in foreign trade in Louisiana where commodities completely dominated .
Translation: 尽管佣金行与商行之间的界限往往并不十分清晰，但人口普查数据表明，佣金业务在对外贸易中具有重要地位。在1840年的人口普查中，路易斯安那州从事对外贸易的佣金行有381家，而商行仅有24家，当地商品贸易占据绝对主导地位。

Query_Text_en: For New York ( where the commodity trades were major ) the division was 1,044 commission houses and 469 commercial houses ; in Boston ( where such trades were of much less significance ) , there were 241 commercial houses and only 123 commission houses .
Translation: 在纽约（商品交易占主要地位），共有1,044家佣金行和469家商业行；而在波士顿（此类交易的重要性远低于纽约），则有241家商业行和仅123家佣金行。

Query_Text_en: By 1840 , too , the older , less specialized houses had come to concentrate on cotton or some other commodity and to trade on commission .
Translation: 到1840年，较早期、业务较为分散的商行也开始专注于棉花或其他某一商品，并以佣金代理的方式进行贸易。

Query_Text_en: The first man in the chain of the new middlemen from the planter to the manufacturer was the cotton factor .
Translation: 在从种植者到制造商的新型中间商链条中，第一个环节是棉花经纪人。

Query_Text_en: He not only marketed the planter s crop , but also purchased his supplies and provided him with credit .
Translation: 他不仅负责销售种植园主的农作物，还为其采购所需物资并提供信贷支持。

Query_Text_en: Relations between the two were close and personal .
Translation: 双方关系密切且具有个人色彩。

Query_Text_en: In purchasing supplies , equipment , and household goods for the plantation , the factor purchased locally and normally traveled twice a year to buy in New York and other commercial centers of the northeast .
Translation: 在为种植园采购物资、设备和家庭用品时，代理人通常会在本地采购，并每年两次前往纽约及美国东北部其他商业中心进行采购。

Query_Text_en: In marketing the planter s crop in the impersonal international market , the factor sold directly to the agents of manufacturers or shipped on consignment to other middlemen in nearby river or coastal ports , or to others in New York and other coastal cities , and still others in Liverpool and continental ports .
Translation: 在将种植园主的农作物推向无差别的国际市场时，棉花商直接将产品销售给制造商的代理人，或以寄售方式运往附近河港或沿海港口的其他中间商，或运往纽约及其他沿海城市的中间商，甚至远销利物浦及欧洲大陆的港口。

Query_Text_en: These middlemen , in turn , sold directly or on consignment to manufacturers in the United States as well as in Britain or often to yet another set of middlemen .
Translation: 这些中间商则直接或以寄售方式将商品出售给美国和英国的制造商，或者常常转卖给另一批中间商。

Query_Text_en: In addition , the factor made arrangements for the transportation of the crop , the payment of insurance , storage , drayage , and , where necessary , the payment of duties , wharf fees , and the like .
Translation: 此外，代理商还负责安排农作物的运输、支付保险费、仓储费、搬运费，并在必要时支付关税、码头费等相关费用。

Query_Text_en: On all of these different transactions , he received a commission . And in the process both of buying and of selling , the factor usually made the credit arrangements .
Translation: 在所有这些不同的交易中，他都能获得佣金。在买卖的过程中，代理人通常还负责安排信贷事宜。

Query_Text_en: The distribution system was also a credit network , with the credit based on the crop in transit .
Translation: 分销系统同时也是一个信贷网络，其信贷以运输中的农作物作为担保。

Query_Text_en: The cotton trade was financed largely by advances .
Translation: 棉花贸易主要依靠预付款进行融资。

Query_Text_en: Cotton moved in one direction and the advances against its shipment in the other .
Translation: 棉花向一个方向流动，而针对其运输的预付款则向另一个方向流动。

Query_Text_en: On the American side , as Harold Woodman , the historian of the factor , has written : Anyone with cotton on hand could easily get an advance from the merchant to whom he chose to consign it , be that merchant in the interior , in the port cities , or in the North , or in Europe . On the British side , a commission merchant in 1833 stated that it was virtually impossible to get goods on consignment without giving advances .
Translation: 正如研究代理商的历史学家哈罗德·伍德曼所写的那样，在美国方面，任何手中有棉花的人，都可以轻松地从他选择委托棉花的商人那里获得预付款，无论这个商人是在内陆、港口城市、北方，还是在欧洲。而在英国方面，一位1833年的佣金商人则表示，如果不提供预付款，几乎不可能获得寄售商品。

Query_Text_en: The providing of advances did , therefore , carry a certain risk , for if the price fell during transit , as it often did while the annual harvest was being completed , the house providing the advance might have to sell at a loss .
Translation: 因此，提供预付款确实存在一定风险，因为如果在运输途中价格下跌——而这在每年收获季节尚未结束时常常发生——那么提供预付款的商行可能不得不亏本出售。

Query_Text_en: The credit system , a complex one , relied on traditional instruments : the promissory note and the bill of exchange . Planters , factors , or river or coastal port merchants were rarely paid in cash but in promissory notes or bills of exchange payable in 60 , 90 , or even 120 days at 7 or 8 percent interest .
Translation: 信贷体系十分复杂，依赖于传统工具：本票和汇票。种植园主、代理商以及河港或沿海港口的商人很少以现金收款，通常以本票或汇票结算，这些票据在60、90甚至120天后支付，利率为7%或8%。

Query_Text_en: If the advance was given before the delivery of the crop , it was made in the form of a promissory note , which was often renewed if it became due before the actual sale was transacted .
Translation: 如果预付款是在作物交付前发放的，通常以本票的形式进行；如果本票到期时作物尚未实际售出，本票往往会被续期。

Query_Text_en: If the payment was made at the time of delivery , it was made in the form of a bill of exchange , drawn on the house providing the credit .
Translation: 如果在交付时进行付款，则付款方式为汇票，由提供信用的公司开出。

Query_Text_en: Such transactions were further complicated by the need to convert pounds sterling into dollars .
Translation: 此类交易因需将英镑兑换成美元而变得更加复杂。

Query_Text_en: A simple sale , involving two middlemen , could give rise to as many as four different transactions and four different bills of exchange .
Translation: 一次简单的销售，涉及两个中间商，可能会产生多达四笔不同的交易和四张不同的汇票。

Query_Text_en: In the 1844-1845 season , Johnson had the New Orleans firm sell part of his cotton in Liverpool through Todd , Jackson and Company , the Liverpool branch of the firm .
Translation: 在1844至1845年这一季，约翰逊让新奥尔良的公司通过托德、杰克逊公司——该公司在利物浦的分支机构——在利物浦出售了部分棉花。

Query_Text_en: After shipping his cotton to New Orleans , Johnson drew on Washington Jackson and Company , thereby creating a domestic bill for discount .
Translation: 约翰逊将棉花运往新奥尔良后，向华盛顿·杰克逊公司开具汇票，从而形成了一张可供贴现的国内票据。

Query_Text_en: The New Orleans firm reimbursed itself for this advance by drawing on the Liverpool house after shipping the cotton there , thus creating a second bill for discount .
Translation: 新奥尔良公司在将棉花运往利物浦后，向利物浦公司开出汇票，从而收回了这笔预付款，并由此产生了第二张可供贴现的汇票。

Query_Text_en: When a sale was made in Liverpool , Todd , Jackson and Company sent a sterling bill for the proceeds over and above the advance drawn upon them .
Translation: 当利物浦完成一笔销售时，托德、杰克逊公司会就销售所得扣除已预支款项后，将剩余款项以英镑汇票的形式寄出。

Query_Text_en: The New Orleans firm sold the sterling bill to a bank for local currency and then authorized Johnson to draw another bill to cover his returns over the advance he had drawn originally .
Translation: 新奥尔良公司将英镑汇票出售给银行以换取本地货币，并授权约翰逊开立另一张汇票，以弥补其最初预支款项之外的收益。

Query_Text_en: It was in providing advances and in discounting bills of exchange that the older resident merchants came to play their most important role in the new cotton trade . Some , indeed , soon became specialists in finance .
Translation: 在提供预付款和贴现汇票方面，资深本地商人在新兴棉花贸易中发挥了最为重要的作用。事实上，其中一些人很快就专门从事金融业务。

Query_Text_en: Those with the largest resources became , through the financing of the cotton trade , the most influential businessmen of the day .
Translation: 那些拥有最多资源的人，通过资助棉花贸易，成为当时最具影响力的商人。

Query_Text_en: They were , for the most part , British business houses in Liverpool and London .
Translation: 他们大多是位于利物浦和伦敦的英国商行。

Query_Text_en: They stood at the end of the long chain of credit stretching from the banks of the Mississippi to Lombard Street .
Translation: 他们站在那条从密西西比河畔银行延伸至伦巴德街的漫长信贷链条的终端。

Query_Text_en: In the major ports , the volume of trade was large enough to permit the rise of another type of specialized enterprise the brokerage house . Not attached to any specific set of clients , it brought together buyers and sellers of cotton for a commission .
Translation: 在主要港口，贸易量足够大，促使另一类专业企业——经纪行的兴起。经纪行不隶属于任何特定客户群，而是通过收取佣金，撮合买卖双方进行棉花交易。

Query_Text_en: The basic distinction between the broker and the factor was that the former did not , as did the latter , buy or sell on his principal s account or , more precisely , did not make contracts in his own name that were binding on his principal .
Translation: 经纪人与代理人的基本区别在于，经纪人不像代理人那样以委托人的名义进行买卖，或者更准确地说，经纪人不会以自己的名义签订对委托人具有约束力的合同。

Query_Text_en: The broker s function was to help factors or other merchants or manufacturing agents obtain the cotton necessary to fill out a shipment or order and dispose of odd lots after the completion of a major transaction .
Translation: 经纪人的职能是协助代理商、其他商人或制造代理商获取完成一批货物或订单所需的棉花，并在主要交易完成后处理零散余货。

Query_Text_en: As the farming frontier moved west across the mountains into the Mississippi Valley , a somewhat different network evolved to move provisions ( corn , pork , and whiskey ) , some cotton , and then wheat and other grains from the west to the south and east .
Translation: 随着农业前沿越过山脉向西推进至密西西比河谷，一套略有不同的运输网络逐步形成，用于将西部的粮食（玉米、猪肉和威士忌）、部分棉花，以及后来的小麦和其他谷物运往南部和东部。

Query_Text_en: Where the soil was tilled by many small farmers rather than a few large planters , the country storekeeper took the place of the plantation factor as the first businessman on the chain of middlemen from the interior to the seaport .
Translation: 在由众多小农而非少数大种植园主耕作的地区，乡村商店老板取代了种植园代理人成为从内陆到海港中间商链条上的首位商人。

Query_Text_en: These storekeepers , the economic descendants of the pre-Revolutionary Scottish factors in Virginia and of the storekeepers scattered in the interior of colonial Pennsylvania and New England , marketed and purchased for the farmer much as the factors did for the planters .
Translation: 这些店主是弗吉尼亚革命前苏格兰代理商以及殖民时期宾夕法尼亚和新英格兰内陆各地店主的经济继承者，他们为农民进行商品销售和采购，方式与代理商为种植园主所做的类似。

Query_Text_en: They differed from the factors , however , in that they bought and sold primarily on their own account .
Translation: 然而，他们与代理商不同之处在于，他们主要以自有资金进行买卖。

Query_Text_en: In the early years of western settlement the outgoing crops and the incoming goods moved along different routes .
Translation: 在西方移民定居的早期，输出的农作物和输入的商品是通过不同的路线运输的。

Query_Text_en: Tobacco , hemp , lead , and produce went down the river to and through New Orleans to the east and the finished goods came westward across the mountains to Pittsburgh and then down the Ohio .
Translation: 烟草、大麻、铅以及农产品顺流而下，经新奥尔良运往东部，而制成品则自东部穿越群山运至匹兹堡，再沿俄亥俄河向西运输。

Query_Text_en: Storekeepers , and at first even farmers , accompanied their crops south .
Translation: 最初，商店老板，甚至农民自己，都会随同他们的农作物一起南下。

Query_Text_en: In a short time , however , they made arrangements with commission merchants in New Orleans and other river ports Cincinnati , Louisville , St. Louis , Memphis , and Nashville to receive their crops and sell them , or to forward them to other merchants , to provide advances , and to send payments .
Translation: 然而，不久之后，他们便与新奥尔良及其他河港城市，如辛辛那提、路易斯维尔、圣路易斯、孟菲斯和纳什维尔的委托商达成了安排，由这些商人负责接收并销售他们的农作物，或将其转运给其他商人，同时提供预付款，并将销售款项汇回。

Query_Text_en: The storekeepers , like the plantation cotton factors , went east normally twice a year to purchase their stocks of finished goods , coffee , tea , sugar , and other staples .
Translation: 这些店主和种植园的棉花经纪人一样，通常每年两次前往东部采购成品货物、咖啡、茶叶、糖以及其他日用品。

Query_Text_en: There they had to work out complex arrangements for the transportation of their goods west and for their warehousing , drayage , and loading at the different transshipment points along the way .
Translation: 在那里，他们不得不为货物向西运输以及沿途各个中转点的仓储、短途运输和装载等复杂安排进行协调。

Query_Text_en: The western storekeepers were soon relying on credit more from the eastern wholesalers from whom they purchased their supplies than from the commission houses through which they sold their produce .
Translation: 西部商店老板很快就更多依赖于东部批发商提供的信贷，而不是依赖通过佣金行销售农产品时获得的信贷。

Query_Text_en: With the opening of the Erie Canal in the mid-1820s and the completion of the Ohio and Pennsylvania canal systems in the next decade , a new trade sprang up , creating still another string of middlemen to handle the transactions and transshipments involved in moving the crops .
Translation: 随着19世纪20年代中期伊利运河的开通，以及下一个十年俄亥俄和宾夕法尼亚运河系统的建成，一种新的贸易形式应运而生，催生出另一批中间商，专门负责农作物运输过程中涉及的交易和转运。

Query_Text_en: Prior to 1830 , little wheat had been raised in the Mississippi Valley . Tobacco , hemp , provisions , horses , and mules , rather than wheat and flour , were the region s major exports .
Translation: 1830年以前，密西西比河流域很少种植小麦。该地区主要出口的是烟草、麻类、食品、马和骡，而不是小麦和面粉。

Query_Text_en: Then , since the canal provided a shorter route through a cooler part of the country ( wheat and flour sent via New Orleans often rotted or soured ) , production expanded . In 1839 Cleveland received 2.8 million bushels of wheat and flour , or 87 percent more than New Orleans . In the same year , New York received three times as much wheat as New Orleans .
Translation: 由于运河提供了一条经过气候较凉爽地区的更短运输路线（通过新奥尔良运送的小麦和面粉常常腐烂或变质），产量得以扩大。1839年，克利夫兰接收了280万蒲式耳的小麦和面粉，比新奥尔良多87%。同年，纽约接收的小麦数量是新奥尔良的三倍。

Query_Text_en: Cleveland , Buffalo , and other lake ports , including the new village of Chicago , became transshipping centers similar to New Orleans and the other cotton ports .
Translation: 克利夫兰、布法罗以及其他湖港，包括新兴的芝加哥村，成为了类似新奥尔良及其他棉花港口的中转中心。

Query_Text_en: As in the cotton trade , advances and the discounting of notes on goods in transit came to play critical roles in financing the movement of crops .
Translation: 与棉花贸易一样，预付款和对运输途中货物的票据贴现在作物流通融资中发挥了关键作用。

Query_Text_en: Western millers , storekeepers , local merchants who built warehouses , and occasionally the farmers themselves consigned their grain or flour to commission houses and more specialized freight forwarders in the lake ports , particularly Buffalo .
Translation: 西部的碾磨商、店主、建有仓库的本地商人，以及偶尔的农民本人，将他们的粮食或面粉委托给位于湖港、尤其是布法罗的佣金行和更专业的货运代理公司。

Query_Text_en: In return they received advances which they usually discounted for cash .
Translation: 作为回报，他们获得了预付款，通常会以折价方式兑换现金。

Query_Text_en: The Buffalo merchants , in turn , sent grain to the millers of Rochester , or grain or flour to New York merchants such as Eli Hart and Company ; Suydam , Sage and Company ; or Chouteau , Merle and Standford who had previously provided advances .
Translation: 布法罗的商人则将粮食运往罗切斯特的磨坊主，或将粮食或面粉运往纽约的商行，如Eli Hart and Company、Suydam, Sage and Company，以及曾经提供预付款的Chouteau, Merle and Standford。

Query_Text_en: Whenever the final purchase was not designated , the shipment was sent on to a commission house or appointed agent in the east for final sale .
Translation: 如果最终购买方未被指定，货物便会被运往东部的委托行或指定代理进行最终销售。

Query_Text_en: That agent might ship it on consignment to a commission house in Liverpool or Rio de Janeiro for sale on the foreign market .
Translation: 该代理人可能会将其以寄售方式运送到利物浦或里约热内卢的佣金行，在海外市场进行销售。

Query_Text_en: These merchants shipping overseas obtained funds for advances from international merchant banking houses such as the Barings .
Translation: 这些从事海外航运的商人通过像巴林银行这样的国际商业银行获得了用于预付的资金。

Query_Text_en: The grain trade differed from the cotton trade , however , in that it marketed primarily in the United States and therefore was financed by American rather than British capital .
Translation: 然而，谷物贸易与棉花贸易不同，主要在美国国内销售，因此依靠美国资本而非英国资本进行融资。

Query_Text_en: Moreover , the trade had hardly been fully established before it was radically transformed in the 1850s by the coming of the railroad and the telegraph .
Translation: 此外，这一贸易尚未完全建立，就因19世纪50年代铁路和电报的出现而发生了根本性的变革。

Query_Text_en: The cotton trade , on the other hand , continued to operate relatively unchanged for several decades .
Translation: 另一方面，棉花贸易则在随后几十年里基本保持不变地持续运作。

Query_Text_en: The rise of specialized commercial enterprise to handle the flow of agricultural products out of the interior to the east and Europe was paralleled by a comparable specialization of enterprise to bring finished goods and staples into the coastal ports and thence to the interior .
Translation: 随着专门化商业企业的兴起，负责将农产品从内陆运往东部和欧洲，与此同时，也出现了同样专门化的企业，将制成品和日用品运入沿海港口，并进一步输送到内陆。

Query_Text_en: After 1815 , imports of manufactured products dry goods , metals , hardware , and drugs grew to an impressive volume .
Translation: 1815年以后，制成品的进口量大幅增长，包括纺织品、金属制品、五金和药品等，达到了可观的规模。

Query_Text_en: The expanding economy also increased the demand for coffee , tea , sugar , and molasses , products that grew in tropical or semitropical countries , and wines and spirits that were produced in Europe .
Translation: 经济的扩张也带动了对咖啡、茶叶、糖和糖浆等热带或亚热带国家生产的商品，以及欧洲生产的葡萄酒和烈酒的需求增长。

Query_Text_en: Before 1815 many of the commission houses which exported cotton also imported a wide variety of goods from Europe and the West Indies .
Translation: 1815年以前，许多出口棉花的委托行还从欧洲和西印度群岛进口各种商品。

Query_Text_en: But as the new patterns of trade evolved , they tended to concentrate on cotton exports and a smaller variety of more specialized imports .
Translation: 但随着新的贸易模式逐步形成，出口主要集中在棉花，进口则趋于品种更少、更加专业化。

Query_Text_en: In importing standardized goods , they increasingly gave way to the specialized importer who purchased directly in Europe and sold to local manufacturers , retailers , and wholesalers .
Translation: 在进口标准化商品方面，他们逐渐让位于专业进口商，后者直接在欧洲采购，并将商品销售给本地制造商、零售商和批发商。

Query_Text_en: Importers differed from exporters , since they often took title to goods , rather than selling them on consignment or commission .
Translation: 进口商与出口商不同，因为他们通常取得货物所有权，而不是以寄售或佣金的方式销售货物。

Query_Text_en: The experience of Nathan Trotter of Philadelphia provides a good example of the new specialized importer .
Translation: 费城的内森·特罗特公司的经历很好地体现了新型专业进口商的典型案例。

Query_Text_en: When Trotter joined a family partnership in 1802 , the firm was still importing and exporting a wide variety of goods .
Translation: 1802年，特罗特加入家族合伙企业时，公司仍在从事各类商品的进出口业务。

Query_Text_en: During the Napoleonic Wars the partnership concentrated on importing from Europe dry goods , felt , leather , and metals , much of which was reshipped and sold to the West Indies and Latin America .
Translation: 在拿破仑战争期间，该合作伙伴关系主要从欧洲进口干货、毛毡、皮革和金属，其中大部分被转运并销往西印度群岛和拉丁美洲。

Query_Text_en: The firm also shipped sugar , molasses , rum , and coffee to the United States and to Europe .
Translation: 该公司还向美国和欧洲出口糖、糖蜜、朗姆酒和咖啡。

Query_Text_en: Then , in 1816 , when Nathan Trotter took over the firm , he began to concentrate on importing a single line of goods iron , copper , and other metals .
Translation: 1816年，内森·特罗特接管公司后，开始专注于进口单一品类的商品——铁、铜及其他金属。

Query_Text_en: These he purchased directly in Britain and northern Europe .
Translation: 这些商品是他直接在英国和北欧采购的。

Query_Text_en: As domestic tariffs appeared , raising the price of metals , he began to buy in the United States .
Translation: 随着国内关税出台，金属价格上涨，他开始在美国采购。

Query_Text_en: He sold some of the more finished goods to local retailers and jobbers .
Translation: 他将部分加工较为精细的商品出售给当地零售商和批发商。

Query_Text_en: But the largest share of his trade went to traditional artisans ( blacksmiths , tinsmiths , and coppersmiths ) , to artisans who were beginning to specialize in making a single line of goods ( stoves , grates , furnaces , lamps , gas fixtures , and steam engines ) , and to new types of craftsmen ( roofers and plumbers ) . Elsewhere in the metals trade , Trotter s story was paralleled by that of Anson G. Phelps , James Boorman , and Joseph Johnson in New York , and David Reeves and Alfred Hunt in Philadelphia .
Translation: 但他的大部分贸易还是流向了传统工匠（如铁匠、锡匠和铜匠）、那些开始专门制造某一类产品的工匠（如炉具、壁炉、暖炉、灯具、煤气装置和蒸汽机），以及新兴的工匠类型（如屋顶工和管道工）。在金属贸易领域的其他地方，Trotter的经历与纽约的Anson G. Phelps、James Boorman和Joseph Johnson，以及费城的David Reeves和Alfred Hunt的故事如出一辙。

Query_Text_en: In the years after 1815a new type of specialized middleman appeared in the eastern seaports .
Translation: 1815年以后，东部沿海港口出现了一种新的专业中间人。

Query_Text_en: This was the jobber who , unlike the importer , purchased at home and who , more than the importer , sold his goods to plantation factors and storekeepers from the south and west .
Translation: 这就是批发商，与进口商不同，他在本地采购商品，并且比进口商更频繁地将商品销售给南部和西部的种植园代理人及店主。

Query_Text_en: Jobbers were , in the words of an 1829 report of the New York state legislature , an intermediate grade of merchants , between the wholesale and importing merchants and the retail shopkeepers .
Translation: 正如1829年纽约州议会报告中所述，批发商是介于批发和进口商与零售商之间的中间层级商人。

Query_Text_en: They purchased largely at auctions , at package sales , or wholesale importers , and in other such ways that they can obtain merchandise in reasonable ways .
Translation: 他们主要通过拍卖、打包销售或批发进口商等渠道采购商品，以此以合理的方式获得货物。

Query_Text_en: They then broke down large lots into smaller more varied ones , to meet the needs of local retailers and of country storekeepers and plantation factors who made semiannual purchases in their shops .
Translation: 随后，他们将大批量货物拆分成更小、更为多样的批次，以满足本地零售商、乡村店主以及种植园代理人在其商店中进行半年一次采购的需求。

Query_Text_en: As the quotation suggests , the rise of the jobber was closely related to the use of auctions in the marketing of imported goods .
Translation: 正如引文所示，掮客的兴起与进口商品营销中拍卖方式的运用密切相关。

Query_Text_en: Auctioning began on a large scale when the British dumped their textiles in New York and , to a lesser extent , other ports upon the reopening of transatlantic trade at the end of the War of 1812 .
Translation: 1812年战争结束后，跨大西洋贸易重新开放，英国人大量将纺织品倾销到纽约以及其他港口（规模较小），由此大规模拍卖活动开始兴起。

Query_Text_en: In Philadelphia and Boston established merchants were able to restrict the use of auctions by means of local and state ordinances .
Translation: 在费城和波士顿，已有的商人通过地方和州级条例限制了拍卖的使用。

Query_Text_en: In New York similar attempts failed . The extensive use of auctions during the 1820s helped to make New York a mecca for the country trade and brought a concentration of jobbers to that city . Although used primarily in the marketing of textiles , auctions became employed in the other basic trades as well . During the decade 1821-1830 auction sales in New York City amounted to $ 160 million or 40 percent of the value of that port s total imports and one-fifth of the value of the entire nation s imports .
Translation: 在纽约，类似的尝试未能成功。1820年代广泛采用拍卖，使纽约成为全国贸易的中心，并吸引了大量批发商聚集于此。拍卖主要用于纺织品的销售，但随后也被应用于其他主要行业。在1821至1830年间，纽约市的拍卖销售额达到了1.6亿美元，占该港口进口总值的40%，相当于全国进口总值的五分之一。

Query_Text_en: $  $ 1.0 million teas , silks , and chinaware from distant seas ; and $ 0.4 million wines and spirits largely from Europe .
Translation: 价值100万美元的茶叶、丝绸和瓷器来自遥远的海外；以及价值40万美元的葡萄酒和烈酒，主要来自欧洲。

Query_Text_en: In the 1830s and 1840s jobbers began to rely less on auctions and began to purchase more directly from agents of manufacturers , at first buying from domestic and then foreign producers .
Translation: 19世纪30至40年代，批发商开始减少对拍卖的依赖，转而更多地直接从制造商的代理商处采购，起初是向本国生产商购买，随后也开始向国外生产商采购。

Query_Text_en: A check of city directories emphasizes how predominant specialized business enterprise had become by the 1840s in the marketing and distributing of goods in the eastern ports .
Translation: 查阅城市名录可以看出，到19世纪40年代，专业化商业企业在东部港口的商品营销和分销中已占据主导地位。

Query_Text_en: It also shows in which trades the jobber had become most influential .
Translation: 它还显示了掮客在哪些行业中影响力最大。

Query_Text_en: For example , Dogget 's Directory for New York City in 1846 indicates that the number of specialized business enterprises was highest in dry goods and groceries , with 318 establishments in the first and 221 in the second .
Translation: 例如，1846年纽约市的多格特商业名录显示，专门经营的企业数量最多的是干货和杂货行业，前者有318家，后者有221家。

Query_Text_en: There were more jobbers than importers in dry goods , groceries , china , glass , and earthenware , and about the same number in drugs and wines and spirits .
Translation: 在干货、杂货、瓷器、玻璃和陶器行业，批发商的数量多于进口商，而在药品及酒类行业，两者数量大致相当。

Query_Text_en: On the other hand , importers continued to dominate the hardware , fancy dry goods , and clothing trades .
Translation: 另一方面，进口商依然主导着五金、精品杂货和服装行业。

Query_Text_en: All 40 watch dealers were importers . A quick and relatively superficial check of directories in other cities indicates that , until the 1850s , jobbers and importers that is , wholesalers who took title to their goods instead of selling on commission were concentrated in the eastern ports of New York , Philadelphia , and Baltimore .
Translation: 所有40家钟表商都是进口商。对其他城市目录进行快速且相对粗略的检查显示，直到19世纪50年代，批发商和进口商——也就是那些拥有商品所有权而非按佣金销售的批发商——主要集中在纽约、费城和巴尔的摩这些东部港口城市。

Query_Text_en: In these many ways the specialized impersonalized world of the jobber , importer , factor , broker , and the commission agent of the river and port towns replaced the personal world of the colonial merchant .
Translation: 在诸多方面，河港城镇的批发商、进口商、代理商、经纪人以及佣金代理人的专业化、非个人化世界，取代了殖民地商人的个人化世界。

Query_Text_en: Cotton had paced the transformation .
Translation: 棉花推动了这一变革。

Query_Text_en: The massive exports of the new crop provided payments for greatly expanded imports of manufactured goods and of foods and beverages that could not be grown or produced in this country .
Translation: 新作物的大规模出口为大量增加的进口提供了资金，这些进口包括本国无法种植或生产的工业制品以及食品和饮料。

Query_Text_en: The flows in and out of the nation and across the ocean came to be handled by a network of specialized middlemen .
Translation: 国内外以及跨洋的流通逐渐由一套专业中介网络来管理。

Query_Text_en: Nearly every plantation , farm , and village in the interior came to have direct commercial access to the growing cities of the east as well as to the manufacturing centers of Europe .
Translation: 几乎每一个内陆的种植园、农场和村庄，都能够直接与东部日益发展的城市以及欧洲的制造业中心进行商业往来。

Query_Text_en: The output of millions of acres moved every fall over thousands of miles of water .
Translation: 每年秋天，数百万英亩的产出通过数千英里的水路运输。

Query_Text_en: Dry goods from Manchester , hardware from Birmingham , iron from Sweden , the teas of China , and the coffees of Brazil were regularly shipped to towns and villages in a vast region which only a few years before was still wilderness .
Translation: 曼彻斯特的纺织品、伯明翰的五金、瑞典的铁、来自中国的茶叶和巴西的咖啡，定期运往那些仅在数年前还是荒野的广大地区的城镇和村庄。

Query_Text_en: This quickly created continental commercial network was coordinated almost entirely by market mechanisms .
Translation: 这个迅速建立的大陆商业网络几乎完全由市场机制进行协调。

Query_Text_en: Goods produced for other than local consumption moved through the national and international economy by a series of market transactions and physical transshipments .
Translation: 为非本地消费而生产的商品通过一系列市场交易和实际转运，在国家和国际经济体系中流通。

Query_Text_en: The cotton , as it traveled from the plantation to the river ports ( Memphis , Natchez , Huntsville , Montgomery , and Augusta ) , to the coastal ports ( New Orleans , Mobile , Savannah , Charleston ) , to the northeastern ports ( New York and Boston ) , to the continental ports ( Liverpool , Le Havre , Hamburg ) , and finally to the cotton textile manufacturers in New England , old England , and the continent , required at the very least four transactions ( between planter , factor , manufacturer s agent , and manufacturer ) , and often several more . And it passed through at least four transshipments and often several more .
Translation: 棉花从种植园运往河港（孟菲斯、纳奇兹、亨茨维尔、蒙哥马利和奥古斯塔）、再到沿海港口（新奥尔良、莫比尔、萨凡纳、查尔斯顿）、再到东北部港口（纽约和波士顿）、再到欧洲大陆港口（利物浦、勒阿弗尔、汉堡），最终抵达新英格兰、英国及欧洲大陆的棉纺织制造商。在这一过程中，棉花至少要经过四次交易（种植者、中间商、制造商代理和制造商），通常还会有更多交易。同时，棉花至少要经过四次转运，往往也会有更多次转运。

Query_Text_en: Provisions from the west moved south and east through a similar network .
Translation: 来自西部的物资通过类似的网络向南和向东运输。

Query_Text_en: Grain from the northwest also went through a comparable number of transactions and transshipments as it traveled from the farmer to the country store , to the interior town , river , or lake port , to the eastern seaport , and then sometimes overseas .
Translation: 来自西北地区的粮食在从农民手中流向乡村商店、内陆城镇、河港或湖港、再到东部海港，最后有时出口海外的过程中，也经历了类似数量的交易和转运环节。

Query_Text_en: The flow of finished goods involved similar sets of buyers , sellers , and shippers in European cities , American seaports , and river towns .
Translation: 成品的流通在欧洲城市、美洲港口和河畔城镇中，涉及类似的买家、卖家和运输商。

Query_Text_en: The granting of credit and the making of payments required a still different and even more complex set of transactions and flows .
Translation: 授信与支付的实现则需要另一套更加复杂的交易和流程。

Query_Text_en: In the agrarian economy of the first decades of the nineteenth century , the flow of goods was closely tied to the planting and harvesting of the crops .
Translation: 在十九世纪最初几十年的农业经济中，商品的流通与农作物的播种和收获紧密相关。

Query_Text_en: The merchants who carried out the commercial transactions and made the arrangements to move the crops out and finished goods in did so in order to make a profit on each transaction or sale .
Translation: 那些负责商业交易并安排农作物外运及成品进口的商人，都是为了在每一笔交易或销售中获得利润。

Query_Text_en: The American economy of the 1840s provides a believable illustration of the working of the untrammeled market economy so eloquently described by Adam Smith .
Translation: 19世纪40年代的美国经济为亚当·斯密所精辟阐述的自由市场经济的运作提供了一个可信的实例。

Query_Text_en: The expansion of trade in the first decades of the nineteenth century caused business enterprises to specialize in the financing and transportation of goods as well as in their marketing and distribution .
Translation: 19世纪最初几十年贸易的扩展，使商业企业不仅专注于商品的融资和运输，还专注于商品的营销和分销。

Query_Text_en: Specialization in finance and transportation , unlike that in distribution , led to an important institutional development : the growth of incorporated joint-stock companies .
Translation: 金融和交通领域的专业化，与流通领域的专业化不同，促成了一项重要的制度发展：股份有限公司的兴起。

Query_Text_en: Merchants continued to use the partnership as the legal form for shipping and financing ventures , as they did for their trading firms . Only when they found it advantageous to pool large amounts of capital to improve financial and transportation services by setting up banks , turnpikes , and canals did they turn to the corporation .
Translation: 商人们在航运和融资项目中，依然像经营贸易公司一样，采用合伙制作为法律形式。只有当他们发现，通过设立银行、公路和运河等方式，集中大量资本以提升金融和运输服务更为有利时，才转而采用公司制。

Query_Text_en: At first they looked on the corporation as the proper legal form for what they considered to be private enterprise in the public interest .
Translation: 起初，他们认为公司是将私人企业服务于公共利益的适当法律形式。

Query_Text_en: They used it to provide essential specialized ancillary services to support their profit-making commercial activities .
Translation: 他们利用它提供必要的专业辅助服务，以支持其盈利性商业活动。

Query_Text_en: When the pooling of local capital in a corporation was not enough to provide these services , the merchants did not hesitate to seek funds from public sources .
Translation: 当企业内部本地资本的筹集不足以提供这些服务时，商人们便毫不犹豫地寻求公共资金的支持。

Query_Text_en: Specialization in finance was a natural concomitant of specialization in other commercial activities .
Translation: 金融领域的专业化是其他商业活动专业化的自然结果。

Query_Text_en: As trade expanded , the older resident general merchants often turned to finance .
Translation: 随着贸易的扩展，早期常驻的总商们往往转向金融业。

Query_Text_en: The alternative was to specialize in trade with more distant regions , particularly China , India , and the East Indies , where the low volume of trade and high value of goods made it possible to continue the old patterns of commerce .
Translation: 另一种选择是专注于与更遥远地区的贸易，尤其是中国、印度和东印度，这些地区的贸易量较低但商品价值较高，使得延续以往的商业模式成为可能。

Query_Text_en: For some years after the War of 1812 the Perkinses , Forbeses , and Lees of Boston , and the Griswolds , Howlands , and Grinnells of New York continued to reap profits from these more exotic trades .
Translation: 在1812年战争结束后的若干年里，波士顿的珀金斯家族、福布斯家族和李家，以及纽约的格里斯沃尔德家族、豪兰家族和格林内尔家族，依然从这些更为异域的贸易中持续获利。

Query_Text_en: For most general merchants the old ways were no longer rewarding .
Translation: 对于大多数普通商人来说，传统方式已不再具有吸引力。

Query_Text_en: They suffered from the same experience as the Browns of Rhode Island .
Translation: 他们和罗德岛的布朗一家遭遇了同样的经历。

Query_Text_en: As James B. Hedges has recorded : The story of the shipping interests of Brown and Ives from 1815 to 1838 is anti-climactic , a doleful story of gradual decline and decay .
Translation: 正如詹姆斯·B·赫奇斯所记载：布朗与艾夫斯的航运业务在1815年至1838年间的发展并无高潮，而是一段逐渐衰落和凋敝的悲哀历程。

Query_Text_en: For many , the more profitable alternative was to concentrate on finance .
Translation: 对许多人来说，更有利可图的选择是专注于金融领域。

Query_Text_en: John Jacob Astor , Nathaniel Prime , Stephen Girard , Samuel Ward , the Browns of Providence , and the Browns of Baltimore were resident general merchants whose business increasingly became that of granting credit to and discounting exchanges for other merchants .
Translation: 约翰·雅各布·阿斯特、纳撒尼尔·普赖姆、斯蒂芬·吉拉德、塞缪尔·沃德、普罗维登斯的布朗家族以及巴尔的摩的布朗家族，都是常驻的综合商人，他们的业务逐渐转向为其他商人提供信贷和汇票贴现。

Query_Text_en: Later , even successful specialized merchants like Trotter carried on such banking activities .
Translation: 后来，即便像特罗特这样成功的专业商人，也继续从事此类银行业务。

Query_Text_en: And by the 1820s younger men were entering business as specialized private bankers and brokers .
Translation: 到了19世纪20年代，年轻人开始以专业私人银行家和经纪人的身份进入商界。

Query_Text_en: Fitch and Company of New York , Thomas Biddle and Company of Philadelphia , and Oelrich and Lurman of Baltimore were from their beginnings specialized banking enterprises rather than general mercantile firms .
Translation: 纽约的费奇公司、费城的托马斯·比德尔公司以及巴尔的摩的奥尔里奇与卢尔曼公司自成立之初就是专业的银行业企业，而非一般的商业公司。

Query_Text_en: The most powerful financiers in the American economy after 1815 were , however , those same men who had once held the most influential partnerships in trade : moving cotton out of and , to a lesser extent , finished goods into the United States .
Translation: 1815年后，美国经济中最具影响力的金融家，正是那些曾经在贸易领域拥有最重要合伙关系的人——他们主要负责将棉花运出美国，以及在较小程度上将制成品运入美国。

Query_Text_en: These were the enterprises that provided the credit advances so essential to the financing of the cotton trade .
Translation: 这些企业正是为棉花贸易融资提供至关重要的信贷预付的机构。

Query_Text_en: As Britain was the center of finance and had greater capital resources , these firms were British rather than American .
Translation: 由于英国是金融中心，资本实力更为雄厚，因此这些公司是英国企业，而非美国企业。

Query_Text_en: and Rathbone and Company .
Translation: 以及拉斯本公司。

Query_Text_en: After 1820 , leading London firms like Baring Brothers and the three W s ( Thomas Wilson and Company , George Wildes and Company , and Thomas Wiggins and Company ) entered the trade .
Translation: 1820年以后，伦敦的知名公司如巴林兄弟公司以及“三个W公司”（托马斯·威尔逊公司、乔治·怀尔德斯公司和托马斯·威金斯公司）也加入了这一贸易。

Query_Text_en: The only American-based firm to become one of the leading Anglo-American merchant bankers was the Browns of Baltimore , and this firm s Central partnership was housed in Liverpool .
Translation: 唯一一家跻身英美顶级商业银行家的美国本土公司是巴尔的摩的布朗家族，而该公司在英国的核心合伙机构设在利物浦。

Query_Text_en: With the merchants and merchant bankers financing interregional and international movements of trade , the incorporated bank served local needs .
Translation: 在商人和商业银行家为跨地区及国际贸易活动提供资金支持的同时，股份制银行则满足了本地需求。

Query_Text_en: By pooling of local capital in state chartered banks , businessmen increased sources for long-term loans , based on mortgages , securities , and even personal promissory notes ( if the latter had the additional signature of a co-maker ) .
Translation: 通过在州特许银行集中本地资本，商人们扩大了长期贷款的资金来源，这些贷款以抵押、证券，甚至个人本票为基础（如果个人本票上还有共同签署人的签名）。

Query_Text_en: In the United States early commercial banks became , therefore , more providers of long and medium capital needs than sources of short-term commercial loans .
Translation: 因此，在美国，早期的商业银行更多地成为中长期资本需求的提供者，而不是短期商业贷款的来源。

Query_Text_en: As one British commentator noted in 1837 about American banks : Their rule is our exception , our rule their exception .
Translation: 正如一位英国评论家在1837年谈及美国银行时所指出的：“他们的常规是我们的例外，我们的常规却是他们的例外。”

Query_Text_en: They prefer accommodation paper , resting on personal security and fixed wealth , to real bills of exchange , resting on wealth in transition from merchants and manufacturers to consumers . In addition state chartered banks issued bank notes which became the standard circulating medium in the United States .
Translation: 他们更倾向于以个人信用和固定资产为基础的承兑票据，而不是以商人和制造商向消费者转移中的流动财富为基础的真实汇票。此外，州特许银行发行的银行票据成为美国的标准流通媒介。

Query_Text_en: This was because the United States government issued almost no paper money until 1862 and only a limited amount of coin and because bills of exchange were not as abundant as they were in Europe where they served as the basic medium of exchange . Banks provided other services .
Translation: 这是因为在1862年之前，美国政府几乎没有发行纸币，硬币的发行量也十分有限；而汇票在美国也不像在欧洲那样普遍，欧洲的汇票是基本的交换媒介。银行则提供了其他服务。

Query_Text_en: They were relatively safe places to deposit funds .
Translation: 这些地方相对来说是资金存放的安全场所。

Query_Text_en: Their stock could be purchased as an investment at a time when investment opportunities in other than land and nonliquid assets were limited .
Translation: 在除土地和非流动性资产之外的投资机会有限的时期，他们的股票可以作为一种投资进行购买。

Query_Text_en: Finally , by incorporating a bank , local merchants were able to turn over the day-to-day work in providing specialized financial services to a fulltime salaried employee , who usually had the title of cashier .
Translation: 最后，通过设立银行，当地商人能够将日常提供专业金融服务的工作交由一名全职有薪员工负责，这名员工通常被称为出纳员。

Query_Text_en: The need for such services was strong enough to bring the incorporated bank quickly to all parts of the nation .
Translation: 对此类服务的强烈需求促使这家股份制银行迅速在全国各地开展业务。

Query_Text_en: The first was the Bank of North America in Philadelphia chartered in 1781 .
Translation: 第一家是于1781年在费城获准设立的北美银行。

Query_Text_en: In 1790 , six more banks were operating in the major American ports : New York , Philadelphia , Boston , Baltimore , and Charleston .
Translation: 1790年，美国主要港口城市纽约、费城、波士顿、巴尔的摩和查尔斯顿又有六家银行开始运营。

Query_Text_en: In 1791 , Congress approved Alexander Hamilton s proposal for a federally chartered bank with headquarters in Philadelphia and branches in the larger towns .
Translation: 1791年，国会批准了亚历山大·汉密尔顿提出的设立联邦特许银行的建议，该银行总部设在费城，并在较大城镇设有分支机构。

Query_Text_en: Indeed , I hinted I had learned something ;
Translation: 事实上，我暗示过我有所收获。

Query_Text_en: I thought it would force them to return me to the base where the aliens could let me live on or kill me , as it pleased them .
Translation: 我原以为这会迫使他们把我送回基地，让外星人决定是让我继续活下去还是杀死我，任由他们处置。

Query_Text_en: There was a good side to it : they flew up my daughter , whom I had never hoped to see again .
Translation: 这件事也有好的一面：他们把我的女儿接来了，我原本以为再也见不到她了。

Query_Text_en: Another air base , a wartime airfield , hardly more than a widened strip of highway and a few inconspicuous buildings in the middle of never-ending woods .
Translation: 另一个空军基地，一座战时机场，仅仅是一条拓宽的公路和几座不起眼的建筑，坐落在无尽森林的中央。

Query_Text_en: My daughter spent her days down by the lake , chaperoned by a long-haired conscript or watching Norwegian , Swedish , Finnish , and Russian children 's programs on TV .
Translation: 我女儿白天不是在湖边由一位长发的义务兵陪伴，就是在电视上观看挪威、瑞典、芬兰和俄罗斯的儿童节目。

Query_Text_en: The north of Sweden is an enormous country , largely uninhabited ; you can travel for hundreds of miles without seeing signs of human habitation .
Translation: 瑞典北部地域辽阔，人口稀少；你可以行驶数百英里而不见任何人类居住的迹象。

Query_Text_en: It is easy to get lost in this enormous wilderness where the night is as light as the day , where days pass away without one being aware of it , where one never seems to sleep .
Translation: 在这片广袤的荒野中，人们很容易迷失方向——这里的夜晚如白昼般明亮，时光悄然流逝而不觉，仿佛永远都无法入睡。

Query_Text_en: I was already lost in time ; I never noticed it .
Translation: 我早已迷失在时间里，根本没有察觉。

Query_Text_en: `` I took her over , '' I said to a more than usually affable young woman who stayed there for some time .
Translation: “我把她带过去了，”我对一位比平时更和蔼的年轻女士说道，她在那里待了一段时间。

Query_Text_en: She was small and round , with a big smile and rotten breath , and she bravely walked with me for miles , trying to pretend she enjoyed it .
Translation: 她个子矮小，身材圆润，脸上总挂着灿烂的笑容，口中却带着腐烂的气息。她勇敢地陪我走了好几英里，努力装作很享受的样子。

Query_Text_en: Of course , she knew I had taken her over instead of the other way around , that 's what made me so interesting .
Translation: 当然，她知道是我征服了她，而不是她征服了我，这正是我令她感兴趣的原因。

Query_Text_en: I glanced at her . She smiled back `` Her , '' I said , `` or him , or it , whatever . ''
Translation: 我瞥了她一眼。她回以微笑。“她，”我说，“或者他，或者它，随便。”

Query_Text_en: We stood on a rise overlooking the lake . My daughter was out there in a rowboat with the bored conscript She had quickly found out that she could order him around and have him obey , and she made him run errands like a schoolboy .
Translation: 我们站在一个小坡上俯瞰着湖面。我的女儿正和那个无精打采的征召兵一起划着小船。她很快发现自己可以指挥他，让他听从命令，于是像对待小学生一样让他跑腿办事。

Query_Text_en: He did n't seem to mind very much .
Translation: 他似乎并不太在意。

Query_Text_en: `` I 've lost her too , '' I said .
Translation: “我也失去了她，”我说。

Query_Text_en: `` That 's really the only thing that hurts .
Translation: “那才是真正让我感到痛苦的事情。”

Query_Text_en: She did n't understand . `` Yes , '' she said and smiled .
Translation: 她并不明白。“好的，”她微笑着说道。

Query_Text_en: `` You do n't like yourself , '' she said with a voice that suggested she understood and shared my opinion .
Translation: “你不喜欢自己，”她用一种似乎理解并认同我的看法的语气说道。

Query_Text_en: `` I do , but I do n't think I understand myself . ''
Translation: “我确实如此，但我觉得我并不真正了解自己。”

Query_Text_en: `` It is n't true at all , '' I said . `` You humor me , that 's something entirely different . ''
Translation: “根本不是这样的，”我说，“你只是迁就我，那完全是两回事。”

Query_Text_en: I tried to explain it to the psychiatrist , but without much success .
Translation: 我试图向那位精神科医生解释，但收效甚微。

Query_Text_en: I had no words to explain with , not even images to explain .
Translation: 我无法用语言来表达，甚至连图像也无法说明。

Query_Text_en: I had been brought to the air force base outside Stockholm , together with the two other Swedish Contacts ;
Translation: 我与另外两位瑞典联系人一起被带到了斯德哥尔摩郊外的空军基地。

Query_Text_en: contact was established , and I was rejected .
Translation: 取得了联系，但我被拒绝了。

Query_Text_en: That would have been the end of it , only it became known I had taken control over the contacting alien , which made me very interesting .
Translation: 事情本该就此结束，然而我掌控了与外星人接触的主动权，这一消息传开后，我变得极具吸引力。

Query_Text_en: I had also killed her , but that was not known then .
Translation: 我也杀了她，但当时还没人知道。

Query_Text_en: I said , `` Nothing that would make any sense to you .
Translation: 我说：“没有什么是你能理解的。”

Query_Text_en: It does n't even make sense to me . It was something that is n't done there , something so vile they could n't even think about it , so shameful they do n't have a name for it , or even a punishment .
Translation: 这对我来说简直无法理解。这种事情在那儿根本不会发生，恶劣到他们甚至无法想象，羞耻到连名字都没有，更没有任何惩罚措施。

Query_Text_en: I had her there , she was interested , it could be a break , a means of getting to the aliens , maybe a weapon of sorts .
Translation: 我把她留在那里，她对此很感兴趣，这或许是一个突破口，是接触外星人的途径，甚至可能是一种武器。

Query_Text_en: She watched me .
Translation: 她注视着我。

Query_Text_en: My daughter was out on the lake again , at two o'clock in the morning -- catching fish , watching them die , and throwing them back .
Translation: 我女儿凌晨两点又出现在湖上——钓鱼，看着鱼儿死去，然后再把它们扔回湖里。

Query_Text_en: `` I do n't have time anymore , '' I said , `` that 's why I must get back to them if they do n't come for me . ''
Translation: “我已经没有时间了，”我说，“所以如果他们不来接我，我必须回去找他们。”

Query_Text_en: These weeks and months could be a moment for her , or an eternity .
Translation: 这段时间对她来说，可能只是转瞬即逝的片刻，也可能是漫长无尽的永恒。

Query_Text_en: She could return any time , and she would not have changed at all .
Translation: 她随时都可以回来，而且她一点都不会改变。

Query_Text_en: I had killed her ; but for a species that does n't know time , death is just another experience among others , she 'd be back .
Translation: 我杀了她；但对于一个不知时间为何物的物种来说，死亡不过是众多经历中的一种，她还会回来。

Query_Text_en: In the eternal night at the bottom of the great oceans , innumerable metal nodules are spread over the never-ending deep-sea plains .
Translation: 在浩瀚大洋的永恒黑夜中，无数金属结核散布在无尽的深海平原上。

Query_Text_en: At one time the continent will sink , and the nodule resume its journey over the deep-sea plains , toward its starting point .
Translation: 有一天，这片大陆将会下沉，结核将重新开始在深海平原上的旅程，回到它的起点。

Query_Text_en: I watched my daughter playing on the beach , and I thought of the stones that started wandering long before life emerged on Earth and that will continue wandering long after it has disappeared .
Translation: 我看着女儿在海滩上玩耍，心里想着那些在地球上生命诞生之前就开始漂泊的石头，以及在生命消逝之后仍将继续漂泊的它们。

Query_Text_en: During the days and months that followed , I walked in the woods , pursued by shadows without names .
Translation: 在接下来的日子和月份里，我在林中漫步，身后始终被无名的阴影追逐。

Query_Text_en: I defended myself like when I was a kid , by walking certain trails without ever touching tree roots , or stepping over every second stone .
Translation: 我像小时候一样保护自己，走特定的小路时从不踩到树根，或者每隔一块石头就跨过去。

Query_Text_en: Two inventions sparked the computer revolution .
Translation: 两项发明引发了计算机革命。

Query_Text_en: The first was the so-called stored program concept .
Translation: 第一个是所谓的存储程序概念。

Query_Text_en: Every computer system since the late 1940s has adhered to this model , which prescribes a processor for crunching numbers and a memory for storing both data and programs .
Translation: 自20世纪40年代末以来，所有计算机系统都遵循这一模型：该模型规定，计算机应配备用于处理数据的处理器，以及用于存储数据和程序的存储器。

Query_Text_en: The advantage in such a system is that , because stored programs can be easily interchanged , the same hardware can perform a variety of tasks .
Translation: 这种系统的优势在于，由于存储程序可以轻松更换，同一硬件能够执行多种任务。

Query_Text_en: Had computers not been given this flexibility , it is probable that they would not have met with such widespread use .
Translation: 如果计算机没有具备这种灵活性，它们很可能不会得到如此广泛的应用。

Query_Text_en: During the late I940s , researchers invented the transistor .
Translation: 在20世纪40年代末，研究人员发明了晶体管。

Query_Text_en: These silicon switches were much smaller than the vacuum tubes used in early circuitry .
Translation: 这些硅开关比早期电路中使用的真空管要小得多。

Query_Text_en: As such , they enabled workers to create smaller and faster electronics .
Translation: 因此，它们使工人能够制造更小、更快的电子产品。

Query_Text_en: More than a decade passed before the stored program design and transistors were brought together in the same machine , and it was not until 1971 that the most significant pairing -- the Intel 4004-came about .
Translation: 在存储程序设计与晶体管被应用于同一台计算机之间，经历了十余年的时间，直到1971年，这两者才实现了最具意义的结合——英特尔4004的诞生。

Query_Text_en: This processor was the first to be built on a single silicon chip , which was no larger than a child 's fingernail .
Translation: 该处理器首次实现了在单一硅芯片上构建，其尺寸仅相当于儿童指甲大小。

Query_Text_en: Because of its tiny size , it was dubbed a microprocessor .
Translation: 由于其体积微小，它被称为微处理器。

Query_Text_en: Although this basic recipe is still followed , the production line has made ever cheaper , faster chips over time by churning out larger wafers and smaller transistors .
Translation: 尽管这一基本工艺仍被沿用，但生产线通过制造更大尺寸的晶圆和更小的晶体管，持续推出成本更低、速度更快的芯片。

Query_Text_en: This trend reveals an important principle of microprocessor economics : the more chips made per wafer , the less expensive they are .
Translation: 这一趋势揭示了微处理器经济学中的一个重要原则：每片晶圆制造的芯片越多，单个芯片的成本就越低。

Query_Text_en: Larger chips are faster than smaller ones because they can hold more transistors .
Translation: 较大的芯片比小型芯片速度更快，因为它们可以容纳更多的晶体管。

Query_Text_en: But larger chips are also more likely to contain flaws .
Translation: 但更大尺寸的芯片也更容易出现缺陷。

Query_Text_en: Computer companies acted in concert to adopt this design strategy during the I980s , and as a result , the rate of improvement in microprocessor technology has risen from 35 percent a year only a decade ago to its current high of approximately 55 percent a year , or almost 4 percent each month .
Translation: 20世纪80年代，计算机公司协同采取了这一设计策略，因此，微处理器技术的进步速度从十年前每年仅35%，提升到目前每年约55%的高水平，几乎相当于每月提高4%。

Query_Text_en: These breakthroughs will undoubtedly lead to further advancements in the near future .
Translation: 这些突破无疑将在不久的将来带来进一步的发展。

Query_Text_en: One key technique is called pipelining .
Translation: 一种关键技术被称为流水线。

Query_Text_en: The pipelined approach is much quicker .
Translation: 流水线式方法速度更快。

Query_Text_en: As soon as the first load is in the dryer , the second dirty load goes into the washer , and so on .
Translation: 第一批衣物放进烘干机后，第二批脏衣服就立即进入洗衣机，如此循环。

Query_Text_en: All the stages operate concurrently .
Translation: 所有阶段同时运行。

Query_Text_en: The pipelining paradox is that it takes the same amount of time to clean a single dirty sock by either method .
Translation: 流水线悖论在于，无论采用哪种方法，清洗一只脏袜子所需的时间都是相同的。

Query_Text_en: Yet pipelining is faster in that more loads are finished per hour .
Translation: 然而，流水线作业的速度更快，因为每小时完成的装载数量更多。

Query_Text_en: In fact , assuming that each stage takes the same amount of time , the time saved by pipelining is proportional to the number of stages involved .
Translation: 事实上，假设每个阶段所需时间相同，流水线节省的时间与所涉及的阶段数量成正比。

Query_Text_en: In our example , pipelined laundry has four stages , so it would be nearly four times faster than nonpipelined laundry .
Translation: 在我们的例子中，流水线式洗衣分为四个阶段，因此其速度几乎是非流水线洗衣的四倍。

Query_Text_en: Twenty loads would take roughly five hours .
Translation: 二十车货大约需要五个小时。

Query_Text_en: Also in the interest of making faster chips , designers have begun to include more hardware to process more tasks at each stage of a pipeline .
Translation: 同样出于提升芯片速度的考虑，设计人员开始在流水线的每个阶段加入更多硬件，以便在每个阶段处理更多任务。

Query_Text_en: The buzzword `` superscalar '' is commonly used to describe this approach .
Translation: “超标量”一词通常用来描述这种方法。

Query_Text_en: A superscalar laundromat , for example , would use a professional machine that could say and wash three loads at once .
Translation: 例如，超标量洗衣店会使用专业设备，一次可以同时清洗三批衣物。

Query_Text_en: Modem superscalar microprocessors try to perform anywhere from three to six instructions in each stage .
Translation: 现代超标量微处理器在每个阶段通常会执行三到六条指令。

Query_Text_en: Hence , a 250 - megahertz , four-way superscalar microprocessor can execute a billion instructions per second .
Translation: 因此，一款250兆赫、四路超标量微处理器每秒可执行十亿条指令。

Query_Text_en: A 21st-century microprocessor may well launch up to dozens of instructions in each stage .
Translation: 21世纪的微处理器在每个阶段可能会同时启动多达数十条指令。

Query_Text_en: Since random-access memory -LRB- RAM -RRB- on a chip became widely available in the mid-I970s , its capacity has grown fourfold every three years .
Translation: 自20世纪70年代中期芯片上的随机存取存储器（RAM）被广泛应用以来，其容量每三年增长四倍。

Query_Text_en: But memory speed has not increased at anywhere near this rate .
Translation: 但内存速度的提升远未达到这一增长幅度。

Query_Text_en: The gap between the top speed of processors and the top speed of memories is widening .
Translation: 处理器的最高速度与存储器的最高速度之间的差距正在扩大。

Query_Text_en: The Holy Grail of computer design is an approach called parallel processing , which delivers all the benefits of a single fast processor by engaging many inexpensive ones at the same time .
Translation: 计算机设计领域的终极目标是并行处理，这种方法通过同时运行多个廉价处理器，实现了单一高速处理器所带来的全部优势。

Query_Text_en: In our analogy , we would go to a laundromat and use 20 washers and 20 dryers to do 20 loads simultaneously .
Translation: 在我们的类比中，我们会去自助洗衣店，使用20台洗衣机和20台烘干机，同时清洗20批衣物。

Query_Text_en: Clearly , parallel processing is an expensive solution for a small workload .
Translation: 显然，对于较小的工作负载而言，采用并行处理是一种成本较高的解决方案。
