Query_Text_en: Archimedes therefore fixed upon a three-master merchantman of the royal fleet , which had been dragged ashore by the great labors of many men , and after putting on board many passengers and the customary freight , he seated himself at a distance from her , and without any great effort , but quietly setting in motion with his hand a system of compound pulleys , drew her towards him smoothly and evenly , as though she were gliding through the water .
Translation: 因此，阿基米德选择了一艘属于王室舰队的三桅商船，这艘船曾经在众多工人的辛勤努力下被拖上岸。他将大量乘客和常规货物装载上船后，自己坐在距离船只较远的地方，仅凭手轻松地操控一套复合滑轮系统，毫不费力地将船平稳均匀地拉向自己，仿佛船只在水中滑行一般。

Query_Text_en: The principle of lever plays a very important role in all walks of life from a farmer using a crowbar to move away a heavy boulder , to the intricate machinery used in modern engineering .
Translation: 杠杆原理在各行各业中都发挥着极其重要的作用，无论是农民用撬棍搬动沉重的石块，还是现代工程中复杂的机械设备，都离不开它。

Query_Text_en: The law of lever formulated by Archimedes permits us to introduce a very important mechanical notion of the work done by an acting force .
Translation: 阿基米德提出的杠杆定律使我们能够引入一个非常重要的力学概念——作用力所做的功。

Query_Text_en: Probably the best-known discovery made by Archimedes is his law pertaining to the loss of weight by bodies submerged into a liquid .
Translation: 阿基米德最著名的发现，可能就是他关于物体浸入液体后重量减轻的定律。

Query_Text_en: In the case of Archimedes , although he made many wonderful discoveries of diverse kinds , yet of them all , the following , which I shall relate , seems to have been the result of a boundless ingenuity .
Translation: 以阿基米德为例，尽管他在多个领域都有诸多杰出的发现，但在所有成就之中，我接下来要讲述的这一项，似乎最能体现他无与伦比的才智。

Query_Text_en: Hiero , after gaining the royal power in Syracuse , resolved as the consequence of his successful exploit , to place in a certain temple a golden crown which he had vowed to the immortal gods .
Translation: 希罗在取得锡拉库萨的王权后，决定因自己的成功事迹，将一顶他曾向永生诸神许愿的金冠供奉于某座神庙。

Query_Text_en: He contracted for its making at a fixed price and weighed out a precise amount of gold to the contractor .
Translation: 他以固定价格签订了制作合同，并精确称量了一定数量的黄金交给承包商。

Query_Text_en: At the appointed time the latter delivered to the King 's satisfaction an exquisitely finished piece of handiwork , and it appeared that in weight the crown corresponded precisely to what the gold had weighed .
Translation: 到了约定的时间，这位工匠向国王呈上了一件精美绝伦的手工艺品，国王对此非常满意。经称量，王冠的重量与原先黄金的重量完全一致。

Query_Text_en: But afterwards a charge was made that gold had been abstracted and an equivalent weight of silver had been added in the manufacture of the crown .
Translation: 但后来有人指控，在制造王冠的过程中，有人取出了部分黄金，并加入了等量的白银。

Query_Text_en: Hiero , thinking it an outrage that he had been tricked , and yet not knowing how to detect the theft , requested Archimedes to consider the matter .
Translation: 希罗认为自己受骗是一种极大的侮辱，但又不知如何查明盗窃的真相，于是请求阿基米德设法解决此事。

Query_Text_en: Taking this as the beginning of his discovery , it is said that he made two masses of the same weight as the crown , one of gold and the other of diver .
Translation: 据说，他以此为发现的起点，制作了两个与王冠重量相同的物体，一个是金的，另一个是银的。

Query_Text_en: After making them , he filled a large vessel with water to the very brim and dropped the mass of silver into it .
Translation: 制作完成后，他将一个大容器装满水，直到水面与容器边缘齐平，然后把那块银块放进去。

Query_Text_en: As much water ran out as was equal in bulk to that of the silver sunk in the vessel .
Translation: 流出的水量与沉入容器中的银块体积相等。

Query_Text_en: Then , taking out the mass , he poured back the lost quantity of water , using a pint measure , until it was level with the brim as it had been before .
Translation: 然后，他取出固体物质，用品脱量杯将失去的水量重新倒回去，直到水面与之前一样齐平杯口。

Query_Text_en: Thus he found the weight of silver corresponding to a definite quantity of water .
Translation: 因此，他找到了与一定量水相对应的银的重量。

Query_Text_en: After this experiment , he likewise dropped the mass of gold into the full vessel and , on taking it out and measuring as before , found that not so much water was lost , but a smaller quantity : namely , as much less as a mass of gold lacks in bulk compared to a mass of silver of the same weight .
Translation: 在这次实验之后，他同样将金块投入装满水的容器中，并像之前一样取出金块并进行测量，发现损失的水量并没有那么多，而是更少；具体来说，减少的水量正好等于同等重量的金块与银块在体积上的差异。

Query_Text_en: Finally , filling the vessel again and dropping the crown itself into the same quantity of water , he found that more water ran over for the crown than for the mass of gold of the same weight .
Translation: 最后，他再次将容器注满水，并将王冠本身投入相同数量的水中，发现溢出的水比等重的金块更多。

Query_Text_en: Hence , reasoning from the fact that more water was lost in the case of the crown than in that of the mass , he detected the mixing of silver with the gold and made the theft of the contractor perfectly clear .
Translation: 因此，通过推断王冠比金块失去更多水量，他发现黄金中掺杂了银，从而明确揭示了承包商的盗窃行为。

Query_Text_en: The proof of Archimedes ' law given by him in his book On Floating Bodies is somewhat cumbersome , even though completely correct , and we will reproduce it here in more modern language , considering what will happen if we submerge a solid metal ball into a bucket of water .
Translation: 阿基米德在其著作《浮体论》中给出的阿基米德定律证明虽然完全正确，但过程略显繁琐。我们将在这里用更现代的语言重新阐述这一证明，假设将一个实心金属球浸入一桶水中，探讨会发生什么。

Query_Text_en: Suppose we first take , instead of an iron sphere , a thin plastic sphere of the same diameter filled with water .
Translation: 假设我们首先不是使用一个铁球，而是用一个直径相同、内部装满水的薄塑料球。

Query_Text_en: Since the weight of the plastic shell can be neglected , the situation will be the same as if the water inside the shell would be just a part of water in the bucket , and the scales will show zero .
Translation: 由于塑料壳的重量可以忽略不计，因此这种情况下，壳内的水就相当于桶中水的一部分，天平的读数将为零。

Query_Text_en: Now replace the water in the shell with iron , which is seven times heavier than the equal volume of water . Since 1 pound of water was supported by the rest of the water in the bucket with the scales showing zero , the change from water to iron will add only 7 1 = 6 additional pounds , and that is what the scales are going to read in this case .
Translation: 现在将壳中的水换成铁，铁的重量是同体积水的七倍。由于之前壳中1磅水被桶内其他水支撑，秤显示为零，因此将水换成铁后，只会增加7磅减去1磅，即额外增加6磅，这就是秤在这种情况下的读数。

Query_Text_en: Thus , we conclude that the iron sphere weighing ( in air ) 7 pounds lost 1 pound by being submerged in water , i.e. , the weight of water it displaces .
Translation: 因此，我们得出结论：在空气中重达7磅的铁球，浸入水中后减轻了1磅，也就是说，它排开了1磅重的水。

Query_Text_en: This is Archimedes law , which states that any solid body submerged in a liquid loses the weight of this liquid displaced by it .
Translation: 这就是阿基米德定律，即任何固体浸入液体中时，都会失去与其所排开的液体重量相等的重量。

Query_Text_en: Besides being a great mathematician and the founder of the science of mechanics , Archimedes also served , putting it in modem terms , as a ' consultant to industry and to the Armed Forces ' . The best known of his engineering inventions is the so-called ' Archimedian screw ' , shown in Figure 1-7 , used for raising water .
Translation: 除了是一位伟大的数学家和力学科学的奠基人之外，用现代术语来说，阿基米德还曾担任“工业和军队的顾问”。他最著名的工程发明是所谓的“阿基米德螺旋”，如图1-7所示，用于提升水流。

Query_Text_en: This device , the functioning of which is self-evident , was apparently widely used in irrigation , and for removing subterranean water from the mines .
Translation: 这种装置，其工作原理一目了然，显然被广泛用于灌溉以及排除矿井中的地下水。

Query_Text_en: Archimedes ' participation in war work started apparently from his demonstration of the pulley to King Hiero .
Translation: 阿基米德参与战争工作的起点，显然是他向希罗国王展示滑轮的那次演示。

Query_Text_en: Hiero , being amazed by this demonstration , and comprehending the power of his art , persuaded Archimedes to prepare for him offensive and defensive engines to be used in every kind of siege warfare .
Translation: 希罗对此展示感到震惊，并深刻领会到阿基米德技艺的威力，于是说服阿基米德为他制造攻防兼备、适用于各种攻城战的机械装备。

Query_Text_en: These he had never used himself , because he spent the greater part of his life in freedom from war and amid the festal rites of peace ; but at the present time his apparatus stood the Syracusans in good stead , and , with the apparatus , its fabricator .
Translation: 这些装备他本人从未使用过，因为他的大部分人生都在和平的庆典和远离战争的环境中度过；但在当下，这些装备以及它们的制造者却为叙拉古人带来了极大的帮助。

Query_Text_en: When , therefore , the Romans assaulted them by sea and land , the Syracusans were stricken dumb with terror ; they thought that nothing could withstand so furious an onset by such forces .
Translation: 因此，当罗马人从海陆两路对他们发起进攻时，叙拉古人被恐惧所震慑，惊愕无言；他们认为，没有任何力量能够抵挡如此强大的军队发动的猛烈攻势。

Query_Text_en: But Archimedes began to ply his engines , and shot against the land forces of the assailants all sorts of missiles and immense masses of stones , which came down with incredible din and speed ; nothing whatever could ward off their weight , but they knocked down in heaps those who stood in their way , and threw their ranks into confusion .
Translation: 但阿基米德开始操纵他的机械，对进攻的陆军发射各种弹药和巨大的石块，这些石块以难以置信的轰鸣和速度砸下来，没有任何东西能够抵挡它们的重量，凡是挡在前面的士兵都被成堆击倒，敌军阵型也因此陷入混乱。

Query_Text_en: At the same time huge beams were suddenly projected over the ships from the walls , which sank some of them with great weights plunging down from on high ; others were seized at the prow by iron claws , or beaks like the beaks of cranes , drawn straight up into the air , and then plunged stern foremost into the depths , or were turned round and round by means of enginery within the city , and dashed upon the steep cliffs that jutted out beneath the wall of the city , with great destruction of the fighting men on board , who perished in the wrecks .
Translation: 与此同时，城墙上突然伸出巨大的横梁，有的从高处投下沉重的物体，将一些船只击沉；还有的用铁钩或类似鹤嘴的装置抓住船头，直接将船只提到空中，然后船尾朝下抛入深水中；或者通过城内的机械装置将船只反复旋转，猛力撞向城墙下突出的陡峭岩石，船上的士兵在船只毁坏中大量丧生。

Query_Text_en: Frequently , too , a ship would be lifted out of the water into mid-air , whirled hither and thither as it hung there , a dreadful spectacle , until its crew had been thrown out and hurled in all directions , when it would fall empty upon the walls , or slip away from the clutch that had held it .
Translation: 常常，一艘船会被从水中举到空中，在半空中旋转飘荡，成为令人恐惧的景象，直到船员被抛出、四散飞落，船才空无一人地坠落在城墙上，或从那只抓住它的手中滑脱。

Query_Text_en: As for the engine which Marcellus was bringing up on the bridge of ships , and which was called ' sambuca ' from some resemblance it had to the musical instrument of that name , while it was still some distance off in its approach to the wall , a stone of ten talents ' weight was discharged at it , then a second and a third ; some of these , falling upon it with great din and surge of wave , crushed the foundation of the engine , shattered its frame-work , and dislodged it from the platform , so that Marcellus , in perplexity , ordered his ships to sail back as fast as they could , and his land forces to retire .
Translation: 至于马塞勒斯正在桥上推进的攻城器械，由于其形状与同名乐器相似，被称为“桑布卡”，当它距离城墙尚有一段距离时，一块重达十塔兰特的巨石被投射而来，随后又接连第二块、第三块巨石。部分巨石伴随着巨大的轰鸣和波涛落在器械上，摧毁了其基础，击碎了框架，并将其从平台上震落。马塞勒斯陷入困惑，随即下令舰队尽快撤退，陆军也随之后撤。

Query_Text_en: Then , in a council of war , it was decided to come up under the walls while it was still night , if they could ; for the ropes which Archimedes used in his engines , since they imported great impetus to the missiles cast , would , they thought , send them flying over their heads , but would be ineffective at close quarters , where there was no space for the cast .
Translation: 于是，在一次军事会议上，他们决定如果可能的话，在夜色尚浓时靠近城墙；因为阿基米德在其攻城器械中使用的绳索，能够为投射物提供巨大的冲击力，他们认为这些投射物会从头顶飞过，但在近距离时，由于没有足够的投射空间，这些器械就无法发挥作用。

Query_Text_en: Archimedes , however , as it seemed , had long before prepared for such an emergency engines with a range adapted to any interval and missiles of short flight , and , through many small and contiguous openings in the wall , short-range engines called ' scorpions ' could be brought to bear on objects dose at hand without being seen by the enemy .
Translation: 然而，阿基米德似乎早已为此类紧急情况做好了准备，他设计了射程可根据距离调整的各类攻防器械和短程投射武器。通过城墙上众多小而相连的开口，可以部署名为“蝎子”的短程攻城器械，对近距离目标进行打击，而敌人却无法发现这些武器的存在。

Query_Text_en: When , therefore , the Romans came up under the walls , thinking themselves unnoticed , once more they encountered a great storm of missiles ; huge stones came tumbling down upon them almost perpendicularly , and the wall shot out arrows at them from every point ; they therefore retired .
Translation: 因此，当罗马人悄然逼近城墙，以为无人察觉时，他们再次遭遇了一场猛烈的箭雨；巨石几乎垂直地砸向他们，城墙各处也不断射出箭矢。于是，罗马人只得撤退。

Query_Text_en: And here again , when they were some distance off , missiles darted forth and fell upon them ; many of their ships , too , were dashed together , and they could not retaliate in any way upon their foes . For Archimedes had built most of his engines close behind the wall , and the Romans seemed to be fighting against the gods , now that countless mischiefs were poured out upon them from an invisible source .
Translation: 这一次，当他们距离城墙还有一段距离时，飞射的弹药又袭来，落在他们身上；许多战船也被撞在一起，他们无法对敌人进行任何反击。因为阿基米德将大多数攻城器械都建在城墙后方，罗马人仿佛在与神作战，无数灾祸从看不见的地方倾泻而下。

Query_Text_en: However , Marcellus made his escape , and jesting with his own artificers and engineers , ' Let us stop , ' said he , ' fighting against this geometrical Briareus , who uses our ships like cups to ladle water from the sea , and has whipped and driven off in disgrace our sambuca , and with the many missiles which he shoots against us all at once , outdoes the hundred handed monsters of mythology . '
Translation: 然而，马塞勒斯成功逃脱，并对自己的工匠和工程师开玩笑说：“让我们停止与这个几何学的百臂巨人作战吧。他把我们的船当作勺子，从海里舀水，还羞辱并赶走了我们的桑布卡攻城器。他一次发射的众多弹药，远胜神话中的百手怪物。”

Query_Text_en: For in reality all the rest of the Syracusans were but a body for the designs of Archimedes , and his the one soul moving and managing everything ; for all other weapons lay idle , and his alone were then employed by the city both in offence and defense .
Translation: 实际上，所有其他叙拉古人不过是阿基米德谋划的躯壳，而他则是唯一主导和操控一切的灵魂；其他武器都被搁置一旁，只有他的发明在城中用于攻防两端。

Query_Text_en: At last the Romans became so fearful that , whenever they saw a bit of rope or a stick of timber projecting a little over the wall , ' There it is , ' they cried , ' Archimedes is training some engine upon us , ' and turned their backs and fled .
Translation: 最后，罗马人变得极度恐慌，每当他们看到墙上稍微伸出一根绳子或一块木头，便惊叫道：“在那里！阿基米德又在用某种器械对付我们！”随即转身逃跑。

Query_Text_en: Seeing this , Marcellus desisted from all fighting and assault , and thenceforth depended on a long siege .
Translation: 见此情形，马塞勒斯停止了所有战斗和进攻，从此转而依靠长期围困。

Query_Text_en: When , after two years of siege , in the year 212 B.C. , Syracuse was finally captured by Roman legions , a detachment of Roman soldiers broke into the house of Archimedes , who was engaged in his back yard in drawing some complicated geometrical figures on the sand .
Translation: 公元前212年，经过两年的围困，罗马军团终于攻占了叙拉古。一队罗马士兵闯入阿基米德的住所，当时他正在自家后院的沙地上绘制一些复杂的几何图形。

Query_Text_en: In response , the soldier drove his spear through the body of the old philosopher .
Translation: 作为回应，士兵用长矛刺穿了那位老哲学家的身体。

Query_Text_en: When Cicero was quaestor , visiting Sicily in 137 B.C. he found the tomb of Archimedes , near the Agrigentinc gate , overgrown with thorns and briers .
Translation: 西塞罗在公元前137年担任财务官访问西西里时，发现了阿基米德的墓地，该墓位于阿格里真图门附近，早已被荆棘和野草覆盖。

Query_Text_en: ` ' Thus , ' writes Cicero , ' would this most famous and once most learned city of Greece have remained a stranger to the tomb of its most ingenious citizen , had it not been discovered by a man of Arpinum . '
Translation: 因此，西塞罗写道：“这座曾经最著名、最博学的希腊城市，若不是由一位阿尔皮努姆人发现，竟会对其最具才华的公民的墓地一无所知。”

Query_Text_en: With the decline of the political and economic power of Athens , the center of Greek culture shifted to Alexandria , founded in 332 B.C. on the Egyptian shore of the Mediterranean by Alexander the Great as the key port for trade between Europe and the Orient .
Translation: 随着雅典政治和经济实力的衰落，希腊文化的中心转移到了亚历山大城。该城由亚历山大大帝于公元前332年在地中海的埃及海岸建立，成为连接欧洲与东方贸易的关键港口。

Query_Text_en: By that time Alexandria developed into a beautiful city with ' . . .  : 4,000 palaces , 4,000 baths , 12,000 gardeners , 40,000 Jews who paid tribute , and 400 theaters and other places of amusement . '
Translation: 到那时，亚历山大城已发展成为一座美丽的城市，拥有“……4,000座宫殿、4,000家浴场、12,000名园丁、40,000名纳贡的犹太人，以及400家剧院和其他娱乐场所。”

Query_Text_en: It also boasted a leading university , and a great library which was later unfortunately destroyed by fire as a result of a general conflagration of the city caused by Julius Caesar 's order to bum the Egyptian fleet in Alexandria 's harbor .
Translation: 它还拥有一所著名大学和一座宏伟的图书馆，遗憾的是，这座图书馆后来因朱利乌斯·凯撒下令焚烧亚历山大港口的埃及舰队，引发城市大火而被毁。

Query_Text_en: Here Euclid wrote his Elements of Geometry , and Archimedes acquired his knowledge of the sciences as a young student from Syracuse .
Translation: 欧几里得在这里撰写了《几何原本》，而阿基米德则在年少时从叙拉古来到这里，获得了他的科学知识。

Query_Text_en: In the field of astronomy , Alexandria was represented by Hipparchus , who lived in the middle of the 2nd century B.C. Hipparchus developed to the highest precision possible at that time the observation of the position of stars , and compiled a catalogue of 1,080 stars , which is still used by modern astronomers as the reference source for the ancient data on stellar positions .
Translation: 在天文学领域，亚历山大城由希帕克斯代表，他生活在公元前2世纪中叶。希帕克斯将恒星位置的观测提升到了当时能够达到的最高精度，并编制了一份包含1,080颗恒星的星表。该星表至今仍被现代天文学家用作古代恒星位置数据的参考来源。

Query_Text_en: He also discovered the phenomenon of precession of equinoxes , which are the points on the celestial sphere at which the sun crosses the celestial equator in its annual motion between the stars .
Translation: 他还发现了春分点岁差现象，即太阳在其年度穿越恒星之间运动时，穿越天球赤道的那些点。

Query_Text_en: This phenomenon is due to the fact that the axis of the earth 's rotation , being inclined to the plane of its orbit , describes a cone in space around the line perpendicular to the orbit , with the period of 26,000 years .
Translation: 这一现象是由于地球自转轴相对于其轨道平面存在倾斜，并以2.6万年为周期，围绕垂直于轨道的那条线在太空中描绘出一个圆锥体所致。

Query_Text_en: The cause of that motion was found almost a thousand years later by Sir Isaac Newton .
Translation: 近一千年后，艾萨克·牛顿爵士才发现了这种运动的原因。

Query_Text_en: As far as physics goes , the Alexandrian school was represented by Heron ( or Hero ) , who was less of a physicist and more of an engineer inventor .
Translation: 在物理学方面，亚历山大学派的代表人物是赫伦（或称希罗），他与其说是物理学家，不如说更是一位工程师和发明家。

Query_Text_en: His book Mechanics contains many true statements , but many bad mathematical mistakes .
Translation: 他的著作《力学》包含许多正确的论述，但也存在大量严重的数学错误。

Query_Text_en: In spite of its defects in the mathematical treatment of the basic problems , Heron 's book on mechanics contains the description of a large number of useful gadgets , such as composite pulleys , various types of gears , and cogwheel mechanisms , etc. .
Translation: 尽管在基本问题的数学处理上存在不足，希罗的《力学》一书仍详细描述了大量实用装置，如复合滑轮、各种类型的齿轮以及齿轮机构等。

Query_Text_en: In his book on ' pneumatics ' he describes the principle of siphon , and a steam jet engine which , being similar to an ordinary lawn sprinkler , can be considered , however , as the precursor of modern jet propulsion motors .
Translation: 在他的《气体力学》一书中，他描述了虹吸原理，并介绍了一种蒸汽喷射发动机。该发动机与普通的草坪喷洒器类似，但可以被视为现代喷气推进发动机的先驱。

Query_Text_en: Heron had also written a book entitled Catoptrics , containing the theory of mirrors and their practical applications .
Translation: 赫龙还著有《镜学》一书，内容涵盖了镜子的理论及其实际应用。

Query_Text_en: Catoptrics is clearly a science worthy of study and at the same time produces spectacles which excite wonder in the observer .
Translation: 镜学显然是一门值得研究的科学，同时还能创造出令观者惊叹的奇观。

Query_Text_en: For with the aid of this science , mirrors are constructed which show the right side as right side , and similarly the left side , whereas ordinary mirrors by their nature have the contrary property and show the opposite sides .
Translation: 借助这门科学，可以制造出镜子，使右侧显示为右侧，左侧显示为左侧，而普通镜子由于其本质特性则恰恰相反，显示的是对立的两侧。

Query_Text_en: This is done by placing two mirrors , without frames , edge to edge and at a right angle to one another .
Translation: 具体做法是将两面无框镜子边对边地以直角摆放。

Query_Text_en: It is possible with the aid of mirrors to see our own backs ( the way the barber shows you the haircut on the back of your neck ) and to see ourselves inverted , standing on our heads , with three eyes and two noses , the features distorted as if in intense grief ( as in a mirror pavilion in an amusement park ) .
Translation: 借助镜子，我们可以看到自己的背部（就像理发师展示你后颈的发型一样），也可以看到自己倒立的样子，拥有三只眼睛和两个鼻子，五官扭曲，仿佛陷入深切的悲伤（如同游乐园里的镜厅）。

Query_Text_en: Practically all who have written of dioptrics have been in doubt as to why rays proceeding from our eyes are reflected by mirrors and why the reflections arc at equal angles .
Translation: 几乎所有研究屈光学的人都曾对为何来自我们眼睛的光线会被镜子反射，以及为何反射角相等感到疑惑。

Query_Text_en: Now the proposition that our sight is directed in straight lines proceeding from the organ of vision may be substantiated as follows .
Translation: 现在，我们可以通过以下方式证明这样一个观点：我们的视线是沿着从视觉器官发出的直线投射出去的。

Query_Text_en: For whatever moves with unchanging velocity moves in a straight line .
Translation: 任何以恒定速度运动的物体都沿直线运动。

Query_Text_en: The arrows we see shot from bows may serve as an example .
Translation: 我们看到弓箭射出的箭矢可以作为一个例子。

Query_Text_en: For , because of the impelling force , the object in motion strives to move over the shortest possible distance , since it has not the time for slower motion , that is , for the motion over a longer trajectory . The impelling force does not permit such retardation .
Translation: 由于推动力的作用，运动中的物体力图沿最短距离前进，因为它没有时间进行较慢的运动，也就是沿更长轨迹的运动。推动力不允许这种减速。

Query_Text_en: And so , by reason of its speed , the object tends to move over the shortest path .
Translation: 因此，由于其速度，这一物体倾向于沿最短路径运动。

Query_Text_en: But the shortest of all lines having the same endpoints is the straight line .
Translation: 但在所有具有相同端点的线段中，最短的线段是直线。

Query_Text_en: That the rays proceeding from our eyes move with infinite velocity may be gathered from the following consideration . For when , after our eyes have been closed , we open them and look up at the sky , no interval of time is required for the visual rays to reach the sky .
Translation: 我们可以从以下事实推断出，从我们眼睛发出的光线以无限速度传播：当我们闭上眼睛后再睁开，并抬头望向天空，视觉光线到达天空并不需要任何时间间隔。

Query_Text_en: Indeed , we see the stars as soon as we look up , though the distance is , as we may say , infinite .
Translation: 的确，只要我们抬头仰望，就能看到星星，尽管它们的距离可以说是无穷遥远。

Query_Text_en: Again , if the distance were greater the result would be the same , so that , clearly , the rays are emitted with infinite velocity .
Translation: 同样地，如果距离更远，结果也会相同，因此显然射线是以无限速度发射的。

Query_Text_en: Therefore they will suffer neither interruption , nor curvature , nor breaking , but will move along the shortest path , a straight line .
Translation: 因此，它们不会受到干扰、弯曲或断裂，而是沿着最短的路径——直线——运动。

Query_Text_en: This passage reveals an amusing fact that Heron , and apparently all his contemporaries , believed that vision is due to some rays emitted from the eye and reflected back by the object , thus being based on the same principle as today 's radar .
Translation: 这段文字揭示了一个有趣的事实：希伦以及显然他所有的同时代人都认为视觉是由于眼睛发射出某种射线，被物体反射回来而产生的，这一原理与今天的雷达原理相同。

Query_Text_en: Another great Alexandrian was the astronomer Gaudius Ptolemy ( not to be confused with the members of Ptolemaic dynasty who reigned in Egypt many years before the Christian era ) , who lived and worked during the first half of the 2nd century a.d. Ptolemy 's observations of stars and planets , collected in his book known as Almagest , represented a considerable addition to the data obtained by Hipparchus two and a half centuries earlier .
Translation: 另一位著名的亚历山大学者是天文学家克劳狄乌斯·托勒密（不要与早在公元前许多年统治埃及的托勒密王朝成员混淆），他生活并工作于公元2世纪上半叶。托勒密在其著作《天文学大成》中收集的恒星和行星观测数据，较两百五十年前希帕恰斯所获得的资料有了显著的补充和发展。

Query_Text_en: His important contributions to physics are contained in his book Optics which came to us as the Latin translation of the lost Arabic version of the original Creek manuscript .
Translation: 他对物理学的重要贡献收录在他的著作《光学》中，该书以拉丁文译本流传至今，而拉丁文译本则是根据已佚失的阿拉伯文版本翻译而来，阿拉伯文版本又源自原始的希腊手稿。

Query_Text_en: In this book Ptolemy discusses , among other things , the important subject of the refraction of light in passing from one medium into another .
Translation: 在本书中，托勒密讨论了包括光从一种介质进入另一种介质时发生折射这一重要课题在内的诸多内容。

Query_Text_en: Visual rays may be altered in two ways : by reflection , i.e. the rebound from objects , called mirrors , which do not permit the penetration , and by bending ( i.e. refraction ) in the case of media which permit the penetration and have a common designation ( ' transparent materials ' ) for the reason that visual ray penetrates them .
Translation: 视觉射线的改变有两种方式：一种是反射，即从物体表面反弹回来，这些物体被称为镜子，因为它们不允许射线穿透；另一种是折射，即在允许射线穿透的介质中发生弯曲，这类介质因视觉射线能够穿透，被统称为“透明材料”。

Query_Text_en: He illustrates the phenomenon of refraction by the following simple experiment with a coin placed at the bottom of a vessel filled with water , called a ' baptistir ' .
Translation: 他用一个简单的实验来说明折射现象：将一枚硬币放在盛满水的容器底部，这种容器被称为“baptistir”。

Query_Text_en: Suppose that the position of the eye is such that the visual ray emanating from it and just passing over the edge of the baptistir reaches a point higher than the coin .
Translation: 假设眼睛的位置使得从眼睛发出的视线恰好掠过洗礼池的边缘，并到达一个高于硬币的位置。

Query_Text_en: Then , allowing the coin to remain in its position , pour water gently into the baptistir until the ray that just passes over the edge is bent downward and falls upon the coin .
Translation: 然后，保持硬币原位不动，缓缓向洗礼池中注水，直到那条刚好掠过池边的光线被折射向下，正好照射到硬币上。

Query_Text_en: The result is that the object not previously seen is then seen along the straight line passing from the eye to the point above the true position of the object .
Translation: 结果是，原本未被看到的物体随后会沿着从眼睛到物体真实位置上方某点的直线被看到。

Query_Text_en: Now the observer will not suppose that the visual ray has been bent toward the object , but that the object is itself afloat and is raised towards the ray .
Translation: 现在，观察者不会认为视觉射线是向物体弯曲的，而是认为物体本身漂浮起来，并向射线方向升高。

Query_Text_en: The object , therefore , will appear on the perpendicular drawn from it to the surface of the water .
Translation: 因此，该物体将在从其到水面所作的垂线上显现出来。

Query_Text_en: Later in the text , Ptolemy describes an experiment designed to study in detail the laws of refraction of light .
Translation: 在后文中，托勒密描述了一项旨在详细研究光的折射规律的实验。

Query_Text_en: Ptolemy also studied by a similar method the refraction of light rays on the boundary between air and glass , and found that in that case the bending of the ray is larger .
Translation: 托勒密还以类似的方法研究了光线在空气与玻璃交界处的折射，发现此时光线的弯折程度更大。

Query_Text_en: He did not try , however ( or at least did not succeed if he did ) , to express the results of his observations by means of a mathematical formula , and the mathematical formulation of the law of refraction of light was not found until the 17th century .
Translation: 然而，他并未尝试（或者即使尝试了也未能成功）用数学公式来表达他的观察结果，而光的折射定律的数学表述直到17世纪才被发现。

Query_Text_en: It is ironical enough that he could have easily done so , since the mathematical apparatus involved in the formulation of that law was the relation between arcs and chords discussed by Plutarchus one and a half centuries before him and developed by himself at great length in Almagest in connection with astronomical observations .
Translation: 讽刺的是，他本可以轻松做到这一点，因为该定律所涉及的数学工具，正是弧与弦之间的关系——这一关系早在他之前一个半世纪就已被普鲁塔克讨论，而他本人又在《天文学大成》中结合天文观测进行了详尽的阐述和发展。

Query_Text_en: The problem was to find the length of chord ADB corresponding to the arc ACB of the unit radius circle .
Translation: 问题是求单位半径圆中，对应于弧ACB的弦ADB的长度。

Query_Text_en: Using ingenious mathematical methods , Ptolemy built a table , part of which is reproduced below :
Translation: 托勒密运用巧妙的数学方法编制了一张表格，部分内容如下所示：

Query_Text_en: This table corresponds to what is now known as trigonometrical tables of sines , with the only difference that one used half-arcs ( the angle AOC ) and half-chords AD .
Translation: 该表格实际上就是现在所称的正弦三角函数表，只不过当时采用的是半弧（角AOC）和半弦AD。

Query_Text_en: The length AD for the unit radius is known as sine AOC , while the distance OD is cosine AOC .
Translation: 单位半径下，AD的长度称为AOC的正弦，而OD的距离则为AOC的余弦。

Query_Text_en: Trigonometric functions are extremely useful in solving various geometrical problems involving both lengths and angles .
Translation: 三角函数在解决涉及长度和角度的各种几何问题时极为有用。

Query_Text_en: If Ptolemy would have compared the results of his experiment on refraction of light with his table of sines , he would have found that the ratio of the sine of the angle of incidence to the sine of the angle of refraction is a constant for any given pair of substances .
Translation: 如果托勒密将他关于光的折射实验结果与他的正弦表进行比较，他就会发现，对于任意一对特定的物质，入射角正弦与折射角正弦的比值是一个常数。

Query_Text_en: He did not , and the above-stated law of refraction was not discovered until fourteen centuries later by the Dutch astronomer and mathematician Willebrord Snell .
Translation: 他并未做到这一点，而上述折射定律直到十四世纪后才由荷兰天文学家兼数学家威利布罗德·斯涅尔发现。

Query_Text_en: As we shall see later , Snell 's law is of paramount importance for understanding the nature of light .
Translation: 正如我们稍后将会看到的，斯涅尔定律对于理解光的本质具有极其重要的意义。

Query_Text_en: Ptolemy 's work was the last great contribution of ancient Greek culture to the development of science , and after his death research in Alexandria rapidly began to decay .
Translation: 托勒密的著作是古希腊文化对科学发展最后的重要贡献，他去世后，亚历山大的科研工作迅速衰落。

Query_Text_en: Probably the last name which can be mentioned in connection with the Alexandrian school is that of Hypatia , a daughter of the mathematician Theon , and herself a teacher of science and philosophy .
Translation: 与亚历山大学派有关的最后一位人物，或许要提到希帕提娅——她是数学家西昂的女儿，本人也是一位科学与哲学的教师。

Query_Text_en: She lived during the reign of the Roman Emperor Julian the Apostate , who tried to protect Greek learning and Greek gods against the ever-increasing power of the Christian church .
Translation: 她生活在罗马皇帝朱利安·背教者统治时期，朱利安试图保护希腊学术和希腊诸神，以抵抗基督教教会日益增长的权力。

Query_Text_en: The reaction which took place after his death resulted , in a.d. 415 , in a big anti-Greek revolt organized by Bishop Kyrillos of Alexandria .
Translation: 他去世后，亚历山大主教基里罗斯于公元415年组织了一场大规模的反希腊暴动。

Query_Text_en: Hypatia was tom to pieces by the Christian mobs , and the remainder of the city 's libraries were destroyed .
Translation: 希帕提娅被基督教暴民撕成碎片，城市剩余的图书馆也被摧毁。

Query_Text_en: With the extinction of the Greek culture the development of science in general and of physics in particular came to a virtual standstill .
Translation: 随着希腊文化的消亡，科学总体的发展，尤其是物理学的发展，几乎陷入停滞。

Query_Text_en: Romans , who were the potentates of the world during this period of human history , cared little about abstract thinking . Theirs was a ' businessman 's civilization ' and , although they encouraged learning , they were mostly interested in the practical applications .
Translation: 罗马人在这一历史时期是世界的统治者，但他们对抽象思维并不关心。他们的文明属于“商人文明”，虽然鼓励学习，但主要关注知识的实际应用。

Query_Text_en: After the fall of the Roman Empire the situation went from bad to worse , and the feudal states which grew on its ruins certainly did not represent a fertile soil for any kind of scientific development .
Translation: 罗马帝国灭亡后，形势每况愈下，而在其废墟上兴起的封建国家，无疑也并非孕育任何科学发展的沃土。

Query_Text_en: The only unifying stimulus during this period , which extended well over a thousand years , was the Christian religion , and the abbeys and monasteries became intellectual centers .
Translation: 在这一时期，持续了逾千年，唯一能够凝聚人心的力量是基督教，而修道院和寺院则成为了知识的中心。

Query_Text_en: Consequently , the main interests became centered around theological problems , and whatever scientific ideas were left over after the fall of the ancient Greek culture were subjugated to religious dictatorship .
Translation: 因此，主要关注点转向了神学问题，而古希腊文化衰落后遗留下来的科学思想，则被宗教专制所压制。

Query_Text_en: The Ptolemaic system of the world , with the earth resting in the center and the sun , planets , and stars rotating around it , was accepted as unshakable dogma , since it was best fitted to the concept of the central position of the Vatican as the abode of God 's chosen emissary on earth .
Translation: 托勒密的宇宙体系认为地球处于中心，太阳、行星和恒星围绕其旋转，这一观点被视为不可动摇的教条，因为它最契合梵蒂冈作为上帝在世间所选使者居所的中心地位理念。

Query_Text_en: ` ' Scientific ' discussions were mostly limited to such problems as to how many angels can dance on the end of a needle and whether Almighty God could make a stone which is so heavy that He can not lift it Himself .
Translation: “科学”讨论大多局限于诸如多少天使能在针尖上跳舞，以及全能的上帝是否能造出一块连他自己都无法举起的石头这类问题。

Query_Text_en: Primitive ' Lysenkoism ' was flourishing all over Europe , and the Holy Inquisition took care of stamping out any deviation from the general line of religious belief .
Translation: 原始的“李森科主义”在整个欧洲盛行，宗教裁判所则负责消除任何背离宗教信仰主流的思想。

Query_Text_en: Fortunately for us , Greek science found a refuge in the newly born Arabian Empire which , in the course of the 7th century , engulfed all the lands south of the Mediterranean and splashed over into Spain , over the narrow Straits of Gibraltar .
Translation: 幸运的是，希腊科学在新兴的阿拉伯帝国中找到了庇护。7世纪期间，这一帝国席卷了地中海以南的所有土地，并越过狭窄的直布罗陀海峡，扩展到了西班牙。

Query_Text_en: The benevolent potentate Haroun Al-Raschid of the story of ' A Thousand and One Nights ' founded , in a.d. 800 , a school of science in Bagdad , while the city of Cordoba in Spain became a cultural center of the Arabian Empire on European soil .
Translation: 《一千零一夜》故事中仁慈的君主哈伦·拉希德于公元800年在巴格达创办了一所科学学府，而西班牙的科尔多瓦则成为阿拉伯帝国在欧洲大陆上的文化中心。

Query_Text_en: Arabian scholars studied and translated Greek manuscripts salvaged from the partially destroyed Hellenic libraries , and carried the banner of science while Europe was suffocating in the clutches of medieval scholasticism .
Translation: 阿拉伯学者研究并翻译了从部分被毁的希腊图书馆中抢救出来的希腊手稿，在欧洲被中世纪经院哲学束缚、难以呼吸之时，肩负起了科学的旗帜。

Query_Text_en: The Arabian era in the history of science is witnessed by such scientific terms in use today , as : Algebra , Alcohol , Alkali , Amalgam , Almanac , Antares , etc. .
Translation: 阿拉伯时代在科学史上的影响，至今仍可从一些常用的科学术语中见证，如：代数、酒精、碱、汞合金、历书、心宿二等。

Query_Text_en: The Arabs made consider able progress in mathematics , developing algebra , unknown to the Greeks , and introducing arabic numerals which make computation much easier than it was with the Roman system .
Translation: 阿拉伯人在数学领域取得了显著进步，发展了希腊人所不知的代数学，并引入了阿拉伯数字，使计算比罗马数字系统更加简便。

Query_Text_en: But , perhaps as the result of Scheherazade 's fairy tales , their work in astronomy and chemistry was limited mostly to the pursuit of fantastic aims in predicting man 's life on the basis of the configuration of the stars under which he was born ( astrology ) , and finding the methods of turning common metals into precious gold ( alchemy ) .
Translation: 然而，也许是受舍赫拉查德的童话故事影响，他们在天文学和化学领域的研究主要局限于一些奇幻目标，比如根据出生时星辰的排列来预测人的命运（占星术），以及寻找将普通金属转化为贵重黄金的方法（炼金术）。

Query_Text_en: They did not seem to do anything in the field of physics , except , of course , for the fact that alchemistry can be considered as a precursor of modern techniques of transforming one chemical element into another .
Translation: 他们在物理领域似乎并没有做出什么贡献，当然，炼金术可以被视为现代将一种化学元素转变为另一种元素技术的先驱。

Query_Text_en: But , ' when the Moor accomplished his task , the Moor must go away , ' and in the 12th century the Arabian Empire rapidly succumbed as the result of Genghis Khan 's invasion and the persistent Christian crusades to the Holy Land .
Translation: 然而，“摩尔人完成了他的使命后，便必须离去”，12世纪时，随着成吉思汗的入侵和基督教世界对圣地持续不断的十字军东征，阿拉伯帝国迅速衰落。

Query_Text_en: By this time , European states were slowly emerging from the chaos of the dark Middle Ages and learning was on the upgrade again .
Translation: 此时，欧洲各国正逐步走出黑暗中世纪的混乱局面，学术活动也重新兴盛起来。

Query_Text_en: In a.d. 784 , Charlemagne , the ruler of the French Empire , decreed that all abbeys in his vast domain should have schools attached to them , and in a.d. 1100 the University of Paris was founded .
Translation: 公元784年，法兰克帝国的统治者查理曼大帝下令，其广阔领土内的所有修道院都必须设立附属学校。公元1100年，巴黎大学成立。

Query_Text_en: The universities of Bologna , Oxford , and Cambridge were founded soon thereafter and rapidly became the recognized centers of scholastic activity .
Translation: 博洛尼亚大学、牛津大学和剑桥大学随后相继成立，并迅速成为公认的学术活动中心。

Query_Text_en: The customary course of study consisted of the ' trivium ' , which included Latin grammar , rhetoric , and logic , and the ' quadrivium ' , which included arithmetic , geometry , music , and astronomy .
Translation: 传统的课程设置包括“文法三学科”，即拉丁语语法、修辞学和逻辑学，以及“理科四学科”，即算术、几何、音乐和天文学。

Query_Text_en: However , education was still under the vigilant supervision of the Church , and universities in all the Christian countries had to obtain the Pope 's sanction in order to continue their existence .
Translation: 然而，教育仍然受到教会的严密监督，所有基督教国家的大学必须获得教皇的批准才能继续存在。

Query_Text_en: Studies were based mostly on the writings of Aristotle , which reached Europe in Arabian translation .
Translation: 研究主要基于亚里士多德的著作，这些著作是通过阿拉伯文译本传入欧洲的。

Query_Text_en: As we stated earlier , the fact that Aristotle , although excelling in many other respects , was not too good in the field of physical sciences certainly did not help the rejuvenation of physics in Europe , which was just awakening from her thousand-year sleep .
Translation: 正如我们之前所说，尽管亚里士多德在许多方面都表现出色，但他在自然科学领域并不擅长，这一事实无疑不利于欧洲物理学的复兴，而当时的欧洲正从长达千年的沉睡中苏醒。

Query_Text_en: One of the important factors in the spread of knowledge was the invention of the printing press in the middle of the 15th century in the shop of a man called Fust in Mainz , Germany , and one of the most important books which came off these early presses was undoubtedly De Revolutionibus Orbitum Coelestium ( Nuremberg Press , a.d. 1543 ) by Nicolaus Copernicus , in which he established a new system of the world with the sun in the center of it .
Translation: 知识传播的一个重要因素，是15世纪中叶德国美因茨一位名叫富斯特的人在其作坊中发明了印刷机。而最早期印刷机印制的最重要书籍之一，无疑是尼古拉·哥白尼于1543年在纽伦堡印刷所出版的《天体运行论》。在这本书中，哥白尼确立了以太阳为中心的全新宇宙体系。

Query_Text_en: But , in order to avoid banishment by the Church , it was found necessary to supply this book with a preface ( written , presumably , without Copernicus ' knowledge by his editor Andreas Osiander ) which stated that all the ideas expressed in it were of purely hypothetical nature and represented more of a mathematical exercise than a description of real things .
Translation: 然而，为了避免被教会驱逐，有必要为这本书加上一篇前言（据推测，这篇前言是由编辑安德烈亚斯·奥西安德尔在哥白尼不知情的情况下撰写的），声明书中所表达的所有观点都仅属于假设性质，更像是一种数学练习，而非对现实事物的描述。

Query_Text_en: The mixture of theology and true science during this era is probably best illustrated by the following passages from Mysterium Cosmographicum ( 1596 ) by Johannes Kepler , the discoverer of the basic laws of planetary motion .
Translation: 这一时期神学与真正科学的融合，或许最能通过约翰内斯·开普勒（行星运动基本定律的发现者）于1596年发表的《宇宙的奥秘》中的以下段落得到体现。

Query_Text_en: What I have promised seven months ago , to wit a work that according to the judgment of the learned will be elegant , impressive , and far superior to all annual calendars , I now present to your gracious company , my noble Lords , a work that though it be small in compass and but the fruit of my own modest efforts , yet treats of a wondrous subject .
Translation: 七个月前我曾许诺要完成一部作品，依照学者们的评价，这部作品将优雅、卓越，远胜于所有年历。如今，我将这部作品呈献给尊贵的诸位阁下。虽然篇幅不大，仅为我个人谦逊努力的结晶，但所论及的却是一个奇妙非凡的主题。

Query_Text_en: If you desire novelty it is the first time that this subject is being presented to all mankind by myself .
Translation: 如果你渴望新意，那么这是我首次向全人类提出这一主题。

Query_Text_en: If you desire venerability nothing is more precious , nothing more beautiful than our magnificent temple of God .
Translation: 如果你渴望庄严神圣，没有什么比我们宏伟的神殿更珍贵、更美丽。

Query_Text_en: If you wish to know the mysteries nothing in Nature is , or ever has been , more recondite .
Translation: 如果你想了解这些奥秘，那么在自然界中，没有什么比它更深奥，也从未有过比它更隐秘的事物。

Query_Text_en: It is but for one reason that my object will not satisfy everybody , for its usefulness will not be apparent to the thoughtless .
Translation: 我的目标之所以无法让所有人满意，只有一个原因，那就是对于那些缺乏思考的人来说，其价值并不明显。

Query_Text_en: I am speaking of the Book of Nature , which is so highly esteemed in the Holy Scriptures . St. Paul admonished the Heathens to reflect on God within themselves as they would on the Sun in the water or in a mirror .
Translation: 我说的是《自然之书》，它在《圣经》中备受推崇。圣保罗曾告诫异教徒，要像在水中或镜中看到太阳一样，在自身内省思上帝。

Query_Text_en: Our piety in this is the deeper the greater is our awareness of creation and of its grandeur .
Translation: 我们对这一点的虔诚，随着我们对创造及其伟大意义的认知加深而愈发深厚。

Query_Text_en: When we compare the individuals of the same variety or sub-variety of our older cultivated plants and animals , one of the first points which strikes us is , that they generally differ more from each other than do the individuals of any one species or variety in a state of nature .
Translation: 当我们比较同一品种或亚品种的老式栽培植物和动物的个体时，首先引起我们注意的一点是，它们之间的差异通常比自然状态下任何一个物种或品种的个体之间的差异要大。

Query_Text_en: And if we reflect on the vast diversity of the plants and animals which have been cultivated , and which have varied during all ages under the most different climates and treatment , we are driven to conclude that this great variability is due to our domestic productions having been raised under conditions of life not so uniform as , and somewhat different from , those to which the parent species had been exposed under nature .
Translation: 如果我们思考一下历代以来在各种不同气候和培育方式下被驯化并发生变异的众多动植物的巨大多样性，我们不得不得出这样的结论：这种高度的变异性，是因为我们的家养物种生长的生活条件并不像它们的原始物种在自然状态下所经历的那样一致，而是存在一定的差异。

Query_Text_en: There is , also , some probability in the view propounded by Andrew Knight , that this variability may be partly connected with excess of food .
Translation: 安德鲁·奈特提出的观点也具有一定的合理性，即这种变异性可能在一定程度上与食物过剩有关。

Query_Text_en: and that , when the organization has once begun to vary , it generally continues varying for many generations .
Translation: 而且，一旦有机体开始发生变异，这种变异通常会持续许多代。

Query_Text_en: No case is on record of a variable organism ceasing to vary under cultivation .
Translation: 没有任何记录显示，可变生物在人工培育条件下会停止变异。

Query_Text_en: Our oldest cultivated plants , such as wheat , still yield new varieties : our oldest domesticated animals are still capable of rapid improvement or modification .
Translation: 我们最早栽培的作物，如小麦，至今仍能培育出新的品种；我们最早驯养的动物至今依然能够快速改良或变异。

Query_Text_en: As far as I am able to judge , after long attending to the subject , the conditions of life appear to act in two ways directly on the whole organization or on certain parts alone and indirectly by affecting the reproductive system .
Translation: 据我长期关注这一问题的判断，生活条件似乎以两种方式产生影响：一是直接作用于整个机体或某些特定部位，二是通过影响生殖系统间接产生作用。

Query_Text_en: With respect to the direct action , we must bear in mind that in every case , as Professor Weismann has lately insisted , and as I have incidentally shown in my work on Variation under Domestication , there are two factors : namely , the nature of the organism and the nature of the conditions .
Translation: 关于直接作用，我们必须牢记，如魏斯曼教授最近所强调的，以及我在《家养变异》一书中偶然提及的，每一种情况都存在两个因素：即生物体的特性和环境条件的特性。

Query_Text_en: The former seems to be much the more important ;
Translation: 前者似乎要重要得多。

Query_Text_en: and , on the other hand , dissimilar variations arise under conditions which appear to be nearly uniform .
Translation: 另一方面，在看似几乎一致的条件下，也会出现不同的变异。

Query_Text_en: The effects on the offspring are either definite or indefinite .
Translation: 对后代的影响可以是确定的，也可以是不确定的。

Query_Text_en: They may be considered as definite when all or nearly all the offspring of individuals exposed to certain conditions during several generations are modified in the same manner .
Translation: 当个体在数代中处于某种特定环境下时，如果其所有或几乎所有后代都以相同方式发生变化，这种变化就可以被视为确定性的。

Query_Text_en: It is extremely difficult to come to any conclusion in regard to the extent of the changes which have been thus definitely induced .
Translation: 对于这些已经明确产生的变化程度，要得出任何结论都极为困难。

Query_Text_en: There can , however , be little doubt about many slight changes , such as size from the amount of food , color from the nature of the food , thickness of the skin and hair from climate , etc. .
Translation: 然而，对于许多细微的变化，如食物量影响体型、食物性质影响颜色、气候影响皮肤和毛发的厚度等，几乎没有什么疑问。

Query_Text_en: and if the same cause were to act uniformly during a long series of generations on many individuals , all probably would be modified in the same manner .
Translation: 如果同样的原因在许多代中持续一致地作用于大量个体，所有个体很可能都会以相同的方式发生变化。

Query_Text_en: Such facts as the complex and extraordinary out growths which variably follow from the insertion of a minute drop of poison by a gall-producing insect , shows us what singular modifications might result in the case of plants from a chemical change in the nature of the sap .
Translation: 诸如瘿蜂注入微量毒液后所产生的复杂且异常的生长变化等事实，向我们展示了植物的汁液性质发生化学变化时，可能会引发何种奇特的变异。

Query_Text_en: Indefinite variability is a much more common result of changed conditions than definite variability , and has probably played a more important part in the formation of our domestic races .
Translation: 在环境变化的影响下，不定变异远比定向变异更为常见，并且在我们家养品种的形成过程中，可能发挥了更加重要的作用。

Query_Text_en: We see indefinite variability in the endless slight peculiarities which distinguish the individuals of the same species , and which can not be accounted for by inheritance from either parent or from some more remote ancestor . Even strongly-marked differences occasionally appear in the young of the same litter , and in seedlings from the same seed-capsule .
Translation: 我们观察到，同一物种的个体之间存在无穷无尽的细微差异，这些差异无法用父母或更远的祖先遗传来解释。即使是同一胎的幼崽，或同一荚果中的幼苗，有时也会出现明显的差异。

Query_Text_en: but monstrosities can not be separated by any distinct line from slighter variations .
Translation: 但畸形与较轻微的变异之间并无明显界限可分。

Query_Text_en: All such changes of structure , whether extremely slight or strongly marked , which appear among many individuals living together , may be considered as the indefinite effects of the conditions of life on each individual organism , in nearly the same manner as the chill effects different men in an indefinite manner , according to their state of body or constitution , causing coughs or colds , rheumatism , or inflammation of various organs .
Translation: 所有这类结构上的变化，无论极其细微还是非常显著，只要在许多共同生活的个体中出现，都可以视为生活条件对每个个体有机体产生的无定影响，类似于寒冷对不同人的影响因其身体状况或体质而异，可能导致咳嗽、感冒、风湿或各种器官的炎症。

Query_Text_en: With respect to what I have called the indirect action of changed conditions , namely , through the reproductive system of being affected , we may infer that variability is thus induced , partly from the fact of this system being extremely sensitive to any change in the conditions , and partly from the similarity , as Kolreuter and others have remarked , between the variability which follows from the crossing of distinct species , and that which may be observed with plants and animals when reared under new or unnatural conditions .
Translation: 关于我所称的环境变化的间接作用，即通过影响生殖系统产生作用，我们可以推断变异正是由此引发的。一方面，生殖系统对任何环境变化都极为敏感；另一方面，正如科尔雷特等人所指出的，不同物种杂交后出现的变异，与动植物在新的或非自然环境下培育时观察到的变异具有相似性。

Query_Text_en: Many facts clearly show how eminently susceptible the reproductive system is to very slight changes in the surrounding conditions .
Translation: 许多事实清楚地表明，生殖系统对周围环境的细微变化极为敏感。

Query_Text_en: Nothing is more easy than to tame an animal , and few things more difficult than to get it to breed freely under confinement , even when the male and female unite .
Translation: 驯服一种动物再容易不过，但即使雌雄配对，在圈养条件下让其自由繁殖却极为困难。

Query_Text_en: How many animals there are which will not breed , though kept in an almost free state in their native country !
Translation: 有多少动物即使在本国几乎自由的环境下饲养，也不会繁殖！

Query_Text_en: This is generally , but erroneously attributed to vitiated instincts .
Translation: 这通常被错误地归因于本能的扭曲。

Query_Text_en: Many cultivated plants display the utmost vigor , and yet rarely or never seed !
Translation: 许多栽培植物表现出极强的生长活力，但却很少结籽，甚至从不结籽！

Query_Text_en: In some few cases it has been discovered that a very trifling change , such as a little more or less water at some particular period of growth , will determine whether or not a plant will produce seeds .
Translation: 在极少数情况下，人们发现，仅仅在植物生长的某一特定阶段多浇或少浇一点水这样微小的变化，就能决定植物是否会结籽。

Query_Text_en: I can not here give the details which I have collected and elsewhere published on this curious subject ;
Translation: 关于这一有趣的话题，我无法在此详述我所收集并已在其他地方发表的具体内容。

Query_Text_en: but to show how singular the laws are which determine the reproduction of animals under confinement , I may mention that carnivorous animals , even from the tropics , breed in this country pretty freely under confinement , with the exception of the plantigrades or bear family , which seldom produce young ;
Translation: 但为了说明限制条件下动物繁殖规律的特殊性，我可以举例说明：即使是来自热带的食肉动物，在本国圈养条件下也能相当顺利地繁殖，唯有蹠行类动物，即熊科动物，很少能繁殖后代。

Query_Text_en: whereas , carnivorous birds , with the rarest exception , hardly ever lay fertile eggs .
Translation: 而猛禽类鸟类，极少有例外，几乎从不产可受精的卵。

Query_Text_en: Many exotic plants have pollen utterly worthless , in the same condition as in the most sterile hybrids .
Translation: 许多外来植物的花粉完全无用，其状况与最不育的杂交种一样。

Query_Text_en: and when , on the other hand , we see individuals , though taken young from a state of nature perfectly tamed , long-lived , and healthy ( of which I could give numerous instances ) , yet having their reproductive system so seriously affected by unperceived causes as to fail to act , we need not be surprised at this system , when it does act under confinement , acting irregularly , and producing offspring somewhat unlike their parents .
Translation: 另一方面，我们看到一些个体虽然在幼年时从自然状态中被带走，完全被驯化，且长寿健康（对此我可以举出许多例子），但由于一些难以察觉的原因，他们的生殖系统受到严重影响，无法正常发挥作用。由此，当这些生殖系统在圈养环境下能够发挥作用时，其表现也常常不规律，并产生与父母略有不同的后代，这种现象并不令人意外。

Query_Text_en: I may add that as some organisms breed freely under the most unnatural conditions for instance , rabbits and ferrets kept in hutches showing that their reproductive organs are not easily affected ;
Translation: 我还可以补充一点，有些生物即使在极为不自然的环境下也能自由繁殖，例如被圈养在笼舍中的兔子和雪貂，这表明它们的生殖器官不易受到影响。

Query_Text_en: so will some animals and plants withstand domestication or cultivation , and vary very slightly perhaps hardly more than in a state of nature .
Translation: 因此，一些动植物在驯化或栽培过程中，可能能够适应，但其变异幅度极小，或许与自然状态下几乎没有区别。

Query_Text_en: Some naturalists have maintained that all variations are connected with the act of sexual reproduction ; but this is certainly an error ;
Translation: 一些自然主义者认为所有变异都与有性繁殖有关，但这一观点显然是错误的。

Query_Text_en: for I have given in another work a long list of sporting plants ; as they are called by gardeners ;
Translation: 因为我在另一部著作中已经列举了大量园艺师所称的“变异植株”名单。

Query_Text_en: that is , of plants which have suddenly produced a single bud with a new and sometimes widely different character from that of the other buds on the same plant .
Translation: 也就是说，指的是某些植物突然长出一个具有新特征、且有时与同一植株上其他芽的特征截然不同的单一芽体。

Query_Text_en: These bud variations , as they may be named , can be propagated by grafts , offsets , etc. , and sometimes by seed .
Translation: 这些芽变品种可以通过嫁接、分株等方式繁殖，有时也可通过种子繁殖。

Query_Text_en: They occur rarely under nature , but are far from rare under culture .
Translation: 它们在自然环境中很少出现，但在人工环境下却并不罕见。

Query_Text_en: and as buds on distinct trees , growing under different conditions , have sometimes yielded nearly the same variety for instance , buds on peach-trees producing nectarines , and buds on common roses producing moss-roses we clearly see that the nature of the conditions is of subordinate importance in comparison with the nature of the organism in determining each particular form of variation ; perhaps of not more importance than the nature of the spark , by which a mass of combustible matter is ignited , has in determining the nature of the flames .
Translation: 正如不同树木上的芽在不同环境下生长，有时却能产生几乎相同的变种——例如桃树上的芽能长出油桃，普通玫瑰上的芽能长出苔藓玫瑰——我们可以清楚地看到，在决定每一种具体变异形式时，环境条件的性质相较于有机体本身的性质只是次要因素；它的重要性或许不比点燃一团可燃物的火花性质对火焰性质的决定作用更大。

Query_Text_en: Changed habits produce an inherited effect as in the period of the flowering of plants when transported from one climate to another .
Translation: 习惯的改变会产生遗传效应，正如植物在从一种气候迁移到另一种气候的开花期所表现出的那样。

Query_Text_en: With animals the increased use or disuse of parts has had a more marked influence ;
Translation: 对于动物而言，某些部位的使用或废弃程度增加，对其影响更加显著。

Query_Text_en: thus I find in the domestic duck that the bones of the wing weigh less and the bones of the leg more , in proportion to the whole skeleton , than do the same bones in the wild duck ;
Translation: 因此，我发现家鸭的翅骨在整个骨骼中所占的比例比野鸭要小，而腿骨所占的比例则比野鸭要大。

Query_Text_en: and this change may be safely attributed to the domestic duck flying much less , and walking more , than its wild parents .
Translation: 这种变化可以安全地归因于家鸭比其野生祖先飞行得少、行走得多。

Query_Text_en: The great and inherited development of the udders in cows and goats in countries where they are habitually milked , in comparison with these organs in other countries , is probably another instance of the effects of use .
Translation: 在那些习惯性挤奶的国家，奶牛和山羊的乳腺发育得格外显著且具有遗传性，这与其他国家同类动物的乳腺发育情况相比，很可能又是“用进作用”影响的一个例证。

Query_Text_en: Not one of our domestic animals can be named which has not in some country drooping ears ;
Translation: 我们所饲养的家畜中，没有一种在某些国家没有垂耳现象。

Query_Text_en: and the view which has been suggested that the drooping is due to disuse of the muscles of the ear , from the animals being seldom much alarmed , seems probable .
Translation: 有人提出，耳朵下垂是由于耳部肌肉缺乏使用所致，因为这些动物很少受到惊吓，这一观点似乎是有道理的。

Query_Text_en: Many laws regulate variation , some few of which can be dimly seen , and will hereafter be briefly discussed . I will here only allude to what may be called correlated variation .
Translation: 许多法律调控着变异，其中有少数可以隐约察觉，后文将作简要讨论。此处我仅提及可称为相关变异的现象。

Query_Text_en: Important changes in the embryo or larva will probably entail changes in the mature animal .
Translation: 胚胎或幼虫阶段的重要变化很可能会导致成熟动物发生相应变化。

Query_Text_en: In monstrosities , the correlations between quite distinct parts are very curious ; and many instances are given in Isidore Geoffroy St. Hilaire s great work on this subject .
Translation: 在畸形现象中，截然不同部位之间的关联极为奇特；对此，伊西多尔·杰弗里·圣希莱尔在其关于该主题的著作中列举了许多实例。

Query_Text_en: Breeders believe that long limbs are almost always accompanied by an elongated head .
Translation: 育种者认为，四肢修长几乎总是伴随着头部的拉长。

Query_Text_en: Some instances of correlation are quite whimsical ;
Translation: 有些相关性显得颇为随意。

Query_Text_en: thus cats which are entirely white and have blue eyes are generally deaf ;
Translation: 因此，完全是白色且拥有蓝色眼睛的猫通常是聋的。

Query_Text_en: but it has been lately stated by Mr. Tait that this is confined to the males .
Translation: 但泰特先生最近指出，这种情况仅限于雄性。

Query_Text_en: Colour and constitutional peculiarities go together , of which many remarkable cases could be given among animals and plants .
Translation: 色彩与体质特征往往相伴而生，在动植物中有许多这样的典型案例。

Query_Text_en: From facts collected by Heusinger , it appears that white sheep and pigs are injured by certain plants , while dark-coloured individuals escape : Professor Wyman has recently communicated to me a good illustration of this fact ; on asking some farmers in Virginia how it was that all their pigs were black , they informed him that the pigs ate the paint-root ( Lachnanthes ) , which colored their bones pink , and which caused the hoofs of all but the black varieties to drop off ;
Translation: 据Heusinger收集的事实显示，白色的羊和猪会因某些植物受伤，而深色个体则能幸免于难。Wyman教授最近向我提供了一个很好的例证：他曾询问弗吉尼亚的一些农民，为什么他们养的猪都是黑色的，农民们告诉他，猪会吃一种叫做paint-root（Lachnanthes）的植物，这种植物会使猪的骨头变成粉红色，并导致除了黑色品种之外的所有猪蹄脱落。

Query_Text_en: and one of the crackers ( i.e. Virginia squatters ) added , we select the black members of a litter for raising , as they alone have a good chance of living .
Translation: 其中一位“裂谷佬”（即弗吉尼亚的佃农）补充道：“我们会挑选窝里黑色的小猪来饲养，因为只有它们才有较大的存活机会。”

Query_Text_en: pigeons with short beaks have small feet , and those with long beaks large feet .
Translation: 喙短的鸽子脚也小，喙长的鸽子脚则大。

Query_Text_en: Hence if man goes on selecting , and thus augmenting , any peculiarity , he will almost certainly modify unintentionally other parts of the structure , owing to the mysterious laws of correlation .
Translation: 因此，如果人类持续进行选择，从而增强某一特征，那么由于相关性这一神秘规律的作用，他几乎必然会在无意中改变结构的其他部分。

Query_Text_en: The results of the various , unknown , or but dimly understood laws of variation are infinitely complex and diversified .
Translation: 各种未知或仅为人所知甚少的变异规律，其结果极为复杂多样。

Query_Text_en: It is well worth while carefully to study the several treatises on some of our old cultivated plants , as on the hyacinth , potato , even the dahlia , etc. ;
Translation: 非常值得认真研究关于我们一些古老栽培植物的专著，如关于风信子、马铃薯，甚至大丽花等。

Query_Text_en: and it is really surprising to note the endless points of structure and constitution in which the varieties and sub-varieties differ slightly from each other .
Translation: 令人颇感惊讶的是，各种变种和亚变种在结构和构成上存在着无数细微的差异。

Query_Text_en: The whole organization seems to have become plastic , and departs in a slight degree from that of the parental type .
Translation: 整个组织似乎变得具有可塑性，并在某种程度上偏离了亲本类型的结构。

Query_Text_en: Any variation which is not inherited is unimportant for us .
Translation: 任何不能遗传的变异对我们来说都无关紧要。

Query_Text_en: But the number and diversity of inheritable deviations of structure , both those of slight and those of considerable physiological importance , are endless .
Translation: 但可遗传的结构变异，无论是轻微的还是具有重大生理意义的，其数量和类型都无穷无尽。

Query_Text_en: Dr. Prosper Lucas treatise , in two large volumes , is the fullest and the best on this subject .
Translation: 普罗斯珀·卢卡斯博士的专著共两大卷，是该领域最为详尽且最优秀的著作。

Query_Text_en: No breeder doubts how strong is the tendency to inheritance ; that like produces like is his fundamental belief : doubts have been thrown on this principle only by theoretical writers .
Translation: 没有任何育种者会怀疑遗传倾向的强大；“有其父必有其子”是他们的基本信念。只有理论作家才对这一原则提出过质疑。

Query_Text_en: When any deviation of structure often appears , and we see it in the father and child , we can not tell whether it may not be due to the same cause having acted on both ;
Translation: 当结构上出现任何变异时，且我们在父代和子代中都观察到这种变异，我们无法判断这是否是由于同一原因作用于二者所致。

Query_Text_en: but when among individuals , apparently exposed to the same conditions , any very rare deviation , due to some extraordinary combination of circumstances , appears in the parent say , once among several million individuals and it reappears in the child , the mere doctrine of chances almost compels us to attribute its reappearance to inheritance .
Translation: 然而，当在个体之间，显然处于相同条件下时，如果某种极为罕见的偏差因某种特殊的环境组合在亲代中出现——比如在几百万个体中仅出现一次——而这种偏差又在子代中再次出现，那么仅凭概率理论几乎就不得不将其再次出现归因于遗传。

Query_Text_en: Every one must have heard of cases of albinism , prickly skin , hairy bodies , etc. , appearing in several members of the same family .
Translation: 每个人都一定听说过白化病、皮肤粗糙、多毛等现象在同一家族的多名成员中出现的案例。

Query_Text_en: If strange and rare deviations of structure are truly inherited , less strange and commoner deviations may be freely admitted to be inheritable .
Translation: 如果那些奇特且罕见的结构变异确实能够遗传，那么较不奇特且更常见的变异也可以被认为是可以遗传的。

Query_Text_en: Perhaps the correct way of viewing the whole subject would be , to look at the inheritance of every character whatever as the rule , and non-inheritance as the anomaly .
Translation: 或许，正确的看待这一问题的方式是，将所有性状的遗传视为常规，而非遗传则视为例外。

Query_Text_en: The laws governing inheritance are for the most part unknown ;
Translation: 关于继承的法律在很大程度上尚不为人所知；

Query_Text_en: why a peculiarity is often transmitted from one sex to both sexes , or to one sex alone , more commonly but not exclusively to the like sex .
Translation: 为什么某种特性常常从一个性别传递到两个性别，或者仅传递到一个性别，且更常见的是传递给相同性别，但并非绝对如此。

Query_Text_en: It is a fact of some importance to us , that peculiarities appearing in the males of our domestic breeds are often transmitted , either exclusively or in a much greater degree , to the males alone .
Translation: 对我们来说，有一点颇为重要，那就是家养品种中出现于雄性个体的某些特征，往往只传递给雄性，或者在雄性中表现得更为明显。

Query_Text_en: A much more important rule , which I think may be trusted , is that , at whatever period of life a peculiarity first appears , it tends to reappear in the offspring at a corresponding age , though sometimes earlier .
Translation: 我认为一个更为重要且值得信赖的规律是，无论某种特征在个体生命的哪个阶段首次出现，它往往会在后代的相应年龄再次出现，尽管有时会提前。

Query_Text_en: In many cases this could not be otherwise ;
Translation: 在许多情况下，这本就是不可避免的。

Query_Text_en: peculiarities in the silk-worm are known to appear at the corresponding caterpillar or cocoon stage .
Translation: 蚕的特殊性通常会在相应的幼虫或茧期表现出来。

Query_Text_en: But hereditary diseases and some other facts make me believe that the rule has a wider extension , and that , when there is no apparent reason why a peculiarity should appear at any particular age , yet that it does tend to appear in the offspring at the same period at which it first appeared in the parent .
Translation: 但遗传性疾病及其他一些事实使我相信，这一规律具有更广泛的适用性，即使没有明显的理由解释某种特征为何会在特定年龄出现，这一特征仍然倾向于在后代中于其在亲代首次出现的同一时期表现出来。

Query_Text_en: I believe this rule to be of the highest importance in explaining the laws of embryology .
Translation: 我认为这一原则对于解释胚胎学规律具有极其重要的意义。

Query_Text_en: These remarks are of course confined to the first APPEARANCE of the peculiarity , and not to the primary cause which may have acted on the ovules or on the male element ;
Translation: 这些论述当然仅限于该特性的首次表现，而不涉及可能作用于胚珠或雄性因素的初始原因。

Query_Text_en: in nearly the same manner as the increased length of the horns in the offspring from a short-horned cow by a long-horned bull , though appearing late in life , is clearly due to the male element .
Translation: 这与短角母牛与长角公牛所生后代的角变长的情况几乎如出一辙，虽然这种特征在后代生命后期才显现，但显然是由雄性因素所致。

Query_Text_en: Having alluded to the subject of reversion , I may here refer to a statement often made by naturalists namely , that our domestic varieties , when run wild , gradually but invariably revert in character to their aboriginal stocks .
Translation: 既然已经提及返祖这一主题，我在此可以引用自然学家们常常提出的一种说法，即我们的家养变种在野外放养后，会逐渐且必然地恢复到其原始祖先的特征。

Query_Text_en: Hence it has been argued that no deductions can be drawn from domestic races to species in a state of nature .
Translation: 因此，有人认为，不能根据家养品种得出关于自然状态下物种的结论。

Query_Text_en: I have in vain endeavored to discover on what decisive facts the above statement has so often and so boldly been made .
Translation: 我一直未能找到上述声明屡次被大胆提出所依据的确凿事实。

Query_Text_en: There would be great difficulty in proving its truth : we may safely conclude that very many of the most strongly marked domestic varieties could not possibly live in a wild state .
Translation: 要证明其真实性将极为困难：我们可以有把握地得出结论，许多特征最为显著的家养变种在野生状态下几乎不可能生存。

Query_Text_en: In many cases we do not know what the aboriginal stock was , and so could not tell whether or not nearly perfect reversion had ensued .
Translation: 在许多情况下，我们并不了解原始种群的情况，因此无法判断是否已经发生了近乎完全的返祖现象。

Query_Text_en: It would be necessary , in order to prevent the effects of intercrossing , that only a single variety should be turned loose in its new home .
Translation: 为了防止杂交带来的影响，有必要只引入单一品种到其新的栖息地。

Query_Text_en: Nevertheless , as our varieties certainly do occasionally revert in some of their characters to ancestral forms , it seems to me not improbable that if we could succeed in naturalising , or were to cultivate , during many generations , the several races , for instance , of the cabbage , in very poor soil in which case , however , some effect would have to be attributed to the DEFINITE action of the poor soil that they would , to a large extent , or even wholly , revert to the wild aboriginal stock . Whether or not the experiment would succeed is not of great importance for our line of argument ; for by the experiment itself the conditions of life are changed .
Translation: 然而，鉴于我们的某些品种确实偶尔会在某些性状上返祖，我认为，如果我们能够使多代甘蓝等不同品系在极为贫瘠的土壤中归化或栽培——当然，在这种情况下，必须将部分影响归因于贫瘠土壤的确定性作用——那么这些品系将在很大程度上，甚至完全，退化回野生原始类型。我认为，这一实验是否能够成功，对于我们的论证主线并无重大意义，因为实验本身已经改变了生存条件。

Query_Text_en: If it could be shown that our domestic varieties manifested a strong tendency to reversion that is , to lose their acquired characters , while kept under the same conditions and while kept in a considerable body , so that free intercrossing might check , by blending together , any slight deviations in their structure , in such case , I grant that we could deduce nothing from domestic varieties in regard to species .
Translation: 如果能够证明，我们的家养品种在相同条件下、并且在数量较大的群体中饲养时，表现出强烈的返祖倾向——即丧失其获得的特征——而且自由杂交能够通过融合各自结构上的细微差异来抑制这些偏离，那么，在这种情况下，我承认我们无法根据家养品种得出关于物种的任何结论。

Query_Text_en: But there is not a shadow of evidence in favor of this view : to assert that we could not breed our cart and race-horses , long and short-horned cattle , and poultry of various breeds , and esculent vegetables , for an unlimited number of generations , would be opposed to all experience .
Translation: 但这种观点毫无证据支持；断言我们无法对马车马和赛马、长角和短角牛、各种品种的家禽以及食用蔬菜进行无限代的繁育，完全与所有经验相悖。

Query_Text_en: When we look to the hereditary varieties or races of our domestic animals and plants , and compare them with closely allied species , we generally perceive in each domestic race , as already remarked , less uniformity of character than in true species .
Translation: 当我们观察家养动植物的遗传品种或品系，并将其与密切相关的物种进行比较时，通常可以发现，如前所述，每一种家养品系的性状一致性普遍低于真正的物种。

Query_Text_en: Domestic races often have a somewhat monstrous character ;
Translation: 本土竞赛往往带有某种畸形特征。

Query_Text_en: by which I mean , that , although differing from each other and from other species of the same genus , in several trifling respects , they often differ in an extreme degree in some one part , both when compared one with another , and more especially when compared with the species under nature to which they are nearest allied .
Translation: 我的意思是，虽然它们在若干细微之处彼此之间以及与同属的其他物种存在差异，但它们在某一部分往往表现出极为显著的差异，无论是相互之间比较，还是与自然界中与其最为接近的物种相比，尤其如此。

Query_Text_en: With these exceptions ( and with that of the perfect fertility of varieties when crossed a subject hereafter to be discussed ) , domestic races of the same species differ from each other in the same manner as do the closely allied species of the same genus in a state of nature , but the differences in most cases are less in degree .
Translation: 除了这些例外（以及品种间杂交时完全具有生育能力这一问题，后文将会讨论），同一物种的家养品系之间的差异，与自然状态下同属的近缘物种之间的差异方式相同，只是在大多数情况下，前者的差异程度较小。

Query_Text_en: This must be admitted as true , for the domestic races of many animals and plants have been ranked by some competent judges as the descendants of aboriginally distinct species , and by other competent judges as mere varieties .
Translation: 这一点必须予以承认，因为许多动物和植物的家养品种，有些权威认为它们是原本不同物种的后代，而另一些权威则认为它们仅仅是变种。

Query_Text_en: If any well marked distinction existed between a domestic race and a species , this source of doubt would not so perpetually recur .
Translation: 如果家养品种与物种之间存在明显区别，这种疑虑就不会如此反复出现。

Query_Text_en: It has often been stated that domestic races do not differ from each other in characters of generic value .
Translation: 人们常说，家养品种之间在具有属级价值的特征上并无差异。

Query_Text_en: It can be shown that this statement is not correct ;
Translation: 可以证明该说法并不正确。

Query_Text_en: but naturalists differ much in determining what characters are of generic value ; all such valuations being at present empirical .
Translation: 但博物学家在确定哪些特征具有属级价值时存在很大分歧；目前所有此类评判仍属经验性的。

Query_Text_en: When it is explained how genera originate under nature , it will be seen that we have no right to expect often to find a generic amount of difference in our domesticated races .
Translation: 当自然界中属的起源得到解释时，我们将会明白，实际上我们没有理由经常在家养品种中发现属级别的差异。

Query_Text_en: In attempting to estimate the amount of structural difference between allied domestic races , we are soon involved in doubt , from not knowing whether they are descended from one or several parent species .
Translation: 在试图估算近缘本土种群之间的结构性差异时，我们很快会陷入疑惑，因为我们无法确定它们是源自同一祖先物种还是多个祖先物种。

Query_Text_en: This point , if it could be cleared up , would be interesting ;
Translation: 如果这一点能够澄清，将颇具意义。

Query_Text_en: if , for instance , it could be shown that the greyhound , bloodhound , terrier , spaniel and bull-dog , which we all know propagate their kind truly , were the offspring of any single species , then such facts would have great weight in making us doubt about the immutability of the many closely allied natural species for instance , of the many foxes inhabiting the different quarters of the world .
Translation: 例如，如果能够证明我们所熟知的灵缇犬、猎犬、梗犬、猎兔犬和斗牛犬这些能够稳定繁衍后代的犬种，实际上都源自同一物种，那么这一事实将极大地动摇我们对于许多彼此密切相关的自然物种——比如分布在世界各地的多种狐狸——不变性的信念。

Query_Text_en: I do not believe , as we shall presently see , that the whole amount of difference between the several breeds of the dog has been produced under domestication ;
Translation: 我认为，正如我们接下来将看到的，狗的各个品种之间的全部差异，并非都是在驯化过程中产生的。

Query_Text_en: I believe that a small part of the difference is due to their being descended from distinct species .
Translation: 我认为，这种差异中有一小部分原因在于他们源自不同的物种。

Query_Text_en: It has often been assumed that man has chosen for domestication animals and plants having an extraordinary inherent tendency to vary , and likewise to withstand diverse climates .
Translation: 人们常常认为，人类在驯化动植物时，选择了那些具有非凡内在变异倾向以及能够适应多种气候的物种。

Query_Text_en: I do not dispute that these capacities have added largely to the value of most of our domesticated productions ;
Translation: 我并不否认，这些能力极大地提升了我们大多数驯化产物的价值；

Query_Text_en: I can not doubt that if other animals and plants , equal in number to our domesticated productions , and belonging to equally diverse classes and countries , were taken from a state of nature , and could be made to breed for an equal number of generations under domestication , they would on an average vary as largely as the parent species of our existing domesticated productions have varied .
Translation: 我毫不怀疑，如果将与我们现有家养物种数量相等、类别和原产地同样多样的其他动植物，从自然状态中带出，并在驯化条件下繁殖相同代数，它们的变异幅度平均而言会与我们现有家养物种的祖先所经历的变异一样大。

Query_Text_en: In the case of most of our anciently domesticated animals and plants , it is not possible to come to any definite conclusion , whether they are descended from one or several wild species .
Translation: 对于我们大多数古早驯化的动植物，目前尚无法得出明确结论，它们究竟起源于单一还是多个野生物种。

Query_Text_en: The argument mainly relied on by those who believe in the multiple origin of our domestic animals is , that we find in the most ancient times , on the monuments of Egypt , and in the lake-habitations of Switzerland , much diversity in the breeds ; and that some of these ancient breeds closely resemble , or are even identical with , those still existing .
Translation: 主张家养动物多重起源论者主要依据的论点是：在最古老的时代，无论是埃及的遗迹，还是瑞士的湖居遗址，都发现了品种的高度多样性；而且其中一些古老品种与现存品种极为相似，甚至完全相同。

Query_Text_en: But this only throws far backward the history of civilisation , and shows that animals were domesticated at a much earlier period than has hitherto been supposed .
Translation: 但这只是将文明史的起点大大提前，表明动物的驯化远早于此前的普遍认知。

Query_Text_en: The lake-inhabitants of Switzerland cultivated several kinds of wheat and barley , the pea , the poppy for oil and flax ; and they possessed several domesticated animals .
Translation: 瑞士湖区居民种植多种小麦和大麦、豌豆、罂粟（用于榨油）和亚麻，并饲养多种家畜。

Query_Text_en: They also carried on commerce with other nations .
Translation: 他们还与其他国家开展了贸易。

Query_Text_en: and this again implies a long continued previous period of less advanced civilisation , during which the domesticated animals , kept by different tribes in different districts , might have varied and given rise to distinct races .
Translation: 这再次表明，在此之前曾有一个较为原始的文明长期存在，在这一时期，不同部落在不同地区饲养的家养动物可能发生了变异，并由此产生了不同的品种。

Query_Text_en: Since the discovery of flint tools in the superficial formations of many parts of the world , all geologists believe that barbarian men existed at an enormously remote period ;
Translation: 自从在世界许多地区的表层地层中发现燧石工具以来，所有地质学家都认为，野蛮人类在极其久远的时期就已存在。

Query_Text_en: and we know that at the present day there is hardly a tribe so barbarous as not to have domesticated at least the dog .
Translation: 我们知道，时至今日，几乎没有哪个部落还野蛮到连狗都没有驯养。

Query_Text_en: The origin of most of our domestic animals will probably forever remain vague .
Translation: 我们大多数家养动物的起源很可能永远难以确切知晓。

Query_Text_en: But I may here state that , looking to the domestic dogs of the whole world , I have , after a laborious collection of all known facts , come to the conclusion that several wild species of Canidae have been tamed , and that their blood , in some cases mingled together , flows in the veins of our domestic breeds .
Translation: 但我可以在此说明，经过对全球家养犬的深入研究和对所有已知事实的细致收集后，我得出结论：多种野生犬科动物曾被驯化，并且它们的血统在某些情况下相互融合，流淌在我们家养犬种的血脉之中。

Query_Text_en: In regard to sheep and goats I can form no decided opinion .
Translation: 对于羊和山羊，我无法形成明确的看法。

Query_Text_en: From facts communicated to me by Mr. Blyth , on the habits , voice , constitution and structure of the humped Indian cattle , it is almost certain that they are descended from a different aboriginal stock from our European cattle ;
Translation: 根据布莱斯先生向我提供的有关驼背印度牛的习性、叫声、体质和结构等事实，可以几乎确定它们与我们的欧洲牛起源于不同的原始种群。

Query_Text_en: and some competent judges believe that these latter have had two or three wild progenitors , whether or not these deserve to be called species .
Translation: 一些有见地的学者认为，后者可能有两到三个野生祖先，不论这些祖先是否应被称为物种。

Query_Text_en: This conclusion , as well as that of the specific distinction between the humped and common cattle , may , indeed , be looked upon as established by the admirable researches of Professor Rutimeyer .
Translation: 这一结论，以及驼牛与普通牛之间具体区别的结论，实际上可以认为已被鲁蒂迈耶教授的卓越研究所确立。

Query_Text_en: With respect to horses , from reasons which I can not here give , I am doubtfully inclined to believe , in opposition to several authors , that all the races belong to the same species .
Translation: 关于马，出于一些在此无法详述的原因，我倾向于认为，尽管有多位作者持不同观点，所有品种实际上都属于同一物种。

Query_Text_en: Having kept nearly all the English breeds of the fowl alive , having bred and crossed them , and examined their skeletons , it appears to me almost certain that all are the descendants of the wild Indian fowl , Gallus bankiva ; and this is the conclusion of Mr. Blyth , and of others who have studied this bird in India .
Translation: 我饲养过几乎所有英国品种的家禽，并对它们进行过繁育和杂交，检查过它们的骨骼结构。由此看来，几乎可以确定它们都源自印度野生鸡——红原鸡（Gallus bankiva）。这一结论也得到了布莱斯先生及其他在印度研究该鸟的专家的认同。

Query_Text_en: In regard to ducks and rabbits , some breeds of which differ much from each other , the evidence is clear that they are all descended from the common duck and wild rabbit .
Translation: 关于鸭和兔，有些品种之间差异很大，但证据表明，它们都源自普通的野鸭和野兔。

Query_Text_en: The doctrine of the origin of our several domestic races from several aboriginal stocks , has been carried to an absurd extreme by some authors .
Translation: 有些作者将我们各类家养品种源自多个原始种群的学说推向了荒谬的极端。

Query_Text_en: They believe that every race which breeds true , let the distinctive characters be ever so slight , has had its wild prototype .
Translation: 他们认为，每一个能够稳定遗传的品种，无论其独特特征多么微小，都曾有其野生原型。

Query_Text_en: At this rate there must have existed at least a score of species of wild cattle , as many sheep , and several goats , in Europe alone , and several even within Great Britain .
Translation: 照此推算，仅在欧洲就至少应当存在二十多个野牛物种、同样数量的野羊物种，以及若干山羊物种，甚至在大不列颠境内也有数种。

Query_Text_en: So it is in India .
Translation: 印度亦是如此。

Query_Text_en: Even in the case of the breeds of the domestic dog throughout the world , which I admit are descended from several wild species , it can not be doubted that there has been an immense amount of inherited variation ;
Translation: 即便是全球范围内的家犬品种，我承认它们确实源自多个野生物种，但毫无疑问，家犬品种中存在大量遗传变异。

Query_Text_en: It has often been loosely said that all our races of dogs have been produced by the crossing of a few aboriginal species ;
Translation: 人们常常笼统地说，我们所有的犬种都是由少数几种原始犬类杂交产生的。

Query_Text_en: but by crossing we can only get forms in some degree intermediate between their parents ; and if we account for our several domestic races by this process , we must admit the former existence of the most extreme forms , as the Italian greyhound , bloodhound , bull-dog , etc. , in the wild state .
Translation: 但通过杂交，我们只能得到在某种程度上介于亲本之间的中间类型；如果我们用这种方式来解释我们现有的各种家养品种，就必须承认像意大利灵缇、猎血犬、斗牛犬等这些极端类型曾经以野生状态存在过。

Query_Text_en: Moreover , the possibility of making distinct races by crossing has been greatly exaggerated .
Translation: 此外，通过杂交形成不同种族的可能性被大大夸张了。

Query_Text_en: but to obtain a race intermediate between two quite distinct races would be very difficult .
Translation: 但要获得一种介于两种截然不同种族之间的中间种族，将会非常困难。

Query_Text_en: Sir J. Sebright expressly experimented with this object and failed .
Translation: 塞布赖特爵士曾专门就此进行实验，但未能成功。

Query_Text_en: The offspring from the first cross between two pure breeds is tolerably and sometimes ( as I have found with pigeons ) quite uniform in character , and every thing seems simple enough ;
Translation: 第一次将两种纯种进行杂交所产生的后代，其性状通常相当一致，有时（正如我在鸽子身上发现的）甚至非常统一，一切看起来都很简单。

Query_Text_en: but when these mongrels are crossed one with another for several generations , hardly two of them are alike , and then the difficulty of the task becomes manifest .
Translation: 但当这些杂交种经过数代相互交配后，几乎没有两只相同，这时任务的难度便显现出来。

Query_Text_en: Believing that it is always best to study some special group , I have , after deliberation , taken up domestic pigeons .
Translation: 我认为研究某一特定群体总是最好的，因此经过慎重考虑，我选择了家鸽作为研究对象。

Query_Text_en: I have kept every breed which I could purchase or obtain , and have been most kindly favored with skins from several quarters of the world , more especially by the Hon. W. Elliot from India , and by the Hon. C. Murray from Persia .
Translation: 我曾购买或获得所有能够得到的犬种，并且非常荣幸地从世界各地收到了皮毛，尤其是印度的埃利奥特阁下和波斯的默里阁下对我给予了极大的帮助。

Query_Text_en: Many treatises in different languages have been published on pigeons , and some of them are very important , as being of considerable antiquity .
Translation: 关于鸽子的著作已经用多种语言出版，其中一些因年代久远而具有重要价值。

Query_Text_en: I have associated with several eminent fanciers , and have been permitted to join two of the London Pigeon Clubs .
Translation: 我曾与几位著名的鸽友交往，并获准加入了伦敦的两个鸽子俱乐部。

Query_Text_en: The diversity of the breeds is something astonishing .
Translation: 品种的多样性令人惊叹。

Query_Text_en: Compare the English carrier and the short-faced tumbler , and see the wonderful difference in their beaks , entailing corresponding differences in their skulls .
Translation: 比较一下英国信鸽和短脸翻滚鸽，你会发现它们的喙有着惊人的差异，这也导致了它们头骨结构的相应不同。

Query_Text_en: and the common tumbler has the singular inherited habit of flying at a great height in a compact flock , and tumbling in the air head over heels .
Translation: 普通翻滚鸽具有独特的遗传习性，即以紧密的群体在高空飞行，并在空中翻滚。

Query_Text_en: some of the sub-breeds of runts have very long necks , others very long wings and tails , others singularly short tails .
Translation: 一些侏儒鸽的亚品种具有非常长的颈部，有的则拥有特别长的翅膀和尾巴，还有的尾巴异常短小。

Query_Text_en: The barb is allied to the carrier , but , instead of a long beak , has a very short and broad one .
Translation: 胡须鸽与信鸽同属一类，但它没有长喙，而是喙短而宽。

Query_Text_en: The pouter has a much elongated body , wings , and legs ; and its enormously developed crop , which it glories in inflating , may well excite astonishment and even laughter .
Translation: 信鸽的身体、翅膀和腿都十分修长，而它极度发达的嗉囊，常常自豪地鼓胀起来，不仅令人惊叹，甚至引发笑声。

Query_Text_en: The turbit has a short and conical beak , with a line of reversed feathers down the breast ; and it has the habit of continually expanding , slightly , the upper part of the oesophagus .
Translation: 鸽种“特比特鸽”具有短而圆锥形的喙，胸部有一排逆向羽毛，并且常常习惯性地轻微扩张食道上部。

Query_Text_en: The Jacobin has the feathers so much reversed along the back of the neck that they form a hood , and it has , proportionally to its size , elongated wing and tail feathers .
Translation: 雅各宾鸽的颈背部羽毛极度反向排列，形成一个兜帽状结构，并且其翅膀和尾部的羽毛相较于体型而言也格外修长。

Query_Text_en: The trumpeter and laugher , as their names express , utter a very different coo from the other breeds .
Translation: 正如其名称所示，号手鸽和笑鸽发出的咕咕声与其他品种截然不同。

Query_Text_en: The fantail has thirty or even forty tail-feathers , instead of twelve or fourteen , the normal number in all the members of the great pigeon family ;
Translation: 扇尾鸽拥有三十甚至四十根尾羽，而鸽科其他成员的正常尾羽数量仅为十二或十四根。

Query_Text_en: the oil-gland is quite aborted .
Translation: 油腺几乎完全退化。

Query_Text_en: Several other less distinct breeds might be specified .
Translation: 还可以列举其他一些不太明显的品种。

Query_Text_en: In the skeletons of the several breeds , the development of the bones of the face , in length and breadth and curvature , differs enormously .
Translation: 在不同品种的骨骼中，面部骨骼在长度、宽度和曲度上的发育存在极大的差异。

Query_Text_en: The shape , as well as the breadth and length of the ramus of the lower jaw , varies in a highly remarkable manner .
Translation: 下颌骨支的形状、宽度和长度都表现出极为显著的多样性。

Query_Text_en: as does the number of the ribs , together with their relative breadth and the presence of processes . The size and shape of the apertures in the sternum are highly variable ;
Translation: 肋骨的数量、相对宽度以及突起的存在情况也同样如此。胸骨上的开口大小和形状变化很大；

Query_Text_en: so is the degree of divergence and relative size of the two arms of the furcula . The proportional width of the gape of mouth , the proportional length of the eyelids , of the orifice of the nostrils , of the tongue ( not always in strict correlation with the length of beak ) , the size of the crop and of the upper part of the oesophagus ; the development and abortion of the oil-gland ; the number of the primary wing and caudal feathers ; the relative length of the wing and tail to each other and to the body ; the relative length of the leg and foot ; the number of scutellae on the toes , the development of skin between the toes , are all points of structure which are variable .
Translation: 叉骨两臂的分叉程度和相对大小也是如此。口裂的相对宽度、眼睑的相对长度、鼻孔开口的相对长度、舌头的相对长度（并不总是与喙的长度严格相关）、嗉囊和食管上部的大小，油腺的发育或退化，初级翅羽和尾羽的数量，翅膀与尾巴之间及与身体之间的相对长度，腿和足的相对长度，趾上的鳞片数量、趾间皮肤的发育情况，都是结构上存在变异的要点。

Query_Text_en: The period at which the perfect plumage is acquired varies , as does the state of the down with which the nestling birds are clothed when hatched .
Translation: 获得完全羽毛的时间各有不同，雏鸟孵化时所覆盖的绒羽状况也不尽相同。
