Query_Text_en: II . Those who are impatient with mere administrative reform , or who lack faith in it , declare that what we need is brotherly love .
Translation: 二、那些对单纯的行政改革感到不耐烦，或对其缺乏信心的人，宣称我们真正需要的是兄弟般的爱。

Query_Text_en: Thousands of pulpits admonish us to remember that we are all children of one Heavenly Father and that we should bear one another 's burdens with fraternal patience .
Translation: 无数讲坛告诫我们，要铭记我们都是同一位天父的子女，应以兄弟般的宽容彼此分担重担。

Query_Text_en: Labor is bent on its own narrow interests regardless of the risks Capital takes .
Translation: 工会只顾自身狭隘利益，丝毫不顾资本所承担的风险。

Query_Text_en: We are all dependent on one another , and a recognition of this should beget mutual forbearance and glad co-operation .
Translation: 我们彼此相互依存，认识到这一点应当促使我们相互包容，并愉快地合作。

Query_Text_en: Let us forget ourselves in others .
Translation: 让我们忘却自我，投身于他人。

Query_Text_en: The fatherhood of God has been preached by Christians for over eighteen centuries , and the brotherhood of man by the Stoics long before them .
Translation: 基督徒宣扬上帝的父性已有十八个多世纪，而斯多葛学派早在他们之前就提倡人类的兄弟情谊。

Query_Text_en: The doctrine has proved compatible with slavery and serfdom , with wars blessed , and not infrequently instigated , by religious leaders , and with industrial oppression which it requires a brave clergyman or teacher to denounce today .
Translation: 这一教义已被证明能够与奴隶制和农奴制共存，也能与由宗教领袖加以祝福、甚至时常煽动的战争共存，还能与当今只有勇敢的神职人员或教师才敢谴责的工业压迫现象共存。

Query_Text_en: True , we sometimes have moments of sympathy when our fellow-creatures become objects of tender solicitude .
Translation: 确实，我们有时会对同类产生同情之心，将他们视为关切和怜悯的对象。

Query_Text_en: Some rare souls may honestly flatter themselves that they love mankind in general , but it would surely be a very rare soul indeed who dared profess that he loved his personal enemies--much less the enemies of his country or institutions .
Translation: 有些罕见的人或许会真诚地自认为爱全人类，但敢于宣称自己爱个人的敌人——更不用说国家或制度的敌人——这样的人恐怕极为罕见。

Query_Text_en: We still worship a tribal god , and the
Translation: 我们依然崇拜着部落之神，而

Query_Text_en: Suspicion and hate are much more congenial to our natures than love , for very obvious reasons in this world of rivalry and common failure .
Translation: 在这个充满竞争和普遍失败的世界里，怀疑与仇恨比爱更符合人性，这背后的原因显而易见。

Query_Text_en: There is , beyond doubt , a natural kindliness in mankind which will show itself under favorable auspices .
Translation: 毫无疑问，人类本性中蕴含着一种善良，只要条件适宜，这种善良便会显现出来。

Query_Text_en: But experience would seem to teach that it is little promoted by moral exhortation .
Translation: 但经验似乎表明，道德劝诫对其促进作用甚微。

Query_Text_en: This is the only point that need be urged here .
Translation: 这是此处唯一需要强调的一点。

Query_Text_en: Whether there is another way of forwarding the brotherhood of man will be considered in the sequel .
Translation: 是否还有其他方式能够促进人类的博爱，将在后文中予以探讨。

Query_Text_en: III . One disappointed in the effects of mere reorganization , and distrusting the power of moral exhortation , will urge that what we need above all is education .
Translation: 三、对于单纯重组效果感到失望、对道德劝诫的力量持怀疑态度的人会认为，我们最需要的，归根结底是教育。

Query_Text_en: It is quite true that what we need is education , but something so different from what now passes as such that it needs a new name .
Translation: 我们确实需要教育，但我们所需要的教育与现今所谓的教育截然不同，甚至需要一个新的名称来称呼。

Query_Text_en: Education has more various aims than we usually recognize , and should of course be judged in relation to the importance of its several intentions , and of its success in gaining them .
Translation: 教育的目标远比我们通常所认识的更加多样，当然应当根据其各项目标的重要性以及实现这些目标的成效来进行评判。

Query_Text_en: The arts of reading and writing and figuring all would concede are basal in a world of newspapers and business .
Translation: 在充满报纸和商业活动的世界里，阅读、写作和计算的能力无疑是最基本的技能。

Query_Text_en: Then there is technical information and the training that prepares one to earn a livelihood in some more or less standardized guild or profession .
Translation: 此外，还有技术性的信息和培训，使人能够在某种程度上标准化的行业或职业中谋生。

Query_Text_en: Both these aims are reached fairly well by our present educational system , subject to various economies and improvements in detail .
Translation: 目前的教育体系在实现这两个目标方面表现得相当不错，只需在细节上进行一些调整和优化。

Query_Text_en: Then there are the studies which it is assumed contribute to general culture and to
Translation: 此外，还有一些被认为有助于提升整体文化素养的研究，以及

Query_Text_en: by the many as at best an amenity which has little relation to the real purposes and success of life .
Translation: 被许多人视为充其量只是一种附属品，与人生的真正目标和成功关系不大。

Query_Text_en: It is highly traditional and retrospective in the main , concerned with ancient tongues , old and revered books , higher mathematics , somewhat archaic philosophy and history , and the fruitless form of logic which has until recently been prized as man 's best guide in the fastnesses of error .
Translation: 总体而言，它极具传统色彩，带有回顾性质，关注古老语言、久负盛名的典籍、高等数学、略显陈旧的哲学与历史，以及那种至今仍被视为人类在错误迷宫中最佳指引、却无果的逻辑形式。

Query_Text_en: To these has been added in recent decades a choice of the various branches of natural science .
Translation: 近年来，自然科学的各个分支也成为了可供选择的方向。

Query_Text_en: The results , however , of our present scheme of liberal education are disappointing .
Translation: 然而，我们当前自由教育体系的成效却令人失望。

Query_Text_en: One who , like myself , firmly agrees with its objects and is personally so addicted to old books , so pleased with such knowledge as he has of the ancient and modern languages , so envious of those who can think mathematically , and so interested in natural science--such a person must resent the fact that those who have had a liberal education rarely care for old books , rarely read for pleasure any foreign language , think mathematically , love philosophy or history , or care for the beasts , birds , plants , and rocks with any intelligent insight , or even real curiosity .
Translation: 像我这样坚定认同其目标、个人酷爱古籍、对自己掌握的古今语言知识感到满足、羡慕能够进行数学思考的人、并对自然科学充满兴趣的人，必然会对那些接受过人文教育的人很少喜欢古书、很少出于兴趣阅读任何外语、很少进行数学思考、热爱哲学或历史、或以有见地甚至真正好奇的态度关注动物、鸟类、植物和岩石这一事实感到不满。

Query_Text_en: This arouses the suspicion that our so-called
Translation: 这引发了人们对我们所谓的……的怀疑。

Query_Text_en: The three educational aims enumerated above have one thing in common . They are all directed toward an enhancement of the chances of personal worldly success , or to the increase of our personal culture and intellectual and literary enjoyment .
Translation: 上述三项教育目标有一个共同点：它们都旨在提升个人在世俗层面的成功机会，或是增进我们的个人修养以及对知识和文学的欣赏。

Query_Text_en: Their purpose is not primarily to fit us to play a part in social or political betterment .
Translation: 他们的目的并非主要是让我们适应参与社会或政治进步的角色。

Query_Text_en: But of late a fourth element has been added to the older ambitions , namely the hope of preparing boys and girls to become intelligent voters .
Translation: 但最近，旧有目标中又新增了第四个因素，即希望培养男孩和女孩成为有见识的选民。

Query_Text_en: This need has been forced upon us by the coming of political democracy , which makes one person 's vote exactly as good as another 's .
Translation: 这种需求是由于政治民主的到来而被迫产生的，因为在政治民主下，每个人的选票都具有同等效力。

Query_Text_en: Now education for citizenship would seem to consist in gaining a knowledge of the actual workings of our social organization , with some illuminating notions of its origin , together with a full realization of its defects and their apparent sources .
Translation: 公民教育似乎应包括了解我们社会组织的实际运作，对其起源有一定的认识，并充分认识到其缺陷及其明显根源。

Query_Text_en: But here we encounter an obstacle that is unimportant in the older types of education , but which may prove altogether fatal to any good results in our efforts to make better citizens .
Translation: 但在这里，我们遇到了一个障碍，这在以往的教育模式中无关紧要，但在我们努力培养更优秀公民的过程中，却可能彻底阻碍取得任何积极成果。

Query_Text_en: Subjects of instruction like reading and writing , mathematics , Latin and Greek , chemistry and physics , medicine and the law are fairly well standardized and retrospective .
Translation: 诸如阅读与写作、数学、拉丁语与希腊语、化学与物理、医学与法律等课程内容，已经相当规范化，并具有较强的回顾性。

Query_Text_en: Doubtless there is a good deal of internal change in method and content going on , but this takes place unobtrusively and does not attract the attention of outside critics .
Translation: 无疑，内部在方法和内容上正在发生许多变化，但这些变化悄然进行，并未引起外部评论者的注意。

Query_Text_en: Political and social questions , on the other hand , and matters relating to prevailing business methods , race animosities , public elections , and governmental policy are , if they are vital , necessarily
Translation: 另一方面，政治和社会问题，以及与现行商业方式、种族敌意、公共选举和政府政策相关的事项，如果它们具有重要性，则必然

Query_Text_en: School boards and superintendents , trustees and presidents of colleges and universities , are sensitive to this fact .
Translation: 各级学区委员会和学区总监、学院及大学的理事会成员和校长对此都十分敏感。

Query_Text_en: They eagerly deprecate in their public manifestos any suspicion that pupils and students are being awakened in any way to the truth that our institutions can possibly be fundamentally defective , or that the present generation of citizens has not conducted our affairs with exemplary success , guided by the immutable principles of justice .
Translation: 他们在公开宣言中急切地否定任何关于学生和学者被唤醒、意识到我们的制度可能存在根本缺陷，或认为当代公民并未以不变的正义原则卓有成效地管理国家事务的怀疑。

Query_Text_en: So , courses in government , political economy , sociology , and ethics confine themselves to inoffensive generalizations , harmless details of organization , and the commonplaces of routine morality , for only in that way can they escape being controversial .
Translation: 因此，政府、政治经济学、社会学和伦理学课程往往局限于无害的概括、组织结构的细节以及常规道德的陈词滥调，只有这样才能避免引发争议。

Query_Text_en: Teachers are rarely able or inclined to explain our social life and its presuppositions with sufficient insight and honesty to produce any very important results .
Translation: 教师很少能够或愿意以足够的洞察力和诚实态度来解释我们的社会生活及其前提条件，因此难以产生任何重要的效果。

Query_Text_en: Even if they are tempted to tell the essential facts they dare not do so , for fear of losing their places , amid the applause of all the righteously minded .
Translation: 即使他们有意透露关键事实，也因害怕失去职位而不敢开口，而所有正义人士对此都拍手称快。

Query_Text_en: However we may feel on this important matter , we must all agree that the aim of education for citizenship as now conceived is a preparation for the same old citizenship which has so far failed to eliminate the shocking hazards and crying injustices of our social and political life .
Translation: 无论我们对这一重要问题有何看法，我们都必须承认，如今所设想的公民教育，其目标依然是为传统的公民身份做准备，而这种公民身份至今未能消除我们社会和政治生活中令人震惊的风险与触目惊心的不公。

Query_Text_en: For we sedulously inculcate in the coming generation exactly the same illusions and the same ill-placed confidence in existing institutions and prevailing notions that have brought the world to the pass in which we find it .
Translation: 我们孜孜不倦地向下一代灌输那些曾让世界陷入如今困境的同样幻想，以及对现有制度和主流观念的盲目信任。

Query_Text_en: Since we do all we can to corroborate the beneficence of what we have , we can hardly hope to raise up a more intelligent generation bent on achieving what we have not .
Translation: 既然我们竭尽全力去证明现有事物的优越性，我们就很难指望培养出一个致力于实现我们尚未拥有之事的更有见识的一代人。

Query_Text_en: it has been forcibly impressed on our minds of late .
Translation: 最近，这一点已经深深地印在我们的脑海中。

Query_Text_en: some of us do not like to think about it at all , but a few will be glad to spend a little time weighing certain suggestions in this volume which may indicate a way out of this . & ;  ( 1 ]
Translation: 我们当中有些人根本不愿去思考这个问题，但也有少数人愿意花些时间，认真考虑本书中提出的某些建议，这些建议或许能为我们指出一条出路。

Query_Text_en: We have now considered briefly the three main hopes that have been hitherto entertained of bettering things ( I ) by changing the rules of the game , ( II ) by urging men to be good , and to love their neighbor as themselves , and ( III ) by education for citizenship .
Translation: 我们已经简要探讨了迄今为止改善现状的三种主要希望：（一）通过改变游戏规则；（二）通过劝导人们行善，并爱人如己；（三）通过公民教育。

Query_Text_en: It may be that these hopes are not wholly unfounded , but it must be admitted that so far they have been grievously disappointed .
Translation: 这些希望或许并非毫无根据，但必须承认，迄今为止它们已遭受严重的挫折。

Query_Text_en: Doubtless they will continue to be cherished on account of their assured respectability .
Translation: 毫无疑问，他们将因其公认的体面而继续受到珍视。

Query_Text_en: Mere lack of success does not discredit a method , for there are many things that determine and perpetuate our sanctified ways of doing things besides their success in reaching their proposed ends .
Translation: 仅仅因为缺乏成功，并不能否定一种方法，因为除了实现既定目标的成效之外，还有许多因素决定并延续我们被认可的做事方式。

Query_Text_en: Had this not always been so , our life today would be far less stupidly conducted than it is .
Translation: 如果情况一直不是这样，我们今天的生活就不会像现在这样愚蠢地进行。

Query_Text_en: But let us agree to assume for the moment that the approved schemes of reform enumerated above have , to say the least , shown themselves inadequate to meet the crisis in which civilized society now finds itself .
Translation: 但让我们暂且同意上述获批准的改革方案，至少可以说，它们已被证明不足以应对当前文明社会所面临的危机。

Query_Text_en: Yes , there is Intelligence .
Translation: 是的，确实存在情报。

Query_Text_en: That is as yet an untested hope in its application to the regulation of human relations .
Translation: 在调节人类关系方面，这仍然是一种尚未经过检验的希望。

Query_Text_en: It is not discredited because it has not been tried on any large scale outside the realm of natural science .
Translation: 它并未被否定，因为在自然科学领域之外，还没有在大规模范围内得到实践。

Query_Text_en: There , everyone will confess , it has produced marvelous results .
Translation: 在那方面，大家都承认，它确实取得了令人瞩目的成果。

Query_Text_en: Employed in regard to stars , rocks , plants , and animals , and in the investigation of mechanical and chemical processes , it has completely revolutionized men 's notions of the world in which they live , and of its inhabitants , with the notable exception of man himself .
Translation: 科学被应用于研究星体、岩石、植物和动物，以及机械和化学过程的探索，彻底改变了人们对所居世界及其生物的认知，唯独对人类自身的看法尚未发生显著变化。

Query_Text_en: These discoveries have been used to change our habits and to supply us with everyday necessities which a hundred years ago were not dreamed of as luxuries accessible even to kings and millionaires .
Translation: 这些发现已经被用来改变我们的生活习惯，并为我们提供日常必需品，而这些必需品在一百年前甚至连国王和百万富翁都无法想象为奢侈品。

Query_Text_en: But most of us know too little of the past to realize the penalty that had to be paid for this application of intelligence .
Translation: 但我们大多数人对过去知之甚少，无法意识到为这种智慧的运用所付出的代价。

Query_Text_en: In order that these discoveries should be made and ingeniously applied to the conveniences of life , it was necessary to discard practically all the consecrated notions of the world and its workings which had been held by the best and wisest and purest of mankind down to three hundred years ago--indeed , until much more recently .
Translation: 为了能够进行这些发现并巧妙地应用于生活便利，有必要彻底摒弃几百年来甚至直到更近时期，人类中最优秀、最智慧、最纯洁的人们所奉为圭臬的关于世界及其运行方式的所有传统观念。

Query_Text_en: Intelligence , in a creature of routine like man and in a universe so ill understood as ours , must often break valiantly with the past in order to get ahead .
Translation: 在像人类这样习惯于循规蹈矩的生物，以及在我们如此难以理解的宇宙中，智慧常常需要勇敢地打破过去，才能不断进步。

Query_Text_en: It would be pleasant to assume that all we had to do was to build on well-designed foundations , firmly laid by the wisdom of the ages .
Translation: 我们很愿意认为，我们所要做的只是建立在由历代智慧牢固奠定的良好基础之上。

Query_Text_en: But those who have studied the history of natural science would agree that Bacon , Galileo , and Descartes found no such foundation , but had to begin their construction from the ground up .
Translation: 但研究过自然科学史的人都会认为，培根、伽利略和笛卡尔并未找到这样的基础，而是不得不从零开始构建他们的体系。

Query_Text_en: The several hopes of reform mentioned above all assume that the now generally accepted notions of righteous human conduct are not to be questioned .
Translation: 上述提到的几种改革希望，都假定现已普遍认可的正义人类行为观念不容置疑。

Query_Text_en: Our churches and universities defend this assumption .
Translation: 我们的教会和大学都在维护这一假设。

Query_Text_en: Our editors and lawyers and the more vocal of our business men adhere to it .
Translation: 我们的编辑、律师以及那些声音较为突出的商界人士都坚持这一观点。

Query_Text_en: Even those who pretend to study society and its origin seem often to believe that our present ideals and standards of property , the state , industrial organization , the relations of the sexes , and education are practically final and must necessarily be the basis of any possible betterment in detail .
Translation: 即便是那些自称研究社会及其起源的人，似乎也常常认为我们当前关于财产、国家、产业组织、两性关系以及教育的理念和标准几乎是最终的，必然成为任何细节改进的基础。

Query_Text_en: But if this be so Intelligence has already done its perfect work , and we can only lament that the outcome in the way of peace , decency , and fairness , judged even by existing standards , has been so disappointing .
Translation: 但如果事实如此，那么理性已经完成了它的完美工作，而我们只能遗憾地看到，即便以现有标准来衡量，和平、体面和公正的结果却如此令人失望。

Query_Text_en: There are , of course , a few here and there who suspect and even repudiate current ideals and standards .
Translation: 当然，也有少数人对当前的理想和标准持怀疑态度，甚至予以否定。

Query_Text_en: But at present their resentment against existing evils takes the form of more or less dogmatic plans of reconstruction , like those of the socialists and communists , or exhausts itself in the vague protest and faultfinding of the average
Translation: 但目前，他们对现存弊端的愤懑主要表现为或多或少教条式的重建方案，如社会主义者和共产主义者的计划，或者仅仅流于普通人的模糊抗议和指责。

Query_Text_en: Neither the socialist nor the common run of Intellectual appears to me to be on the right track .
Translation: 无论是社会主义者还是普通的知识分子，在我看来都没有走在正确的道路上。

Query_Text_en: the other , more indefinite than he need be .
Translation: 另一个则显得比必要的更加模糊不清。

Query_Text_en: If Intelligence is to have the freedom of action necessary to accumulate new and valuable knowledge about man 's nature and possibilities which may ultimately be applied to reforming our ways , it must loose itself from the bonds that now confine it .
Translation: 如果要让智力拥有积累关于人类本质与潜能的新知识、并最终应用于改革我们行为所需的行动自由，就必须摆脱当前束缚它的枷锁。

Query_Text_en: The primeval curse still holds :
Translation: 原始的诅咒依然存在：

Query_Text_en: No one denies that Intelligence is the light of the world and the chief glory of man , but , as Bertrand Russell says , we dread its indifference to respectable opinions and what we deem the well-tried wisdom of the ages .
Translation: 无人否认，智慧是世界的光芒，是人类最重要的荣耀，但正如伯特兰·罗素所言，我们却惧怕智慧对主流观点以及我们所认为的历经考验的古老智慧的漠视。

Query_Text_en: fear that their cherished beliefs should prove harmful , fear lest they themselves should prove less worthy of respect than they have supposed themselves to be .
Translation: 担心他们所珍视的信念可能带来危害，担心自己可能并不像自认为的那样值得尊敬。

Query_Text_en: This fear is natural and inevitable , but it is none the less dangerous and discreditable .
Translation: 这种恐惧是自然而不可避免的，但它同样具有危险性和不光彩的一面。

Query_Text_en: Human arrangements are no longer so foolproof as they may once have been when the world moved far more slowly than it now does .
Translation: 在人类社会运转远比现在缓慢的过去，制度安排或许曾经万无一失，但如今已不再如此。

Query_Text_en: It should therefore be a good deed to remove or lighten any of the various restraints on thought .
Translation: 因此，消除或减轻各种对思想的限制，应被视为一项善举。

Query_Text_en: I believe that there is an easy and relatively painless way in which our respect for the past can be lessened so that we shall no longer feel compelled to take the wisdom of the ages as the basis of our reforms .
Translation: 我认为，有一种简单且相对无痛的方法，可以减弱我们对过去的敬畏，这样我们就不必再把古人的智慧作为改革的基础。

Query_Text_en: My own confidence in what President Butler calls
Translation: 我本人对巴特勒总统所称的内容充满信心

Query_Text_en: I have no reforms to recommend , except the liberation of Intelligence , which is the first and most essential one .
Translation: 我没有任何改革建议，除了解放思想，这是首要且最为重要的。

Query_Text_en: I propose to review by way of introduction some of the new ideas which have been emerging during the past few years in regard to our minds and their operations .
Translation: 作为引言，我建议回顾一下近年来关于我们思维及其运作方式所涌现出的一些新观点。

Query_Text_en: Then we shall proceed to the main theme of the book , a sketch of the manner in which our human intelligence appears to have come about .
Translation: 接下来，我们将进入本书的主题，即对人类智能产生方式的简要勾勒。

Query_Text_en: If anyone will follow the story with a fair degree of sympathy and patience he may , by merely putting together well-substantiated facts , many of which he doubtless knows in other connections , hope better to understand the perilous quandary in which mankind is now placed and the ways of escape that offer themselves .
Translation: 如果有人能够以相当的同情心和耐心来关注这个故事，仅仅通过汇集那些有充分依据的事实——其中许多他在其他情境下可能早已知晓——他就有望更好地理解人类目前所处的危险困境，以及摆在我们面前的各种出路。

Query_Text_en:
3 . ON VARIOUS KINDS OF THINKING

The truest and most profound observations on Intelligence have in the past been made by the poets and , in recent times , by story-writers .
Translation:
关于各种思维方式

过去，最真实、最深刻的关于智慧的观察，往往出自诗人，而近年来，则多见于小说家。

Query_Text_en: They have been keen observers and recorders and reckoned freely with the emotions and sentiments .
Translation: 他们一直是敏锐的观察者和记录者，并且坦率地对情感和情绪进行考量。

Query_Text_en: Most philosophers , on the other hand , have exhibited a grotesque ignorance of man 's life and have built up systems that are elaborate and imposing , but quite unrelated to actual human affairs .
Translation: 另一方面，大多数哲学家却对人类生活表现出极其荒谬的无知，他们构建的体系虽然庞大而宏伟，却与现实人类事务毫无关联。

Query_Text_en: They have almost consistently neglected the actual process of thought and have set the mind off as something apart to be studied by itself .
Translation: 他们几乎一直忽视了思维的实际过程，而是将心智视为一个独立的对象，单独进行研究。

Query_Text_en: But no such mind , exempt from bodily processes , animal impulses , savage traditions , infantile impressions , conventional reactions , and traditional knowledge , ever existed , even in the case of the most abstract of metaphysicians .
Translation: 然而，即便是最抽象的形而上学家，也从未存在过这样一种心灵——它完全不受身体过程、动物本能、野蛮传统、童年印象、习惯性反应和传统知识的影响。

Query_Text_en: Kant entitled his great work A Critique of Pure Reason . But to the modern student of mind pure reason seems as mythical as the pure gold , transparent as glass , with which the celestial city is paved .
Translation: 康德将他的重要著作命名为《纯粹理性批判》。但对于现代心理学研究者而言，纯粹理性似乎如同那用以铺设天城、透明如玻璃的纯金一般虚幻。

Query_Text_en: Formerly philosophers thought of mind as having to do exclusively with conscious thought .
Translation: 过去，哲学家们认为心灵只与有意识的思维有关。

Query_Text_en: It was that within man which perceived , remembered , judged , reasoned , understood , believed , willed .
Translation: 那是人内在的感知、记忆、判断、推理、理解、信仰和意志。

Query_Text_en: and that a great part of the thinking of which we are aware is determined by that of which we are not conscious .
Translation: 我们所意识到的大部分思维，实际上是由我们未曾察觉的思维所决定的。

Query_Text_en: It has indeed been demonstrated that our unconscious psychic life far outruns our conscious .
Translation: 事实确实证明，我们的无意识心理活动远远超越我们的意识。

Query_Text_en: The sharp distinction between the mind and the body is , as we shall find , a very ancient and spontaneous uncritical savage prepossession .
Translation: 我们将会发现，心灵与身体之间的鲜明区分，是一种非常古老且自发的、未经批判的原始观念。

Query_Text_en: What we think of as
Translation: 我们所认为的

Query_Text_en: Every thought reverberates through the body , and , on the other hand , alterations in our physical condition affect our whole attitude of mind .
Translation: 每一个念头都会在身体中产生回响；反过来，身体状况的变化也会影响我们的整体心态。

Query_Text_en: The insufficient elimination of the foul and decaying products of digestion may plunge us into deep melancholy , whereas a few whiffs of nitrous monoxide may exalt us to the seventh heaven of supernal knowledge and godlike complacency .
Translation: 消化过程中产生的恶臭和腐败物未能充分排除，可能使我们陷入深深的忧郁；而几口一氧化二氮却能让我们升入超然的第七天堂，获得神一般的知识与满足。

Query_Text_en: And vice versa , a sudden word or thought may cause our heart to jump , check our breathing , or make our knees as water .
Translation: 反之，一个突如其来的词语或念头也可能让我们心头一震，呼吸急促，甚至双腿发软。

Query_Text_en: There is a whole new literature growing up which studies the effects of our bodily secretions and our muscular tensions and their relation to our emotions and our thinking .
Translation: 现在出现了一整套新的研究文献，专门探讨人体分泌物和肌肉紧张对我们的情感和思维的影响及其相互关系。

Query_Text_en: Then there are hidden impulses and desires and secret longings of which we can only with the greatest difficulty take account .
Translation: 此外，还有一些隐秘的冲动、欲望和内心深处的渴望，我们几乎难以察觉和把握。

Query_Text_en: They influence our conscious thought in the most bewildering fashion .
Translation: 它们以最令人困惑的方式影响着我们的有意识思维。

Query_Text_en: Many of these unconscious influences appear to originate in our very early years .
Translation: 许多这样的无意识影响似乎源于我们早年的成长阶段。

Query_Text_en: The older philosophers seem to have forgotten that even they were infants and children at their most impressionable age and never could by any possibility get over it .
Translation: 年长的哲学家们似乎忘记了，他们自己也曾在最易受影响的年幼时期是婴儿和儿童，而且这一经历无论如何都无法摆脱。

Query_Text_en: The term
Translation: 该术语

Query_Text_en: There should , however , be no special mystery about it .
Translation: 不过，这其中并没有什么特别神秘之处。

Query_Text_en: It is not a new animistic abstraction , but simply a collective word to include all the physiological changes which escape our notice , all the forgotten experiences and impressions of the past which continue to influence our desires and reflections and conduct , even if we can not remember them .
Translation: 这并不是一种新的泛灵论抽象，而只是一个集合性的词语，用以涵盖所有未被我们察觉的生理变化，以及那些被遗忘但仍持续影响我们的欲望、思考和行为的过去经历与印象，即便我们无法回忆起它们。

Query_Text_en: What we can remember at any time is indeed an infinitesimal part of what has happened to us .
Translation: 我们在任何时刻能够记起的，确实只是我们所经历过的事情中极其微小的一部分。

Query_Text_en: We could not remember anything unless we forgot almost everything .
Translation: 除非我们几乎忘记了一切，否则我们无法记住任何事情。

Query_Text_en: As Bergson says , the brain is the organ of forgetfulness as well as of memory .
Translation: 正如柏格森所言，大脑既是记忆的器官，也是遗忘的器官。

Query_Text_en: Moreover , we tend , of course , to become oblivious to things to which we are thoroughly accustomed , for habit blinds us to their existence .
Translation: 此外，我们往往会对那些我们极为习惯的事物变得视而不见，因为习惯使我们对它们的存在变得麻木。

Query_Text_en: So the forgotten and the habitual make up a great part of the so-called
Translation: 因此，被遗忘的和习以为常的构成了所谓……的重要部分。

Query_Text_en: If we are ever to understand man , his conduct and reasoning , and if we aspire to learn to guide his life and his relations with his fellows more happily than heretofore , we can not neglect the great discoveries briefly noted above .
Translation: 如果我们希望真正理解人类、人的行为和思维，并且希望比以往更好地引导人的生活及其与他人的关系，那么我们绝不能忽视上述简要提及的那些重大发现。

Query_Text_en: We must reconcile ourselves to novel and revolutionary conceptions of the mind , for it is clear that the older philosophers , whose works still determine our current views , had a very superficial notion of the subject with which they dealt .
Translation: 我们必须接受关于心灵的新颖而革命性的观念，因为很明显，那些至今仍影响我们观点的早期哲学家，对他们所探讨的主题理解得非常肤浅。

Query_Text_en: But for our purposes , with due regard to what has just been said and to much that has necessarily been left unsaid ( and with the indulgence of those who will at first be inclined to dissent ) , we shall consider mind chiefly as conscious knowledge and intelligence , as what we know and our attitude toward it--our disposition to increase our information , classify it , criticize it and apply it .
Translation: 但就我们的目的而言，在充分考虑刚才所述以及许多不得不略去的内容（并请那些初时可能持异议者予以包容）的情况下，我们将主要把“心智”视为有意识的知识与智能，即我们所知以及我们对知识的态度——我们增加信息、分类、批判并应用知识的倾向。

Query_Text_en: We do not think enough about thinking , and much of our confusion is the result of current illusions in regard to it .
Translation: 我们对思考本身关注不够，而我们许多困惑正是源于当前对思考存在的种种误解。

Query_Text_en: The first thing that we notice is that our thought moves with such incredible rapidity that it is almost impossible to arrest any specimen of it long enough to have a look at it .
Translation: 我们首先注意到的是，我们的思维运转极为迅速，以至于几乎无法将其中的任何一个片段停留足够长的时间来加以观察。

Query_Text_en: When we are offered a penny for our thoughts we always find that we have recently had so many things in mind that we can easily make a selection which will not compromise us too nakedly .
Translation: 当有人请我们谈谈想法时，我们总会发现，最近脑海中浮现过许多念头，因此我们很容易挑选出一个不会让自己过于坦露的内容来分享。

Query_Text_en: On inspection we shall find that even if we are not downright ashamed of a great part of our spontaneous thinking it is far too intimate , personal , ignoble or trivial to permit us to reveal more than a small part of it .
Translation: 经过审视我们会发现，即便我们不至于对自己大量的自发思考感到羞愧，其中绝大部分也过于私密、个人化、卑微或琐碎，以至于我们只能公开极少部分。

Query_Text_en: I believe this must be true of everyone .
Translation: 我认为这对每个人来说都应当如此。

Query_Text_en: We do not , of course , know what goes on in other people 's heads .
Translation: 当然，我们无法知晓他人内心的想法。

Query_Text_en: They tell us very little and we tell them very little .
Translation: 他们对我们透露的信息很少，我们对他们透露的信息也很少。

Query_Text_en: The spigot of speech , rarely fully opened , could never emit more than driblets of the ever renewed hogshead of thought--noch grosser wie 's Heidelberger Fass .
Translation: 言语的阀门很少完全打开，永远只能滴滴答答地流出那不断更新、如海德堡大酒桶般庞大的思想。

Query_Text_en: We find it hard to believe that other people 's thoughts are as silly as our own , but they probably are .
Translation: 我们很难相信别人的想法会和我们自己的一样荒谬，但实际上很可能如此。

Query_Text_en: We all appear to ourselves to be thinking all the time during our waking hours , and most of us are aware that we go on thinking while we are asleep , even more foolishly than when awake .
Translation: 我们每个人在清醒时似乎都在不停地思考，大多数人也意识到，即使在睡眠中我们依然在思考，而且比清醒时更加荒诞。

Query_Text_en: When uninterrupted by some practical issue we are engaged in what is now known as a reverie . This is our spontaneous and favorite kind of thinking .
Translation: 当没有任何实际问题打扰时，我们便会陷入如今被称为“遐想”的状态。这是我们自发且最喜欢的一种思考方式。

Query_Text_en: by our likes and dislikes , our loves and hates and resentments .
Translation: 受我们的喜好、爱憎与怨恨所左右。

Query_Text_en: There is nothing else anything like so interesting to ourselves as ourselves .
Translation: 没有什么比我们自身更令我们感兴趣的了。

Query_Text_en: All thought that is not more or less laboriously controlled and directed will inevitably circle about the beloved Ego .
Translation: 所有未经或多或少艰苦努力加以控制和引导的思想，最终都不可避免地会围绕着自我打转。

Query_Text_en: It is amusing and pathetic to observe this tendency in ourselves and in others .
Translation: 观察到我们自身及他人身上这种倾向，既令人发笑，又令人感到可悲。

Query_Text_en: We learn politely and generously to overlook this truth , but if we dare to think of it , it blazes forth like the noontide sun .
Translation: 我们通常以礼貌和宽容的态度去忽略这个事实，但如果我们敢于直面它，它便如正午的烈阳般耀眼。

Query_Text_en: The reverie or
Translation: 遐想或

Query_Text_en: While investigators are not yet agreed on the results , or at least on the proper interpretation to be given to them , there can be no doubt that our reveries form the chief index to our fundamental character .
Translation: 尽管调查人员尚未就结果达成一致，或者至少尚未就如何正确解读结果达成共识，但毫无疑问，我们的遐想是反映我们根本性格的主要指标。

Query_Text_en: They are a reflection of our nature as modified by often hidden and forgotten experiences .
Translation: 它们反映了我们的本性，而这种本性常常受到那些隐秘且被遗忘的经历的影响和改变。

Query_Text_en: We need not go into the matter further here , for it is only necessary to observe that the reverie is at all times a potent and in many cases an omnipotent rival to every other kind of thinking .
Translation: 我们无需在此进一步探讨这个问题，只需指出，白日梦始终是其他各种思维方式的有力竞争者，在许多情况下甚至是无可匹敌的对手。

Query_Text_en: It doubtless influences all our speculations in its persistent tendency to self-magnification and self-justification , which are its chief preoccupations , but it is the last thing to make directly or indirectly for honest increase of .
Translation: 它无疑影响着我们所有的思考，因为它始终倾向于自我夸大和自我辩护，这也是它最主要的关注点，但它却最不可能直接或间接地促进诚实的增长。

Query_Text_en: & ;  ( 2 ] Philosophers usually talk as if such thinking did not exist or were in some way negligible . This is what makes their speculations so unreal and often worthless .
Translation: 哲学家们通常谈论问题时，仿佛这种思考不存在，或者无足轻重。正因如此，他们的推测显得脱离现实，常常毫无价值。

Query_Text_en: The reverie , as any of us can see for himself , is frequently broken and interrupted by the necessity of a second kind of thinking .
Translation: 正如我们每个人都能亲身体会到的，遐想常常会因另一种思维方式的必要性而被打断和中断。

Query_Text_en: We have to make practical decisions .
Translation: 我们必须作出切实可行的决策。

Query_Text_en: Decisions are easily distinguishable from the free flow of the reverie .
Translation: 决策很容易与自由流动的遐想区分开来。

Query_Text_en: often , however , they are made impulsively .
Translation: 然而，这些决定往往是冲动作出的。

Query_Text_en: They are a more difficult and laborious thing than the reverie , and we resent having to
Translation: 它们比幻想更加艰难和费力，而我们却不得不去做，这让人感到不满。

Query_Text_en: Weighing a decision , it should be noted , does not necessarily add anything to our knowledge , although we may , of course , seek further information before making it .
Translation: 需要注意的是，权衡一个决策本身并不一定会增加我们的知识，尽管我们在做出决策前当然可以寻求更多信息。

Query_Text_en: A third kind of thinking is stimulated when anyone questions our belief and opinions .
Translation: 当有人质疑我们的信仰和观点时，会激发出第三种思维方式。

Query_Text_en: We sometimes find ourselves changing our minds without any resistance or heavy emotion , but if we are told that we are wrong we resent the imputation and harden our hearts .
Translation: 有时我们会在没有任何抵触或强烈情绪的情况下改变想法，但如果有人告诉我们错了，我们会对这种指责感到不满，并变得更加固执。

Query_Text_en: We are incredibly heedless in the formation of our beliefs , but find ourselves filled with an illicit passion for them when anyone proposes to rob us of their companionship .
Translation: 我们在形成信念时极为漫不经心，但一旦有人试图剥夺我们与这些信念的陪伴，我们却会对其产生一种近乎非法的执着。

Query_Text_en: It is obviously not the ideas themselves that are dear to us , but our self-esteem , which is threatened .
Translation: 我们真正珍视的显然并不是那些观点本身，而是我们的自尊心，因为自尊心受到了威胁。

Query_Text_en: We are by nature stubbornly pledged to defend our own from attack , whether it be our person , our family , our property , or our opinion .
Translation: 我们天生就坚定地誓言捍卫属于我们的一切，无论是我们自身、家庭、财产，还是我们的观点，凡遭受攻击，我们都将坚决维护。

Query_Text_en: A United States Senator once remarked to a friend of mine that God Almighty could not make him change his mind on our Latin-America policy .
Translation: 一位美国参议员曾对我的一位朋友表示，即便是全能的上帝也无法让他改变对我们拉美政策的看法。

Query_Text_en: We may surrender , but rarely confess ourselves vanquished .
Translation: 我们或许会选择投降，但很少承认自己被击败。

Query_Text_en: In the intellectual world at least peace is without victory .
Translation: 至少在思想领域，和平并不以胜利为前提。

Query_Text_en: indeed , we have a natural repugnance to so doing .
Translation: 事实上，我们对此确实有一种本能的反感。

Query_Text_en: We like to continue to believe what we have been accustomed to accept as true , and the resentment aroused when doubt is cast upon any of our assumptions leads us to seek every manner of excuse for clinging to them .
Translation: 我们往往倾向于继续相信那些我们习以为常、认定为真实的事物，而一旦有人对我们的某些假设提出质疑，我们内心的不满便会促使我们寻找各种理由来坚持原有的看法。

Query_Text_en: In entering upon a college course you are taking a step that may completely revolutionize your life . You are facing new situations vastly different from any you have previously met . They are also of great variety , such as finding a place to eat and sleep , regulating your own finances , inaugurating a new social life , forming new friendships , and developing in body and mind . The problems connected with mental development will engage your chief attention .
Translation: 进入大学课程，意味着你正在迈出一步，这一步可能会彻底改变你的人生。你将面对许多全新的情境，这些情境与以往经历大不相同，且种类繁多，比如寻找食宿之地、管理个人财务、开启新的社交生活、建立新的友谊，以及身心的成长。与智力发展相关的问题将成为你关注的重点。

Query_Text_en: You are now going to use your mind more actively than ever before and should survey some of the intellectual difficulties before plunging into the fight .
Translation: 你现在将比以往任何时候都更加积极地运用你的思维，并且在投入这场斗争之前，应当先审视一些可能遇到的思想难题。

Query_Text_en: Perhaps the first difficulty you will encounter is the substitution of the lecture for the class recitation to which you were accustomed in high school .
Translation: 也许你首先会遇到的困难，就是由你在高中习惯的课堂提问转变为大学的讲座授课。

Query_Text_en: This substitution requires that you develop a new technic of learning , for the mental processes involved in an oral recitation are different from those used in listening to a lecture . The lecture system implies that the lecturer has a fund of knowledge about a certain field and has organized this knowledge in a form that is not duplicated in the literature of the subject . The manner of presentation , then , is unique and is the only means of securing the knowledge in just that form .
Translation: 这种替代方式要求你培养一种新的学习方法，因为口头复述所涉及的心理过程与听讲座时所用的不同。讲座制意味着讲师在某一领域拥有丰富的知识，并将这些知识以一种在该学科文献中未曾出现的形式进行组织。因此，讲师的呈现方式具有独特性，是以这种特定形式获取知识的唯一途径。

Query_Text_en: As soon as the words have left the mouth of the lecturer they cease to be accessible to you .
Translation: 讲师的话语一旦说出口，你便无法再获取。

Query_Text_en: The situation is not like that in reading , in which a temporary lapse of attention may be remedied by turning back and rereading . In listening to a lecture , you are obliged to catch the words on the fly .
Translation: 情况并非阅读那样，在阅读时，注意力暂时分散还可以通过回头重读来弥补。而在听讲座时，你必须随时捕捉讲者的话语。

Query_Text_en: Accordingly you must develop new habits of paying attention . You will also need to develop a new technic for memorizing , especially for memorizing things heard .
Translation: 因此，你必须养成新的注意力习惯。同时，你还需要培养一种新的记忆方法，尤其是针对听到内容的记忆方法。

Query_Text_en: As a partial aid in this , and also for purposes of organizing material received in lectures , you will need to develop ability to take notes .
Translation: 为此，作为一项辅助措施，同时也是为了整理课堂上所获得的材料，你需要培养记笔记的能力。

Query_Text_en: It is a most important phase of college life , however , and will repay earnest study .
Translation: 然而，这一阶段是大学生活中极为重要的一部分，值得我们认真研究。

Query_Text_en: Another characteristic of college study is the vast amount of reading required .
Translation: 大学学习的另一个特点是需要大量阅读。

Query_Text_en: Instead of using a single textbook for each course , you may use several . They may cover great historical periods and represent the ideas of many men . In view of the amount of reading assigned , you will also be obliged to learn to read faster .
Translation: 你们可以不必每门课程只用一本教材，而是可以使用多本教材。这些教材可能涵盖重要的历史时期，反映众多学者的思想。鉴于阅读任务较重，你们还必须学会提高阅读速度。

Query_Text_en: No longer will you have time to dawdle sleepily through the pages of easy texts ;
Translation: 你将不再有时间昏昏欲睡地翻阅那些浅显易懂的文本；

Query_Text_en: you will have to cover perhaps fifty or a hundred pages of knotty reading every day .
Translation: 你每天可能需要阅读五十到一百页内容复杂的材料。

Query_Text_en: Accordingly you must learn to handle books expeditiously and to comprehend quickly .
Translation: 因此，你必须学会高效处理书籍，并迅速理解内容。

Query_Text_en: In fact , economy must be your watchword throughout .
Translation: 事实上，节约必须始终作为你的准则。

Query_Text_en: You should be warned also that college demands not only a greater quantity but also a higher quality of work . When you were a high school student the world expected only a high school student 's accomplishments of you . Now you are a college student , however , and your intellectual responsibilities have increased . The world regards you now as a person of considerable scholastic attainment and expects more of you than before .
Translation: 你还应当注意，大学不仅要求你完成更多的任务，而且对任务的质量也有更高的要求。作为高中生时，社会对你的期望仅限于高中生应有的成就。而现在你已成为一名大学生，你所肩负的学术责任也随之增加。社会如今视你为具有相当学术水平的人，对你的期望也比以往更高。

Query_Text_en: In academic terms this means that in order to attain a grade of 95 in college you will have to work much harder than you did for that grade in high school , for here you have not only more difficult subject matter , but also keener competition for the first place .
Translation: 从学术角度来说，这意味着在大学里要想取得95分的成绩，你必须比在高中时为这一分数付出更多努力，因为这里不仅课程内容更加困难，争夺第一名的竞争也更加激烈。

Query_Text_en: In high school you may have been the brightest student in your class . In college , however , you encounter the brightest students from many schools .
Translation: 在高中时，你可能是班里最优秀的学生；然而到了大学，你会遇到来自许多学校的优秀学生。

Query_Text_en: Your work from now on must be of better quality .
Translation: 你今后的工作必须更加高质量。

Query_Text_en: Not the least of the perplexities of your life as a college student will arise from the fact that no daily schedule is arranged for you .
Translation: 作为一名大学生，生活中诸多困惑之一便在于没有人为你安排每日的作息时间。

Query_Text_en: The only time definitely assigned for your work is the fifteen hours a week , more or less , spent in the classroom .
Translation: 你唯一被明确分配的工作时间，就是每周在教室里度过的大约十五个小时。

Query_Text_en: The rest of your schedule must be arranged by yourself .
Translation: 剩余的日程需由您自行安排。

Query_Text_en: This is a real task and will require care and thought if your work is to be done with greatest economy of time and effort .
Translation: 这是一项真正的任务，如果你想以最高的时间和精力效率完成工作，就需要认真对待并加以思考。

Query_Text_en: This brief survey completes the catalogue of problems of mental development that will vex you most in adjusting your methods of study to college conditions .
Translation: 这份简要的调查补充了有关心理发展问题的目录，这些问题在你适应大学学习方法时将最令你困扰。

Query_Text_en: In order to make this adjustment you will be obliged to form a number of new habits .
Translation: 为实现这一调整，您必须养成一系列新的习惯。

Query_Text_en: Indeed , as you become more and more expert as a student , you will see that the whole process resolves itself into one of habit-formation , for while a college education has two phases the acquisition of facts and the formation of habits it is the latter which is the more important .
Translation: 事实上，随着你在学习过程中不断精进，你会发现整个过程归根结底就是习惯的养成。因为大学教育包括两个阶段：知识的获取和习惯的养成，而后者才是更为重要的。

Query_Text_en: but the habits of study you form will be permanent possessions .
Translation: 但你养成的学习习惯将成为你永久的财富。

Query_Text_en: They will consist of such things as methods of grasping facts , methods of reasoning about facts , and of concentrating attention .
Translation: 它们将包括诸如把握事实的方法、对事实进行推理的方法以及集中注意力的方法。

Query_Text_en: In acquiring these habits you must have some material upon which you may concentrate your attention , and it will be supplied by the subjects of the curriculum .
Translation: 在养成这些习惯的过程中，你必须有一些可以集中注意力的素材，而课程设置中的各门学科将为你提供这些素材。

Query_Text_en: You will be asked , for instance , to write innumerable themes in courses in English composition ; not for the purpose of enriching the world 's literature , nor for the delectation of your English instructor , but for the sake of helping you to form habits of forceful expression .
Translation: 例如，在英语写作课程中，你将被要求写无数篇作文；这并不是为了丰富世界文学，也不是为了取悦你的英语老师，而是为了帮助你养成有力表达的习惯。

Query_Text_en: You will be asked to enter the laboratory and perform numerous experiments , not to discover hitherto unknown facts , but to obtain practice in scientific procedure and to learn how to seek knowledge by yourself .
Translation: 你将被要求进入实验室并进行多项实验，这些实验的目的并非发现前所未知的事实，而是为了让你熟练掌握科学实验的方法，并学会如何自主探索知识。

Query_Text_en: The curriculum and the faculty are the means , but you yourself are the agent in the educational process .
Translation: 课程和师资只是手段，而你自己才是教育过程中的主体。

Query_Text_en: No matter how good the curriculum or how renowned the faculty , you can not be educated without the most vigorous efforts on your part .
Translation: 无论课程多么优质，师资多么著名，如果你自己不付出最大的努力，都无法真正获得教育。

Query_Text_en: Banish the thought that you are here to have knowledge pumped into you .
Translation: 不要以为你来到这里只是为了被灌输知识。

Query_Text_en: To acquire an education you must establish and maintain not a passive attitude but an active attitude .
Translation: 要获得教育，必须树立并保持积极的态度，而非被动的态度。

Query_Text_en: Learning is not a process of passive soaking-in . It is a matter of vigorous effort , and the harder you work the more powerful you become . In securing a college education you are your own master .
Translation: 学习不是被动吸收的过程，而是需要积极努力。你付出的努力越多，能力就越强。在接受大学教育的过程中，你是自己的主人。

Query_Text_en: In the development of physical prowess you are well aware of the importance of doing everything in good form .
Translation: 在锻炼身体素质的过程中，你深知以规范的姿势完成每一个动作的重要性。

Query_Text_en: The same principle holds true in the development of the mind .
Translation: 同样的原则也适用于心智的发展。

Query_Text_en: The most serviceable mind is that which accomplishes results in the shortest time and with least waste motion .
Translation: 最有用的头脑，是能够在最短时间内、以最少无效动作取得成果的头脑。

Query_Text_en: Take every precaution , therefore , to rid yourself of all superfluous and impeding methods . Strive for the development of good form in study .
Translation: 因此，要采取一切预防措施，摒弃所有多余且妨碍进步的方法，努力培养良好的学习方式。

Query_Text_en: Especially is this necessary at the start . Now is the time when you are laying the foundations for your mental achievements in life . Keep a sharp lookout , then , at every point , to see that you build into the foundation only those materials and that workmanship which will support a masterly structure .
Translation: 尤其是在开始阶段，这一点尤为重要。现在正是你为人生的精神成就奠定基础的时候。因此，在每一个环节都要保持警觉，确保你所用的材料和工艺，能够支撑起一个卓越的结构。

Query_Text_en: Most educated people find occasion , at some time or other , to take notes .
Translation: 多数受过教育的人在某个时候都会有记笔记的需要。

Query_Text_en: Although this is especially true of college students , they have little success , as any college instructor will testify .
Translation: 虽然大学生尤其如此，但他们收效甚微，任何大学教师都可以证明这一点。

Query_Text_en: Students , as a rule , do not realize that there is any skill involved in taking notes . Not until examination time arrives and they try vainly to labor through a maze of scribbling , do they realize that there must be some system in note-taking .
Translation: 学生们通常并未意识到记笔记是一项需要技巧的工作。直到考试临近，他们试图在一堆杂乱的笔记中艰难应对时，才意识到记笔记必须讲究方法和系统。

Query_Text_en: A careful examination of note-taking shows that there are rules or principles , which , when followed , have much to do with increasing ability in study .
Translation: 仔细研究笔记记录可以发现，其中存在一些规则或原则，遵循这些规则或原则对于提升学习能力有着重要作用。

Query_Text_en: One criterion that should guide in the preparation of notes is the use to which they will be put .
Translation: 在撰写笔记时，应以其未来的用途作为指导标准之一。

Query_Text_en: If this is kept in mind , many blunders will be saved .
Translation: 只要牢记这一点，许多错误就可以避免。

Query_Text_en: Notes may be used in three ways : as material for directing each day 's study , for cramming , and for permanent , professional use .
Translation: 笔记可以有三种用途：用于指导每日学习、临时突击复习，以及作为长期的专业参考资料。

Query_Text_en: Thus a notebook may be a thing of far-reaching value .
Translation: 因此，笔记本可能具有深远的价值。

Query_Text_en: Notes you take now as a student may be valuable years hence in professional life .
Translation: 你现在作为学生所做的笔记，几年后在职业生涯中可能会变得非常有价值。

Query_Text_en: Recognition of this will help you in the preparation of your notes and will determine many times how they should be prepared .
Translation: 认识到这一点将有助于你在整理笔记时进行准备，并且在很多情况下会决定笔记的整理方式。

Query_Text_en: The chief situations in college which require note-taking are lectures , library reading and laboratory work .
Translation: 在大学中需要记笔记的主要情境包括听讲、图书馆阅读和实验操作。

Query_Text_en: Accordingly the subject will be considered under these three heads .
Translation: 因此，该议题将从这三个方面进行探讨。

Query_Text_en: Lecture Notes . When taking notes on a lecture , there are two extremes that present themselves , to take exceedingly full notes or to take almost no notes .
Translation: 讲座笔记。在听讲座时记笔记，通常会出现两种极端情况：要么记得非常详细，要么几乎不记笔记。

Query_Text_en: One can err in either direction . True , on first thought , entire stenographic reports of lectures appear desirable , but second thought will show that they may be dispensed with , not only without loss , but with much gain .
Translation: 人们可能会犯两种不同的错误。诚然，初看之下，完整的讲座速记记录似乎是理想的，但进一步思考会发现，这些记录不仅可以舍弃，而且舍弃后不仅不会有损失，反而会带来更多益处。

Query_Text_en: The most obvious objection is that too much time would be consumed in transcribing short-hand notes . Another is that much of the material in a lecture is undesirable for permanent possession .
Translation: 最明显的反对意见是，转录速记笔记会耗费过多时间。另一个问题是，讲座中的许多内容并不适合长期保存。

Query_Text_en: You do not need these illustrations in written form , however , for once the point is made you rarely need to depend upon the illustrations for its retention .
Translation: 你无需以书面形式保留这些例证，因为一旦观点阐明，你很少需要依赖这些例证来加深记忆。

Query_Text_en: A still more cogent objection is that if you occupy your attention with the task of copying the lecture verbatim , you do not have time to think , but become merely an automatic recording machine .
Translation: 一个更有说服力的反对意见是，如果你把注意力都放在逐字记录讲座内容上，就没有时间思考，只会变成一个机械的记录工具。

Query_Text_en: Experienced stenographers say that they form the habit of recording so automatically that they fail utterly to comprehend the meaning of what is said .
Translation: 经验丰富的速记员表示，他们养成了自动记录的习惯，以至于完全无法理解所说内容的含义。

Query_Text_en: You as a student can not afford to have your attention so distracted from the meaning of the lecture , therefore reduce your classroom writing to a minimum .
Translation: 作为学生，你不能让注意力过于分散而忽略讲课内容，因此应尽量减少课堂笔记的书写。

Query_Text_en: Probably the chief reason why students are so eager to secure full lecture notes is that they fear to trust their memory .
Translation: 学生之所以如此渴望获得完整的讲义，主要原因是他们担心无法依靠自己的记忆。

Query_Text_en: Such fears should be put at rest , for your mind will retain facts if you pay close attention and make logical associations during the time of impression .
Translation: 这种担忧大可不必，只要你在记忆时专注并进行逻辑联想，头脑就能牢牢记住事实。

Query_Text_en: Keep your mind free , then , to work upon the subject-matter of the lecture . Debate mentally with the speaker . Question his statements , comparing them with your own experience or with the results of your study .
Translation: 保持头脑清醒，让自己专注于讲座的内容。与讲者在心中进行辩论，对他的观点提出质疑，并将其与自己的经验或学习成果进行比较。

Query_Text_en: The essential thing is to maintain an attitude of mental activity , and to avoid anything that will reduce this and make you passive .
Translation: 关键在于保持积极主动的思维态度，避免任何可能削弱这一态度、使你变得被动的因素。

Query_Text_en: Reading Notes . The question of full or scanty notes arises in reading notes as in lecture notes .
Translation: 读书笔记中，同样存在记笔记详尽还是简略的问题，这与听课笔记时面临的情况类似。

Query_Text_en: In general , your notes should represent a summary , in your own words , of the author 's discussion , not a duplication of it .
Translation: 一般来说，你的笔记应以自己的语言对作者论述内容进行总结，而不是对其内容的简单复制。

Query_Text_en: Students sometimes acquire the habit of reading single sentences at a time , then of writing them down , thinking that by making an exact copy of the book , they are playing safe .
Translation: 有些学生常常养成逐句阅读、逐句抄写的习惯，认为只要完全照搬书上的内容，就万无一失了。

Query_Text_en: This is a pernicious practice ; it spoils continuity of thought and application . Furthermore , isolated sentences mean little , and fail grossly to represent the real thought of the author .
Translation: 这种做法极为有害，破坏了思想和实践的连贯性。此外，孤立的句子意义有限，严重无法体现作者的真实思想。

Query_Text_en: A better way is to read through an entire paragraph or section , then close the book and reproduce in your own words what you have read . Next , take your summary and compare with the original text to see that you have really grasped the point .
Translation: 更好的方法是先通读整段或整个章节，然后合上书，用自己的话复述所读内容。接下来，将你的总结与原文进行对照，看看自己是否真正掌握了要点。

Query_Text_en: it will lead you to regard thought and not words . ( You are undoubtedly familiar with the state of mind wherein you find yourself reading merely words and not following the thought . ) Lastly , material studied in this way is remembered longer than material read scrappily .
Translation: 这样做会引导你关注思想本身，而不是只关注词句。（你无疑对那种只是在阅读文字而没有跟上思想的状态非常熟悉。）最后，以这种方式学习的内容，比零散阅读的内容记得更久。

Query_Text_en: In short , such a method of reading makes not only for good memory , but for good mental habits of all kinds .
Translation: 简而言之，这种阅读方法不仅有助于记忆，还能培养各种良好的思维习惯。

Query_Text_en: In all your reading , hold to the conception of yourself as a thinker , not a sponge .
Translation: 在阅读过程中，要始终把自己视为思考者，而不是被动吸收的海绵。

Query_Text_en: Remember , you do not need to accept unqualifiedly everything you read .
Translation: 请记住，你无需对所读内容全盘接受。

Query_Text_en: Often this will be indicated in topical headings . Keep it in the background of your mind while reading , and search for the answer .
Translation: 这一点通常会在主题标题中有所体现。阅读时请将其作为背景思考，并寻找答案。

Query_Text_en: Then , when you have read the necessary portion , close the book and summarize , to see if the author furnished what you sought .
Translation: 然后，在阅读了必要的部分之后，合上书，总结一下，看作者是否提供了你所寻求的内容。

Query_Text_en: In this way will there be direction in your reading and your thought .
Translation: 这样，您的阅读和思考就会有明确的方向。

Query_Text_en: This discussion of reading notes has turned into an essay on How to Read , and you must be convinced by this time that there is much to learn in this respect , so much that we may profitably spend more time in discussing it .
Translation: 关于读书笔记的讨论，已经演变成了一篇关于“如何阅读”的文章。此时此刻，你一定已经认识到，在这方面有许多值得学习的内容，甚至值得我们花更多时间来深入探讨。

Query_Text_en: Every book you take up should be opened with some preliminary ceremony .
Translation: 每一本你拿起的书，都应以某种预备的仪式开启。

Query_Text_en: This does not refer to the physical operation of opening a new book , but to the mental operation .
Translation: 这并不是指实际去翻开一本新书，而是指心理上的开启。

Query_Text_en: Observe the title . See exactly what field the book attempts to cover .
Translation: 注意书名，明确该书试图涵盖的具体领域。

Query_Text_en: Observe the author 's name .
Translation: 请注意作者姓名。

Query_Text_en: If you are to use his book frequently , discover his position in the field . Remember , you are going to accept him as authority , and you should know his status .
Translation: 如果你打算经常使用他的著作，就要了解他在该领域的地位。请记住，你将把他视为权威，因此应当清楚他的学术地位。

Query_Text_en: You may be told this on the title-page , or you may have to consult Who 's Who , or the biographical dictionary .
Translation: 你可能会在书名页上看到这个信息，也可能需要查阅《名人录》或传记词典。

Query_Text_en: Glance over the preface . Under some circumstances you should read it carefully . If you are going to refer to the book very often , make friends with the author ; let him introduce himself to you ; this he will do in the preface .
Translation: 浏览一下前言。在某些情况下，你应该认真阅读它。如果你将频繁查阅这本书，不妨与作者“交朋友”，让他向你自我介绍——这正是前言的作用。

Query_Text_en: Observe the date of publication , also , in order to get an idea as to the recency of the material .
Translation: 请注意出版日期，以便了解资料的新近程度。

Query_Text_en: Glance over the table of contents .
Translation: 浏览目录。

Query_Text_en: If you are very familiar with the field , and the table of contents is outlined in detail , you might advantageously study it and dispense with reading the book .
Translation: 如果你对该领域非常熟悉，并且目录列得很详细，你可以直接研究目录而无需阅读全文。

Query_Text_en: On the other hand , if you are going to consult the book only briefly , you might find it necessary to study the table of contents in order to see the relation of the part you read to the entire work .
Translation: 另一方面，如果你只是短暂查阅这本书，可能需要仔细阅读目录，以了解你所阅读的部分与全书整体之间的关系。

Query_Text_en: Use the index intelligently ; it may save you much time .
Translation: 合理利用索引，这能为你节省大量时间。

Query_Text_en: Laboratory Notes . The form for laboratory notes varies with the science and is usually prescribed by the instructor .
Translation: 实验记录。实验记录的格式因学科而异，通常由指导教师规定。

Query_Text_en: Reports of experiments are usually written up in the order : Object , Apparatus , Method , Results , Conclusions .
Translation: 实验报告通常按照以下顺序撰写：目的、仪器、方法、结果、结论。

Query_Text_en: When detailed instructions are given by the instructor , follow them accurately .
Translation: 在教师给出详细指令时，务必准确遵循。

Query_Text_en: Pay special attention to neatness .
Translation: 特别注意整洁。

Query_Text_en: Instructors say that the greatest fault with laboratory notebooks is lack of neatness .
Translation: 指导老师认为实验室笔记最大的缺点是不够整洁。

Query_Text_en: This reacts upon the instructor , causing him much trouble in correcting the notebook . The resulting annoyance frequently prejudices him , against his will , against the student .
Translation: 这会对教师产生影响，使其在批改作业时遇到诸多麻烦。由此带来的烦恼常常让教师不由自主地对学生产生偏见。

Query_Text_en: It is safe to assert that you will materially increase your chances of a good grade in a laboratory course by the preparation of a neat notebook .
Translation: 可以肯定地说，认真整理一本整洁的实验记录本，将显著提高你在实验课程中获得好成绩的机会。

Query_Text_en: The key-note of the twentieth century is economy , the tendency in all lines being toward the elimination of waste . College students should adopt this aim in the regulation of their study affairs , and there is much opportunity for applying it in note-taking .
Translation: 二十世纪的主旋律是经济，各领域的趋势都是消除浪费。大学生在安排学习事务时也应秉持这一目标，而在课堂笔记的整理中，这一原则有着广泛的应用空间。

Query_Text_en: So far , the discussion has had to do with the content of the notebook , but its form is equally important . Much may be done by utilization of mechanical devices to save time and energy .
Translation: 到目前为止，讨论主要集中在笔记本的内容上，但其形式同样重要。通过使用各种机械设备，可以大大节省时间和精力。

Query_Text_en: First , write in ink .
Translation: 首先，用墨水书写。

Query_Text_en: Pencil marks blur badly and become illegible in a few months .
Translation: 铅笔痕迹很容易模糊，几个月后就会变得无法辨认。

Query_Text_en: Remember , you may be using the notebook twenty years hence , therefore make it durable .
Translation: 请记住，你可能在二十年后还会使用这本笔记本，因此要确保它经久耐用。

Query_Text_en: Second , write plainly .
Translation: 第二，表达要简明扼要。

Query_Text_en: This injunction ought to be superfluous , for common sense tells us that writing which is illegible can not be read even by the writer , once it has grown cold .
Translation: 这一告诫本应是多余的，因为常识告诉我们，写得无法辨认的文字，即使是作者本人，等到时间一久也无法再读懂。

Query_Text_en: Third , take care in forming sentences . Do not make your notes consist simply of separate , scrappy jottings .
Translation: 第三，注意句子的完整性。不要让你的笔记只是一些零散、片段式的记录。

Query_Text_en: True , it is difficult , under stress , to form complete sentences . The great temptation is to jot down a word here and there and trust to luck or an indulgent memory to supply the context at some later time . A little experience , however , will quickly demonstrate the futility of such hopes ; therefore strive to form sensible phrases , and to make the parts of the outline cohere . Apply the principles of English composition to the preparation of your notebook .
Translation: 确实，在压力之下很难组织完整的句子。人们往往会忍不住随手记下几个词，寄希望于运气或宽容的记忆在日后能够补全上下文。然而，稍有经验便会很快发现这种做法毫无意义。因此，应努力写出有意义的短语，使提纲各部分前后连贯。在整理笔记时，也要运用英语写作的基本原则。

Query_Text_en: A fourth question concerns size and shape of the notebook .
Translation: 第四个问题涉及笔记本的尺寸和形状。

Query_Text_en: These features depend partly upon the nature of the course and partly upon individual taste .
Translation: 这些特点部分取决于课程的性质，部分取决于个人的偏好。

Query_Text_en: It is often convenient and practicable to keep the notes for all courses in a single notebook .
Translation: 将所有课程的笔记集中在一本笔记本中，通常既方便又可行。

Query_Text_en: Men find it advantageous to use a small notebook of a size that can be carried in the coat pocket and studied at odd moments .
Translation: 人们发现，随身携带一本可以放入口袋的小笔记本，并在空闲时加以翻阅，是十分有益的。

Query_Text_en: Generally the latter will be found more desirable .
Translation: 通常情况下，后者更为理想。

Query_Text_en: Leaves are easily inserted and the sections are easily filed on completion of a course .
Translation: 课程结束后，资料页可以方便地插入，并且各部分也便于归档。

Query_Text_en: We have noted some of the most obvious and immediate benefits derived from well-prepared notes , consisting of economy of time , ease of review , ease of permanent retention .
Translation: 我们已经注意到，精心整理的笔记带来了一些最为明显和直接的好处，包括节省时间、便于复习以及便于长期记忆。

Query_Text_en: There are other benefits , however , which , though less obvious , are of far greater importance .
Translation: 然而，还有一些其他好处，虽然不那么显而易见，但却重要得多。

Query_Text_en: These are the permanent effects upon the mind .
Translation: 这些都是对心智产生的永久影响。

Query_Text_en: Habits of correct thinking are the chief result of correct note-taking .
Translation: 正确的笔记习惯主要培养了正确的思维方式。

Query_Text_en: As you develop in this particular ability , you will find corresponding improvement in your ability to comprehend and assimilate ideas , to retain and reproduce facts , and to reason with thoroughness and independence .
Translation: 随着你在这一能力上的提升，你会发现自己在理解和吸收观点、记忆和复述事实，以及独立、全面地进行推理方面也会有相应的进步。

Query_Text_en: Though most people understand more or less vaguely that the brain acts in some way during study , exact knowledge of the nature of this action is not general .
Translation: 尽管大多数人或多或少模糊地知道大脑在学习过程中以某种方式发挥作用，但对于这种作用的具体性质，普遍还缺乏确切的认识。

Query_Text_en: As you will be greatly assisted in understanding mental processes by such knowledge , we shall briefly examine the brain and its connections . It will be manifestly impossible to inquire into its nature very minutely , but by means of a description you will be able to secure some conception of it and thus will be able better to control the mental processes which it underlies .
Translation: 鉴于此类知识将极大帮助您理解心理过程，我们将简要探讨大脑及其相关结构。虽然无法对其本质进行极为细致的研究，但通过描述，您可以对其有所了解，从而更好地掌控大脑所支配的心理活动。

Query_Text_en: To the naked eye the brain is a large jelly-like mass enclosed in a bony covering , about one-fourth of an inch thick , called the skull .
Translation: 肉眼所见，大脑是一个类似果冻的大块组织，被一层约四分之一英寸厚的骨质结构包裹，这层结构被称为颅骨。

Query_Text_en: Inside the skull it is protected by a thick membrane . At its base emerges the spinal cord , a long strand of nerve fibers extending down the spine .
Translation: 在颅骨内部，大脑受到一层厚膜的保护。在其底部，脊髓从中延伸出来，这是一条沿着脊柱向下延展的神经纤维束。

Query_Text_en: For most of its length , the cord is about as large around as your little finger , but it tapers at the lower end .
Translation: 大部分长度上，这根脊髓的粗细大约与你的小指相仿，但在下端逐渐变细。

Query_Text_en: From it at right angles throughout its length branch out thirty-one pairs of fibrous nerves which radiate to all parts of the body . The brain and spinal cord , with all its ramifications , are known as the nervous system .
Translation: 从其全长的两侧以直角分布着三十一对纤维神经，向身体各部位延伸。大脑和脊髓及其所有分支统称为神经系统。

Query_Text_en: You see now that , though we started with the statement that the mind is intimately connected with the brain , we must now enlarge our statement and say it is connected with the entire nervous system . It is therefore to the nervous system that we must turn our attention .
Translation: 你现在可以看到，虽然我们一开始认为心智与大脑密切相关，但现在我们必须拓展这一说法，认为心智与整个神经系统都有联系。因此，我们必须将注意力转向神经系统。

Query_Text_en: Although to the naked eye the nervous system is apparently made up of a number of different kinds of material , still we see , when we turn our microscopes upon it , that its parts are structurally the same .
Translation: 虽然从肉眼来看，神经系统似乎由多种不同类型的物质组成，但当我们用显微镜观察时，会发现其各部分在结构上是相同的。

Query_Text_en: Reduced to lowest terms , the nervous system is found to be composed of minute units of structure called nerve-cells or neurones .
Translation: 从最基本的层面来看，神经系统由被称为神经细胞或神经元的微小结构单元组成。

Query_Text_en: Each of these looks like a string frayed out at both ends , with a bulge somewhere along its length .
Translation: 每一条都像是一根两端散开的线，中间某处还有一个鼓包。

Query_Text_en: Some of the neurones are as long as three feet ; others measure but a fraction of an inch in length .
Translation: 有些神经元长达三英尺，而另一些则只有几英寸的一小部分。

Query_Text_en: The nervous system is made up of millions of these little cells packed together in various combinations and distributed throughout the body .
Translation: 神经系统由数百万个这样的微小细胞以不同方式组合并分布于全身组成。

Query_Text_en: We do not know exactly how the mind , that part of us which feels , reasons and wills , is connected with this mass of cells called the nervous system .
Translation: 我们并不确切知道，那部分能够感受、思考和意志的心智，是如何与这被称为神经系统的细胞群相连接的。

Query_Text_en: We do know , however , that every time anything occurs in the mind , there is a change in some part of the nervous system .
Translation: 然而，我们确实知道，每当大脑中发生任何活动时，神经系统的某一部分都会发生变化。

Query_Text_en: Applying this fact to study , it is obvious that when you are performing any of the operations of study , memorizing foreign vocabularies , making arithmetical calculations , reasoning out problems in geometry , you are making changes in your nervous system .
Translation: 将这一事实应用到学习中，我们可以明显看出，无论是在记忆外语词汇、进行算术计算，还是推理几何问题时，你都在对自己的神经系统产生变化。

Query_Text_en: The question before us , then , is , what is the nature of these changes ?
Translation: 那么，摆在我们面前的问题是，这些变化的本质是什么？

Query_Text_en: According to present knowledge , the action of the nervous system is best conceived as a form of chemical change that spreads among the nerve-cells .
Translation: 根据现有知识，神经系统的活动最好被理解为一种在神经细胞间传播的化学变化。

Query_Text_en: We call this commotion the nervous current .
Translation: 我们称这种骚动为神经电流。

Query_Text_en: It is very rapid , moving faster than one hundred feet a second , and runs along the cells in much the same way as a spark runs along a train of gunpowder . It is important to note that neurones never act singly ; they always act in groups , the nervous current passing from neurone to neurone .
Translation: 它的速度非常快，每秒超过一百英尺，并且沿着细胞传导的方式很像火花沿着火药线蔓延。需要注意的是，神经元从不单独活动；它们总是以群体的形式协同作用，神经冲动从一个神经元传递到另一个神经元。

Query_Text_en: It is thought that the most important changes in the nervous system do not occur within the individual neurones , but at the points where they join with each other .
Translation: 人们认为，神经系统中最重要的变化并非发生在单个神经元内部，而是发生在神经元之间的连接点上。

Query_Text_en: This point of connection is called the synapse and although we do not understand its exact nature , it may well be pictured as a valve that governs the passage of the nervous current from neurone to neurone .
Translation: 这种连接点被称为突触，尽管我们尚未完全了解其具体特性，但可以将其形象地比作一个阀门，控制着神经电流在神经元之间的传递。

Query_Text_en: At time of birth , most of the valves are closed . Only a few are open , mainly those connected with the vegetative processes such as breathing and digestion .
Translation: 在出生时，大多数阀门都是关闭的。只有少数阀门是开启的，主要是与呼吸和消化等生命维持过程相关的那些。

Query_Text_en: But as the individual is played upon by the objects of the environment , the valves open to the passage of the nervous current .
Translation: 然而，随着个体受到环境中各种事物的影响，神经通路的阀门便会开启，让神经电流得以通过。

Query_Text_en: With increased use they become more and more permeable , and thus learning is the process of making easier the passage of the nervous current from one neurone to another .
Translation: 随着使用频率的增加，神经元之间的通透性逐渐增强，因此，学习的过程实际上就是使神经冲动在神经元之间传递变得更加顺畅的过程。

Query_Text_en: We shall secure further light upon the action of the nervous system if we examine some of the properties belonging to nervecells .
Translation: 如果我们研究神经细胞的一些特性，将能进一步揭示神经系统的作用。

Query_Text_en: The first one is impressibility . Nerve-cells are very sensitive to impressions from the outside .
Translation: 第一个特点是易受刺激。神经细胞对外界的刺激非常敏感。

Query_Text_en: If you have ever had the dentist touch an exposed nerve , you know how extreme this sensitivity is .
Translation: 如果你曾经被牙医触碰到暴露的神经，就会明白这种敏感有多么强烈。

Query_Text_en: Naturally such a property is very important in education , for had we not the power to receive impressions from the outside world we should not be able to acquire knowledge . We should not even be able to perceive danger and remove ourselves from harm .
Translation: 这种能力在教育中当然非常重要，因为如果我们无法从外部世界接受信息，就无法获得知识，甚至无法感知危险并避开伤害。

Query_Text_en: The second property of nerve-cells which is important in study is conductivity .
Translation: 神经细胞在研究中重要的第二个特性是传导性。

Query_Text_en: As soon as a neurone is stimulated at one end , it communicates its excitement , by means of the nervous current , to the next neurone or to neighboring neurones . Just as an electric current might pass along one wire , thence to another , and along it to a third , so the nervous current passes from neurone to neurone .
Translation: 一旦神经元一端受到刺激，它便通过神经电流将兴奋传递给下一个神经元或邻近的神经元。正如电流可以沿着一根导线传递到另一根导线，再传到第三根导线一样，神经电流也是从一个神经元传递到另一个神经元。

Query_Text_en: The third property of nerve-cells which is important in study is modifiability .
Translation: 神经细胞在研究中重要的第三个特性是可塑性。

Query_Text_en: That is , impressions made upon the nervecells are retained .
Translation: 也就是说，神经细胞所受到的刺激会被保留下来。

Query_Text_en: Most living tissue is modifiable to some extent .
Translation: 大多数活组织在一定程度上都是可变的。

Query_Text_en: The features of the face are modifiable , and if one habitually assumes a peevish expression , it becomes , after a time , permanently fixed .
Translation: 人的面部特征是可以改变的，如果一个人长期习惯于带着不满的表情，久而久之，这种表情就会永久地固定在脸上。

Query_Text_en: The nervous system , however , possesses the power of modifiability to a marked degree , even a single impression sufficing to make striking modification .
Translation: 然而，神经系统具有显著的可塑性，甚至一次刺激就足以产生显著的变化。

Query_Text_en: This is very important in study , being the basis for the retentive powers of the mind .
Translation: 这是学习中非常重要的一点，是培养记忆力的基础。

Query_Text_en: Having examined the action of the nervous system in its simplicity , we have now to examine the ways in which the parts of the nervous system are combined .
Translation: 在研究了神经系统的基本作用之后，我们现在需要探讨神经系统各部分的组合方式。

Query_Text_en: We shall be helped if we keep to the conception of it as an aggregation of systems or groups of pathways . Some of these we shall attempt to trace out . Beginning with those at the outermost parts of the body , we find them located in the sense-organs , not only within the traditional five , but also within the muscles , tendons , joints , and internal organs of the body such as the heart , and digestive organs .
Translation: 如果我们将其视为由多个系统或路径群组成的集合体，将有助于我们的理解。我们将尝试追踪其中的一些路径。首先从身体最外部的部分开始，我们发现这些路径分布在感觉器官中，不仅包括传统的五种感觉器官，还存在于肌肉、腱、关节以及心脏和消化器官等内部器官之中。

Query_Text_en: In all these places we find ends of neurones which converge at the spinal cord and travel to the brain .
Translation: 在所有这些部位，我们都可以发现神经元的末端在脊髓处汇聚，并向大脑传导。

Query_Text_en: They are called sensory neurones and their function is to carry messages inward to the brain .
Translation: 它们被称为感觉神经元，其作用是将信息传递到大脑内部。

Query_Text_en: Thus , the brain represents , in great part , a central receiving station for impressions from the outside world .
Translation: 因此，大脑在很大程度上充当着来自外部世界信息的中央接收站。

Query_Text_en: The nerve-cells carrying messages from the various parts of the body terminate in particular areas .
Translation: 来自身体各部位的神经细胞在特定区域终止。

Query_Text_en: another area near the top of the brain receives messages from the skin .
Translation: 大脑顶部附近的另一个区域接收来自皮肤的信息。

Query_Text_en: These areas are quite clearly marked out and may be studied in detail by means of the accompanying diagram .
Translation: 这些区域划分得非常清晰，可以通过附图进行详细研究。

Query_Text_en: There is another large group of nervecells which , when traced out , are found to have one terminal in the brain and the other in the muscles throughout the body .
Translation: 还有一大类神经细胞，一端连接大脑，另一端分布在全身的肌肉中。

Query_Text_en: The area in the brain , where these neurones emerge , is near the top of the brain in the area marked Motor on the diagram .
Translation: 这些神经元所在的大脑区域位于大脑顶部，在图中标注为“运动区”的位置。

Query_Text_en: From here the fibers travel down through the spinal cord and out to the muscles .
Translation: 从这里，神经纤维沿着脊髓向下延伸，最终到达肌肉。

Query_Text_en: The nerve-cells in this group are called motor neurones and their function is to carry messages from the brain out to the muscles , for a muscle ordinarily does not act without a nervous current to set it off .
Translation: 这一组神经细胞被称为运动神经元，其功能是将信息从大脑传递到肌肉，因为肌肉通常不会在没有神经信号的情况下自行活动。

Query_Text_en: So far we have seen that the brain has the two functions of receiving impressions from the sense-organs and of sending out orders to the muscles .
Translation: 到目前为止，我们已经了解到，大脑具有两个功能：一是接收来自感官器官的刺激，二是向肌肉发出指令。

Query_Text_en: There is a further mechanism that must now be described . When messages are received in the sensory areas , it is necessary that there be some means within the brain of transmitting them over to the motor area so that they may be acted upon .
Translation: 还需要进一步说明一种机制。当信息在感觉区域被接收时，大脑内部必须有某种方式将这些信息传递到运动区域，以便能够对其作出反应。

Query_Text_en: Such an arrangement is provided by another group of nerve-cells in the brain , having as their function the transmission of the nervous current from one area to another .
Translation: 这种机制由大脑中另一组神经细胞提供，其功能是将神经电流从一个区域传递到另一个区域。

Query_Text_en: They are called association neurones and transmit the nervous current from sensory areas to motor areas or from one sensory area to another .
Translation: 它们被称为联络神经元，负责将神经冲动从感觉区传递到运动区，或从一个感觉区传递到另一个感觉区。

Query_Text_en: For example , suppose you see a brick falling from above and you dodge quickly back .
Translation: 例如，假设你看到一块砖头从上方掉下来，你迅速向后躲开。

Query_Text_en: The neural action accompanying this occurrence consists of an impression upon the nerve-cells in the eye , the conduction of the nervous current back to the visual area of the brain , the transmission of the current over association neurones to the motor area , then its transmission over the motor neurons down the spinal cord , to the muscles that enable you to dodge the missile . The association neurones have the further function of connecting one sensory area in the brain with another .
Translation: 这一过程所伴随的神经活动包括：眼部神经细胞受到刺激，神经电流传导至大脑视觉区域，经联络神经元传递至运动区域，再通过运动神经元沿脊髓传递至控制你躲避飞来物体的肌肉。联络神经元还具有将大脑中一个感觉区域与另一个感觉区域连接的功能。

Query_Text_en: For example , when you see , smell , taste and touch an orange , the corresponding areas in the brain act in conjunction and are associated by means of the association neurones connecting them . The association neurones play a large part in the securing and organizing of knowledge . They are very important in study , for all learning consists in building up associations .
Translation: 例如，当你看到、闻到、尝到并触摸一个橙子时，大脑中相应的区域会协同活动，并通过连接这些区域的联络神经元实现关联。联络神经元在获取和组织知识的过程中起着重要作用。它们在学习中非常关键，因为所有的学习本质上都是建立各种关联的过程。

Query_Text_en: From the foregoing description we see that the nervous system consists merely of a mechanism for the reception and transmission of incoming messages and their transformation into outgoing messages which produce movement .
Translation: 从上述描述可以看出，神经系统仅仅是一个接收和传递外来信息，并将其转化为产生运动的输出信息的机制。

Query_Text_en: The brain is the center where such transformations are made , being a sort of central switchboard which permits the sense-organs to come into communication with muscles . It is also the instrument by means of which the impressions from the various senses can be united and experience can be unified . The brain serves further as the medium whereby impressions once made can be retained . That is , it is the great organ of memory . Hence we see that it is to this organ we must look for the performance of the activities necessary to study . Everything that enters it produces some modification within it . Education consists in a process of undergoing a selected group of experiences of such a nature as to leave beneficial results in the brain . By means of the changes made there , the individual is able better to adjust himself to new situations .
Translation: 大脑是进行此类转化的中枢，相当于一个中央交换台，使感觉器官能够与肌肉进行沟通。大脑还是将来自不同感官的印象加以整合、实现经验统一的工具。此外，大脑还是使已获得的印象得以保留的媒介，也就是说，它是记忆的重要器官。因此，我们可以看到，学习所需的各种活动都离不开这一器官。任何进入大脑的信息都会在其中产生某种变化。教育的过程，就是让个体经历一系列经过筛选的、有益于大脑留下积极影响的体验。通过这些变化，个体能够更好地适应新的情境。

Query_Text_en: The pathways for complex acts , both as speaking English or French , or writing , are not formed at birth but must be built up within the life-time of the individual .
Translation: 复杂行为的路径，例如说英语或法语、或写作，并非在出生时就已形成，而是必须在个人的一生中逐步建立。

Query_Text_en: It is the process of building them up that we call education .
Translation: 我们称之为教育的，正是培养他们的过程。

Query_Text_en: This process is a physical feat involving the production of changes in physical material in the brain . Study involves the overcoming of resistance in the nervous system . That is why it is so hard .
Translation: 这一过程是一项身体上的挑战，涉及到大脑物质的物理变化。学习需要克服神经系统的阻力，这也是学习如此艰难的原因。

Query_Text_en: In your early schooldays , when you set about laboriously learning the multiplication table , your unwilling protests were wrung because you were being compelled to force the nervous current through new pathways , and to overcome the inertia of physical matter .
Translation: 在你早期的求学阶段，当你艰难地学习乘法表时，你之所以不情愿地抗议，是因为你被迫让神经电流通过新的路径，并克服物质的惯性。

Query_Text_en: Today , when you begin a train of reasoning , the task is difficult because you are opening hitherto untravelled pathways .
Translation: 如今，当你开始进行一系列推理时，这项任务是艰巨的，因为你正在开辟前所未有的道路。

Query_Text_en: There is a comforting thought , however , which is derived from the factor of modifiability , in that with each succeeding repetition , the task becomes easier , because the path becomes worn smoothly and the nervous current seeks it of its own accord ;
Translation: 然而，有一个令人宽慰的想法源于可变性这一因素，那就是随着每一次重复，任务会变得更加容易，因为路径变得更加顺畅，神经冲动会自然而然地选择这条通路。

Query_Text_en: in other words , each act and each thought tends to become habitualized .
Translation: 换句话说，每一个行为和每一个想法都倾向于变成习惯。

Query_Text_en: Education is then a process of forming habits , and the rest of the book will be devoted to the description and discussion of habits which a student should form .
Translation: 因此，教育就是一个养成习惯的过程，本书余下部分将专门描述和讨论学生应当养成的各种习惯。

Query_Text_en: Exercise 1 . Draw a picture of the brain , showing roughly what takes place there ( a ) when you read a book , ( 6 ) listen to a lecture , ( c ) take notes .
Translation: 练习1：画一幅大脑的示意图，分别展示在以下情况下大脑中大致发生的活动：（a）阅读书籍时，（b）听讲座时，（c）做笔记时。

Query_Text_en: As already intimated , this book adopts the view that education is a process of forming habits in the brain .
Translation: 如前所述，本书认为教育是一个在大脑中形成习惯的过程。

Query_Text_en: Accordingly we shall devote a chapter to the consideration of habits in general before discussing the specific habits involved in various kinds of study .
Translation: 因此，在讨论各种学习所涉及的具体习惯之前，我们将专门用一章来探讨习惯这一主题。

Query_Text_en: Habit may be defined roughly as the tendency to act time after time in the same way . Thus defined , you see that the force of habit extends throughout the entire universe .
Translation: 习惯可以粗略地定义为一次又一次以相同方式行动的倾向。按照这样的定义，你会发现，习惯的力量遍及整个宇宙。

Query_Text_en: A piece of paper once folded tends to crease in the same place .
Translation: 一张纸折过之后，往往会在同一个地方留下折痕。

Query_Text_en: The hair may be trained to lie this way or that . These are examples of habit in living tissue . But there is one particular form of living tissue which is most susceptible to habit ; that is nerve tissue . Let us review briefly the facts which underlie this characteristic . In nerve tissue , impressibility , conductivity and modifiability are developed to a marked degree . The nervecells in the sense organs are impressed by stimulations from the outside world . The nervous current thus generated is conducted over long nerve fibers , through the spinal cord to the brain where it is received and we experience a sensation . Thence it pushes on , over association neurones in the brain to motor neurones , over which it passes down the spinal cord again to muscles , and ends in some movement . In the pathway which it traverses it leaves its impression , and , thereafter , when the first neurone is excited , the nervous current tends to take the same pathway and to end in the same movement .
Translation: 头发可以被训练成向这个方向或那个方向梳理。这些都是生物组织习惯性的例子。但有一种特殊的生物组织对习惯最为敏感，那就是神经组织。让我们简要回顾一下这一特性的基本事实。在神经组织中，易受刺激性、传导性和可塑性都得到了显著的发展。感觉器官中的神经细胞会受到来自外界的刺激。由此产生的神经电流沿着长长的神经纤维，通过脊髓传导到大脑，在那里被接收，我们便产生了感觉。随后，神经电流继续沿着大脑中的联络神经元传递到运动神经元，再沿脊髓传导至肌肉，最终引发某种动作。在神经电流经过的通路上，它会留下印记，此后，当第一个神经元被激发时，神经电流往往会沿着相同的通路传导，并以相同的动作结束。

Query_Text_en: It should be emphasized that the nervous current , once started , always tends to seek outlet in movement .
Translation: 需要强调的是，一旦神经冲动产生，便总是倾向于通过运动来释放。

Query_Text_en: Movement may be started by the stimulation of a sense organ or by an idea .
Translation: 运动的产生可以由感觉器官的刺激或某种观念引发。

Query_Text_en: Howsoever it starts you may be sure that it seeks a way out , and prefers pathways already traversed .
Translation: 无论它如何开始，你可以确信它总在寻找出路，并倾向于选择已经走过的道路。

Query_Text_en: Hence you see you are bound to have habits . They will develop whether you wish them or not . Already you are . bundle of habits ; they manifest themselves in two ways as habits of action and habits of thought . You illustrate the first every time you tie your shoes or sign your name . To illustrate the second , I need only ask you to supply the end of this sentence : Columbus discovered America in . Speech reveals many of these habits of thought . Certain phrases persist in the mind as habits so that when the phrase is once begun , you proceed habitually with the rest of it . When someone starts in spite , your mind goes on to think of ; more or calls up less . When I ask you what word is called up by black , you reply white according to the principles of mental habit .
Translation: 因此，你会发现你必然会形成习惯。无论你是否愿意，习惯都会养成。实际上，你已经是一个由各种习惯组成的“集合体”；这些习惯以两种方式表现出来：行动习惯和思维习惯。每当你系鞋带或签署名字时，就是在体现前者。至于后者，只需让我请你补全这个句子即可：“哥伦布于——年发现了美洲。”言语中也常常显现出许多思维习惯。某些短语会以习惯的形式留存在头脑中，一旦开头说出，你便会习惯性地把剩下的部分说出来。当有人说“尽管如此”，你的思维便会自然而然地联想到“还是”或“仍然”。当我问你“黑色”会让你想到什么词时，你会根据思维习惯回答“白色”。

Query_Text_en: Your mind is arranged in such habitual patterns , and from these examples you readily see that a large part of what you do and think during the course of twenty-four hours is habitual . Twenty years hence you will be even more bound by this overpowering despot .
Translation: 你的思维已经形成了习惯性的模式，从这些例子中你可以清楚地看到，在一天二十四小时内，你所做的事情和思考的大部分都是习惯性的。二十年后，你将更加受制于这个强大的“专制者”。

Query_Text_en: Since you can not avoid forming habits , how important it is that you seek to form those that are useful and desirable .
Translation: 既然无法避免养成习惯，那么积极培养那些有益且令人向往的习惯就显得尤为重要。

Query_Text_en: In acquiring them , there are several general principles deducible from the facts of nervous action .
Translation: 在获得这些能力的过程中，可以从神经活动的事实中归纳出若干一般性原则。

Query_Text_en: The first is : Guard the pathways leading to the brain .
Translation: 首先，要守护通往大脑的通道。

Query_Text_en: Nerve tissue is impressible and everything that touches it leaves an ineradicable trace . You can control your habits to some extent , then , by observing caution in permitting things to impress you . Many unfortunate habits of study arise from neglect of this .
